Large-scale evaluation of 24 models reveals motion-level corruptions are most threatening, fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are highly vulnerable, providing a crucial benchmark for safety assessment.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地建立了3D检测鲁棒性基准，对自动驾驶安全研究具有重要指导意义。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建了首个全面的3D检测鲁棒性基准，并揭示了不同模型对损坏的脆弱性。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 设计了覆盖真实场景的27种损坏类型，并进行了大规模模型评估。
2303.11040|v2.result: 发现运动级损坏影响最大，融合模型更鲁棒，为后续研究提供了数据支持。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 针对LSS-based多视角3D检测中卷积忽略BEV特征径向对称性、增加优化难度的问题，提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）和方位角等变锚框。AeConv的采样网格始终沿径向方向，学习方位角不变的BEV特征；锚框使检测头预测方位角无关的目标。同时引入相机解耦虚拟深度统一不同相机内参的深度预测。在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2和BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that convolution ignores the radial symmetry of BEV features in LSS-based detectors, this paper proposes azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) and anchors, which learn azimuth-invariant features and predict azimuth-irrelevant targets. A camera-decoupled virtual depth is also introduced. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 该论文从几何对称性角度创新设计卷积和锚框，显著提升BEV检测性能，具有高影响力。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积和锚框，以及相机解耦虚拟深度，实现高性能BEV检测。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计等变卷积，简化检测优化。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得62.0% NDS，大幅超越现有方法。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 针对多帧点云检测中Detect-and-Fuse框架的冗余计算问题，提出运动引导的序列融合方法（MSF）。该方法利用物体运动的连续性，在当前帧生成3D proposals并基于估计速度传播到前序帧，然后池化感兴趣点并编码为proposal特征，通过双向特征聚合模块促进跨帧交互。同时优化点云池化技术，使数百万点能在几毫秒内处理。在效率和精度上均取得提升。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: To address redundant computation in multi-frame point cloud detection, this paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which propagates 3D proposals to preceding frames based on velocities, pools points-of-interest, and uses a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation module for cross-frame interaction. Optimized voxel-based sampling enables processing millions of points in milliseconds, improving both efficiency and accuracy.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多帧检测的效率瓶颈提出运动引导融合，兼顾精度和速度，实用性强。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导的序列融合方法，通过proposal传播和双向特征聚合提升多帧检测效率。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用运动连续性减少冗余计算，并优化点云池化加速处理。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在效率和精度上均优于现有方法，支持实时处理。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 针对NeRF场景中直接进行物体检测的问题，提出NeRF-RPN框架，直接在预训练的NeRF上操作，无需渲染即可回归3D边界框。通过利用多尺度3D神经体素特征，NeRF-RPN能端到端训练，且无需类别标签。实验验证了不同骨干网络、RPN头和损失函数的有效性，并构建了包含合成和真实数据的基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: To enable object detection directly in NeRF scenes, this paper proposes NeRF-RPN, which operates on pre-trained NeRF models and regresses 3D bounding boxes without rendering. By exploiting multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features, it can be trained end-to-end without class labels. Experiments validate various backbones and heads, and a new benchmark dataset is introduced.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 该论文开辟了NeRF中物体检测的新方向，但相关性较低，适合特定场景研究。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的物体检测框架，并构建基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用多尺度体素特征实现无需渲染的3D检测。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了框架的有效性。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中无监督域适应（UDA）对点云密度差异敏感的问题。提出了一种密度不敏感的UDA方法，通过设计密度感知的特征对齐和样本重加权策略，减少源域（如KITTI）与目标域（如Waymo）之间点云密度分布差异带来的负面影响。相比现有UDA方法，该方法在密度变化剧烈的场景下更鲁棒。实验表明在多个跨域基准上显著提升了目标域检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses the density sensitivity issue in unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) for 3D object detection. It proposes a density-insensitive UDA method with density-aware feature alignment and sample reweighting to mitigate the negative impact of point cloud density distribution gaps between source and target domains. Compared to existing UDA methods, it is more robust under severe density variations, achieving significant accuracy improvements on multiple cross-domain benchmarks.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该论文针对UDA中一个实际但常被忽视的问题，方法设计合理，对跨域3D检测研究有参考价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的UDA框架，提升3D检测器在密度差异大的目标域上的泛化能力。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 引入密度感知的对齐与重加权机制，缓解点云密度分布偏移。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个跨域基准上显著提升目标域检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D目标检测中相机深度信息利用不足和跨模态融合粒度不够的问题。提出了MSMDFusion框架，包含多深度反投影（MDU）方法，利用深度感知设计将2D语义特征提升到3D空间，并在体素空间进行多尺度细粒度跨模态交互。相比现有基于种子提升和简单拼接/注意力融合的方法，该方法更有效地融合LiDAR和相机信息。在nuScenes和Waymo等基准上取得了领先的检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth utilization and coarse cross-modal fusion in multi-modal 3D object detection. It proposes MSMDFusion with a Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) method that lifts 2D semantic features into 3D using depth-aware designs, and performs multi-scale fine-grained cross-modal interaction in voxel space. Compared to seed-lifting and simple concatenation/attention fusion, it more effectively integrates LiDAR and camera data, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes and Waymo benchmarks.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该论文方法创新性强，融合策略精细，实验结果充分，对多模态3D检测有重要贡献。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出多深度反投影和多尺度融合框架，显著提升LiDAR-相机融合的3D检测精度。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 深度感知的种子提升和体素空间细粒度交互机制。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机3D目标检测中跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段知识迁移不足的问题。提出了X3KD框架，通过知识蒸馏在模态（LiDAR到相机）、任务（检测到分割等）和训练阶段之间传递信息，以增强纯相机模型的性能。相比仅使用单一蒸馏策略的方法，该方法综合利用多种知识源，显著提升了多相机3D检测的精度。在nuScenes等数据集上验证了有效性。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient knowledge transfer across modalities, tasks, and stages in multi-camera 3D object detection. It proposes X3KD, a framework that distills knowledge from LiDAR to camera, across tasks, and between training stages to boost camera-only models. Compared to single-strategy distillation, it leverages multiple knowledge sources, significantly improving multi-camera 3D detection accuracy, as validated on nuScenes.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该论文系统性地探索了多维度知识蒸馏，对多相机感知和模型压缩研究有较高价值。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、任务和阶段的统一知识蒸馏框架，增强多相机3D检测。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 多维度蒸馏策略的协同设计。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升纯相机模型的检测性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中局部与全局跨模态融合不充分的问题。提出了LoGoNet，通过局部融合模块捕捉精细几何特征，全局融合模块建模长距离依赖，实现LiDAR和相机信息的互补。相比仅局部或仅全局融合的方法，该方法在复杂场景下更鲁棒。在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了先进的检测结果。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient local and global cross-modal fusion in 3D object detection. It proposes LoGoNet with local fusion for fine-grained geometry and global fusion for long-range dependencies, complementing LiDAR and camera data. Compared to local-only or global-only fusion, it is more robust in complex scenes, achieving state-of-the-art results on KITTI and nuScenes.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该论文融合策略全面，实验扎实，对多模态3D检测有实际贡献。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出局部到全局的跨模态融合网络，提升3D检测精度。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 局部与全局融合模块的有机结合。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 该论文重新思考了LiDAR点云3D目标检测中的网络设计，质疑了复杂局部点聚合器的必要性。提出了PillarNeXt，基于柱状表示并借鉴2D检测的成功经验（如扩大感受野），在保持低延迟的同时显著提升精度。相比现有基于点聚合的模型，该方法更简单高效。在Waymo和nuScenes上取得了最先进的性能，挑战了精细几何建模必须的直觉。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper rethinks network designs for LiDAR-based 3D object detection, questioning the necessity of complex local point aggregators. It proposes PillarNeXt, a pillar-based network with modernized designs such as enlarged receptive fields, achieving high accuracy with low latency. Compared to point-aggregation models, it is simpler and more efficient, achieving state-of-the-art performance on Waymo and nuScenes, challenging the intuition that detailed geometry modeling is essential.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该论文观点新颖，实验充分，对3D检测网络设计有重要启示。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 提出简化高效的柱状网络PillarNeXt，刷新多个基准。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 从计算资源分配角度重新设计网络，借鉴2D检测经验。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得最先进性能。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云序列中遮挡和远距离目标检测困难的问题。提出了MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，将时序上下文中的目标信息传播到当前帧，生成虚拟点增强LiDAR点云。相比仅使用原始点云或简单时序聚合的方法，该方法能有效利用超长序列（如18秒）信息，显著提升检测性能。在Waymo Open Dataset上取得了新的最先进结果，且计算开销小。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range object detection in point cloud sequences. It proposes MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to propagate object information from temporal contexts to the target frame, generating virtual points to augment LiDAR data. Compared to raw point clouds or simple temporal aggregation, it effectively leverages extra-long sequences (e.g., 18s), significantly improving detection, achieving new state-of-the-art on Waymo Open Dataset with low computation overhead.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合运动预测与检测，对时序3D检测有重要价值。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出MoDAR虚拟模态，利用运动预测增强点云序列检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测输出转化为虚拟点，实现高效时序信息利用。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo上取得最先进性能，计算开销小。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督与梯度优化不一致的问题，即标准IoU损失在梯度传播时可能产生次优更新，影响检测精度。②提出了一种梯度校正的IoU监督方法，通过分析损失函数的梯度方向，设计校正项以引导优化过程更有效地提升IoU。③相比传统IoU损失，该方法在训练中动态调整梯度，增强了对难例的优化能力，无需额外标注或网络结构改动。④实验表明，该方法在多个3D检测基准上显著提升了平均精度（如AP值提升约2-3%），验证了其有效性和通用性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between IoU supervision and gradient optimization in 3D object detection, where standard IoU losses can yield suboptimal updates. It proposes a gradient-corrected IoU supervision method that adjusts gradients during training to better optimize IoU, improving detection accuracy without extra annotations. Experiments show significant AP gains (e.g., 2-3%) on multiple 3D detection benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalizability.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该论文聚焦于损失函数优化这一基础但关键的问题，方法简洁且具有实用价值，对提升3D检测性能有直接帮助。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督机制，优化3D检测中的训练过程。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 通过分析梯度方向动态校正IoU损失，提升优化效率。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 在多个基准上AP提升约2-3%，验证了方法的有效性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D目标检测依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致且数据成本高的问题。②提出了一种仅需2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法，利用投影一致性、多视图一致性和方向一致性三种约束，并设计了新的2D方向标注方式以提升旋转预测精度。③相比现有弱监督方法，该方法无需3D标注即可训练，且通过多视图投影和方向一致性增强了几何约束，降低了标注成本。④实验表明，该方法在KITTI等数据集上取得了与部分全监督方法相当的性能，且作为预训练方法时显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on LiDAR point clouds for labeling in monocular 3D object detection, which causes training-inference inconsistency and high data costs. It proposes a weakly supervised method using only 2D labels, leveraging projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, along with a novel 2D direction labeling scheme. Experiments show comparable performance to some fully supervised methods on KITTI, and as a pretraining approach, it significantly outperforms the fully supervised baseline.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该论文有效解决了单目3D检测的数据标注瓶颈，弱监督设计具有实际应用价值，且实验验证充分。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测框架，降低标注成本。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 利用多视图投影和方向一致性约束，实现无3D标注训练。
2303.08686|v2.result: 性能与部分全监督方法相当，预训练时显著超越基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）因遮挡和截断导致定位精度差的问题。②提出SeaBird方法，在鸟瞰图（BEV）分割任务中使用Dice损失，并设计专门的网络结构来增强BEV特征。③相比传统基于中心点或回归框的方法，Dice损失直接优化BEV分割的IoU，更适应大型物体的形状和稀疏性。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，对大型物体的3D检测精度显著提升，尤其在中远距离场景下，AP指标提升明显。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor monocular 3D detection accuracy for large objects like trucks and buses caused by occlusion and truncation. It proposes SeaBird, which applies Dice loss to bird's eye view (BEV) segmentation and designs a tailored network to enhance BEV features. Compared to center-point or regression-based methods, Dice loss directly optimizes BEV segmentation IoU, better handling the shape and sparsity of large objects. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show significant AP improvements for large objects, especially at medium-to-long ranges.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该论文针对单目3D检测中的长尾难题，通过BEV分割与Dice损失的结合提供了新思路，实验充分，对自动驾驶中大型车辆检测有实用价值。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出利用Dice损失优化BEV分割，显著提升单目3D检测中大型物体的性能。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将BEV分割的Dice损失引入单目3D检测，替代传统回归损失，增强对大型物体的空间建模。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上大型物体检测AP显著提升，尤其在中远距离场景。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: ①针对时序3D目标检测中计算开销大和长程依赖建模不足的问题。②提出PTT（Point-Trajectory Transformer），利用点轨迹（point trajectories）作为时序聚合的载体，通过Transformer高效融合多帧点云信息。③相比基于体素或BEV的时序方法，PTT直接操作原始点云轨迹，减少信息丢失，并利用轨迹的稀疏性降低计算量。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，以较低的计算成本实现了与最先进方法相当的检测精度，尤其在运动物体上表现优异。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost and insufficient long-range dependency modeling in temporal 3D object detection. It proposes PTT, which uses point trajectories as the carrier for temporal aggregation and employs a Transformer to efficiently fuse multi-frame point clouds. Compared to voxel- or BEV-based temporal methods, PTT operates directly on raw point trajectories, reducing information loss and leveraging sparsity for efficiency. On nuScenes and Waymo, it achieves accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art methods with lower computation, especially for moving objects.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该论文创新性地将点轨迹与Transformer结合，为时序3D检测提供了高效且准确的方案，对自动驾驶实时感知有重要参考价值。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出基于点轨迹的Transformer架构，实现高效且准确的时序3D目标检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 利用点轨迹作为时序聚合单元，结合Transformer的全局建模能力，兼顾效率与精度。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上以较低计算成本达到SOTA精度，运动物体检测尤其突出。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐不充分和引导信息利用不足的问题。②提出GAFusion，通过多种引导（如深度、语义、边界框）自适应融合LiDAR和相机特征，并设计注意力机制动态调整融合权重。③相比简单拼接或固定权重融合，GAFusion利用多级引导增强跨模态交互，提升对遮挡和远距离目标的鲁棒性。④在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，3D检测精度显著优于现有融合方法，尤其在困难难度和远距离目标上。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient modality alignment and underutilization of guidance in LiDAR-camera fusion. It proposes GAFusion, which adaptively fuses LiDAR and camera features using multiple guidance cues (e.g., depth, semantics, boxes) and an attention mechanism to adjust fusion weights dynamically. Compared to simple concatenation or fixed-weight fusion, GAFusion enhances cross-modal interaction, improving robustness to occlusion and distant objects. On KITTI and nuScenes, it significantly outperforms existing fusion methods, especially on hard cases and long-range targets.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该论文通过多引导自适应融合机制，有效提升了多模态3D检测性能，方法设计合理，实验验证充分，对自动驾驶感知融合有较强启发。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架，显著提升LiDAR-相机3D检测精度。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 利用深度、语义和边界框等多级引导，通过注意力机制动态融合跨模态特征。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上检测精度显著提升，困难场景和远距离目标表现突出。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: ①针对当前3D检测中稀疏BEV框架（如query-based）在密集场景下性能受限的问题。②提出BEVNeXt，重新设计密集BEV框架，通过增强特征提取、优化多尺度融合和引入时序建模，恢复密集BEV的表示能力。③相比稀疏方法，密集BEV能保留更完整的空间信息，且通过改进的架构设计克服了计算效率瓶颈。④在nuScenes和Waymo上，BEVNeXt以更高的效率实现了优于现有密集和稀疏方法的检测精度，mAP和NDS指标均显著提升。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitations of sparse BEV frameworks (e.g., query-based) in dense scenes for 3D detection. It proposes BEVNeXt, which revives dense BEV frameworks by enhancing feature extraction, optimizing multi-scale fusion, and incorporating temporal modeling. Compared to sparse methods, dense BEV retains more complete spatial information, and the improved architecture overcomes computational bottlenecks. On nuScenes and Waymo, BEVNeXt achieves higher detection accuracy (mAP and NDS) than both dense and sparse methods with better efficiency.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该论文重新审视并强化了密集BEV框架，在精度和效率上均取得突破，对BEV感知方向具有重要指导意义，值得重点关注。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出改进的密集BEV框架BEVNeXt，在3D检测中实现精度与效率的双重提升。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 通过架构优化和时序建模，克服密集BEV的计算瓶颈，恢复其表示优势。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上mAP和NDS显著提升，且效率优于现有方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中不同场景（如室内外）和物体类别（如车辆、行人）的域差异问题。②提出UniMODE，通过统一的框架联合建模单目3D检测，利用多任务学习和自适应特征对齐处理域偏移。③相比针对特定场景的专用模型，UniMODE在单一模型中同时处理多种场景，减少部署成本并提升泛化能力。④在KITTI、nuScenes和SUN RGB-D等数据集上，UniMODE在跨域场景下取得了优于专用模型的检测精度，尤其在迁移学习设置中。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap across different scenes (indoor/outdoor) and object categories (vehicles/pedestrians) in monocular 3D detection. It proposes UniMODE, a unified framework that jointly models monocular 3D detection using multi-task learning and adaptive feature alignment to handle domain shifts. Compared to scene-specific models, UniMODE handles multiple scenes in a single model, reducing deployment cost and improving generalization. On KITTI, nuScenes, and SUN RGB-D, UniMODE achieves better detection accuracy than specialized models in cross-domain settings, especially in transfer learning.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该论文提出统一的单目3D检测框架，有效解决跨域泛化问题，对多场景自动驾驶应用具有实际意义，实验设计较全面。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出统一单目3D检测框架UniMODE，实现跨场景和跨类别的泛化检测。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 通过多任务学习和自适应特征对齐，在单一模型中处理多种域差异。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在多个数据集上跨域检测精度优于专用模型，迁移学习表现突出。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: ①针对雷达与相机融合在BEV空间中特征对齐和噪声处理不足的问题。②提出RCBEVDet，在BEV视角下融合雷达和相机特征，设计专门的雷达特征编码和跨模态注意力机制。③相比早期融合或后期融合方法，RCBEVDet在BEV空间进行深度融合，充分利用雷达的测距精度和相机的语义信息，并有效抑制雷达噪声。④在nuScenes数据集上，RCBEVDet在3D检测任务中取得了优于现有雷达-相机融合方法的精度，尤其在恶劣天气和夜间场景下。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature alignment and noise handling in radar-camera fusion within BEV space. It proposes RCBEVDet, which fuses radar and camera features in BEV with specialized radar feature encoding and cross-modal attention. Compared to early or late fusion methods, RCBEVDet performs deep fusion in BEV, leveraging radar's ranging accuracy and camera's semantic information while suppressing radar noise. On nuScenes, RCBEVDet achieves higher 3D detection accuracy than existing radar-camera fusion methods, especially in adverse weather and nighttime scenes.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该论文聚焦雷达-相机BEV融合，针对实际自动驾驶中的恶劣环境有显著提升，方法实用性强，实验验证充分。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出BEV空间下的雷达-相机深度融合框架，提升3D检测在恶劣条件下的鲁棒性。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 设计雷达专用编码和跨模态注意力，在BEV中有效融合并抑制噪声。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上检测精度优于现有融合方法，恶劣天气和夜间表现突出。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D物体检测中依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出利用实例感知的体积轮廓渲染方法。②方法通过将2D实例分割与体积渲染结合，生成3D伪标签，无需3D框标注。③相比现有弱监督方法，引入实例级体积表示，提升了对遮挡和形状变化的鲁棒性。④在KITTI等数据集上，该方法显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距，尤其在车辆类别上AP提升明显。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly supervised 3D object detection by proposing instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering to generate 3D pseudo-labels from 2D instance segmentation. It improves robustness to occlusion and shape variation compared to prior work, achieving notable AP gains on KITTI and narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该论文为弱监督3D检测提供了新思路，体积渲染的引入具有理论新颖性，实验充分，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体积轮廓渲染框架，实现无需3D标注的弱监督3D检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将体积渲染与实例级2D分割结合，生成高质量的3D伪标签。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI上显著提升弱监督检测精度，接近全监督性能。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D物体检测中跨视角信息融合不充分的问题，提出多视角注意力上下文建模方法。②方法通过注意力机制动态聚合各相机视角的上下文特征，增强全局一致性。③相比传统BEV方法，该方法更有效地利用视角间相关性，减少信息丢失。④在nuScenes数据集上，mAP和NDS指标均取得显著提升，尤其在远距离和小物体上表现优异。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This work tackles insufficient cross-view fusion in multi-view 3D detection by introducing multi-view attentive contextualization, which dynamically aggregates contextual features across cameras. It outperforms BEV-based baselines on nuScenes with higher mAP and NDS, especially for distant and small objects.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 方法设计简洁有效，实验验证充分，对多相机感知系统有直接应用价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文模块，提升跨相机特征融合效率。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 利用注意力机制动态建模视角间上下文依赖。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D物体检测中深度估计不准确导致定位差的问题，提出学习占用表示来辅助检测。②方法将3D空间划分为占用网格，通过预测占用概率和特征，为检测提供几何先验。③相比直接回归3D框，占用学习提供了更丰富的场景结构信息，增强了对遮挡和截断的鲁棒性。④在KITTI和nuScenes上，该方法显著提升了3D定位精度和检测AP，尤其在远距离物体上。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses depth ambiguity in monocular 3D detection by learning occupancy representations as geometric priors. It predicts occupancy grids to enrich scene structure, improving localization robustness against occlusion and truncation, with significant AP gains on KITTI and nuScenes.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用学习引入单目检测，思路新颖且实用，实验结果有说服力。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出占用表示辅助单目3D检测，增强几何理解。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 将3D占用预测与检测头联合优化。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上定位精度和AP显著提升。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D物体检测和姿态估计中不确定性建模不足的问题，提出基于扩散模型的方法。②方法利用扩散模型生成3D框和姿态的候选分布，通过迭代去噪提高预测精度。③相比确定性回归，扩散模型能更好地捕捉多模态不确定性，提升复杂场景下的鲁棒性。④在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，该方法在3D AP和姿态估计误差上均有改善，但计算成本较高。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses uncertainty in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by leveraging diffusion models to generate candidate distributions. Iterative denoising improves accuracy over deterministic regression, with gains on KITTI and Waymo, though at higher computational cost.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 扩散模型应用有创新性，但效率问题限制了实际部署，适合学术探索。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 首次将扩散模型用于单目3D检测与姿态估计。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 利用生成式建模处理检测不确定性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上AP和姿态误差改善。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: ①针对路侧视角3D物体检测中BEV表示构建效率低的问题，提出BEVSpread的体素池化方法。②方法通过扩展体素池化范围，更有效地将2D特征投影到BEV空间，减少信息损失。③相比传统体素池化，该方法在保持实时性的同时提升了特征质量，尤其适应路侧大场景。④在DAIR-V2X和Rope3D数据集上，该方法显著提升了3D检测精度，且推理速度满足实时要求。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient BEV construction for roadside 3D detection by proposing BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method that enhances feature projection quality. It achieves higher detection accuracy on DAIR-V2X and Rope3D while maintaining real-time speed, outperforming standard pooling.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 针对路侧场景的BEV优化具有实际价值，方法高效且实验充分。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出扩展体素池化策略，提升路侧BEV表示质量。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 通过空间扩展池化减少投影信息损失。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在DAIR-V2X和Rope3D上精度提升且实时。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: ①针对户外无监督3D物体检测中缺乏类别语义知识的问题，提出利用常识原型引导检测。②方法通过预训练模型提取常识原型，作为类别先验，辅助无监督检测器识别物体。③相比纯聚类方法，常识原型提供了语义约束，减少误检并提升类别区分度。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，该方法显著提升了无监督检测的召回率和精度，尤其在稀疏场景中。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of semantic knowledge in outdoor unsupervised 3D detection by introducing commonsense prototypes as category priors. These prototypes guide the detector, reducing false positives and improving recall and precision on nuScenes and Waymo, especially in sparse scenes.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 将常识知识融入无监督检测，创新性强，实验结果支持有效性。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出常识原型引导的无监督3D检测框架。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用预训练模型的语义原型作为检测先验。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上召回率和精度提升。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏监督（如仅中心点标注）下3D目标检测性能不佳的问题。②提出HINTED检测器，通过混合密度特征融合（MDFF）模块结合密集与稀疏特征，并设计硬实例增强策略（HIE）聚焦难样本。③相比现有稀疏监督方法，MDFF能更有效利用多尺度密度信息，HIE通过重加权损失提升对遮挡和远距离目标的检测。④在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，使用1%标注时显著优于基线，例如KITTI上AP提升约8%。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of 3D object detection under sparse supervision (e.g., center-point only). It proposes HINTED, which integrates mixed-density feature fusion (MDFF) and hard instance enhancement (HIE) to exploit multi-scale density information and focus on difficult samples. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo show notable AP improvements over baselines with only 1% labels.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 该论文针对稀疏监督这一实际痛点，方法设计合理且实验充分，对降低3D检测标注成本有重要价值。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与硬实例增强的稀疏监督3D检测框架。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 首次将密度感知特征融合与难例挖掘结合用于稀疏监督3D检测。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上以1%标注取得显著性能提升。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测中几何特征表示不足的问题。②提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散模型特征（如点云局部几何编码）增强检测器，通过扩散过程生成判别性特征。③相比传统手工特征或纯学习特征，扩散特征能更好捕捉局部形状细节，提升对稀疏点云的鲁棒性。④在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上，mAP分别提升约3.5%和2.8%。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This work tackles the insufficiency of geometric feature representation in 3D detection. It introduces 3DiffTection, which leverages geometry-aware diffusion features to enhance detectors via a diffusion-based feature generation process. Experiments on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D show mAP improvements of ~3.5% and ~2.8%.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型引入3D检测特征学习，思路新颖，实验验证有效，值得关注。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出基于几何感知扩散特征的3D检测增强方法。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 首次将扩散模型用于生成3D几何判别特征。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在室内数据集上取得稳定性能提升。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确的问题。②提出MonoCD，通过互补深度模块（互补深度分支和融合策略）结合多个深度估计来源，提升深度精度。③相比现有单目方法，互补深度能利用不同深度线索的互补性，减少深度误差。④在KITTI上，Car AP 3D达到16.5%，较基线提升约2%。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection. It proposes MonoCD with complementary depth modules that fuse multiple depth sources to improve accuracy. On KITTI, it achieves 16.5% Car AP 3D, improving by ~2% over baseline.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 方法实用，但创新性一般，适合作为单目检测的改进参考。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度融合策略提升单目3D检测精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 利用多源深度互补性增强深度估计。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI上取得一定性能提升。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: ①针对远距离3D目标检测中LiDAR点云稀疏导致性能下降的问题。②提出利用2D框监督（如图像检测框）辅助训练3D检测器，通过跨模态知识迁移增强远距离特征学习。③相比仅用3D标注，2D框监督提供额外语义信息，提升远距离目标的召回率。④在nuScenes上，远距离（>50m）目标AP提升约5%。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of distant 3D object detection due to sparse LiDAR points. It proposes using 2D box supervision to assist 3D detector training via cross-modal knowledge transfer. On nuScenes, AP for distant objects (>50m) improves by ~5%.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 针对自动驾驶远距离检测这一关键问题，方法简单有效，实用性强。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督提升远距离3D检测性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 跨模态监督信号增强稀疏点云特征。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在nuScenes远距离目标上显著提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: ①针对多模态3D检测中实例级与场景级特征融合不足的问题。②提出IS-Fusion，通过实例-场景协同融合模块，在实例级别和场景级别同时融合图像与点云特征，并设计跨模态注意力机制。③相比现有融合方法，IS-Fusion能更精细地利用实例语义和场景上下文，提升检测精度。④在KITTI和nuScenes上，mAP分别提升约2.5%和3.0%。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient instance-scene feature fusion in multimodal 3D detection. It proposes IS-Fusion with collaborative fusion modules at both instance and scene levels, using cross-modal attention. On KITTI and nuScenes, mAP improves by ~2.5% and ~3.0%.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 融合策略设计精细，实验充分，对多模态检测有较强参考价值。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的多模态3D检测框架。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 双层级融合与跨模态注意力结合。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在主流数据集上取得显著提升。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: ①针对跨数据集3D检测无监督域适应中伪标签噪声大的问题。②提出Pseudo Label Refinery，通过置信度校准和一致性过滤机制精炼伪标签，减少噪声影响。③相比直接使用伪标签训练，该方法能更稳定地适应目标域。④在nuScenes→KITTI和Waymo→KITTI上，mAP提升约4%和6%。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy pseudo labels in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D detection. It proposes Pseudo Label Refinery with confidence calibration and consistency filtering. On nuScenes→KITTI and Waymo→KITTI, mAP improves by ~4% and ~6%.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 针对域适应中的伪标签问题，方法有效但创新性中等，适合实际应用。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼机制提升跨数据集3D检测域适应性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 结合置信度校准与一致性过滤。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在多个跨数据集场景下显著提升。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: ①针对全稀疏3D目标检测中计算效率与精度平衡的问题，现有方法依赖密集特征或复杂后处理。②提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏网络，通过稀疏卷积和稀疏注意力机制直接处理原始点云，避免密集化操作。③相比已有全稀疏方法，简化了网络结构，减少了计算开销，同时保持了检测精度。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，SAFDNet在保持实时性能的同时，取得了与主流方法相当的mAP，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the challenge of balancing computational efficiency and accuracy in fully sparse 3D object detection, where existing methods rely on dense features or complex post-processing. ②It proposes SAFDNet, a simple yet effective fully sparse network that processes raw point clouds directly via sparse convolutions and sparse attention, avoiding densification. ③Compared to prior fully sparse methods, it simplifies the architecture and reduces computational cost while maintaining detection accuracy. ④On KITTI and nuScenes, SAFDNet achieves competitive mAP with real-time performance, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该论文为全稀疏3D检测提供了简洁高效的基线，对自动驾驶实时感知有实际价值，值得关注其结构设计与性能权衡。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出一种简单有效的全稀疏3D检测网络，平衡了精度与效率。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 通过稀疏注意力机制简化全稀疏检测流程，避免密集化。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在主流数据集上实现实时性能与竞争性精度。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: ①针对3D目标检测模型部署中模型过大、计算资源受限的问题，现有压缩方法未充分利用类别信息。②提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知知识蒸馏与剪枝，在蒸馏过程中根据类别重要性动态调整蒸馏权重，并联合剪枝以压缩模型。③相比传统均匀蒸馏和独立剪枝，该方法通过类别感知策略提升了轻量化模型的精度保持能力。④在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，CaKDP在显著降低模型参数和计算量的同时，保持了接近教师模型的检测精度，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: ①This paper tackles the deployment challenge of large 3D object detection models under limited computational resources, where existing compression methods ignore category-specific information. ②It proposes CaKDP, a framework that integrates category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning, dynamically adjusting distillation weights based on category importance and jointly pruning the model. ③Compared to uniform distillation and independent pruning, the category-aware strategy better preserves accuracy in lightweight models. ④On KITTI and Waymo, CaKDP substantially reduces parameters and computation while maintaining accuracy close to the teacher, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别信息引入蒸馏与剪枝，为3D检测模型压缩提供了新思路，对自动驾驶边缘部署有重要意义。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出类别感知的蒸馏与剪枝联合框架，实现高效3D检测模型压缩。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 在蒸馏和剪枝中动态利用类别重要性，提升压缩后模型精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在多个数据集上实现高压缩比且保持检测精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D目标检测中标注成本高、半监督学习伪标签噪声大的问题。②提出解耦伪标签方法，将伪标签生成分解为2D检测和深度估计两个独立任务，分别生成更可靠的伪标签，并设计一致性正则化训练。③相比传统端到端伪标签生成，解耦策略减少了任务间干扰，提高了伪标签质量。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，该方法在半监督设置下显著提升了检测精度，尤其在低标注比例时，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the high annotation cost and noisy pseudo-labels in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection. ②It proposes a decoupled pseudo-labeling method that separates pseudo-label generation into 2D detection and depth estimation, producing more reliable labels and using consistency regularization. ③Compared to end-to-end pseudo-labeling, the decoupling reduces task interference and improves label quality. ④On KITTI and nuScenes, the method significantly boosts detection accuracy under semi-supervised settings, especially with low annotation ratios, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 该论文通过解耦伪标签生成，有效缓解了半监督单目3D检测的噪声问题，对降低标注成本具有实用价值。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出解耦伪标签框架，提升半监督单目3D检测性能。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将伪标签生成解耦为2D与深度任务，增强标签可靠性。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在多个数据集上显著提升半监督检测精度。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D目标检测中依赖精确3D标注或复杂先验的问题。②提出Prompt3D方法，利用随机提示（如类别标签或文本描述）辅助弱监督训练，通过提示引导网络关注目标区域，减少对精确标注的依赖。③相比传统弱监督方法，该方法引入提示机制，增强了模型对类别语义的利用，提高了检测鲁棒性。④在SUN-RGBD和ScanNet数据集上，Prompt3D在弱监督设置下取得了优于现有方法的检测精度，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the reliance on precise 3D annotations or complex priors in weakly-supervised 3D object detection. ②It proposes Prompt3D, which uses random prompts (e.g., category labels or text descriptions) to assist training, guiding the network to focus on target regions and reducing annotation dependence. ③Compared to traditional weakly-supervised methods, the prompt mechanism enhances semantic utilization and robustness. ④On SUN-RGBD and ScanNet, Prompt3D achieves superior detection accuracy under weak supervision, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 该论文探索了提示机制在弱监督3D检测中的应用，创新性尚可，但实验充分性和实际效果需进一步验证。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.contribution: 提出随机提示辅助的弱监督3D检测框架。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.innovation: 将提示学习引入弱监督3D检测，减少标注依赖。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.result: 在多个数据集上取得优于现有弱监督方法的精度。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-._arxiv_id: Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合在3D检测中因图像到BEV变换深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题。②提出RaCFormer，采用基于查询的框架，从BEV和原始图像视图自适应采样实例相关特征，并优化查询初始化（极坐标自适应圆形分布）和增强BEV表示（雷达引导深度头、隐式动态捕捉器利用多普勒效应）。③相比朴素BEV融合，避免了未对齐视觉内容的整合，提升了融合质量。④在nuScenes上的大量实验表明，该方法显著提升了3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment issue in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate depth estimation in image-to-BEV transformation. It proposes RaCFormer, a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views, with optimized query initialization via adaptive circular distribution and enhanced BEV representation using a radar-guided depth head and an implicit dynamic catcher. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate significant accuracy improvements over naive fusion baselines.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该论文针对雷达-相机融合中的关键痛点提出创新性解决方案，查询机制和雷达引导深度估计设计合理，实验充分，对多传感器3D检测研究有重要参考价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出基于查询的雷达-相机融合框架RaCFormer，有效解决BEV变换中的特征错位问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 引入极坐标自适应查询初始化和雷达引导深度头，并利用多普勒效应捕捉时序信息。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上显著提升3D检测精度。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_cn: ①针对车联网（V2X）场景下LiDAR与4D雷达融合的3D检测问题，现有方法未充分利用4D雷达的独特特性。②提出V2X-R方法，采用去噪扩散模型进行协同融合，处理多传感器数据的不确定性。③相比传统融合方法，扩散模型能更好地建模传感器噪声和缺失，提升鲁棒性。④在相关数据集上验证了方法的有效性，检测性能优于现有基线。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_en: This work tackles cooperative LiDAR-4D radar fusion for 3D detection in V2X scenarios, leveraging denoising diffusion models to handle sensor uncertainty. It improves robustness over traditional fusion by modeling noise and missing data, achieving superior detection performance on benchmarks.
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.assessment: 将扩散模型引入V2X多传感器融合，思路新颖，对协同感知和鲁棒检测有贡献。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.contribution: 提出基于去噪扩散的LiDAR-4D雷达协同融合方法。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.innovation: 利用扩散模型建模传感器噪声和不确定性。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.result: 在V2X数据集上取得优于基线的检测性能。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion._arxiv_id: V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion with Denoising Diffusion for 3D Object Detection.

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: ①针对室内3D检测中现有数据集规模、精度和物体多样性不足的问题。②引入Cubify-Anything 1M（CA-1M）数据集，包含超过40万3D物体标注和1000多个激光扫描场景，并提出了Cubify Transformer（CuTR），直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框。③相比基于点的方法，CuTR无需3D归纳偏置，但结合CA-1M后性能更优，且对噪声和深度不确定性更鲁棒。④CuTR在3D中召回率超过62%，并支持仅RGB输入。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in indoor 3D detection datasets by introducing CA-1M, a large-scale dataset with over 400K annotated objects, and CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline that predicts 3D boxes from 2D features. CuTR outperforms point-based methods, achieving over 62% recall, and handles noisy depth robustly.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集贡献巨大，模型设计简洁有效，对室内3D检测领域有重要推动作用。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模室内3D检测数据集CA-1M并提出纯Transformer基线CuTR。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 直接从2D特征预测3D框，无需3D点云表示。
2412.04458|v2.result: CuTR在CA-1M上召回率超过62%，优于点基方法。

FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测中全稀疏网络在长距离和小物体检测上的效率与精度问题。②提出FSHNet，一种全稀疏混合网络，结合稀疏卷积和Transformer优势。③相比传统密集或半稀疏方法，全稀疏设计降低计算量，同时保持高精度。④在标准数据集上验证了性能提升。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_en: This paper proposes FSHNet, a fully sparse hybrid network for 3D detection, combining sparse convolutions and Transformers to improve efficiency and accuracy. It achieves better performance than dense or semi-sparse baselines on benchmarks.
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.assessment: 全稀疏设计具有实用价值，但创新性一般，实验细节需进一步确认。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.innovation: 融合稀疏卷积和Transformer实现全稀疏处理。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.result: 在3D检测基准上取得性能提升。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for._arxiv_id: FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for 3D Object Detection.

MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中知识蒸馏效果受限的问题。②提出MonoTAKD，引入助教（Teaching Assistant）模型进行蒸馏，缓解师生模型差距。③相比直接蒸馏，助教机制提供更平滑的知识迁移。④在KITTI等数据集上验证了精度提升。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_en: This paper introduces MonoTAKD, a teaching assistant knowledge distillation method for monocular 3D detection, which bridges the gap between teacher and student models. It improves detection accuracy on benchmarks like KITTI.
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.assessment: 助教蒸馏思路在单目3D检测中应用合理，但创新度有限。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.contribution: 提出助教知识蒸馏方法MonoTAKD。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.innovation: 引入助教模型缓解师生差距。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.result: 在KITTI上提升单目3D检测精度。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D._arxiv_id: MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge Distillation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达点云分布复杂导致相机-雷达融合困难的问题。②提出RICCARDO，显式建模雷达命中分布，利用单目检测器预测分布作为核函数匹配实际雷达点，并融合上下文精炼匹配分数。③相比黑盒融合，显式分布模型提升可解释性和精度。④在nuScenes上达到最先进的雷达-相机检测性能。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes RICCARDO, which explicitly models radar hit distributions to improve camera-radar fusion. It predicts distributions from monocular detections, uses them as kernels to match radar points, and refines scores with context, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 显式建模雷达分布是创新亮点，方法实用且性能领先，值得关注。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出基于雷达命中分布预测和卷积的融合方法RICCARDO。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 显式利用雷达分布模型辅助融合。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得最先进的雷达-相机检测性能。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化能力差的问题，现有域泛化方法过度依赖全局几何特征（如笛卡尔坐标），导致模型偏向位置信息而忽视局部结构。本文提出GBlobs，通过高斯斑块显式编码点云邻域局部结构，无需额外参数即可集成到现有检测器中。相比仅用全局特征的方法，GBlobs在单源域泛化基准上大幅提升性能，如Waymo->KITTI提升21 mAP，KITTI->Waymo提升13 mAP，nuScenes->KITTI提升12 mAP，且不牺牲源域性能；在多源域泛化中也超越SOTA 17、12和5 mAP。该方法高效且即插即用，为跨域3D检测提供了新思路。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors, which overly rely on global geometric features. It proposes GBlobs, which encode local point cloud structure via Gaussian blobs, requiring no extra parameters. Integrating GBlobs into existing detectors improves single-source DG by over 21 mAP (Waymo->KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI->Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes->KITTI), and multi-source DG by 17, 12, and 5 mAP, without sacrificing in-domain performance.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地引入局部结构编码，显著提升跨域3D检测性能，且实现简单、通用性强，对自动驾驶领域具有重要参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs，利用高斯斑块编码局部点云结构，显著提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 首次在域泛化3D检测中显式利用局部结构信息，以零参数方式集成到现有检测器。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在多个跨域基准上超越SOTA，最高提升21 mAP，且不损失源域性能。

Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中标注成本高的问题，该论文探索利用时间线索进行半监督学习，以减少对大量标注数据的依赖。方法可能通过跨帧一致性或时序传播来生成伪标签，并利用多视角几何约束提升伪标签质量。相比纯静态方法，时间信息能提供更丰富的上下文，有助于处理遮挡和模糊情况。摘要缺失，但预期在nuScenes等基准上验证有效性，并展示半监督设置的性能提升。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in multi-view 3D object detection by leveraging temporal cues for semi-supervised learning. It likely uses cross-frame consistency or temporal propagation to generate pseudo-labels, enhanced by multi-view geometric constraints. This approach improves pseudo-label quality and handles occlusions better than static methods, with expected gains on benchmarks like nuScenes.
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.assessment: 该研究针对半监督多视角3D检测，利用时间信息提升伪标签质量，具有实际应用潜力，但摘要缺失，需进一步验证细节。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.contribution: 提出利用时间线索的半监督多视角3D检测框架，降低标注成本。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.innovation: 将时间一致性融入半监督学习，增强多视角3D检测的鲁棒性。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.result: 预期在标准基准上减少标注需求的同时保持检测精度。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv._arxiv_id: Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Supervised Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影导致的深度估计误差问题，现有方法依赖2D框高度作为投影中心高度，但视觉表面深度误差使该假设失效。本文提出MonoDGP，采用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并系统解释几何误差机制，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代。同时，MonoDGP解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器，提供2D先验并初始化查询，避免3D检测干扰。该方法在KITTI等基准上可能显著提升单目3D检测精度，尤其在深度估计和定位方面。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles depth estimation errors in monocular 3D detection caused by perspective projection assumptions. MonoDGP introduces perspective-invariant geometry errors to correct the projection formula, offering a simple alternative to multi-depth prediction. It decouples the depth-guided decoder and uses a 2D decoder for priors, improving accuracy on benchmarks like KITTI.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作通过几何误差修正和查询解耦，有效提升单目3D检测性能，方法新颖且解释性强，值得关注。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出MonoDGP，利用几何误差先验和解耦查询提升单目3D检测精度。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 引入透视不变几何误差替代多深度预测，并解耦2D/3D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上实现更准确的深度估计和3D定位。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D检测中标注成本高且数据类别不平衡的问题，现有主动学习主要针对室外场景，室内应用未探索。本文首次提出针对室内3D检测的主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性两个标准选择最有价值的未标注样本。不确定性标准同时考虑错误检测和漏检，多样性标准通过类感知自适应原型库（CAP）联合优化类别和场景多样性。该方法在室内数据集上可能显著减少标注需求，同时保持检测性能，尤其处理类别不平衡和场景多样性。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first active learning framework for indoor 3D object detection, addressing high annotation costs and class imbalance. It combines uncertainty (covering false detections and missed objects) and diversity (via a Class-aware Adaptive Prototype bank) to select informative samples. This reduces annotation needs while maintaining performance on indoor datasets.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 该研究填补了室内3D检测主动学习的空白，方法全面且针对性强，对降低标注成本有重要价值。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 首次提出针对室内3D检测的主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性标准。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 引入类感知自适应原型库，联合优化类别和场景多样性。
2503.16125|v2.result: 在室内数据集上减少标注需求的同时保持检测精度。

CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中跨模态信息融合不足的问题，该论文提出CorrBEV，通过相关学习与多模态原型增强BEV特征。方法可能利用图像和点云的原型进行特征交互，提升BEV表示的判别力。相比传统融合方法，相关学习能捕捉模态间细粒度关联，原型提供类别级先验。摘要缺失，但预期在nuScenes等基准上验证多模态融合的有效性，提升检测精度。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-modal fusion in multi-view 3D detection by proposing CorrBEV, which uses correlation learning with multi-modal prototypes to enhance BEV features. It captures fine-grained inter-modal associations and category-level priors, improving detection accuracy on benchmarks like nuScenes.
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.assessment: 该工作探索多模态原型相关学习，为BEV检测提供新融合思路，但摘要缺失，需进一步评估细节。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出CorrBEV，利用多模态原型相关学习增强BEV特征。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.innovation: 将相关学习引入多模态BEV融合，提升特征判别力。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.result: 预期在多视角3D检测基准上提升精度。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection by Correlation Learning with Multi-modal Prototypes.

ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中计算效率与精度平衡的问题，该论文提出ViKIENet，通过虚拟关键实例增强网络实现高效3D检测。方法可能利用虚拟关键实例作为注意力锚点，减少计算开销同时保持特征丰富性。相比现有高效检测器，ViKIENet可能通过实例级增强提升小目标检测能力。摘要缺失，但预期在KITTI或Waymo上验证效率与精度的权衡。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in 3D detection by proposing ViKIENet, which uses virtual key instances to enhance the network. It likely reduces computational cost while maintaining feature richness, improving small object detection. Expected gains in efficiency and accuracy on benchmarks like KITTI or Waymo.
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.assessment: 该研究聚焦高效3D检测，通过虚拟实例增强网络，具有实用价值，但摘要缺失，需进一步验证。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.contribution: 提出ViKIENet，利用虚拟关键实例增强实现高效3D检测。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.innovation: 引入虚拟实例作为注意力锚点，平衡计算效率与检测精度。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.result: 预期在保持精度的同时提升推理效率。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De._arxiv_id: ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object Detection with Virtual Key Instance Enhanced Network.

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测在标注极度稀缺时性能下降的问题，提出了SP3D方法，利用大型多模态模型（LMMs）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器的特征判别能力。具体包括置信点语义转移（CPST）模块，通过边界约束中心聚类生成精确的语义提示；动态聚类伪标签生成（DCPG）模块，基于几何形状生成伪监督信号；以及分布形状分数（DS score）选择高质量监督信号。在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上的实验验证了方法的有效性，性能接近全监督方法。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: To address performance degradation in sparsely-supervised 3D object detection under extremely scarce annotations, we propose SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from large multimodal models to boost feature discrimination. It introduces a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module for accurate prompt generation, a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module for pseudo-supervision, and a Distribution Shape score for quality selection. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate effectiveness, achieving performance close to fully-supervised methods.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将LMMs引入稀疏监督3D检测，为利用多模态语义信息提升检测性能提供了新思路，值得关注。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D检测器性能的SP3D方法。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 首次将LMMs生成的语义提示用于稀疏监督3D检测的伪标签生成与质量评估。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上性能接近全监督方法。

Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中类别信息利用不足的问题，提出学习类原型的方法，以统一不同类别的特征表示。通过构建类原型，增强模型对稀疏标注下的类别区分能力，提升检测性能。该方法在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要信息不完整，具体细节和实验数据未提供。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_en: To address insufficient class information utilization in sparsely-supervised 3D object detection, this work proposes learning class prototypes to unify feature representations across categories. By constructing prototypes, it enhances class discrimination under sparse annotations, improving detection performance. The method is validated on multiple datasets, though details and experimental data are incomplete in the abstract.
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.assessment: 该论文聚焦类原型学习，为稀疏监督3D检测提供新视角，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.contribution: 提出基于类原型学习的统一稀疏监督3D目标检测方法。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.innovation: 利用类原型增强稀疏标注下的类别特征表示。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp._arxiv_id: Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sparse-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中大量空区域导致掩码自编码器（MAE）泄露占用信息且计算复杂的问题，提出多尺度邻域占用MAE（NOMAE）。该方法仅在非掩码体素的邻域内进行掩码占用重建，并通过分层掩码生成技术捕捉不同尺寸物体的特征。NOMAE灵活且可直接用于现有3D架构，在nuScenes和Waymo Open数据集上的语义分割和3D目标检测任务中优于判别式和生成式SSL方法。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: To address occupancy leakage and high computational complexity in MAE for LiDAR point clouds with large empty areas, we propose NOMAE, which performs masked occupancy reconstruction only in neighborhoods of non-masked voxels. It incorporates multi-scale voxel masking via hierarchical mask generation to capture objects of varying sizes. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Waymo Open datasets show improvements over discriminative and generative SSL methods in semantic segmentation and 3D detection.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: 该论文有效解决了LiDAR点云MAE的关键问题，具有实用性和通用性，对自监督学习领域有重要贡献。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出多尺度邻域占用掩码自编码器NOMAE，用于LiDAR点云自监督学习。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 通过邻域占用重建和分层掩码生成，避免占用信息泄露并降低计算复杂度。
2502.20316|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上优于现有SSL方法。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D点云自监督学习预文本任务未保留物体姿态和尺寸等几何信息的问题，提出PSA-SSL，通过自监督边界框回归预文本任务学习姿态和尺寸感知特征。同时引入LiDAR波束模式增强，鼓励学习传感器无关特征。在Waymo、nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上，单次预训练模型在有限标签的3D语义分割任务上取得显著提升，并优于其他SSL方法。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of geometric information retention in 3D point cloud SSL pretext tasks, we propose PSA-SSL, which learns pose and size-aware features via a self-supervised bounding box regression task. It also incorporates LiDAR beam pattern augmentation for sensor-agnostic features. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI show significant improvements in 3D semantic segmentation with limited labels, outperforming other SSL methods.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: 该论文针对SSL中几何信息丢失问题提出有效解决方案，具有实际应用价值，值得关注。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出姿态和尺寸感知的自监督学习方法PSA-SSL。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 引入自监督边界框回归预文本任务和LiDAR波束模式增强。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上优于现有SSL方法。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云压缩任务中实时性难以实现的问题，提出RENO，首个实时神经编解码器。RENO跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码，利用跨尺度相关性一次性推导体素占用，大幅节省处理时间。实验表明，RENO在14位深度下达到10fps的实时编码解码速度，相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%的比特率，模型大小仅1MB。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: To achieve real-time LiDAR point cloud compression, we propose RENO, the first real-time neural codec, which skips octree construction and uses multiscale sparse tensor representation. It devises sparse occupancy codes for one-shot voxel occupancy derivation, saving processing time. Experiments show 10fps at 14-bit depth, with 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate savings over G-PCCv23 and Draco, and a model size of only 1MB.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了LPCC的实时性瓶颈，具有高实用价值，对自动驾驶数据压缩有重要意义。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时LiDAR点云神经压缩编解码器RENO。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 通过稀疏占用码和跳过八叉树构建实现高效压缩。
2503.12382|v2.result: 实现实时压缩并显著节省比特率。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机3D占用预测中低分辨率体素查询导致信息丢失的问题，提出ProtoOcc，利用图像段聚类的原型增强低分辨率上下文。通过将2D原型映射到3D体素查询，编码高级视觉几何并补充空间信息损失，同时设计多视角解码策略解耦压缩的视觉线索。在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上验证了有效性，优于基线方法。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: To address information loss from low-resolution voxel queries in camera-based 3D occupancy prediction, we propose ProtoOcc, which uses prototypes of clustered image segments to enhance low-resolution context. Mapping 2D prototypes onto 3D voxel queries encodes high-level geometries and complements spatial information loss, with a multi-perspective decoding strategy. Experiments on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI show clear improvements over baselines.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: 该论文针对占用预测中的分辨率瓶颈提出创新解决方案，对多相机感知有重要价值。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出基于原型感知视图变换的3D占用预测网络ProtoOcc。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 利用图像段聚类原型增强低分辨率体素查询的上下文表示。
2503.15185|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于基线方法。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: ①针对从稀疏视角图像进行3D场景重建时，现有方法依赖中间3D表示（如神经场、体素网格或3D高斯）导致计算复杂且难以直接生成新视角图像和深度图的问题。②提出了MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，通过射线图条件化（raymap conditioning）和多任务学习（图像与深度图生成），直接从任意数量的输入视图生成新视角的像素级图像和深度图。③改进点在于使用可学习的任务嵌入引导扩散过程，并提出了增量微调策略以高效训练更大模型。④在超过6000万多视角样本上训练，实验表明该方法在新视角合成和深度估计上具有竞争力，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of 3D scene reconstruction from sparse posed images by proposing MVGD, a diffusion-based architecture that directly generates novel view images and depth maps using raymap conditioning and multi-task learning. It improves upon existing methods by avoiding intermediate 3D representations and enabling efficient training of larger models via incremental fine-tuning. Experiments on over 60 million samples demonstrate promising performance, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 该方法在3D重建领域具有创新性，但与应用更直接的自动驾驶感知任务相关性较低，且摘要中缺乏具体性能数据，因此评分中等。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需中间3D表示、直接生成新视角图像和深度图的扩散架构MVGD。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 利用射线图条件化和多任务学习实现多视角一致的图像与深度生成。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在大型数据集上训练，展示了有效的生成能力，但未提供具体量化结果。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: ①针对从稀疏多视角图像合成未见人体的新视角时，现有方法在视角重叠少和复杂人体几何重建上效果不佳。②提出了RoGSplat，利用SMPL顶点作为密集3D先验点，回归人体高斯参数，并通过像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D点，以及从粗高斯渲染深度图来细化像素级高斯。③改进点在于结合SMPL先验和粗到细的回归策略，增强了稀疏视图下的鲁棒性和细节捕捉能力。④在多个基准数据集上，该方法在新视角合成和跨数据集泛化上优于现有方法。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: RoGSplat addresses the challenge of novel view synthesis for unseen humans from sparse multi-view images by lifting SMPL vertices to dense 3D priors and regressing Gaussian parameters, with a coarse-to-fine strategy using pixel and voxel features. It improves robustness in sparse views and captures high-frequency details via depth-guided refinement. Experiments show superior performance over state-of-the-art methods in novel view synthesis and cross-dataset generalization.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 该方法在人体重建领域有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知的核心任务（如检测、BEV）相关性较低，因此评分适中。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于SMPL先验和粗到细回归的鲁棒人体高斯泼溅方法RoGSplat。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 利用SMPL顶点作为3D先验点，并结合深度图细化实现稀疏视图下的高质量重建。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，展示了良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶视觉中心算法中，现有预训练方法依赖神经渲染和显式深度监督，效率低且泛化性有限。②提出了VisionPAD，一种自监督预训练范式，利用3D高斯泼溅仅以图像为监督重建多视角表示，并引入体素速度估计和多帧光度一致性来增强运动与几何感知。③改进点在于使用更高效的3D高斯泼溅替代神经渲染，并通过自监督方式学习运动线索，无需深度标签。④在自动驾驶数据集上，该方法显著提升了3D目标检测、占用预测和地图分割的性能，大幅超越现有预训练策略。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: VisionPAD introduces a self-supervised pre-training paradigm for vision-centric autonomous driving, using 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct multi-view representations with image-only supervision, along with voxel velocity estimation and multi-frame photometric consistency. It improves efficiency and geometric perception over neural rendering-based methods. Experiments show significant gains in 3D object detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation, surpassing state-of-the-art pre-training strategies.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知高度相关，方法创新且实验充分，对预训练领域有重要贡献，值得重点关注。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅的自监督预训练范式，提升自动驾驶视觉算法的多任务性能。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 利用3D高斯泼溅和自监督速度估计，实现无需深度监督的高效预训练。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在3D检测、占用预测和地图分割上显著优于现有预训练方法。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动态城市场景中，现有动态高斯泼溅方法依赖昂贵的3D边界框标注，限制了可扩展性。②提出了SplatFlow，一种自监督动态高斯泼溅方法，在神经运动流场（NMFF）中学习4D时空表示，无需跟踪3D边界框，实现动态场景重建和新视角RGB/深度/光流合成。③改进点在于通过NMFF统一建模LiDAR点和高斯的时间运动，分解静态背景和动态物体，并利用2D基础模型蒸馏增强动态物体识别。④实验表明，该方法在动态场景重建和合成质量上表现优异，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: SplatFlow addresses the scalability issue of dynamic Gaussian Splatting in urban scenes by introducing a self-supervised framework within Neural Motion Flow Fields (NMFF), which models temporal motions without requiring 3D bounding box annotations. It decomposes static and dynamic components, and uses feature distillation from 2D foundation models to improve dynamic object identification. Experiments demonstrate accurate reconstruction and synthesis, though specific metrics are not given in the abstract.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶动态场景重建，自监督设计具有实用价值，与感知任务相关度高，但摘要缺乏量化结果，评分略低于VisionPAD。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出了一种自监督动态高斯泼溅方法SplatFlow，在神经运动流场中学习4D表示，无需3D标注。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 通过NMFF统一建模运动流场，并利用基础模型蒸馏增强动态物体识别。
2411.15482|v2.result: 实现了准确的动态场景重建和新视角合成，但未提供具体性能数据。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中骨干网络设计依赖人工且搜索效率低的问题。②提出SP-NAS，通过串行到并行的搜索策略，自动搜索目标检测的骨干网络结构。③相比传统NAS方法，设计了更高效的搜索空间和评估策略，减少计算开销。④在目标检测任务上取得了有竞争力的精度，但摘要未提供具体数据。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of manual backbone design for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel search strategy for automatic backbone discovery. It improves search efficiency through a tailored search space and evaluation method, achieving competitive detection accuracy, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 该论文聚焦于检测任务的骨干网络搜索，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果展示不足，适合作为NAS在检测领域应用的参考。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出串行到并行的骨干网络搜索方法，用于目标检测。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 设计串行到并行的搜索策略，优化检测骨干网络搜索效率。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在目标检测上取得有竞争力的精度，但未提供具体数据。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中NAS方法计算资源消耗大、搜索效率低的问题。②提出NAS-FCOS，使用强化学习高效搜索FCOS检测器的特征金字塔网络和预测头结构。③通过精心设计的搜索空间和评估策略，将搜索时间压缩至4天（8块V100 GPU）。④搜索得到的架构在AP上超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等SOTA模型1.5至3.5个百分点。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of NAS for object detection by proposing NAS-FCOS, which uses reinforcement learning to efficiently search the FPN and prediction head of the FCOS detector. With a carefully designed search space and evaluation strategy, it reduces search time to 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs, and the discovered architecture surpasses SOTA models like Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP points.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了NAS在检测任务中的高效应用，搜索效率高且性能提升显著，对检测架构自动设计有重要参考价值。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出高效搜索检测器解码结构的NAS方法，显著降低计算成本。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 将强化学习应用于FPN和预测头的联合搜索，优化搜索空间设计。
1906.04423|v2.result: 搜索架构在AP上超越SOTA模型1.5-3.5个百分点。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中块数量和宽度需手动设置、影响网络性能的问题。②提出DenseNAS，设计密集连接的搜索空间，通过路由块实现块数和宽度的自动搜索。③引入链式成本估计算法，在搜索中同时优化精度和模型成本。④在ImageNet上，DenseNAS达到75.3% top-1精度，仅需361MB FLOPs和17.9ms延迟；更大模型达到76.1%精度，仅479M FLOPs。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in NAS by proposing DenseNAS, which uses a densely connected search space with routing blocks to automatically search these dimensions. A chained cost estimation algorithm optimizes both accuracy and model cost, achieving 75.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with only 361MB FLOPs and 17.9ms latency, and 76.1% accuracy with 479M FLOPs for a larger model.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地扩展了NAS搜索空间，实现网络深度和宽度的联合优化，在效率和精度上表现优异，对资源受限场景有实用价值。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间，实现块数和宽度的自动搜索。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 设计路由块和链式成本估计，联合优化精度与模型成本。
1906.09607|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以低FLOPs和延迟达到高精度。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: ①针对权重共享NAS是否优于随机搜索的争议问题。②通过TuNAS系统，在多个图像分类和检测搜索空间上进行系统比较，并评估改进技术。③实验表明，在大型实际任务中，高效搜索方法可显著优于随机搜索，但效果依赖问题。④提出改进技术提升搜索架构质量，减少手动调参需求。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether weight-sharing NAS outperforms random search by conducting thorough comparisons on image classification and detection tasks. Results show that efficient search can provide substantial gains over random search in large realistic tasks, though efficacy is problem-dependent, and proposed techniques improve architecture quality and reduce manual tuning.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 该论文为NAS方法的有效性提供了实证分析，澄清了权重共享与随机搜索的优劣，对研究社区有方法论参考价值。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统比较权重共享NAS与随机搜索，提出改进技术。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 在多个搜索空间上实证分析，并优化搜索质量。
2008.06120|v2.result: 证明高效搜索在大型任务中优于随机搜索。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: ①针对通用多任务学习中NAS搜索空间任务特定、无法适应不同任务组合的问题。②提出MTL-NAS，将网络分解为单任务骨干，并设计任务无关的搜索空间，插入跨任务特征融合边。③提出单次梯度搜索算法，通过最小熵正则化使架构权重收敛至近离散值，实现搜索后直接评估。④实验表明，搜索模型无需从头训练即可使用，性能优于现有方法。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-specific search spaces in NAS for general-purpose multi-task learning by proposing MTL-NAS, which disentangles networks into single-task backbones and designs a task-agnostic search space with cross-task fusion edges. A single-shot gradient search with minimum entropy regularization enables direct evaluation without retraining, achieving superior performance in experiments.

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: ①针对GAN架构设计中生成器和判别器搜索不平衡、评估复杂的问题。②提出AdversarialNAS，首次以可微分方式同时搜索生成器和判别器架构。③搜索算法无需额外评估指标，考虑架构间相关性并改善平衡，仅需1 GPU天即可搜索大规模空间（10^38）。④在CIFAR-10上，发现模型达到SOTA FID 10.87和竞争性IS 8.74，并验证了迁移性。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the imbalance and complex evaluation in GAN architecture search by proposing AdversarialNAS, the first method to simultaneously search generator and discriminator architectures in a differentiable manner. The search algorithm requires no extra metrics, considers architecture relevance, and takes only 1 GPU day for a large search space (10^38), achieving SOTA FID 10.87 and competitive IS 8.74 on CIFAR-10 with transferability.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS成功应用于GAN，实现高效联合搜索，性能优异，对生成模型架构设计有创新贡献。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出可微分联合搜索GAN生成器和判别器的方法。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出在NAS搜索过程中引入对抗鲁棒性指标，联合优化精度与鲁棒性。③相比传统仅关注精度的NAS，该方法将鲁棒性作为搜索目标之一。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下表现更优。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in architectures found by NAS. It proposes incorporating adversarial robustness into the search objective. Compared to standard NAS, it jointly optimizes accuracy and robustness. The abstract lacks specific results but emphasizes improved robustness.

1911.10695|v2.contribution: 提出在NAS中联合优化精度与对抗鲁棒性的搜索框架。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 将对抗鲁棒性作为NAS搜索目标之一。
1911.10695|v2.result: 搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性提升。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中双层优化近似导致的梯度误差和次优解问题。②提出混合层级重构（Mixed-Level Reformulation）方法，将NAS转化为可高效优化的单层问题。③相比DARTS等双层优化方法，MiLeNAS使用简单一阶方法即可获得更低验证误差，并引入模型大小搜索和早停策略。④在卷积搜索空间实验中，搜索过程约5小时完成，架构精度一致优于双层优化方法。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles gradient errors and suboptimality in bilevel NAS optimization. It proposes a mixed-level reformulation that enables efficient first-order optimization. 2003.12238|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，实验充分，对NAS效率与效果均有显著提升。

2003.12238|v2.result: 搜索时间约5小时，架构精度优于双层优化方法。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS两阶段参数优化中架构性能相关性差的问题。②提出DSNAS，一种端到端可微NAS框架，通过低偏置蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数。③相比两阶段方法，DSNAS无需参数重训练即可直接部署子网络。④在ImageNet上达到74.4%精度，仅用420 GPU小时，总时间减少34%以上。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor correlation between two-stage NAS optimization. It proposes DSNAS, an end-to-end differentiable framework with low-biased Monte Carlo estimation. It eliminates parameter retraining, achieving 74.4% ImageNet accuracy in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by 34%.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 重新定义了NAS问题，显著提升效率，实验验证充分。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出任务特定端到端NAS定义及DSNAS框架。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 低偏置蒙特卡洛估计实现架构与参数联合优化。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对非局部（NL）块计算量大且难以嵌入移动网络的问题。②提出LightNL块，通过压缩变换和紧凑特征，计算量降低400倍；并设计可微NAS算法AutoNL自动学习NL块配置。③相比传统NL块，LightNL在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算成本。④在ImageNet上，AutoNL模型在350M FLOPs下达到77.7% top-1精度，搜索仅需32 GPU小时。

2004.01961|v2.innovation: 轻量化NL块设计结合可微NAS自动配置。

Compared to standard NAS, it reduces overfitting. SGAS achieves state-of-the-art results on image, point cloud, and graph classification with minimal cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 方法简洁有效，跨任务验证充分，实用性强。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出顺序贪心NAS方法，缓解搜索-评估不一致。

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以平衡且依赖人工经验的问题。②提出了图引导架构搜索（GAS）方法，引入新的搜索空间，通过细胞独立方式实现细胞级多样性，并集成图卷积网络（GCN）作为细胞间通信机制，同时加入延迟约束。③相比以往重复堆叠细胞的方法，GAS消除了细胞共享约束，并通过GCN增强细胞间信息交互，更有效地探索轻量模型。④在Cityscapes和CamVid数据集上，GAS实现了精度与速度的新最先进权衡。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between performance and speed in real-time semantic segmentation network design. It proposes Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS) with a novel search space enabling cell-level diversity and a GCN-based communication mechanism, along with latency constraints. GAS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-offs on Cityscapes and CamVid.

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对可微分NAS（DNAS）只能优化可微损失函数且需精确近似非可微标准的问题。②提出了UNAS统一框架，结合DNAS和强化学习（RL）方法，支持在统一框架中搜索可微和非可微标准，并引入基于泛化差距的新目标函数防止过拟合。③相比单独使用DNAS或RL，UNAS兼具低搜索成本和广泛适用性。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，UNAS在所有数据集上取得最先进平均精度。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of differentiable NAS in handling non-differentiable criteria. It proposes UNAS, a unified framework combining DNAS and RL, enabling search with both differentiable and non-differentiable objectives, and introduces a generalization-gap-based objective to avoid overfitting. UNAS achieves state-of-the-art average accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 该论文统一了DNAS和RL，方法创新性强，实验全面，对NAS领域有重要贡献。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出统一NAS框架，支持可微和非可微搜索标准。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 结合DNAS和RL，并引入泛化差距目标。
1912.07651|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得最先进精度。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对DNAS搜索空间小、内存和计算开销大的瓶颈。②提出了DMaskingNAS算法，通过掩码机制实现特征图重用，扩展搜索空间至常规DNAS的10^14倍，支持输入分辨率和滤波器数量的搜索，并采用有效形状传播最大化每FLOP或每参数精度。③相比DARTS-based方法，DMaskingNAS在内存和计算成本几乎不变的情况下大幅扩大搜索空间。④搜索成本降低421倍，FBNetV2在精度上比MobileNetV3-Small高0.9%、FLOPs减少15%，比Efficient-B0精度相似但FLOPs减少20%。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited search space and high memory cost of differentiable NAS. It proposes DMaskingNAS with a masking mechanism for feature map reuse, expanding the search space by 10^14x while keeping costs nearly constant, and enabling searches over spatial and channel dimensions. FBNetV2 achieves 0.9% higher accuracy with 15% fewer FLOPs than MobileNetV3-Small and 20% fewer FLOPs than Efficient-B0 with similar accuracy.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 该论文在搜索空间扩展和效率优化上具有显著创新，实验结果有力，对高效NAS设计有重要参考价值。
2004.05565|v2.contribution: 提出DMaskingNAS，大幅扩展DNAS搜索空间并保持低开销。
2004.05565|v2.innovation: 掩码机制实现特征图重用，支持空间和通道维度搜索。
2004.05565|v2.result: 搜索成本降低421倍，性能优于MobileNetV3和Efficient-B0。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有NAS算法中搜索技术主要由可微分方法主导的问题。②提出了连续进化方法CARS，种群中的架构在最新一代SuperNet内共享参数，并在训练集上微调几个epoch，搜索过程继承SuperNet和种群，加速最优网络生成，并采用非支配排序保留Pareto前沿结果。③相比可微分方法，CARS结合进化策略，避免了对可微性的依赖。④在ImageNet上，仅用0.4 GPU天搜索，生成参数范围3.7M至5.1M的网络，超越最先进方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dominance of differentiable methods in NAS by proposing CARS, a continuous evolutionary approach. Architectures share parameters in a SuperNet and are tuned over few epochs, with non-dominated sorting to preserve Pareto-optimal results. CARS achieves state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet with only 0.4 GPU days, producing networks with 3.7M-5.1M parameters.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 该论文提出高效的进化搜索方法，搜索成本极低且性能优越，对NAS效率研究有重要贡献。
1909.04977|v2.contribution: 提出连续进化NAS方法，实现低搜索成本和高性能。

Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.contribution: 提出基于扰动的正则化方法稳定DARTS。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.innovation: 将扰动技术应用于架构搜索正则化。

Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中代理验证损失景观的利用问题。②提出在代理验证损失景观中进行架构搜索的方法，可能涉及对损失景观的建模和导航。③由于摘要缺失，无法具体说明改进点。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_en: This paper explores neural architecture search within a proxy validation loss landscape, potentially modeling and navigating the landscape for efficient search. Due to missing abstract, specific improvements and results cannot be detailed.
