Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.contribution: 提出在代理验证损失景观中进行NAS的方法。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.innovation: 利用损失景观信息指导搜索过程。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va._arxiv_id: Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Validation Loss Landscape.

2103.10584|v2.summary_cn: ①针对硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）中硬件成本获取困难、基准测试不可复现的问题。②构建了首个公开的HW-NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench，包含预计算的硬件成本查找表和设备特定模型，降低了非硬件专家的入门门槛。③相比现有工作，提供了统一、可复现的基准，支持多种硬件设备。④通过标准化评估流程，促进了HW-NAS研究的可复现性和可访问性。
2103.10584|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of hardware cost estimation and benchmarking in HW-NAS by introducing HW-NAS-Bench, the first public dataset for HW-NAS research. It provides pre-collected hardware cost look-up tables and device-specific models, lowering the barrier for non-hardware experts. The benchmark enables reproducible and accessible HW-NAS research across various devices.
2103.10584|v2.assessment: 该论文为HW-NAS领域提供了重要基础设施，但更偏向系统工具而非算法创新，对自动驾驶感知的直接相关性较低。
2103.10584|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的硬件感知NAS基准数据集，推动领域标准化。
2103.10584|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地提供跨设备的硬件成本数据，降低研究门槛。
2103.10584|v2.result: 提供了可复现的基准，促进HW-NAS研究发展。

2103.04507|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中网络架构搜索效率低、路径聚合网络设计依赖人工的问题。②提出OPANAS，一种基于one-shot搜索的路径聚合网络架构搜索方法，自动优化特征融合路径。③相比固定FPN/PANet结构，通过搜索空间设计提升检测精度和效率。④在COCO等数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2103.04507|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OPANAS, a one-shot path aggregation network architecture search method for object detection, automating the design of feature fusion paths. It improves over handcrafted FPN/PANet structures by searching optimal paths, enhancing detection accuracy and efficiency. Experiments on COCO demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2103.04507|v2.assessment: 针对检测任务定制NAS搜索空间，有一定应用价值，但摘要信息不完整，需进一步验证。
2103.04507|v2.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的路径聚合网络搜索方法。
2103.04507|v2.innovation: 将one-shot NAS应用于路径聚合网络设计。
2103.04507|v2.result: 在检测任务上提升了精度和效率。

2004.14525|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动设备上目标检测模型依赖深度可分离卷积、性能受限的问题。②通过NAS搜索空间引入常规卷积，并针对检测任务直接优化架构，生成MobileDets模型家族。③相比MobileNetV3+SSDLite，在移动CPU上提升1.7 mAP，在EdgeTPU、DSP、GPU等设备上分别提升3.7、3.4、2.7 mAP，且不增加延迟。④证明了常规卷积在移动加速器上的有效性。
2004.14525|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the use of regular convolutions in mobile object detection models, discovering they boost latency-accuracy trade-offs when strategically placed via NAS. MobileDets outperform MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.7 mAP on mobile CPUs and show gains on various accelerators without latency increase. The work highlights the importance of search space design for hardware-specific optimization.
2004.14525|v2.assessment: 该论文对移动端检测模型设计有重要指导意义，实验充分，结果显著，与自动驾驶边缘部署相关。
2004.14525|v2.contribution: 提出MobileDets，通过NAS优化移动检测架构，提升多硬件性能。
2004.14525|v2.innovation: 在搜索空间中引入常规卷积，针对检测任务直接优化。
2004.14525|v2.result: 在多个移动加速器上实现SOTA精度-延迟权衡。

2104.14545|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标跟踪中SOTA模型过于庞大、难以部署在资源受限设备的问题。②提出LightTrack，利用one-shot NAS设计轻量级跟踪网络，自动搜索高效架构。③相比手工设计的SiamRPN++和Ocean，在精度相当或更优的情况下，大幅减少Flops和参数。④在Snapdragon 845 GPU上，LightTrack比Ocean快12倍，参数少13倍，Flops少38倍。
2104.14545|v2.summary_en: This paper presents LightTrack, a NAS-based approach to design lightweight object trackers, addressing the deployment challenge of heavy SOTA models. It discovers architectures that match or exceed handcrafted trackers like SiamRPN++ and Ocean with significantly fewer resources. On mobile GPUs, LightTrack runs 12x faster than Ocean with 13x fewer parameters and 38x fewer Flops.
2104.14545|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了跟踪任务中的模型压缩问题，结果显著，对自动驾驶中的实时跟踪有参考价值。
2104.14545|v2.contribution: 提出LightTrack，通过NAS实现轻量级高效目标跟踪。
2104.14545|v2.innovation: 将one-shot NAS应用于跟踪网络设计，兼顾精度和效率。
2104.14545|v2.result: 在移动设备上实现大幅加速和压缩，性能不降。

2104.00597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对one-shot NAS中搜索空间庞大、集成模型设计困难的问题。②提出多样性引导的搜索空间收缩方法，用于one-shot神经集成架构搜索，通过多样性指标逐步缩小搜索空间。③相比传统集成方法，提升了搜索效率和集成多样性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法具有理论价值。
2104.00597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of large search spaces in one-shot NAS for ensemble models by proposing a diversity-guided search space shrinking method. It iteratively reduces the search space based on diversity metrics, improving search efficiency and ensemble diversity. The approach offers theoretical value, though specific results are not detailed.
2104.00597|v2.assessment: 方法新颖，但摘要信息有限，实际效果需进一步验证，与自动驾驶相关性中等。
2104.00597|v2.contribution: 提出多样性引导的搜索空间收缩策略用于集成NAS。
2104.00597|v2.innovation: 将多样性指标融入搜索空间优化过程。
2104.00597|v2.result: 提升了集成搜索的效率和多样性。

2103.05471|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中架构比较依赖人工设计指标、效率低的问题。②提出对比神经架构搜索（CTNAS），引入神经架构比较器（NAC）自动学习架构间的优劣关系。③相比传统基于性能预测的方法，NAC能更准确地比较架构，减少评估成本。④在多个NAS基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2103.05471|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Contrastive Neural Architecture Search (CTNAS) with a Neural Architecture Comparator (NAC) to automatically learn pairwise comparisons between architectures, addressing the inefficiency of manual metrics in NAS. The NAC improves ranking accuracy and reduces evaluation cost. Experiments on NAS benchmarks demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not provided.
2103.05471|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的架构比较机制，对NAS效率提升有贡献，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2103.05471|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比学习的架构比较器，优化NAS搜索过程。
2103.05471|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习自动学习架构优劣关系。
2103.05471|v2.result: 提升了NAS中架构评估的准确性和效率。

NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS方法在超网络训练和架构优化上计算开销大的问题。②提出NetAdaptV2，通过快速超网络训练策略和高效的架构优化算法，加速搜索过程。③相比NetAdapt等先前工作，引入了更高效的训练调度和优化目标，减少资源消耗。④在多个图像分类数据集上，以更低的搜索成本达到与先进方法相当的精度。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of NAS in super-network training and architecture optimization. NetAdaptV2 introduces fast training strategies and efficient optimization to accelerate search. It achieves competitive accuracy with reduced search cost compared to prior methods.
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.assessment: 对NAS效率提升有实际价值，但创新性一般，适合关注搜索效率的研究者。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出NetAdaptV2，实现快速超网络训练与高效架构优化。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.innovation: 结合快速训练与优化策略，降低NAS搜索开销。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.result: 在多个数据集上以更低成本达到与先进方法相当的精度。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Fast Super-Network Training and Architecture Optimization.

Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: ①针对图神经架构搜索（GNAS）中消息传递机制未被充分建模的问题。②重新思考GNAS的搜索空间，提出基于消息传递的架构表示和搜索策略。③相比传统GNAS方法，更精确地捕捉图结构信息，提升搜索有效性。④在多个图学习基准上，搜索到的架构在节点分类和图分类任务上优于现有GNAS方法。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper rethinks graph neural architecture search from the message-passing perspective, proposing a new search space and strategy. It improves search effectiveness by better modeling graph structure. The searched architectures outperform existing GNAS methods on node and graph classification benchmarks.
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 对GNAS领域有重要理论贡献，方法设计严谨，值得关注。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出基于消息传递的GNAS搜索框架。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将消息传递机制作为GNAS搜索的核心维度。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多个图学习基准上优于现有GNAS方法。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Search From Message-Passing.

HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉任务（如语义分割）中NAS搜索效率低和Transformer计算量大的问题。②提出HR-NAS，结合轻量级Transformer和高效搜索策略，设计高分辨率专用架构。③相比通用NAS，引入分辨率感知的搜索空间和轻量化模块，减少计算开销。④在Cityscapes等分割数据集上，以更低的FLOPs达到与先进方法相当的mIoU。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_en: This paper tackles NAS inefficiency for high-resolution tasks by proposing HR-NAS with lightweight transformers. It introduces resolution-aware search space and efficient modules. The method achieves competitive mIoU on segmentation benchmarks with lower FLOPs.
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.assessment: 针对高分辨率任务有实际应用价值，方法结合Transformer创新，值得关注。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.contribution: 提出HR-NAS，实现高分辨率视觉任务的高效架构搜索。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.innovation: 将轻量级Transformer融入分辨率感知的NAS搜索空间。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.result: 在分割数据集上以更低FLOPs达到先进精度。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut._arxiv_id: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures With Lightweight Transformers.

2105.11871|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨任务NAS中架构迁移性和泛化性不足的问题。②构建TransNAS-Bench-101基准，包含多任务架构性能数据，并分析跨任务迁移规律。③相比现有NAS基准，提供更全面的任务覆盖和迁移性评估。④实验表明，基于该基准训练的代理模型能有效预测跨任务性能，提升搜索效率。
2105.11871|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor transferability in cross-task NAS by introducing TransNAS-Bench-101, a benchmark with multi-task performance data. It analyzes transfer patterns and enables effective performance prediction. The benchmark improves search efficiency across tasks.
2105.11871|v2.assessment: 为跨任务NAS研究提供了重要基准资源，数据丰富，分析深入。
2105.11871|v2.innovation: 系统分析架构跨任务迁移性，提供多任务性能数据。
2105.11871|v2.result: 基于该基准的代理模型有效提升跨任务搜索效率。

2010.00969|v2.summary_cn: ①针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）中操作和拓扑耦合导致搜索不稳定问题。②提出DOTS方法，解耦操作选择和拓扑学习，分别优化。③相比DARTS，减少搜索-评估差距，提高搜索稳定性。④在多个图像分类数据集上，搜索到的架构性能优于DARTS及其变体。
2010.00969|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses instability in differentiable NAS by decoupling operation and topology learning. DOTS optimizes them separately, reducing search-evaluation gap. It outperforms DARTS variants on image classification benchmarks.
2010.00969|v2.assessment: 对DARTS类方法有改进价值，但创新性有限，适合NAS研究者参考。
2010.00969|v2.contribution: 提出DOTS，解耦可微NAS中的操作与拓扑搜索。
2010.00969|v2.innovation: 分离操作和拓扑优化，提升搜索稳定性。
2010.00969|v2.result: 在图像分类上优于DARTS及其变体。

2103.07289|v2.summary_cn: ①针对One-Shot NAS中搜索空间固定和灵活性不足的问题。②提出架构生成器（Architecture Generator），通过生成方式动态探索架构，实现灵活高效的搜索。③相比传统One-Shot方法，支持更广泛的架构空间和更快的搜索。④在多个数据集上，以较低搜索成本达到与先进方法相当的精度。
2103.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inflexibility in one-shot NAS by introducing an architecture generator that dynamically explores architectures. It enables broader search space and faster search. The method achieves competitive accuracy with lower cost on multiple datasets.
2103.07289|v2.assessment: 生成式NAS思路新颖，灵活性和效率兼顾，值得关注。
2103.07289|v2.contribution: 提出基于架构生成器的灵活One-Shot NAS方法。
2103.07289|v2.innovation: 用生成方式替代固定搜索空间，提升灵活性。
2103.07289|v2.result: 在多个数据集上以较低成本达到先进精度。

Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_cn: ①针对行人重识别任务中网络结构设计依赖人工经验的问题。②提出基于组合深度空间的架构搜索方法，在深度维度上搜索网络结构。③相比固定深度网络，能够自适应地搜索最优深度组合。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of network architectures for person re-identification. It proposes a combined depth space based architecture search method to automatically discover optimal depth configurations. The approach adapts network depth to improve re-identification performance, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.assessment: 摘要缺失，信息有限，且与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.contribution: 提出组合深度空间的架构搜索方法用于行人重识别。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.innovation: 在深度维度上引入组合搜索空间。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture._arxiv_id: Combined Depth Space Based Architecture Search for Person Re-Identification.

NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_cn: ①针对移动端加速场景中网络剪枝与架构搜索分离导致效率低下的问题。②提出编译器感知的统一剪枝与架构搜索框架NPAS，联合优化网络结构和剪枝策略。③相比单独进行剪枝或搜索，统一框架能更好地适应硬件特性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of separate network pruning and architecture search for mobile acceleration. It proposes NPAS, a compiler-aware framework that unifies pruning and architecture search to jointly optimize structure and pruning strategy. The unified approach better adapts to hardware characteristics, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.assessment: 摘要缺失，但主题与高效网络设计相关，对自动驾驶边缘部署有一定参考价值。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.contribution: 提出编译器感知的统一剪枝与架构搜索框架。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.innovation: 将剪枝和架构搜索联合优化并考虑编译器特性。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif._arxiv_id: NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unified Network Pruning and Architecture Search for Beyond Real-Time Mobile Acceleration.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光图像增强任务中现有深度模型依赖人工架构设计且计算负担重的问题。②提出基于Retinex启发的展开与架构搜索方法RUAS，将优化过程展开为网络结构，并通过无参考协同学习策略搜索轻量级先验架构。③相比手工设计网络，RUAS自动发现高效结构，显著降低计算资源需求。④实验表明RUAS在效果和速度上均优于最新方法。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual architecture engineering and high computational cost in low-light image enhancement. It proposes RUAS, which unrolls Retinex-based optimization into a network structure and uses a cooperative reference-free learning strategy to search lightweight prior architectures. Compared to handcrafted networks, RUAS automatically discovers efficient structures with reduced computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate superiority over state-of-the-art methods in both quality and speed.
2012.05609|v2.assessment: 方法新颖，将优化展开与NAS结合，对低光增强任务有显著贡献，对自动驾驶夜间感知有潜在借鉴。
2012.05609|v2.contribution: 提出Retinex启发的展开与架构搜索框架，实现轻量高效低光增强。
2012.05609|v2.innovation: 将优化展开与无参考协同搜索结合，自动发现轻量级先验架构。
2012.05609|v2.result: 在效果和速度上优于最新方法。

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: ①针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样策略忽视性能帕累托前沿、限制搜索精度的问题。②提出AttentiveNAS，改进采样策略以聚焦帕累托前沿，并设计算法在训练中高效识别前沿网络。③相比均匀采样，注意力采样能更有效地探索高性能区域。④在ImageNet上，发现的模型族达到77.3%至80.7%的top-1准确率，优于BigNAS和Once-for-All。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of uniform sampling in two-stage NAS, which ignores the performance Pareto front and restricts search accuracy. It proposes AttentiveNAS to improve sampling strategy focusing on the Pareto front and designs algorithms to efficiently identify Pareto-optimal networks during training. Compared to uniform sampling, attentive sampling explores high-performance regions more effectively. 2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对目标检测中NAS、剪枝和知识蒸馏三大技术通常被流水线式串联使用，导致次优性能和计算开销大的问题。②提出了Joint-DetNAS，一个统一框架，通过学生形态优化（结合权重继承进行架构搜索和参数剪枝）和动态蒸馏（利用弹性教师池选择最优教师）联合优化这三个组件。③相比已有工作，创新在于将三者联合优化而非简单串联，权重继承加速搜索，弹性教师池无需额外成本即可采样教师。④实验表明，Joint-DetNAS显著优于朴素流水线方法，以经典R101-FPN为基础检测器时，能直接输出高性能学生检测器而无需额外训练。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance and high computational cost of naively pipelining NAS, pruning, and knowledge distillation in object detection. It proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes these components via student morphism with weight inheritance and dynamic distillation with an elastic teacher pool. Experiments show significant improvement over the pipelining approach, directly yielding high-performance student detectors from a base detector without extra training.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的联合优化框架，将NAS、剪枝和蒸馏有机结合，对检测器高效压缩和搜索具有重要参考价值，值得关注。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 提出了Joint-DetNAS，首个联合优化NAS、剪枝和动态蒸馏的目标检测框架。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 通过权重继承和弹性教师池实现三者的联合优化，避免流水线式方法的次优性。

2204.05941|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中跨任务迁移时任务相关性建模不足的问题。②提出了Arch-Graph，一种可迁移的NAS方法，通过将任务嵌入作为预测器输入来利用多任务相关性，并将NAS建模为架构关系图预测问题，通过最大加权无环子图（MWAS）优化保证图的无环性。③相比已有工作，Arch-Graph显式建模任务相关性，并引入图约束提升排序可靠性。④摘要未给出具体数据，但方法在理论上增强了跨任务架构预测的适应性和准确性。
2204.05941|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient modeling of task correlations in transferable NAS. It proposes Arch-Graph, which leverages task embeddings as predictor inputs to exploit multi-task correlations and formulates NAS as architecture relation graph prediction, using Maximal Weighted Acyclic Subgraph (MWAS) to enforce acyclicity. Compared to prior work, Arch-Graph explicitly models task correlations and adds graph constraints for reliable ranking. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but the method theoretically improves cross-task architecture prediction adaptability and accuracy.
2204.05941|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将任务相关性和图优化引入NAS，理论框架扎实，对多任务场景有实际意义。

It proposes ISNAS-DIP, an image-specific NAS strategy that requires substantially less training, enabling per-image search. Compared to prior work, it leverages the insight that optimal architectures vary per image, avoiding inefficient dataset-level search. Experiments on a DIP NAS dataset with 522 models demonstrate effectiveness, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.

It empirically analyzes NTK time evolution, showing modern architectures are highly nonlinear, and proposes Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA), which captures nonlinear advantages with minimal training. Compared to prior work, LGA achieves meaningful rank correlation with post-training accuracy after minimal training. The abstract mentions meaningful correlation but lacks specific numbers.

2206.09811|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）中梯度下降更新的架构参数无法准确反映操作对任务性能的真实贡献，导致搜索效果不佳的问题，提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法（Shapley-NAS）。该方法利用Shapley值量化超网中操作在所有可能组合下的边际贡献，并迭代优化超网权重和更新架构参数，从而选择贡献显著的操作。由于精确计算Shapley值是NP难的，采用基于蒙特卡洛采样和早期截断的近似算法。实验表明该方法能有效提升搜索架构的性能。
2206.09811|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that gradient-descent-updated architecture parameters in differentiable architecture search (DARTS) fail to reflect true operation importance, this paper proposes Shapley-NAS, which evaluates operation contributions via Shapley values. It iteratively optimizes supernet weights and updates architecture parameters by quantifying marginal contributions across all combinations, using Monte-Carlo sampling with early truncation for tractability. Experiments demonstrate improved search performance.
2206.09811|v2.assessment: 将博弈论中的Shapley值引入NAS，为操作贡献评估提供了新视角，但计算复杂度和实际收益需进一步验证。

2203.01665|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类方法在搜索过程中存在的性能崩溃鲁棒性弱和搜索架构泛化能力差的问题，提出Beta-Decay正则化方法。该方法通过约束激活架构参数的值和方差不过大，稳定搜索过程，并提供理论分析解释其工作原理。在NAS-Bench-201上的实验表明，该方法能稳定搜索过程，使搜索网络在不同数据集上更具迁移性，且对训练时间和数据依赖更少。
2203.01665|v2.summary_en: To address weak robustness to performance collapse and poor generalization in DARTS-based methods, this paper proposes Beta-Decay regularization, which constrains the value and variance of activated architecture parameters. Theoretical analysis explains its mechanism, and experiments on NAS-Bench-201 show stabilized search and improved transferability across datasets with reduced dependence on training time and data.
2203.01665|v2.assessment: 简单有效的正则化方法，理论分析扎实，对提升DARTS稳定性有实际价值。
2203.01665|v2.contribution: 提出Beta-Decay正则化，解决DARTS性能崩溃和泛化问题。
2203.01665|v2.innovation: 通过约束架构参数的值和方差，提供理论解释的正则化策略。
2203.01665|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上稳定搜索并提升跨数据集迁移性。

2111.13204|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS方法在搜索后期架构退化、难以超越简单基线的问题，将架构搜索形式化为分布学习问题，将架构权重松弛为高斯分布，并利用自然梯度变分推断（NGVI）优化分布。该方法基于现有代码库即可实现，不增加内存和计算消耗，增强探索性和稳定性。在NAS-Bench-201和NAS-Bench-1shot1基准上的实验验证了显著改进，并利用后验采样替代argmax。
2111.13204|v2.summary_en: To address architecture deterioration in differentiable NAS, this paper formulates search as distribution learning by relaxing architecture weights into Gaussian distributions and optimizing via natural-gradient variational inference (NGVI). It enhances exploration and stability without extra memory or computation, and experiments on NAS-Bench-201 and NAS-Bench-1shot1 show significant improvements, with posterior sampling replacing argmax.
2111.13204|v2.assessment: 将贝叶斯原理引入NAS，提供新视角，实验充分，对提升搜索稳定性和性能有贡献。
2111.13204|v2.contribution: 提出基于贝叶斯学习规则的分布学习框架，改进可微NAS。
2111.13204|v2.innovation: 利用自然梯度变分推断优化架构分布，增强探索性。
2111.13204|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升搜索性能。

2203.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Transformer架构搜索（TAS）耗时且CNN中的零成本代理不适用于ViT搜索空间的问题，首次提出训练免费的TAS方案（TF-TAS）。观察到ViT中多头自注意力（MSA）和多层感知机（MLP）特性不同，且MSA的突触多样性显著影响性能，据此设计模块化策略，从突触多样性和突触显著性两个理论角度评估和排序ViT架构，称为DSS-indicator。实验表明DSS-indicator的评估结果与ViT模型测试准确率强相关，实现高效搜索。
2203.12217|v2.summary_en: To address time-consuming TAS and poor generalization of CNN zero-cost proxies to ViT spaces, this paper proposes training-free TAS (TF-TAS). It observes distinct properties of MSA and MLP, with MSA synaptic diversity notably affecting performance, and devises a modular DSS-indicator evaluating architectures via synaptic diversity and saliency. Experiments show strong correlation with ViT test accuracies, enabling efficient search.
2203.12217|v2.assessment: 针对ViT搜索的零成本评估方法，具有实际应用价值，但需验证在不同搜索空间上的泛化性。
2203.12217|v2.contribution: 首次提出训练免费的Transformer架构搜索方法，设计DSS-indicator评估指标。
2203.12217|v2.innovation: 基于突触多样性和显著性理论，实现无需训练的ViT架构评估。
2203.12217|v2.result: DSS-indicator与ViT准确率强相关，实现高效搜索。

2203.10747|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中CNN训练耗时、直接在检测数据集上搜索架构成本高（需数十甚至数百GPU天）的问题。②提出EAutoDet框架，构建骨干和FPN的超级网络，采用可微搜索方法，并提出核复用技术共享候选操作权重以减少内存和计算，以及动态通道细化策略搜索通道数。③相比现有检测NAS方法，显著降低搜索成本至1.4 GPU天，同时提升性能。④在COCO test-dev上，发现的架构达到40.1 mAP@120 FPS和49.2 mAP@41.3 FPS，超越SOTA检测NAS方法，并成功迁移至旋转检测任务（DOTA上77.05 mAP50）。
2203.10747|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high search cost of NAS for object detection by proposing EAutoDet, an efficient framework that searches backbone and FPN architectures in 1.4 GPU-days via differentiable search with kernel reusing and dynamic channel refinement. The discovered architectures achieve 40.1 mAP at 120 FPS and 49.2 mAP at 41.3 FPS on COCO test-dev, surpassing prior detection NAS methods, and transfer well to rotation detection.
2203.10747|v2.assessment: 该工作高效解决了检测NAS的搜索成本瓶颈，具有实用价值，值得关注。
2203.10747|v2.contribution: 提出EAutoDet，实现1.4 GPU天内高效搜索检测骨干和FPN架构。
2203.10747|v2.innovation: 核复用技术和动态通道细化策略降低搜索成本。
2203.10747|v2.result: COCO上达40.1 mAP@120 FPS和49.2 mAP@41.3 FPS，超越SOTA。

ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）架构设计依赖人工经验、缺乏系统搜索的问题。②提出ViTAS，一种视觉Transformer架构搜索方法，探索ViT的深度、头数、嵌入维度等设计空间。③相比手工设计ViT，提供自动化搜索方案，适应不同任务需求。④摘要不完整，但预期通过搜索发现高性能ViT架构。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.summary_en: This paper introduces ViTAS, a neural architecture search method for vision transformers, aiming to automate the design of ViT architectures. It searches over key dimensions like depth and head count, offering an alternative to manual design, though specific results are not detailed in the incomplete abstract.
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.assessment: 摘要不完整，但主题相关，可能对ViT设计有参考价值。
ViTAS: Vision Transformer Architecture S.contribution: 提出ViTAS，自动化搜索视觉Transformer架构。

2201.10355|v2.summary_cn: ①针对SNN使用ANN类架构（如VGG/ResNet）导致时序信息处理次优的问题。②提出一种NAS方法，基于初始化时激活模式选择能表示多样脉冲模式的架构，并搜索前馈和反馈连接以利用时序信息。③相比手工SNN架构，自动化搜索更适配SNN特性。④实验显示SNASNet通过反馈连接提升性能，证明时序设计重要性。
2201.10355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses suboptimal SNN architectures by proposing a NAS approach that selects architectures based on spike activation patterns at initialization and searches feedforward and backward connections. The found SNASNet benefits from backward connections, highlighting the importance of temporal design in SNNs.
2201.10355|v2.assessment: 针对SNN架构设计有创新性，但领域相关性较低。
2201.10355|v2.contribution: 提出SNN专用NAS方法，搜索含反馈连接的架构。
2201.10355|v2.innovation: 基于激活模式初始化搜索和时序反馈连接。
2201.10355|v2.result: SNASNet通过反馈连接提升性能。

2207.05420|v2.summary_cn: ①针对如何有效组合卷积、Transformer和MLP构建高性能混合视觉架构的问题。②提出UniNet，统一建模不同算子以减少搜索空间，并设计上下文感知下采样模块（DSMs）缓解算子间差异，使用强化学习搜索。③相比单独使用某类算子，混合架构能发挥各自优势。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期搜索的混合架构在视觉任务上表现优异。
2207.05420|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of combining convolution, transformer, and MLP operators by proposing UniNet, a unified NAS approach with a reduced search space and context-aware downsampling modules. It uses reinforcement learning to find high-performance hybrid architectures, though specific results are not given in the abstract.
2207.05420|v2.assessment: 统一搜索空间设计有创新性，对混合架构研究有贡献。
2207.05420|v2.contribution: 提出UniNet，统一搜索卷积、Transformer和MLP混合架构。
2207.05420|v2.innovation: 统一算子建模和上下文感知下采样模块。

2112.02086|v2.summary_cn: ①针对隐私保护等场景下无法使用原始训练数据进行NAS的问题。②提出无数据NAS框架，通过递归标签校准合成数据、区域更新策略增强多样性、输入和特征级正则化减小域差距，并实例化到DARTS、ProxylessNAS和SPOS。③相比传统NAS，无需原始数据即可搜索架构。④实验显示搜索的架构性能接近甚至超越有数据NAS。
2112.02086|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses NAS without original training data by synthesizing data via recursive label calibration and regional updates, with regularization to reduce domain gap. The framework is instantiated with DARTS, ProxylessNAS, and SPOS, achieving competitive performance to data-driven NAS.
2112.02086|v2.assessment: 解决隐私场景下的NAS问题，具有实际应用价值。
2112.02086|v2.contribution: 提出无数据NAS框架，通过合成数据引导搜索。
2112.02086|v2.innovation: 递归标签校准和区域更新策略生成高质量合成数据。
2112.02086|v2.result: 搜索架构性能接近有数据NAS。

Robust Network Architecture Search via F.summary_en: This paper addresses robustness in NAS by proposing a feature distortion restraining method during search to improve architecture robustness. It focuses on robustness beyond accuracy, though specific results are not detailed in the incomplete abstract.
Robust Network Architecture Search via F.assessment: 关注NAS鲁棒性，有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限。
Robust Network Architecture Search via F.contribution: 提出特征失真抑制方法增强NAS架构鲁棒性。
Robust Network Architecture Search via F.innovation: 在搜索中引入特征失真约束。

2207.12577|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动设备上超分辨率模型计算量大、难以实时推理的问题，提出编译器感知的NAS框架，联合搜索深度和每层宽度，并采用自适应SR块。将推理速度直接纳入优化目标，同时利用包含编译器优化的速度模型预测延迟，避免在搜索中频繁测量。在三星移动平台GPU/DSP上实现了720p分辨率的实时SR推理，并保持了有竞争力的PSNR和SSIM。
2207.12577|v2.summary_en: To address the high computational cost of super-resolution models on mobile devices, a compiler-aware NAS framework is proposed, jointly searching depth and per-layer width with adaptive SR blocks. Inference speed is directly optimized alongside SR loss, and a compiler-aware speed model predicts latency for faster convergence. Real-time 720p SR inference is achieved on Samsung mobile GPU/DSP with competitive PSNR and SSIM.
2207.12577|v2.assessment: 该工作将编译器优化纳入NAS搜索，对移动端部署有实际价值，但领域相关性较低。
2207.12577|v2.contribution: 提出编译器感知的NAS框架，实现移动端实时超分辨率。
2207.12577|v2.innovation: 将编译器优化集成到速度预测模型中，加速搜索并提升实际推理性能。
2207.12577|v2.result: 在移动平台实现720p实时SR，PSNR和SSIM有竞争力。

2111.15097|v2.summary_cn: 针对GAN架构搜索中训练不稳定和搜索次优的问题，提出两阶段进化NAS框架EAGAN。阶段1固定判别器搜索生成器，采用多对一训练策略；阶段2用最优生成器搜索判别器，采用一对一训练和权重重置策略。使用非支配排序生成多目标（模型大小、IS、FID）下的Pareto前沿架构。
2111.15097|v2.summary_en: To address instability and sub-optimality in GAN architecture search, EAGAN proposes a two-stage evolutionary NAS framework. Stage-1 searches the generator with a fixed discriminator using many-to-one training, while stage-2 searches the discriminator with the optimal generator using one-to-one training and weight resetting. Non-dominated sorting produces Pareto-front architectures under multiple objectives like model size, IS, and FID.
2111.15097|v2.assessment: 该工作针对GAN搜索的稳定性问题，方法有创新性，但领域相关性较低。
2111.15097|v2.contribution: 提出两阶段进化NAS框架EAGAN，稳定搜索GAN架构。
2111.15097|v2.innovation: 解耦生成器和判别器搜索，并采用多种训练策略增强稳定性。
2111.15097|v2.result: 生成Pareto前沿架构，平衡模型大小和生成质量。

2207.03677|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统先搜索后剪枝流程计算成本高的问题，提出SuperTickets方法，首次从超网络中同时识别高效DNN及其彩票子网络。采用联合架构搜索和参数剪枝的两合一训练方案，并开发渐进式统一识别策略，允许子网络连接在训练中变化，提升精度和效率权衡。实验表明SuperTickets可跨任务迁移。
2207.03677|v2.summary_en: To reduce the high cost of the search-train-prune-retrain pipeline, SuperTickets identifies both efficient DNNs and their lottery tickets directly from a supernet via a two-in-one training scheme with joint architecture searching and parameter pruning. A progressive unified strategy allows subnetwork connectivity to change during training, improving accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. SuperTickets show transferability across tasks.
2207.03677|v2.assessment: 该工作结合NAS和彩票假设，具有理论意义和实用价值，但相关性一般。
2207.03677|v2.contribution: 首次从超网络同时识别高效架构和彩票子网络，降低计算成本。
2207.03677|v2.innovation: 联合架构搜索和参数剪枝，并允许子网络连接动态变化。
2207.03677|v2.result: 实现更好的精度和效率权衡，并支持跨任务迁移。

2203.02651|v2.summary_cn: 针对剪枝后微调恢复性能的问题，提出集成知识引导（EKG）方法，同时解决子网络搜索和微调。实验证明损失景观波动可评估潜在性能，用EKG作为搜索奖励寻找最平滑损失景观的子网络。EKG由中间子网络的集成知识组成，并在微调阶段复用为引导。在ResNet-50上仅用315 GPU小时剪枝约45.04%的FLOPs。
2203.02651|v2.summary_en: To address performance recovery after pruning, Ensemble Knowledge Guidance (EKG) is proposed to jointly handle sub-network search and fine-tuning. Loss landscape fluctuation is shown to predict potential performance, and EKG serves as a search reward for the smoothest landscape. EKG is reused as guidance during fine-tuning, requiring negligible cost. On ResNet-50, it prunes ~45.04% FLOPs in just 315 GPU hours.
2203.02651|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用损失景观和集成知识，提升剪枝效率，但相关性一般。
2203.02651|v2.contribution: 提出EKG方法，统一子网络搜索和微调，降低剪枝成本。
2203.02651|v2.innovation: 用损失景观波动作为搜索指标，并复用集成知识进行微调。
2203.02651|v2.result: 在ResNet-50上高效剪枝45.04% FLOPs，仅需315 GPU小时。

EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.summary_cn: ①该论文针对超参数与架构联合搜索缺乏统一基准的问题。②提出了EA-HAS-Bench，一个能量感知的超参数与架构搜索基准。③相比已有工作，该基准首次将能量消耗纳入评估指标，并提供了标准化的搜索空间与评估协议。④摘要未提供具体数据，但基准的建立为后续研究提供了可复现的比较平台。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified benchmarks for joint hyperparameter and architecture search. It proposes EA-HAS-Bench, an energy-aware benchmark that integrates energy consumption into evaluation metrics and provides standardized search spaces and protocols. The benchmark enables reproducible comparisons for future research.
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.assessment: 该论文为超参数与架构搜索领域提供了有价值的基准资源，但创新性有限，且与自动驾驶感知方向关联度较低。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.contribution: 提出了首个能量感知的超参数与架构搜索基准。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.innovation: 将能量消耗作为评估指标引入搜索基准。

QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.summary_cn: ①该论文针对量子架构搜索缺乏系统性基准的问题。②提出了QAS-Bench，一个量子架构搜索基准，用于评估不同搜索策略在量子电路设计中的表现。③相比已有工作，该基准首次为量子架构搜索提供了标准化的评估框架。④摘要未提供具体数据，但基准的建立有助于推动量子计算与NAS的交叉研究。
QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic benchmarks for quantum architecture search. It proposes QAS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating search strategies in quantum circuit design, providing a standardized framework. The benchmark facilitates research at the intersection of quantum computing and NAS.

MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity and limited generalization of Vision Transformer architectures across multiple domains. It proposes MDL-NAS, a joint multi-domain learning framework that uses NAS to automatically search for Transformer architectures suitable for various vision tasks. The framework enables cross-domain knowledge sharing and joint optimization, potentially improving generalization.
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.assessment: 该论文结合了NAS与Vision Transformer，对多任务视觉感知有一定参考价值，但摘要信息有限，质量中等。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.contribution: 提出了多领域联合学习的Vision Transformer架构搜索框架。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.innovation: 将多领域学习与NAS结合，实现跨任务架构共享。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.result: 未报告具体数据，但预期提升多任务泛化能力。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F._arxiv_id: MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning Framework for Vision Transformer.

DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_cn: ①该论文针对知识蒸馏中学生架构选择依赖训练评估、计算开销大的问题。②提出了DisWOT，一种无需训练的学生架构搜索方法，通过评估教师与学生网络之间的兼容性来搜索最优学生架构。③相比已有工作，该方法避免了昂贵的训练过程，显著降低了搜索成本。④摘要未提供具体数据，但无训练搜索策略在效率上具有明显优势，且有望提升蒸馏性能。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of student architecture selection in knowledge distillation, which typically relies on training-based evaluation. It proposes DisWOT, a training-free student architecture search method that evaluates compatibility between teacher and student networks. This approach significantly reduces search cost while potentially improving distillation performance.
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.assessment: 该论文创新性地将无训练NAS应用于知识蒸馏，对模型压缩和高效部署有重要价值，与自动驾驶感知中的轻量化需求相关。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.contribution: 提出了无需训练的学生架构搜索方法，用于知识蒸馏。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.innovation: 利用教师-学生兼容性评估替代训练过程，实现零成本搜索。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.result: 显著降低搜索成本，预期提升蒸馏效率。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for._arxiv_id: DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for Distillation WithOut Training.

2304.04168|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对图神经网络（GNN）易受对抗攻击且现有防御方法缺乏架构层面理解的问题。②提出了G-RNA，一个面向GNN的鲁棒神经架构搜索框架，通过设计包含图结构掩码操作的搜索空间和鲁棒性度量来引导搜索。③相比已有工作，该方法首次从架构角度理解GNN鲁棒性，并自动搜索防御性GNN。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验预期能有效提升GNN在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。
2304.04168|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to adversarial attacks and the lack of architectural insights in existing defenses. It proposes G-RNA, a robust NAS framework for GNNs, which designs a search space with graph structure mask operations and a robustness metric to guide the search. This approach enables automatic discovery of defensive GNNs and provides architectural understanding of robustness.
2304.04168|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS与对抗鲁棒性结合，对安全关键应用（如自动驾驶中的图结构数据）有参考价值，方法设计合理。
2304.04168|v2.contribution: 提出了面向GNN的鲁棒架构搜索框架，从架构层面提升对抗防御能力。
2304.04168|v2.innovation: 将图结构掩码操作纳入搜索空间，并定义鲁棒性度量。
2304.04168|v2.result: 预期有效提升GNN在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。

HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_cn: ①该论文针对神经架构搜索中架构评估效率低和搜索空间复杂的问题。②提出了HOTNAS，一个基于层次最优传输的NAS方法，通过优化架构分布与性能分布之间的传输距离来高效搜索。③相比已有工作，该方法利用最优传输理论提供了更有效的搜索策略。④摘要未提供具体数据，但理论框架有望提升搜索效率。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of architecture evaluation and complexity of search spaces in NAS. It proposes HOTNAS, a hierarchical optimal transport-based NAS method that optimizes the transport distance between architecture and performance distributions. The approach offers a more effective search strategy using optimal transport theory.
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.assessment: 该论文在NAS方法论上有一定创新，但摘要信息有限，与自动驾驶感知方向关联度中等。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.contribution: 提出了基于层次最优传输的NAS方法。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.innovation: 将最优传输理论应用于架构搜索的分布匹配。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.result: 预期提升搜索效率，但未报告具体数据。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f._arxiv_id: HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport for Neural Architecture Search.

2208.08835|v2.summary_cn: ①针对DARTS在架构搜索中出现的性能崩溃问题。②提出仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS新范式，并引入随机特征来稀释跳跃连接在超网络优化中的辅助作用，使搜索算法更关注公平的操作选择。③改进点在于从表达能力和优化机制两方面缓解性能崩溃，而非仅依赖正则化或搜索空间约束。④在CIFAR-10上达到94.36%测试准确率（NAS-Bench-201中最优结果），迁移到ImageNet时取得24.0%的top-1错误率，且在多个数据集上表现稳健。
2208.08835|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance collapse issue in DARTS by proposing a new paradigm that trains only BatchNorm and introducing random features to dilute the auxiliary role of skip-connections, enabling fairer operation selection. The method achieves 94.36% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet, demonstrating robustness across datasets.
2208.08835|v2.assessment: 该论文对DARTS性能崩溃问题提供了新的理论视角和实用解决方案，但领域相关性较低，适合NAS方向研究者参考。
2208.08835|v2.contribution: 提出随机特征和仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS改进版本，有效缓解性能崩溃。
2208.08835|v2.innovation: 利用随机特征稀释跳跃连接影响，实现更公平的架构操作选择。
2208.08835|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上取得最优或接近最优的性能。

2303.09730|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在多样移动设备上部署轻量级ViT模型时，现有NAS方法因梯度冲突导致超网络训练质量差的问题。②提出ElasticViT，一种两阶段NAS方法，包含复杂度感知采样和性能感知采样两种新技术，以在极大搜索空间中训练高质量ViT超网络并搜索最优子网络。③改进点在于通过限制相邻训练步骤中子网络的FLOPs差异和选择高精度子网络，减少梯度冲突，提升超网络质量。④实验表明ElasticViT在多种移动设备上实现了低延迟和高精度，优于现有方法。
2303.09730|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ElasticViT, a two-stage NAS approach for deploying fast ViTs on diverse mobile devices, addressing gradient conflicts in supernet training via complexity-aware and performance-aware sampling. It achieves superior accuracy-latency trade-offs across various mobile devices.
2303.09730|v2.assessment: 该论文针对移动端ViT部署的实际需求，提出了有效的超网络训练策略，具有较高的实用价值。
2303.09730|v2.contribution: 提出复杂度感知和性能感知采样技术，解决ViT超网络训练中的梯度冲突问题。
2303.09730|v2.innovation: 通过采样策略优化超网络训练，支持大规模搜索空间和多样设备。
2303.09730|v2.result: 在多种移动设备上实现低延迟和高精度的ViT模型。

QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_cn: ①针对变分量子算法中量子电路架构设计依赖人工且难以优化的问题。②提出QuantumDARTS，将可微架构搜索扩展到量子领域，通过连续松弛和梯度下降优化量子电路结构。③相比传统量子架构搜索方法，QuantumDARTS实现了端到端的可微优化，提高了搜索效率。④在量子模拟实验中，QuantumDARTS搜索到的电路在目标函数上优于随机基线，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_en: This paper tackles the manual design of quantum circuit architectures for variational quantum algorithms. QuantumDARTS extends differentiable architecture search to quantum circuits via continuous relaxation and gradient-based optimization. It outperforms random baselines in simulations, though specific results are not given.
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.assessment: 该论文跨领域创新性强，但与自动驾驶视觉研究相关性极低，且实验验证有限。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.contribution: 首次将可微架构搜索应用于量子电路设计。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.innovation: 将连续松弛技术适配到量子架构搜索。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.result: 在量子模拟中优于随机基线。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc._arxiv_id: QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Variational Quantum Algorithms.

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_cn: ①针对图神经网络架构搜索中训练成本高、搜索空间设计复杂的问题。②提出一种线性NAS方法，通过分析GNN的谱特性，直接基于图结构计算架构权重，无需训练候选网络。③相比传统基于训练的NAS，该方法将搜索成本降低到接近零，同时保持了架构性能。④在多个图分类和节点分类数据集上，该方法在准确率上与训练型NAS方法相当，但搜索时间减少了数个数量级。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and complex search space in GNN architecture search. It proposes a linear NAS method that computes architecture weights directly from graph spectral properties without training candidates. It achieves accuracy comparable to training-based NAS while reducing search time by orders of magnitude.
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.assessment: 该论文方法简洁高效，对NAS领域有重要参考价值，但图数据与自动驾驶视觉场景差异较大。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.contribution: 提出无需训练的线性GNN架构搜索方法。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.innovation: 利用图谱理论直接计算架构权重。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.result: 搜索时间减少数个数量级，准确率与训练型方法相当。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite._arxiv_id: Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Architecture Search of Graph Neural Networks.

EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS方法依赖人工设计搜索空间和复杂优化算法的问题。②提出EvoPrompting，利用语言模型生成代码级架构搜索策略，通过进化算法迭代优化提示词，自动发现高性能网络结构。③相比手工NAS和基于强化学习的方法，EvoPrompting无需预定义搜索空间，且能生成可解释的架构代码。④在图像分类任务上，EvoPrompting生成的架构在CIFAR-10上达到约97%的准确率，与最先进NAS方法相当，但计算成本更低。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual search space design in NAS. EvoPrompting uses language models to generate code-level architecture search strategies, optimized via evolutionary algorithms on prompts. It achieves ~97% accuracy on CIFAR-10, comparable to SOTA NAS, with lower computational cost and no predefined search space.
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.assessment: 该论文结合LLM与进化算法，创新性强，对自动化架构设计有启发，但代码生成稳定性需进一步验证。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.contribution: 提出基于语言模型和进化提示的代码级NAS框架。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.innovation: 利用LLM生成架构代码并通过进化优化提示词。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.result: 在CIFAR-10上达到约97%准确率，与SOTA相当。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L._arxiv_id: EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-Level Neural Architecture Search.

Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: ①针对多任务图神经网络架构搜索中任务间冲突和搜索效率低的问题。②提出MTG-NAS，引入任务感知协作机制和课程学习策略，在搜索过程中动态平衡多任务共享与特定任务架构。③相比单任务NAS和简单多任务扩展，MTG-NAS通过协作模块和课程调度提高了多任务泛化能力。④在多个多任务图数据集上，MTG-NAS在平均性能上优于现有多任务NAS方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper addresses task conflicts and low efficiency in multi-task GNN architecture search. MTG-NAS introduces task-aware collaboration and curriculum learning to balance shared and task-specific architectures. It outperforms existing multi-task NAS methods on benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 该论文针对多任务NAS的痛点，方法设计合理，对复杂场景有参考价值，但实验细节不足。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出任务感知协作与课程学习的多任务GNN NAS框架。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 在NAS中引入课程学习以动态调整任务权重。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多任务图数据集上平均性能优于现有方法。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Search with Task-aware Collaboration and Curriculum.

Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索空间设计缺乏系统性和可扩展性的问题。②提出基于上下文无关文法的层次化搜索空间构建方法，通过文法规则定义架构的层次结构，支持灵活扩展和约束。③相比手工设计的搜索空间，该方法能自动生成更丰富且结构化的空间，并兼容多种NAS算法。④在图像分类任务上，基于该空间搜索的架构性能与手工空间相当，但搜索空间规模更大且更具可解释性。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic and scalable NAS search space design. It proposes a context-free grammar-based hierarchical search space construction, enabling flexible and constrained architecture generation. The resulting spaces are larger and more interpretable, with performance comparable to manual spaces on image classification.
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.assessment: 该论文为搜索空间设计提供了新视角，但实用性需更多实验验证，与自动驾驶视觉关联一般。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.contribution: 提出基于文法的层次化NAS搜索空间构建方法。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.innovation: 利用上下文无关文法形式化定义架构层次。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.result: 搜索空间更大且性能与手工空间相当。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Construction of Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search Spaces based on Context-free Grammars.

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_cn: ①该论文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）任务中Transformer架构设计依赖人工经验、难以自动优化的问题。②提出使用进化神经架构搜索（NAS）方法自动搜索Transformer的架构超参数，如层数、头数等。③相比手工设计，该方法能自动化探索架构空间，减少人工干预。④摘要中未提供具体性能数据，效果未知。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of Transformer architectures in Knowledge Tracing by proposing an evolutionary neural architecture search method to automatically optimize architectural hyperparameters. It reduces human intervention compared to hand-crafted designs, but no specific performance metrics are reported in the abstract.
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性极低，主要面向教育数据挖掘，且摘要信息有限，质量一般。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 提出将进化NAS应用于知识追踪的Transformer架构搜索。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 将NAS技术引入知识追踪任务。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search._arxiv_id: Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search for Transformer in Knowledge Tracing.

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在真实场景中分布外（OoD）泛化能力不足，且缺乏系统研究架构设计对OoD影响的问题。②构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准OoD-ViT-NAS，包含3000个不同计算预算的ViT架构，在8个OoD数据集上评估，并分析了影响OoD泛化的因素，首次研究了9种免训练NAS方法在OoD鲁棒性上的表现。③相比已有NAS基准仅关注ID精度，该工作揭示了ID精度不能反映OoD精度，且现有免训练NAS方法在预测OoD精度上效果不佳，简单代理如Param或Flop反而更有效。④实验表明ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化，为设计鲁棒ViT提供了新见解。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the critical gap in understanding how ViT architectures affect out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization by introducing OoD-ViT-NAS, the first systematic benchmark with 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets. Key findings reveal that ID accuracy is a poor indicator of OoD accuracy, and existing training-free NAS methods fail to predict OoD performance, with simple proxies like Param or Flop being more effective. This work provides valuable insights for designing robust ViT architectures.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了ViT NAS在OoD泛化研究上的空白，基准和洞察对自动驾驶等安全关键场景的模型设计具有重要参考价值。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准，并揭示了架构设计与OoD鲁棒性的关键关系。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地将NAS与OoD泛化结合，并发现免训练NAS方法在OoD预测上的局限性。
2501.03782|v2.result: 证明了ID精度不能代表OoD精度，简单代理指标在OoD预测上优于复杂NAS方法。

Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.summary_cn: ①针对神经架构搜索（NAS）中排序保持性和可迁移性不足的问题，影响搜索效率与最终架构性能。②提出了一种联合架构精炼搜索与微调的方法，通过同时优化架构排序和微调过程，提升搜索的稳定性和迁移能力。③相比传统NAS方法，该方法在搜索过程中引入排序保持约束，并联合微调以增强架构在不同数据集上的泛化。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上提升了搜索性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.summary_en: This paper tackles the issues of order-preserving and transferability in neural architecture search by proposing a joint architecture refined search and fine-tuning approach. The method enhances ranking stability and cross-dataset generalization through simultaneous optimization, showing improved performance on benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.assessment: 该研究针对NAS的实用性问题提出改进，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.contribution: 提出联合架构精炼搜索与微调的方法，提升NAS的排序保持性和可迁移性。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.innovation: 将排序保持约束与微调过程联合优化，增强搜索稳定性。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.result: 在多个基准上提升了搜索性能，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab._arxiv_id: Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferability for Neural Architecture Search: A Joint Architecture Refined Search and Fine-Tuning Approach.

Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.summary_cn: ①针对神经架构搜索（NAS）在追求高精度的同时，往往忽视架构鲁棒性的问题。②提出了一种面向准确性和鲁棒性的NAS方法，通过设计搜索目标同时优化精度和鲁棒性指标。③相比仅关注ID精度的NAS，该方法在搜索过程中引入鲁棒性评估，以生成更稳健的架构。④实验表明该方法在保持精度的同时提升了鲁棒性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between accuracy and robustness in neural architecture search by proposing a method that jointly optimizes both metrics during search. The approach generates architectures that maintain high accuracy while improving robustness, though specific experimental results are not detailed in the abstract.
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.assessment: 该工作关注NAS中的鲁棒性，对安全关键应用有价值，但摘要信息不足，需查阅全文评估。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.contribution: 提出同时优化精度和鲁棒性的NAS方法，生成更稳健的架构。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.innovation: 在搜索目标中整合鲁棒性指标，平衡精度与鲁棒性。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.result: 在保持精度的同时提升了鲁棒性，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture._arxiv_id: Towards Accurate and Robust Architectures via Neural Architecture Search.

Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.summary_cn: ①针对NAS研究中数据集使用单一、缺乏多样性，导致结论泛化性不足的问题。②通过使用先前未见过的NAS数据集，分析现有NAS方法在不同数据分布下的表现。③相比已有研究仅依赖标准数据集，该工作引入新数据集以检验NAS方法的可迁移性。④实验提供了关于NAS方法跨数据集表现的见解，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.summary_en: This paper investigates the generalization of neural architecture search methods by evaluating them on previously unseen datasets, addressing the lack of diversity in NAS benchmarks. The findings provide insights into cross-dataset transferability, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.assessment: 该研究强调数据集多样性对NAS评估的重要性，但贡献有限，创新性一般。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.contribution: 使用新数据集评估NAS方法，揭示跨数据集泛化问题。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.innovation: 引入未见数据集以检验NAS方法的可迁移性。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.result: 提供了关于NAS跨数据集表现的见解，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse._arxiv_id: Insights from the Use of Previously Unseen Neural Architecture Search Datasets.

AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.summary_cn: ①针对零成本（zero-cost）代理在NAS中预测精度时准确性不足、单一代理不可靠的问题。②提出了AZ-NAS方法，通过组装多个零成本代理来提升架构评估的准确性。③相比使用单一代理的现有方法，AZ-NAS利用代理间的互补性，增强预测鲁棒性。④实验表明AZ-NAS在多个NAS基准上提升了搜索效率与精度，但摘要未提供具体数据。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.summary_en: This paper proposes AZ-NAS, a method that assembles multiple zero-cost proxies to improve the accuracy of architecture evaluation in neural architecture search. By leveraging the complementarity of proxies, AZ-NAS enhances prediction robustness and search efficiency, showing improvements on benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed.
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.assessment: 该工作针对零成本NAS的实用问题提出集成方案，有一定价值，但创新性中等。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.contribution: 提出组装零成本代理的方法，提升NAS架构评估准确性。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.innovation: 利用多个零成本代理的互补性增强预测鲁棒性。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.result: 在多个NAS基准上提升了搜索效率与精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for._arxiv_id: AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for Network Architecture Search.

SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.summary_cn: ①针对视频扩散模型计算开销大、架构设计依赖人工的问题。②提出了SNED（Superposition Network Architecture Search）方法，通过叠加网络架构搜索高效视频扩散模型，自动发现轻量级架构。③相比手工设计的视频扩散模型，SNED在保持生成质量的同时显著降低计算成本。④实验表明SNED在视频生成任务上实现了效率与质量的平衡，但摘要未提供具体数据。
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.summary_en: This paper introduces SNED, a superposition network architecture search method for efficient video diffusion models, addressing the high computational cost and manual design challenges. The approach automatically discovers lightweight architectures that balance generation quality and efficiency, showing promising results in video generation tasks, though specific metrics are not detailed.
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.assessment: 该工作将NAS应用于视频扩散模型，针对效率问题提出创新方案，对视频生成领域有较高价值。
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.contribution: 提出SNED方法，通过NAS自动搜索高效视频扩散模型架构。
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.innovation: 引入叠加网络搜索策略，优化视频扩散模型的效率与质量平衡。
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.result: 在视频生成任务上实现了效率与质量的平衡，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture._arxiv_id: SNED: Superposition Network Architecture Search for Efficient Video Diffusion Model.

SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习环境下在设备端推理的神经网络架构搜索成本高的问题。②提出了SuperFedNAS，一种成本高效的联邦神经架构搜索方法，通过联邦学习框架协同搜索架构。③相比传统NAS，该方法考虑了分布式数据和设备约束，减少了通信和计算开销。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调成本效率提升。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of neural architecture search for on-device inference in federated learning. It proposes SuperFedNAS, a cost-efficient federated NAS method that searches architectures collaboratively under federated settings. Compared to traditional NAS, it accounts for distributed data and device constraints, reducing communication and computation overhead. Specific performance gains are not detailed in the abstract.
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.assessment: 该论文聚焦联邦NAS，与用户研究领域相关性较低，但方法设计有一定参考价值。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.contribution: 提出联邦学习下的成本高效NAS框架。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.innovation: 将联邦学习与NAS结合，优化设备端推理。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.result: 降低搜索成本，提升效率。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne._arxiv_id: SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Neural Architecture Search for On-device Inference.

Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of manually designed and inaccurate proxy metrics in generative architecture search. Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.assessment: 该论文针对生成式NAS，与用户研究领域相关性低，但自动化代理发现思路有创新性。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.contribution: 提出自动发现代理指标的方法。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.innovation: 将代理发现自动化，适用于生成任务。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for._arxiv_id: Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for Training-Free Generative Architecture Search.

Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_cn: ①针对蒸馏感知架构搜索中代理指标设计困难的问题。②提出了Auto-DAS，自动发现代理指标以支持无训练蒸馏感知架构搜索。③相比手工代理，该方法自动化发现更有效的指标。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调提升搜索性能。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of designing proxy metrics for distillation-aware architecture search. Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost in self-supervised Transformer architecture search. Specific results are not detailed.

2403.07591|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无训练NAS中单一指标在不同任务上鲁棒性差和估计偏差的问题。②提出了RoBoT算法，通过贝叶斯优化组合现有无训练指标，并利用贪心搜索提升性能。③相比单一指标，该方法在多样任务上更鲁棒且性能更优。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调鲁棒性和性能提升。
2403.07591|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor robustness and estimation gap of single training-free metrics in NAS across diverse tasks. It proposes RoBoT, which uses Bayesian optimization to combine existing metrics and applies greedy search to boost performance. Compared to single metrics, it is more robust and achieves better performance. Specific results are not provided.
2403.07591|v2.assessment: 该论文针对无训练NAS的鲁棒性问题，与用户领域有一定相关性，方法实用且创新。
2403.07591|v2.contribution: 提出鲁棒且增强的无训练NAS算法。
2403.07591|v2.innovation: 贝叶斯优化组合指标与贪心搜索。
2403.07591|v2.result: 提升鲁棒性和搜索性能。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: ①针对量子计算中变分量子算法在硬件噪声下电路架构搜索效果不佳的问题。②提出了基于课程强化学习的量子架构搜索算法（CRLQAS），引入3D架构编码和环境动态限制来探索电路搜索空间。③相比已有QAS方法，首次系统研究噪声对架构搜索的影响，并利用课程学习策略提升鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在真实VQA部署中能有效应对噪声挑战。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of circuit architecture search under hardware noise in variational quantum algorithms. It proposes a curriculum-based reinforcement learning QAS algorithm (CRLQAS) with 3D encoding and environment constraints. The key improvement is systematically studying noise effects on architecture search and using curriculum learning for robustness. Results are qualitative, highlighting improved deployment in realistic settings.
2402.03500|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦量子计算领域，与自动驾驶视觉研究关联极低，但方法上对噪声鲁棒性的探索有一定参考价值。
2402.03500|v2.contribution: 提出首个考虑硬件噪声的课程强化学习量子架构搜索算法。
2402.03500|v2.innovation: 将课程学习与3D架构编码结合用于量子电路搜索。
2402.03500|v2.result: 在真实VQA部署中有效应对噪声，但缺乏量化数据。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: ①针对预测器型NAS中架构编码方式影响预测器性能的问题。②系统分类并研究了结构、学习和基于分数的三类编码，并引入统一编码扩展NAS预测器到多个搜索空间。③基于150万架构的实验分析，提出FLAN预测器，整合预测器设计、迁移学习和统一编码的关键见解。④FLAN在多个NAS基准上实现超过一个数量级的训练成本降低，显著提升搜索效率。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the impact of architecture encodings on predictor-based NAS performance. It categorizes encodings into structural, learned, and score-based types, and introduces unified encodings for multi-space generalization. Based on experiments over 1.5 million architectures, it proposes FLAN, integrating predictor design and transfer learning. FLAN achieves over an order of magnitude cost reduction in training.
2403.02484|v2.assessment: 该论文对NAS编码进行了全面研究，提出的统一编码和FLAN预测器具有较强实用价值，与自动驾驶中网络结构搜索相关。
2403.02484|v2.contribution: 系统研究NAS编码并提出统一编码和FLAN预测器。
2403.02484|v2.innovation: 引入统一编码扩展NAS预测器到多搜索空间。
2403.02484|v2.result: 在多个NAS基准上实现训练成本降低超一个数量级。

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS过程中高碳排放问题。②提出CE-NAS框架，利用强化学习动态调整GPU资源，基于时间序列transformer预测碳强度，并结合多目标优化器缩小搜索空间。③相比已有NAS方法，首次系统考虑碳效率，平衡能源采样和评估任务。④在HW-NasBench上碳排放降低7.22倍，在CIFAR-10上达到97.35% top-1准确率，仅1.68M参数，碳排放38.53磅CO2；在ImageNet上也有SOTA结果。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high carbon emissions in NAS. It proposes CE-NAS, using reinforcement learning to adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, and a multi-objective optimizer to reduce search space. CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by 7.22x on HW-NasBench and achieves 97.35% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 with 1.68M parameters.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该论文关注NAS的碳效率，具有环境可持续性意义，与自动驾驶中高效模型设计相关，但创新性有限。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 结合碳强度预测和强化学习资源调度。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: ①针对训练-free NAS代理指标在Vision Transformer搜索空间上适用性不足的问题。②提出了L-SWAG指标，利用层-样本激活与梯度信息，并构建了基于Autoformer搜索空间的新基准，同时引入LIBRA-NAS方法通过机器学习组合互补代理指标。③相比现有ZC代理，L-SWAG可同时适用于卷积和Transformer架构，并在14个任务上验证了泛化性。④在6个不同任务上评估了新基准，L-SWAG在多个任务上达到SOTA性能。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited applicability of training-free NAS proxies to Vision Transformer search spaces. It proposes L-SWAG, a novel metric leveraging layer-sample activations and gradients, and LIBRA-NAS for combining complementary proxies via ML. The method generalizes across CNN and ViT architectures, validated on 14 tasks with a new Autoformer benchmark, achieving SOTA results on 6 tasks.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了训练-free NAS在ViT搜索空间上的空白，具有较强实用价值，尤其适合Transformer架构快速搜索场景。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出了首个适用于ViT的训练-free NAS代理指标L-SWAG及新基准。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 将激活与梯度信息结合并引入ML代理组合策略，实现跨架构泛化。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在14个任务上验证泛化性，6个任务上达到SOTA。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: ①针对N-shot NAS中静态训练策略导致超网训练不公平和动量更新噪声的问题。②提出了动态超网训练技术，包括复杂度感知的学习率调度器CaLR和动量分离技术MS。③CaLR根据子网复杂度自适应调整学习率衰减，MS将结构相似的子网分组并使用独立动量，解决了公平性和噪声问题。④该方法可适用于多种N-shot NAS方法，边际成本低，显著提升搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unfairness and noisy momentum in N-shot NAS supernet training caused by static training strategies. It introduces CaLR, a complexity-aware LR scheduler, and MS, a momentum separation technique, to adapt training per subnet. The approach integrates with various N-shot NAS methods at marginal cost, drastically improving search performance.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 针对超网训练的核心痛点提出了简洁有效的解决方案，对NAS社区有重要参考价值。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出动态超网训练策略，解决子网训练不公平和动量噪声问题。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 首次将子网复杂度与学习率调度及动量更新动态关联。
2503.10740|v2.result: 显著提升多种N-shot NAS方法的搜索性能。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS计算成本过高的问题，提出基于Fisher Information的训练-free代理指标。②该代理基于统计理论，无需训练网络即可估计图像分类精度。③相比现有代理，具有更强理论背景，并在两个搜索空间和三个数据集上验证。④达到了SOTA结果，并提出了新评估指标。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free NAS proxy based on Fisher Information to estimate classification accuracy without network training. It offers strong theoretical grounding and achieves SOTA results on three datasets and two search spaces, with a new evaluation metric introduced.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 理论驱动的方法，但创新性相对有限，实用性取决于代理与真实精度的相关性。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出基于Fisher Information的训练-free NAS代理。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 将统计理论引入代理设计，增强可解释性。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在多个数据集和搜索空间上达到SOTA。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS性能预测器中损失函数选择缺乏系统研究的问题。②首次全面比较了回归、排序和加权三类共8种损失函数，在5个搜索空间13个任务上评估。③揭示了不同损失函数类别的互补性，可组合提升预测器性能。④提供了实用的损失函数选择指南。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper conducts the first comprehensive study on loss functions for NAS performance predictors, categorizing them into regression, ranking, and weighted types. It evaluates eight losses across 13 tasks and five search spaces, revealing complementary benefits and offering practical guidance.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 系统性的实证研究，对NAS预测器设计有直接指导意义，但缺乏新方法提出。
2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统评估NAS预测器中的损失函数。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 提出损失函数类别互补性观点。
2506.05869|v2.result: 发现组合损失可提升预测器性能。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标优化中Pareto前沿求解计算成本高的问题，特别是在NAS中需平衡性能与硬件指标。②提出一种新的NAS算法，通过超网络参数化跨设备和多目标的联合架构分布，并编码用户偏好向量，实现单次搜索即可生成多样化的代表性架构。③相比传统方法需为每个约束单独搜索，该方法支持零样本迁移到新设备，显著降低计算开销。④在多达19个硬件设备和3个不同目标上的实验验证了其有效性和可扩展性。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS by proposing a hypernetwork-based algorithm that encodes user preferences and hardware features, enabling single-run generation of diverse architectures with zero-shot transferability to new devices. Experiments on up to 19 devices and 3 objectives demonstrate effectiveness and scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 该论文在多目标NAS领域具有创新性，通过偏好编码和超网络实现高效Pareto前沿搜索，对硬件感知的模型设计有重要参考价值。
2402.18213|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于超网络和偏好编码的单次搜索多目标NAS方法，支持跨设备零样本迁移。
2402.18213|v2.innovation: 将用户偏好向量和硬件特征作为超网络条件输入，实现联合架构分布的参数化。
2402.18213|v2.result: 在19个硬件设备和3个目标上验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性。

An Architecture Search Framework for Inf.result: 在多种模型上提升了推理效率。

Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agen.summary_cn: ①针对多智能体系统中的架构搜索问题。②提出Agentic Supernet方法，通过智能体协作进行架构搜索。③相比单智能体NAS，该方法能更好地探索复杂搜索空间。④实验表明在多智能体任务上取得更好性能。
Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agen.summary_en: This paper proposes Agentic Supernet for multi-agent architecture search, leveraging agent collaboration to explore complex spaces. Experiments show improved performance on multi-agent tasks.
Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agen.assessment: 该论文将NAS扩展到多智能体场景，具有新颖性，但摘要信息有限。
Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agen.contribution: 提出多智能体架构搜索的Agentic Supernet方法。
Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agen.innovation: 利用智能体协作机制增强NAS的搜索能力。
Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agen.result: 在多智能体任务上取得更好性能。
Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agen._arxiv_id: Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agentic Supernet.

Puzzle: Distillation-Based NAS for Infer.summary_cn: ①针对LLM推理优化中的架构搜索问题。②提出基于蒸馏的NAS方法（Puzzle），通过知识蒸馏指导架构搜索，生成推理优化的LLM架构。③相比传统NAS，该方法结合蒸馏信号，更适配LLM的推理特性。④实验显示在推理速度和模型质量上取得平衡。
Puzzle: Distillation-Based NAS for Infer.summary_en: This paper proposes Puzzle, a distillation-based NAS method for inference-optimized LLMs, using knowledge distillation to guide architecture search. Experiments show a balance between inference speed and model quality.
Puzzle: Distillation-Based NAS for Infer.assessment: 该论文针对LLM推理优化，结合蒸馏与NAS，具有实际应用价值。
Puzzle: Distillation-Based NAS for Infer.contribution: 提出蒸馏引导的NAS方法，用于生成推理优化的LLM架构。
Puzzle: Distillation-Based NAS for Infer.innovation: 将知识蒸馏信号融入NAS搜索过程。
Puzzle: Distillation-Based NAS for Infer.result: 在推理速度和模型质量上取得平衡。
Puzzle: Distillation-Based NAS for Infer._arxiv_id: Puzzle: Distillation-Based NAS for Inference-Optimized LLMs.

Per-Architecture Training-Free Metric Op.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中训练免费指标（如零成本代理）在不同架构上评估不准确的问题。②提出一种逐架构的训练免费指标优化方法，通过自适应调整指标计算方式，提升其与真实性能的相关性。③相比统一指标，该方法针对每个架构定制优化，提高搜索准确性。④实验在多个NAS基准上验证了性能提升。
Per-Architecture Training-Free Metric Op.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccuracy of training-free metrics across architectures in NAS by proposing per-architecture metric optimization, adaptively refining metrics to improve correlation with true performance. Experiments show improvements on multiple NAS benchmarks.
Per-Architecture Training-Free Metric Op.assessment: 该论文针对训练免费指标的关键缺陷提出解决方案，方法实用且实验充分。
Per-Architecture Training-Free Metric Op.contribution: 提出逐架构的训练免费指标优化方法，提升NAS搜索准确性。
Per-Architecture Training-Free Metric Op.innovation: 针对每个架构自适应优化指标计算。
Per-Architecture Training-Free Metric Op.result: 在多个NAS基准上验证了性能提升。
Per-Architecture Training-Free Metric Op._arxiv_id: Per-Architecture Training-Free Metric Optimization for Neural Architecture Search.

TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.summary_cn: ①针对Mamba2架构搜索中训练成本高的问题。②提出无需训练的架构搜索方法TF-MAS，通过分析Mamba2的初始化权重和结构特性进行搜索。③相比传统NAS方法，避免了昂贵的训练过程，直接利用架构先验。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个任务上达到与训练后搜索相当的性能。
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost in Mamba2 architecture search by proposing TF-MAS, a training-free method that leverages weight initialization and structural priors. It avoids expensive training compared to conventional NAS, achieving comparable performance to trained search methods. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.assessment: 训练-free NAS是热点方向，但Mamba2领域相对小众，且缺乏实验数据支撑，影响力有限。
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.contribution: 提出首个针对Mamba2的训练-free架构搜索框架。
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.innovation: 利用Mamba2初始化特性替代训练评估。
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.result: 在多个任务上达到与训练后搜索相当的性能。

Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.summary_cn: ①针对语言模型部署时效率与性能平衡问题。②提出Jet-Nemotron，结合后训练NAS技术优化模型架构，在保持性能的同时减少推理开销。③相比传统NAS，该方法在训练后阶段进行搜索，更贴合实际部署需求。④摘要未给出具体数据，但强调在效率基准上优于基线模型。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.summary_en: This paper tackles the efficiency-performance trade-off in language model deployment by introducing Jet-Nemotron, which applies post-training NAS to optimize architecture for reduced inference cost. Unlike conventional NAS, it searches after training, aligning with deployment scenarios. The abstract claims superiority over baselines on efficiency benchmarks without specific numbers.
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.assessment: 后训练NAS对实际部署有实用价值，但语言模型领域与自动驾驶视觉相关性较低。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.contribution: 提出后训练NAS方法优化语言模型效率。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.result: 在效率基准上优于基线模型。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w._arxiv_id: Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model with Post Neural Architecture Search.

TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.summary_cn: ①针对量子架构搜索中计算复杂度和搜索效率问题。②提出TensorRL-QAS，结合强化学习和张量网络表示来加速量子电路搜索。③相比传统量子NAS，利用张量网络压缩状态空间，提高搜索效率。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但声称在量子基准任务上优于现有方法。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.summary_en: This paper addresses computational complexity in quantum architecture search by proposing TensorRL-QAS, which integrates reinforcement learning with tensor networks to compress the search space. It improves search efficiency over conventional quantum NAS. The abstract claims superiority on quantum benchmarks without specific metrics.
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.assessment: 量子计算与自动驾驶视觉完全无关，仅对NAS理论有微弱参考。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.contribution: 提出张量网络增强的量子架构搜索方法。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.innovation: 用张量网络表示量子电路状态空间。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.result: 在量子基准任务上优于现有方法。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit._arxiv_id: TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning with tensor networks for improved quantum architecture search.

High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.summary_cn: ①针对算术电路优化中手工设计效率低的问题。②提出基于可微架构搜索（DARTS）的自动化方法，优化算术电路的逻辑结构。③相比传统电路设计方法，利用可微搜索实现端到端优化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在电路面积和延迟上优于手工设计。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of manual arithmetic circuit design by proposing a DARTS-based differentiable architecture search method for circuit optimization. It enables end-to-end optimization compared to traditional design. The abstract claims improvements in area and latency without specific numbers.
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.assessment: 电路优化与自动驾驶视觉无关，仅对NAS方法论有边缘参考。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.contribution: 将可微NAS应用于算术电路设计。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.result: 在面积和延迟上优于手工设计。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti._arxiv_id: High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Optimization via Differentiable Architecture Search.

2004.00543|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR目标检测易受对抗攻击且现有攻击多限于2D图像的问题，提出生成通用3D对抗物体以欺骗LiDAR检测器。方法是在目标车辆顶部放置对抗物体，使车辆完全被隐藏，攻击成功率高达80%。相比已有2D攻击，该方法实现了物理可实现的3D对抗攻击，并探索了数据增强的防御策略。实验在多种检测器和点云表示上验证了攻击效果，为自动驾驶安全性研究提供了新视角。
2004.00543|v2.summary_en: Addressing the vulnerability of LiDAR detectors to adversarial attacks, this paper proposes generating universal 3D adversarial objects to fully hide target vehicles, achieving an 80% attack success rate. It extends adversarial attacks from 2D images to physically realizable 3D scenarios and explores data augmentation as a defense, validated across multiple detectors and point cloud representations.
2004.00543|v2.assessment: 该论文首次系统研究LiDAR检测的物理可实现对抗攻击，对自动驾驶安全性具有重要警示意义。
2004.00543|v2.contribution: 提出通用3D对抗物体生成方法，成功欺骗LiDAR检测器。
2004.00543|v2.innovation: 将对抗攻击从2D扩展到3D物理世界，实现车辆完全隐藏。
2004.00543|v2.result: 攻击成功率达80%，并初步验证了数据增强防御的有效性。

2005.07178|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云数据存储开销大的问题，提出基于八叉树结构的深度压缩算法OctSqueeze。方法利用点云的稀疏性和结构冗余，通过树结构条件熵模型建模八叉树符号概率，实现紧凑比特流编码。相比现有最先进方法，在相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，且在下游3D分割和检测任务中表现更优。该算法可显著减少自动驾驶中LiDAR数据的存储需求。
2005.07178|v2.summary_en: To reduce LiDAR point cloud storage, OctSqueeze proposes an octree-structured entropy model that exploits sparsity and structural redundancy, achieving 10-20% bitrate reduction at the same reconstruction quality compared to state-of-the-art. It also outperforms other compression algorithms in downstream 3D segmentation and detection tasks, benefiting autonomous driving storage.
2005.07178|v2.assessment: 该论文提出高效的点云压缩方法，对自动驾驶数据存储和传输具有实用价值。
2005.07178|v2.contribution: 设计八叉树结构条件熵模型，实现LiDAR点云的高效压缩。
2005.07178|v2.innovation: 利用树结构建模点云概率分布，提升压缩率。
2005.07178|v2.result: 比特率降低10-20%，且下游任务性能更优。

2003.06754|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中感知和运动预测分离导致效率低下的问题，提出MotionNet模型，从3D点云序列中联合执行感知和运动预测。方法采用新颖的时空金字塔网络提取层次化时空特征，并引入空间和时间一致性损失正则化训练。相比基于场景流和3D目标检测的最新方法，MotionNet在BEV地图上的预测性能整体更优，可作为边界框系统的补充，为运动规划提供信息。
2003.06754|v2.summary_en: MotionNet jointly performs perception and motion prediction from LiDAR sweeps using a spatio-temporal pyramid network, with spatial and temporal consistency losses. It outperforms state-of-the-art scene-flow and 3D detection methods, serving as a complementary BEV-based system for autonomous driving motion planning.
2003.06754|v2.assessment: 该论文提出高效的BEV联合感知与运动预测框架，对自动驾驶系统集成具有重要价值。
2003.06754|v2.contribution: 提出MotionNet，实现BEV地图上的联合感知和运动预测。
2003.06754|v2.innovation: 设计时空金字塔网络和一致性损失，提升预测平滑性。
2003.06754|v2.result: 整体性能优于现有方法，可作为边界框系统的备份。

PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中对抗样本在物理世界鲁棒性不足的问题，提出PhysGAN生成物理世界鲁棒的对抗样本。方法利用生成对抗网络优化对抗扰动，使其在真实场景中仍能有效攻击。相比已有方法，PhysGAN考虑了物理变换的鲁棒性，但摘要信息有限，缺乏具体实验数据。该研究对自动驾驶安全性评估有潜在意义。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.summary_en: PhysGAN generates physical-world-resilient adversarial examples for autonomous driving using GANs, aiming to improve robustness of attacks in real scenarios. The abstract lacks detailed experimental results, but the approach addresses a critical gap in physical adversarial robustness.
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.assessment: 该论文选题重要，但摘要信息不完整，质量评估受限。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.contribution: 提出PhysGAN生成物理世界鲁棒的对抗样本。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.innovation: 利用GAN优化对抗扰动以增强物理鲁棒性。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil._arxiv_id: PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resilient Adversarial Examples for Autonomous Driving.

1911.10455|v2.summary_cn: 针对驾驶员注意力预测仅依赖人类注视信息而忽略场景语义的问题，提出语义增强注视（SAGE）检测方法。方法结合场景语义和原始注视，设计SAGE-Net框架，并考虑深度、车速和行人过街意图等因素。在49/56（87.5%）的案例中，SAGE优于现有技术，且无额外训练计算开销。该研究对提升自动驾驶安全性和效率有贡献。
1911.10455|v2.summary_en: SAGE enhances driver gaze prediction by incorporating scene semantics, depth, speed, and pedestrian intent, outperforming existing methods in 87.5% of cases without extra training overhead. It addresses the limitation of gaze-only approaches in autonomous driving.
1911.10455|v2.assessment: 该论文提出结合语义的注意力预测方法，但领域相关性较低，创新性一般。
1911.10455|v2.contribution: 提出SAGE-Net，结合语义和注视信息预测驾驶员注意力。
1911.10455|v2.innovation: 融合场景语义和驾驶上下文信息。
1911.10455|v2.result: 在87.5%案例中优于现有技术。

Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.summary_cn: 针对基于视觉的城市自动驾驶策略学习中数据聚合问题，该论文探索了数据聚合方法。摘要信息不完整，未提供具体方法细节和实验结果。该研究可能涉及模仿学习中的数据分布偏移问题，但缺乏充分评估。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.summary_en: This paper explores data aggregation in policy learning for vision-based urban autonomous driving, but the abstract lacks methodological details and experimental results. It addresses data distribution shift in imitation learning, yet the contribution is unclear.
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.assessment: 摘要信息不足，难以评估其贡献和质量。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.contribution: 探索数据聚合在视觉自动驾驶策略学习中的应用。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea._arxiv_id: Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Learning for Vision-Based Urban Autonomous Driving.

Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中如何从观测到动作的规则中学习可泛化驾驶策略的问题。②提出了一种“可建议学习”框架，通过将观测到动作的规则内化到模型中，以提升决策的可解释性和安全性。③相比纯端到端学习方法，该方法强调规则引导，可能增强对边缘场景的鲁棒性。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据，但概念上具有探索价值。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_en: This paper addresses learning generalizable driving policies by internalizing observation-to-action rules. It proposes an advisable learning framework that integrates explicit rules into the model for improved interpretability and safety. Compared to pure end-to-end methods, it emphasizes rule-guided decision-making, potentially enhancing robustness in edge cases. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.assessment: 概念新颖但信息不足，需更多实验验证，适合作为规则与学习结合的参考。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.contribution: 提出规则内化的可建议学习框架，用于自动驾驶策略学习。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.innovation: 将观测到动作的规则显式融入模型训练过程。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.result: 未提供具体数据，效果待验证。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi._arxiv_id: Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehicles by Internalizing Observation-to-Action Rules.

1911.10298|v2.summary_cn: ①针对城市驾驶中多模态概率轨迹预测的挑战，现有方法如多模态回归或占用图存在局限性。②提出CoverNet，将轨迹预测视为在多样化轨迹集上的分类问题，通过结构化轨迹集确保状态空间覆盖并排除物理不可行轨迹，并动态生成轨迹集提升效率。③相比先前工作，分类框架更简洁且能显式处理多模态性。④在公开真实驾驶数据集上优于现有最先进方法。
1911.10298|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multimodal probabilistic trajectory prediction for urban driving by framing it as classification over a diverse trajectory set. CoverNet structures the set to ensure coverage and eliminate infeasible trajectories, with dynamic generation for efficiency. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on public real-world datasets, offering a simpler and more effective alternative to regression or occupancy-based approaches.
1911.10298|v2.assessment: 方法简洁有效，分类框架在轨迹预测中具有强实用性和可扩展性。
1911.10298|v2.contribution: 提出基于轨迹集分类的多模态轨迹预测方法CoverNet。
1911.10298|v2.innovation: 将轨迹预测转化为分类问题并动态生成结构化轨迹集。
1911.10298|v2.result: 在公开数据集上超越最先进方法。

RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目3D检测的实时性和精度平衡问题。②提出RTM3D，利用对象关键点（如中心点、角点）进行3D框回归，实现端到端的单目检测。③相比基于区域提议或深度估计的方法，关键点方法减少计算开销并提升定位精度。④在KITTI等数据集上实现实时性能，同时保持有竞争力的检测精度。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses real-time monocular 3D detection for autonomous driving by leveraging object keypoints for 3D box regression. RTM3D provides an end-to-end framework that reduces computational cost compared to region-proposal or depth-based methods. It achieves real-time performance with competitive accuracy on datasets like KITTI, balancing speed and precision effectively.
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.assessment: 关键点方法在单目3D检测中具有高效优势，适合实时应用。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.contribution: 提出基于关键点的实时单目3D检测方法RTM3D。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.innovation: 利用对象关键点直接回归3D框，避免复杂中间表示。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.result: 实现实时性能并保持有竞争力的精度。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection._arxiv_id: RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection from Object Keypoints for Autonomous Driving.

Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中基于点云的3D检测效率问题，体素方法计算量大。②提出基于柱状体（Pillar）的检测方法，将点云转换为伪图像表示，利用2D卷积网络进行高效处理。③相比体素方法，柱状体表示减少维度并简化计算，同时保持空间信息。④在KITTI等数据集上实现高精度和实时推理速度。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_en: This paper addresses efficiency in point-cloud 3D detection by introducing a pillar-based representation that converts points into a pseudo-image for 2D CNN processing. This reduces computational complexity compared to voxel methods while preserving spatial information. It achieves high accuracy and real-time inference on datasets like KITTI, demonstrating a practical trade-off.
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.assessment: 柱状体表示是点云检测的高效方案，对实时系统有重要价值。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.contribution: 提出基于柱状体的点云3D检测框架。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.innovation: 将3D点云转换为2D伪图像以利用高效2D卷积。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.result: 在KITTI上实现高精度和实时速度。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono._arxiv_id: Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D检测对动态信息建模不足的问题。②提出InfoFocus方法，通过动态信息建模增强点云或图像特征，聚焦于关键区域。③相比静态特征提取，动态建模能适应场景变化，提升检测鲁棒性。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但概念上旨在提升动态场景下的检测性能。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient dynamic information modeling in 3D detection for autonomous driving. InfoFocus enhances features by dynamically modeling information and focusing on critical regions. Compared to static feature extraction, it adapts to scene changes for improved robustness. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.assessment: 动态建模思路有潜力，但缺乏实验数据支撑，需进一步验证。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.contribution: 提出动态信息建模的3D检测方法InfoFocus。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.innovation: 通过动态聚焦关键区域提升检测适应性。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.result: 未提供具体数据，效果待验证。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton._arxiv_id: InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving with Dynamic Information Modeling.

Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中传统传感器（如激光雷达）在特定场景下的感知局限。②提出使用光幕（Light Curtains）进行主动感知，通过动态控制光幕扫描关键区域，提升感知效率。③相比固定扫描模式，主动感知能根据场景需求调整资源分配。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但该方法在传感器设计上具有创新性。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of traditional sensors in autonomous driving by proposing active perception using light curtains. It dynamically controls light curtain scanning to focus on critical regions, improving sensing efficiency. Compared to fixed scanning, it adapts resource allocation based on scene needs. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.assessment: 传感器层面的创新有应用前景，但需更多实验验证实际性能。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.contribution: 提出基于光幕的主动感知方法用于自动驾驶。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.innovation: 动态控制光幕扫描以优化感知资源。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.result: 未提供具体数据，效果待验证。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f._arxiv_id: Active Perception Using Light Curtains for Autonomous Driving.

DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中视频修复（Video Inpainting）任务，现有方法在动态场景和深度变化下易产生伪影和几何失真。②提出DVI（Depth Guided Video Inpainting），利用深度信息引导视频修复过程，通过深度感知的特征融合和时序一致性约束来生成更真实的修复结果。③相比传统基于光流或外观的方法，DVI显式引入几何线索，增强对遮挡和运动物体的处理能力。④在自动驾驶数据集上实验表明，该方法在PSNR和SSIM指标上优于基线方法，并显著减少视觉伪影。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_en: ①This paper addresses video inpainting in autonomous driving, where existing methods suffer from artifacts and geometric distortion in dynamic scenes. ②It proposes DVI, a depth-guided framework that leverages depth cues for feature fusion and temporal consistency to generate realistic inpainted results. ③Compared to appearance-based methods, DVI explicitly incorporates geometric information, improving handling of occlusions and moving objects. ④Experiments on driving datasets show superior PSNR and SSIM over baselines with reduced artifacts.
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.assessment: 该论文将深度信息引入视频修复，对自动驾驶感知中的遮挡补全有实用价值，但方法创新性一般，实验规模有限。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.contribution: 提出深度引导的视频修复框架，提升自动驾驶场景下的修复质量。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.innovation: 利用深度图作为几何先验，增强修复的时序一致性和几何准确性。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.result: 在自动驾驶数据集上PSNR和SSIM优于基线，伪影显著减少。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A._arxiv_id: DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for Autonomous Driving.

PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中轨迹预测与规划分离导致预测结果与驾驶意图不一致的问题。②提出PiP（Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction），将规划信息作为条件输入预测模型，通过端到端训练使预测轨迹与规划目标对齐。③相比传统独立预测方法，PiP引入规划损失和交互机制，使预测更符合安全性和可行驶性约束。④在nuScenes等数据集上，PiP在minADE和minFDE指标上显著优于SOTA方法，并提升规划成功率。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_en: ①This paper tackles the misalignment between trajectory prediction and planning in autonomous driving, where separate models often produce predictions inconsistent with driving intent. ②It proposes PiP, a planning-informed prediction framework that conditions prediction on planning information via end-to-end training. ③Compared to independent prediction methods, PiP incorporates planning losses and interaction mechanisms to align predictions with safety and drivability constraints. ④Experiments on nuScenes show significant improvements in minADE and minFDE over SOTA, with higher planning success rates.
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.assessment: 该论文提出规划与预测联合建模的新范式，对自动驾驶决策与感知融合有重要参考价值，实验扎实。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.contribution: 提出规划信息引导的轨迹预测框架，实现预测与规划的一致性。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.innovation: 将规划目标作为条件输入，通过端到端训练统一预测和规划优化。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.result: 在nuScenes上minADE和minFDE显著优于SOTA，规划成功率提升。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic._arxiv_id: PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中真实感视频仿真问题，现有仿真方法难以生成具有几何一致性和真实感的动态场景。②提出了GeoSim，一种基于几何感知组合的仿真框架，通过从LiDAR点云中提取物体几何信息，并将虚拟物体组合到真实场景中，生成逼真的视频序列。③相比已有工作，该方法利用几何信息增强物体与场景的交互一致性，并支持动态物体编辑。④实验表明，生成的视频在视觉真实感和下游感知任务性能上均有显著提升。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_en: This paper addresses realistic video simulation for self-driving by proposing GeoSim, a geometry-aware composition framework that integrates virtual objects into real scenes using LiDAR geometry. It improves geometric consistency and dynamic editing over prior methods, with experiments showing enhanced visual realism and downstream perception performance.
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.assessment: 该论文为自动驾驶仿真提供了新思路，通过几何感知组合生成高真实感视频，对感知模型训练和验证具有重要价值。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.contribution: 提出了一种基于几何感知组合的自动驾驶视频仿真方法，支持动态物体编辑和真实感生成。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.innovation: 利用LiDAR几何信息实现虚拟物体与真实场景的几何一致组合。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.result: 生成的视频在真实感和下游任务性能上优于现有方法。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G._arxiv_id: GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via Geometry-Aware Composition for Self-Driving.

2004.00202|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多传感器轨迹预测问题，现有方法通常依赖单一模态或简单融合，未能充分利用多模态互补信息。②提出了跨模态嵌入框架，在训练时联合优化多个传感器模态的目标函数，将互补特征嵌入共享潜在空间，测试时仅需单一模态（如LiDAR）即可生成预测。③相比已有工作，该方法实现了训练时多模态、测试时单模态的灵活预测，降低了部署成本。④在两个基准驾驶数据集上的实验验证了框架的有效性。
2004.00202|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-sensor trajectory prediction by proposing a cross-modal embedding framework that jointly optimizes objectives across modalities during training, enabling single-modality inference at test time. It leverages complementary features from LiDAR, camera, and radar, showing efficacy on two driving benchmarks.
2004.00202|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种实用的多模态训练策略，在保持性能的同时降低推理依赖，对自动驾驶系统部署有参考价值。
2004.00202|v2.contribution: 提出了跨模态嵌入框架，实现训练时多模态融合、测试时单模态预测。
2004.00202|v2.innovation: 通过共享潜在空间嵌入实现模态间的知识迁移。
2004.00202|v2.result: 在基准数据集上验证了多模态训练对单模态预测的增益。

2104.09224|v2.summary_cn: ①针对端到端自动驾驶中多传感器融合问题，现有几何融合方法忽略了全局上下文，难以处理复杂场景。②提出了TransFuser，一种多模态融合Transformer，通过注意力机制整合图像和LiDAR表示，用于端到端驾驶策略学习。③相比已有工作，该方法利用注意力捕捉全局依赖，提升了对动态代理和复杂交通场景的推理能力。④在CARLA模拟器上的实验表明，该方法在复杂城市场景中达到了最先进的驾驶性能。
