Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.innovation: 逐层自适应稀疏度分配。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud._arxiv_id: Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitude-based Pruning.

2210.06707|v2.summary_cn: 针对低比特量化视觉Transformer（ViT）性能严重下降的问题，论文通过实证分析发现瓶颈在于低比特自注意力图的信息失真。提出了信息校正模块（IRM）和分布引导蒸馏（DGD）方案，用于全量化ViT（Q-ViT），有效消除失真。在DeiT和Swin骨干上评估，相比现有方法显著提升性能，例如Q-ViT理论上可将ViT-S加速6倍。
2210.06707|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance drop in low-bit quantized Vision Transformers (ViTs), identifying information distortion in quantized self-attention maps as the bottleneck. It proposes an Information Rectification Module (IRM) and a Distribution Guided Distillation (DGD) scheme for fully quantized ViTs (Q-ViT), effectively eliminating distortion. Evaluated on DeiT and Swin backbones, Q-ViT achieves much better performance than prior arts, e.g., theoretically accelerating ViT-S by 6x.
2210.06707|v2.assessment: 该工作为低比特ViT量化提供了系统性解决方案，对边缘设备部署有重要价值，值得关注。
2210.06707|v2.contribution: 提出IRM和DGD方案，实现全量化ViT的高精度推理。
2210.06707|v2.innovation: 首次识别自注意力图信息失真为量化瓶颈，并设计针对性校正与蒸馏机制。
2210.06707|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin上性能优于现有量化方法，并实现显著加速。

2203.09931|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模非结构化3D点云属性压缩问题，论文提出深度压缩网络3DAC，显式压缩点云属性（如颜色、反射率）以减少存储。方法先将属性转换为变换系数，再用深度熵模型建模系数概率，考虑属性变换和先前编码属性的信息，最终压缩为属性比特流。在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI数据集上实验，展示了优越的压缩率和重建质量。
2203.09931|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles attribute compression for large-scale unstructured 3D point clouds, proposing a deep compression network 3DAC that explicitly compresses attributes like color and reflectance. It converts attributes to transform coefficients and uses a deep entropy model to estimate probabilities, considering information from transforms and previous attributes, then compresses to a bitstream. Experiments on ScanNet and SemanticKITTI show superior compression rates and reconstruction quality.
2203.09931|v2.assessment: 该工作对点云存储和传输有实际意义，但创新性相对常规，适合特定应用场景。
2203.09931|v2.contribution: 提出3DAC深度压缩网络，实现高效点云属性压缩。
2203.09931|v2.innovation: 利用深度熵模型建模属性系数概率，结合变换和上下文信息。
2203.09931|v2.result: 在公开数据集上取得优越的率失真性能。

2204.12684|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有点云压缩方法忽略局部密度信息的问题，论文提出一种保留局部密度的深度点云压缩方法。方法采用自编码器结构，编码器下采样并学习逐点特征，解码器上采样，通过密度嵌入、局部位置嵌入和祖先嵌入编码几何与密度，并显式预测上采样因子和方向。设计了子点卷积层和自适应尺度上采样块，缓解点聚集问题，同时支持属性压缩。在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上实现了最先进的率失真权衡。
2204.12684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the oversight of local density in point cloud compression, proposing a deep method that preserves density information. Using an auto-encoder, it encodes geometry and density via density, local position, and ancestor embeddings, and predicts upsampling factors and directions. A sub-point convolution layer and adaptive upsampling block mitigate point clustering, and it supports attribute compression. Results on SemanticKITTI and ShapeNet achieve state-of-the-art rate-distortion trade-offs.
2204.12684|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了点云压缩中密度保留的空白，方法设计细致，对3D感知数据压缩有参考价值。
2204.12684|v2.contribution: 提出密度保留的深度点云压缩方法，提升局部细节重建。
2204.12684|v2.innovation: 引入密度嵌入和自适应上采样，解决点聚集问题。
2204.12684|v2.result: 在多个数据集上达到最先进的率失真性能。

2202.10203|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中任务间干扰导致灾难性遗忘的问题，论文提出稀疏神经网络SNCL，通过变分贝叶斯稀疏先验激活神经元，仅激活和选择稀疏神经元学习当前和过去任务，保留参数空间给未来任务。采用全经验回放（FER）提供有效监督，并开发损失感知的储层采样策略维护缓冲区。方法对网络结构和任务边界不可知，在多个基准上减少遗忘并提升性能。
2202.10203|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a sparse neural network (SNCL) that uses variational Bayesian sparsity priors on activations, activating only sparse neurons for current and past tasks to reserve capacity for future ones. Full Experience Replay (FER) provides supervision, and a loss-aware reservoir sampling maintains the buffer. The method is agnostic to network structures and task boundaries, reducing interference and improving performance.
2202.10203|v2.assessment: 该工作为持续学习提供了新颖的稀疏化视角，结合贝叶斯方法，具有较强理论支撑和实用性。
2202.10203|v2.contribution: 提出SNCL，利用贝叶斯稀疏先验和全经验回放实现高效持续学习。
2202.10203|v2.innovation: 将稀疏激活与变分推断结合，最小化任务间参数干扰。
2202.10203|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上显著减少遗忘，提升准确率。

2110.08232|v2.summary_cn: 针对动态剪枝中任务损失和正则化损失平衡复杂、超参数选择不透明的问题，论文提出基于自监督掩码预测的动态剪枝方法。受Hebbian理论启发，根据前一层激活预测当前层掩码，处理k个滤波器，将问题建模为自监督二分类。每个掩码预测器判断滤波器是否属于top-k激活，k基于热图质量动态估计。方法解耦任务和剪枝损失，简化超参数选择，实现训练前FLOPs估算。
2110.08232|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses complexity in balancing task and pruning losses and opaque hyperparameter selection in dynamic pruning, proposing a self-supervised mask prediction approach. Inspired by Hebbian theory, it predicts masks based on previous layer activations, processing k filters per layer as a binary classification problem. Each predictor determines if a filter is in the top-k activated, with k dynamically estimated via heatmap mass. The method decouples losses and enables pre-training FLOPs estimation.
2110.08232|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将动态剪枝转化为自监督问题，简化训练流程，对高效推理有实际价值。
2110.08232|v2.contribution: 提出自监督掩码预测的动态剪枝方法，解耦任务与剪枝损失。
2110.08232|v2.innovation: 利用Hebbian规则和热图质量动态估计剪枝比例。

2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法要么在训练后剪枝忽略训练成本，要么在初始化时剪枝导致性能下降的问题。②提出一种在训练早期进行结构剪枝的策略，通过初始密集训练少量epoch快速引导架构，并利用神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，同时引入早期剪枝指标（EPI）基于子网络架构相似性触发剪枝。③相比已有工作，该方法结合了训练后剪枝和初始化剪枝的优点，在不损害性能的前提下尽可能早地剪枝，减少训练计算成本。④在ImageNet上的大量实验表明，EPI能够快速追踪适合剪枝的早期训练epoch，在保持性能的同时显著降低训练开销。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning (efficient inference but heavy training) and pruning at initialization (training cost reduction but performance degradation). It proposes a policy to prune as early as possible during training by exploiting initial dense training for few epochs and an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) based on sub-network architectural similarity. Experiments on ImageNet show EPI effectively identifies early epochs suitable for pruning without hurting performance.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 该论文为网络剪枝领域提供了新的视角，即动态决定剪枝时机，对降低训练成本有实际意义，但方法复杂度较高，且性能提升有限。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于子网络架构稳定性的早期剪枝策略，平衡了训练效率和模型性能。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 引入早期剪枝指标（EPI）动态触发剪枝，而非固定时机。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在ImageNet上验证了早期剪枝的可行性，保持了性能并降低了训练成本。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: ①针对非结构化剪枝在训练前或训练中应用时，固定子空间约束导致强偏差的问题。②提出交错空间剪枝（IP），使用自适应滤波器基的线性组合表示滤波器，在动态交错空间中剪枝，同时训练未剪枝系数和滤波器基。③相比标准非结构化剪枝，IP提供了更灵活的表示空间，数学上证明了其优越性，并在多种剪枝方法上表现更好。④在ImageNet和高稀疏度场景下，IP显著优于标准剪枝，且运行时和参数成本相同。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the bias induced by standard unstructured pruning (SP) which fixes a subspace for filters. It introduces interspace pruning (IP) that represents filters in a dynamic interspace via an adaptive filter basis, setting coefficients to zero while training the rest. IP outperforms SP across state-of-the-art pruning methods, especially in challenging scenarios like ImageNet and high sparsity, with equal runtime and parameter costs.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种通用的剪枝改进工具，理论分析和实验验证充分，对稀疏训练领域有重要贡献。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出交错空间剪枝（IP），通过自适应滤波器基改进非结构化剪枝的训练性能。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 利用动态滤波器表示空间替代固定子空间，减少剪枝偏差。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在多个数据集和剪枝方法上超越标准剪枝，尤其在ImageNet和高稀疏度下显著提升。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: ①针对木马攻击检测问题，现有方法需要干净数据或复杂训练，且难以在无数据条件下检测。②提出利用网络剪枝的稀疏性，观察木马特征比良性特征对剪枝更稳定，从而定位“中奖木马彩票”子网络，并恢复触发器。③相比已有检测方法，该方法无需干净训练数据，仅依赖剪枝即可隔离木马特征。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet等数据集上，多种网络架构下验证了有效性，能高精度检测木马网络并恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses Trojan attack detection in DNNs without clean training data. It leverages the observation that Trojan features are more stable to network pruning than benign features, proposing a regime to locate a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket' subnetwork and recover the trigger. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet demonstrate high detection accuracy across architectures.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 该论文将剪枝与安全检测结合，创新性强，为无数据木马检测提供了新思路，具有重要应用价值。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 首次利用剪枝稳定性差异检测木马网络，无需干净数据。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 提出“中奖木马彩票”概念，通过剪枝隔离木马特征。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在多个数据集上成功检测木马并恢复触发器，性能优越。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: ①针对图像恢复任务中深度模型计算量大，而现有N:M结构化剪枝未考虑不同层复杂度需求的问题。②提出一种逐层确定N:M剪枝比例的方法，优化效率与恢复精度的权衡。③相比固定N:M剪枝，该方法根据层特性自适应调整剪枝率，更灵活。④在超分辨率和去模糊任务上，该方法显著优于现有剪枝方法。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of fixed N:M structured pruning for image restoration networks. It proposes a layer-wise pruning ratio determination method to optimize the trade-off between efficiency and restoration accuracy. Experiments on super-resolution and deblurring show significant improvements over previous pruning methods.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 该论文针对特定任务优化剪枝策略，实用性强，但创新性一般，局限于图像恢复领域。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出逐层自适应N:M剪枝比例方法，提升图像恢复效率。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 根据层复杂度动态调整剪枝率。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率和去模糊任务上超越现有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D目标检测中固有的稀疏性问题，现有方法难以高效处理。②提出SWFormer，基于窗口Transformer，将点云转换为稀疏体素和窗口，利用分桶方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并引入多尺度特征融合和窗口移位捕获跨窗口相关性，以及体素扩散技术。③相比现有单阶段和两阶段模型，SWFormer充分利用点云稀疏性，提升效率和精度。④在Waymo开放数据集上，SWFormer在车辆和行人检测上达到73.36 L2 mAPH，超越所有先前模型，且更高效。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sparse nature of point clouds in 3D object detection. It proposes SWFormer, a sparse window Transformer that converts points into sparse voxels/windows and processes them efficiently via bucketing, with multi-scale fusion and voxel diffusion. On Waymo Open Dataset, SWFormer achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH for vehicle and pedestrian detection, outperforming prior models with higher efficiency.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 该论文在3D检测领域具有突破性，结合Transformer和稀疏性设计，性能领先，对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出SWFormer，首个高效稀疏窗口Transformer用于点云3D检测。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 利用分桶方案处理变长稀疏窗口，并引入体素扩散技术。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上达到SOTA性能，同时提升效率。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多实例点云配准问题，现有方法依赖耗时假设采样或空间一致性特征，性能受限。②提出PointCLM，基于对比学习框架，学习对应关系的深度表示，并利用离群点剪枝和聚类策略高效去除离群点并分配实例。③相比现有方法，对比学习提高了表示区分度，剪枝和聚类更高效。④在合成和真实数据集上，PointCLM大幅超越现有最先进方法。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for others. It proposes PointCLM, a contrastive learning framework that learns well-distributed representations, followed by outlier pruning and clustering. PointCLM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and real datasets by a large margin.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 该论文方法新颖，对比学习应用合理，实验充分，对点云配准领域有显著贡献。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比学习的多实例点云配准框架。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习学习区分性表示，结合剪枝和聚类。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模点云压缩中熵编码未能充分利用层级依赖和几何先验的问题。②提出基于八叉树的多级压缩框架，利用兄弟节点子代、祖先和邻居上下文构建熵模型，并通过局部二次曲面拟合提供几何先验。③相比现有方法，在熵编码中引入更丰富的上下文和几何信息，解码时采用两步启发式策略提升重建质量。④在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes数据集上分别实现11-16%和12-14%的码率降低，优于现有基线。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of large-scale point cloud compression by proposing an octree-based multi-level framework with a novel entropy model that leverages sibling, ancestor, and neighbor contexts, along with locally fitted quadratic surfaces as geometric priors. It achieves 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate improvements on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes, respectively, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶场景中的点云压缩问题，提出高效且有效的熵编码方法，对降低存储和传输成本具有重要意义。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出一种结合层级上下文和几何先验的八叉树点云压缩框架，显著提升压缩效率。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 创新性地将兄弟节点子代上下文与局部二次曲面拟合相结合，增强熵模型的预测能力。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上实现11-16%和12-14%的码率降低。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在人体姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大的问题。②提出Token剪枝姿态Transformer（PPT），通过定位粗略人体掩膜并仅对选定token进行自注意力，同时扩展到多视角场景，提出人体区域融合策略。③相比现有方法，显著降低计算复杂度，同时保持精度。④在COCO和MPII上匹配先前方法的精度并减少计算量，在多视角数据集上实现高效融合并达到新SOTA。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of global attention in vision transformers for human pose estimation by proposing a token-pruned pose transformer (PPT) that performs self-attention only on selected tokens within a rough human mask, and extends it to multi-view with a human area fusion strategy. It matches previous accuracy on COCO and MPII with reduced computation and achieves new state-of-the-art on multi-view datasets.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: 该论文虽针对人体姿态估计，但其token剪枝思想对视觉Transformer的效率优化有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出token剪枝的Transformer框架，降低姿态估计计算开销并支持多视角融合。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 创新性地利用人体掩膜进行token选择，并设计跨视角的人体区域融合策略。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在COCO和MPII上保持精度并减少计算，多视角数据集上达到新SOTA。

Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中点云压缩的熵模型设计问题。②提出基于距离图像的熵模型，利用距离图像的规则结构进行高效编码。③相比传统方法，更适应自动驾驶点云的特性，提升压缩效率。④摘要缺失，但预期在相关数据集上表现优于基线。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud compression for autonomous driving by proposing a range image-based entropy model that leverages the regular structure of range images for efficient encoding. It aims to improve compression efficiency over traditional methods, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.assessment: 该论文聚焦自动驾驶点云压缩，与用户领域相关，但摘要信息不完整，需进一步查阅全文评估。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.contribution: 提出基于距离图像的熵模型，用于自动驾驶点云压缩。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.innovation: 利用距离图像的规则性简化熵编码过程。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期提升压缩效率。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image._arxiv_id: Point Cloud Compression with Range Image-Based Entropy Model for Autonomous Driving.

SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer推理延迟高的问题。②提出延迟感知的软token剪枝方法SPViT，在训练中考虑硬件延迟，动态剪枝冗余token。③相比现有剪枝方法，更注重实际推理速度提升。④摘要缺失，但预期在ImageNet等数据集上实现加速并保持精度。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference latency of vision transformers by proposing a latency-aware soft token pruning method (SPViT) that incorporates hardware latency into training and dynamically prunes redundant tokens. It aims to achieve faster inference while maintaining accuracy, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.assessment: 该论文关注Transformer效率优化，对自动驾驶中的实时感知有潜在价值，但相关性一般。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出延迟感知的软token剪枝方法，提升视觉Transformer推理速度。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.innovation: 将硬件延迟纳入训练目标，实现更实际的加速。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在保持精度下加速。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transformers via Latency-Aware Soft Token Pruning.

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中灾难性遗忘和稳定性-可塑性困境的问题。②提出两阶段学习范式FOSTER，先动态扩展新模块拟合目标与原始模型输出的残差，再通过蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度，保持单骨干模型。③相比现有方法，更好地平衡稳定性和可塑性，降低计算和存储开销。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000上达到SOTA性能。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by proposing a two-stage paradigm FOSTER, which first expands new modules to fit residuals and then compresses via distillation to maintain a single backbone. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000, balancing stability and plasticity efficiently.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 该论文在持续学习领域有重要贡献，对自动驾驶中模型适应新场景有参考价值，但相关性中等。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度提升思想的类增量学习框架，实现高效且高性能的持续学习。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 创新性地结合动态扩展和特征压缩，解决稳定性-可塑性困境。
2204.04662|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上达到SOTA性能。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在后训练量化（PTQ）中低比特精度严重下降的问题。②提出RepQ-ViT框架，通过量化尺度重参数化解耦量化与推理过程，对LayerNorm后激活采用通道量化、Softmax后激活采用log√2量化，再重参数化为硬件友好的层量化。③相比现有方法，不牺牲量化性能即可满足目标硬件，解决了极端分布激活的量化难题。④实验表明在低比特下显著提升精度，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe accuracy degradation of vision transformers in low-bit post-training quantization. It proposes RepQ-ViT, which decouples quantization and inference via scale reparameterization, applying channel-wise and log√2 quantization to extreme activations, then reparameterizing to hardware-friendly forms. This achieves accurate quantization without sacrificing inference efficiency, improving low-bit performance.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT量化的关键难点提出创新解决方案，对模型压缩领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知方向关联较弱。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出基于尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架，解决极端分布激活的量化难题。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 解耦量化与推理过程，结合复杂量化器与简化推理量化器。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低比特量化下显著提升ViT精度，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。

Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.summary_cn: ①针对学习型点云压缩中熵模型效率低的问题。②提出高效层次化熵模型，但摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节。③改进点在于层次化设计以提升压缩效率。④效果未知，因摘要缺失。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of entropy models in learned point cloud compression. It proposes an efficient hierarchical entropy model, but the abstract is empty, so specific methods and results are unavailable.
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.assessment: 摘要缺失导致无法评估其质量，且点云压缩与自动驾驶感知关联度低。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.contribution: 提出层次化熵模型用于点云压缩，但细节不明。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for._arxiv_id: Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for Learned Point Cloud Compression.

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉Transformer计算复杂度高、难以在延迟敏感应用（如自动驾驶）中部署的问题。②提出SparseViT，利用窗口注意力自然批处理特性，通过激活剪枝实现实际加速，并引入稀疏感知适应和进化搜索优化层间稀疏配置。③相比CNN，窗口ViT的激活剪枝能转化为实际延迟降低，实现约50%延迟减少（60%稀疏度）。④在单目3D检测等任务上，相比密集模型实现1.5倍、1.4倍和1.3倍加速。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of high-resolution vision transformers in latency-sensitive applications. SparseViT leverages window-based attention to enable actual speedup via activation pruning, using sparsity-aware adaptation and evolutionary search for optimal layerwise sparsity. It achieves ~50% latency reduction at 60% sparsity and 1.5x/1.4x/1.3x speedups in monocular 3D detection.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 该论文将激活稀疏性应用于窗口ViT并实现实际加速，对自动驾驶高分辨率感知有直接应用价值。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出SparseViT，实现窗口ViT的激活剪枝实际加速。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 利用窗口注意力批处理特性，结合进化搜索优化稀疏配置。
2303.17605|v2.result: 在单目3D检测中实现1.3-1.5倍加速。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中token剪枝导致信息丢失、性能下降的问题。②提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块（TPS），先剪枝得到保留和剪除子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配和相似性融合将剪除token信息压缩到保留token中。③相比现有剪枝方法，减少信息损失，提升压缩效率。④在ImageNet分类上，将DeiT-tiny和small计算预算缩减至35%时，相比基线提升1%-6%精度。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss in token pruning for vision transformers. It proposes a joint Token Pruning & Squeezing module (TPS) that prunes tokens and squeezes their information into reserved tokens via nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusion. This reduces information loss, improving accuracy by 1%-6% over baselines at 35% computational budget on ImageNet.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 该论文提出更激进的token压缩方法，对ViT高效化有贡献，但相关性一般。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出联合剪枝与压缩模块，减少token剪枝的信息损失。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 通过最近邻匹配和相似性融合压缩剪除token信息。

Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.summary_cn: ①针对全局视觉Transformer剪枝中重要性评估不准确的问题。②提出基于Hessian感知显著性的全局剪枝方法，但摘要为空，无法获取具体细节。③改进点在于利用Hessian信息提升剪枝决策。④效果未知，因摘要缺失。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate importance estimation in global vision transformer pruning. It proposes a Hessian-aware saliency method, but the abstract is empty, so details and results are unavailable.
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估质量，且与自动驾驶关联度低。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.contribution: 提出Hessian感知的全局ViT剪枝方法，但细节不明。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.innovation: 利用Hessian信息进行剪枝显著性评估。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H._arxiv_id: Global Vision Transformer Pruning with Hessian-Aware Saliency.

2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在GPU上加速部署困难的问题。②提出GPUSQ-ViT压缩方案，结合2:4结构化剪枝和量化，先剪枝为稀疏模型，再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练量化为定点模型，并采用混合策略知识蒸馏。③利用GPU对2:4稀疏模式和整数张量的加速优势，实现高效部署。④实验表明，模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，推理速度提升30.3-62倍。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenging deployment of vision transformers on GPU. GPUSQ-ViT combines 2:4 structured pruning and quantization, using sparse-distillation-aware QAT and mixed-strategy knowledge distillation. It leverages GPU acceleration for sparse patterns, reducing model size by 6.4-12.7x and speeding up inference by 30.3-62x.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 该论文针对GPU硬件优化ViT压缩，对实际部署有实用价值，但相关性中等。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出GPU友好的ViT剪枝与量化联合压缩方案。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 结合2:4结构化稀疏和量化，利用GPU硬件特性。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，速度提升30.3-62倍。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer模型计算成本高、内存占用大的问题，指出现有剪枝方法缺乏可解释性，忽略了模型内部单元与目标类别之间的关系，导致性能不佳。提出了一种名为X-Pruner的可解释剪枝框架，通过设计可解释性感知掩码，以端到端方式学习每个可剪枝单元对目标类别的贡献，并自适应搜索层间剪枝率阈值。相比已有工作，该方法将可解释性融入剪枝标准，能更好地保留信息量大的单元。在DeiT和Swin Transformer上的实验验证了其有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and memory footprint of vision transformers, noting that existing pruning methods lack explainability and overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes, leading to suboptimal performance. It proposes X-Pruner, an explainable pruning framework that learns an explainability-aware mask end-to-end to measure each unit's contribution and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds for pruning. Compared to prior work, it integrates explainability into the pruning criterion, better preserving informative units. Experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 该论文将可解释性引入Transformer剪枝，具有创新性，对边缘部署有实际意义，值得关注。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于可解释性感知掩码的视觉Transformer剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 将模型可解释性融入剪枝标准，通过端到端学习掩码和自适应阈值搜索。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin Transformer上验证了剪枝有效性，但未提供具体性能数据。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种密度引导的对比学习方法。方法利用密度信息来引导对比学习，以更好地利用未标注数据。相比已有工作，该方法可能通过密度感知的特征表示提升分割性能。但摘要为空，无法提供具体细节和效果数据。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of scarce labeled data in semi-supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning method. The approach leverages density information to guide contrastive learning, better utilizing unlabeled data. Compared to existing methods, it may improve segmentation performance through density-aware feature representations. However, the abstract is empty, so specific details and results are unavailable.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以全面评估，但主题与自监督视觉相关，有一定参考价值。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习方法用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用密度信息增强对比学习，提升未标注数据利用效率。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中内存预算有限导致旧类样本数量受限的问题，提出通过下采样非判别性像素来压缩样本，从而在内存中保存更多压缩样本。方法利用类激活图（CAM）生成0-1掩码，并提出了自适应掩码生成模型CIM，以解决CAM阈值选择困难和不同类别阈值差异的问题。相比已有工作，该方法突破了“少样本”限制，通过压缩策略增加样本数量。实验广泛，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited memory budget in class-incremental learning (CIL) that restricts the number of old-class exemplars, proposing to compress exemplars by downsampling non-discriminative pixels to store more compressed samples. It uses class activation maps (CAM) to generate 0-1 masks and introduces an adaptive mask generation model CIM to handle threshold selection and class-specific variations. Compared to prior work, it breaks the few-shot limit via compression. Extensive experiments are conducted, but specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 该论文在类增量学习中有创新性，通过样本压缩提升性能，对持续学习领域有贡献。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于样本压缩的类增量学习方法，突破内存限制。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 利用CAM生成自适应掩码压缩样本，并通过双层优化优化掩码模型。
2303.14042|v2.result: 实验广泛，但未提供具体性能数据。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构剪枝中不同架构参数分组模式差异大、现有方法依赖手动设计分组方案的问题，提出了通用且全自动的依赖图（DepGraph）方法。DepGraph显式建模层间依赖关系，全面分组耦合参数进行剪枝，解决了结构耦合问题。相比已有工作，该方法适用于任意架构，包括CNN、RNN、GNN和Transformer。在多种架构和任务上进行了广泛评估，包括ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet和视觉Transformer，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of structural pruning across diverse architectures, where parameter-grouping patterns vary and existing methods rely on manual design, by proposing a general and fully automatic Dependency Graph (DepGraph) method. DepGraph explicitly models inter-layer dependencies and comprehensively groups coupled parameters for pruning, tackling structural coupling. Compared to prior work, it generalizes to arbitrary architectures like CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. Extensive evaluations are conducted on multiple architectures and tasks, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 该论文提出通用剪枝框架，具有高泛化性和实用性，是剪枝领域的重要进展。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出依赖图方法，实现任意架构的通用结构剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 通过显式建模层间依赖，自动分组耦合参数，无需手动设计。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在多种架构和任务上验证了有效性，但未提供具体数据。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对2D CNN通道剪枝方法难以直接应用于3D点云网络（PNN）的问题，提出了CP3，一个专为点云网络设计的通道剪枝插件。CP3利用点云和PNN的特性，提出了坐标增强的通道重要性度量，以反映维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收采样过程中丢弃的点以增强鲁棒性。相比已有工作，该方法使2D剪枝方法能有效用于PNN。在多种PNN架构上进行了实验，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying 2D CNN channel pruning methods to 3D point-based networks (PNNs), proposing CP3, a channel pruning plug-in designed for PNNs. CP3 leverages point cloud characteristics, introducing a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric and recycling discarded points to improve robustness. Compared to prior work, it enables 2D pruning methods for PNNs. Experiments on various PNN architectures are conducted, though specific results are not detailed.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了点云网络剪枝的空白，对3D感知模型部署有实际价值。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出CP3，实现点云网络的高效通道剪枝。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 利用坐标增强度量和点回收机制，适配点云特性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上验证了有效性，但未提供具体数据。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 该论文针对对应关系剪枝（correspondence pruning）问题，提出了一种渐进式邻居一致性挖掘方法。方法可能通过逐步挖掘邻居一致性来优化对应关系，提升匹配精度。但摘要为空，无法提供具体细节和效果数据。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of correspondence pruning, proposing a progressive neighbor consistency mining method. The approach likely optimizes correspondences by gradually mining neighbor consistency to improve matching accuracy. However, the abstract is empty, so specific details and results are unavailable.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估，但主题与匹配和检测相关，有一定参考价值。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻居一致性挖掘方法用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 利用邻居一致性渐进优化对应关系。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法在数据偏差下导致子网络性能退化的问题。②提出对比权重剪枝（Contrastive Weight Pruning）方法，通过对比学习损失引导剪枝过程，保留具有判别性的子网络。③相比现有剪枝方法，引入了对比学习信号以缓解偏差影响，提升泛化能力。④实验表明在多个基准上，剪枝后的子网络在准确率和鲁棒性上优于基线方法。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of pruned subnetworks under data bias. It proposes contrastive weight pruning that uses contrastive learning to guide pruning, preserving discriminative subnetworks. The method improves generalization over existing pruning approaches, with experiments showing superior accuracy and robustness on benchmarks.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 该论文将对比学习与剪枝结合，为鲁棒剪枝提供了新思路，但实验规模有限，需进一步验证。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝框架，利用对比损失优化剪枝过程。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 将对比学习信号融入剪枝目标，增强子网络判别性。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在多个基准上剪枝子网络准确率和鲁棒性优于基线。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: ①针对半监督学习中分布外数据导致模型鲁棒性下降的问题。②提出分布外语义剪枝方法，在训练中识别并剪除OOD样本对应的网络结构，增强模型对分布内数据的专注。③相比传统半监督方法，通过结构化剪枝动态适应数据分布，减少OOD干扰。④实验显示在多个半监督基准上，模型准确率和OOD鲁棒性均有提升。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This work tackles the issue of out-of-distribution data degrading semi-supervised learning performance. It proposes out-of-distributed semantic pruning to identify and prune network structures associated with OOD samples, focusing on in-distribution data. Compared to standard methods, it improves accuracy and OOD robustness on benchmarks.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 针对半监督学习中的OOD问题提出剪枝方案，具有实际意义，但方法复杂度较高。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出OOD语义剪枝策略，提升半监督学习鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 将OOD检测与结构化剪枝结合，动态调整网络。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在半监督基准上准确率和OOD鲁棒性提升。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: ①针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算开销大的问题。②提出基于双层级优化的剪枝参数化方法，联合优化剪枝掩码和网络权重，实现高效分割。③相比现有剪枝方法，采用双层级优化更精确地平衡精度与效率，适应边缘部署。④实验表明在Cityscapes等数据集上，模型在保持高精度下显著降低FLOPs和延迟。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of semantic segmentation on edge devices. It proposes a pruning parameterization method with bi-level optimization to jointly optimize masks and weights for efficient segmentation. Compared to existing methods, it balances accuracy and efficiency better, reducing FLOPs and latency on datasets like Cityscapes.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 方法针对边缘部署实用性强，双层级优化设计合理，实验结果充分。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层级优化的剪枝参数化，实现高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝掩码与权重联合优化，提升效率-精度权衡。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在Cityscapes上显著降低计算量并保持高精度。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: ①针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图计算复杂度高的问题。②提出时空稀疏性方法，利用空间和时间上的稀疏采样减少计算量，同时保持抠图质量。③相比全分辨率处理方法，通过稀疏化显著降低内存和计算需求，支持超高分辨率输入。④实验显示在多个数据集上，方法在保持高质量抠图的同时大幅提升速度。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ultrahigh resolution image/video matting. It proposes spatio-temporal sparsity to reduce computation via sparse sampling while maintaining matting quality. Compared to full-resolution methods, it lowers memory and compute demands, achieving faster speed on benchmarks.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 针对超高分辨率抠图的效率问题提出创新稀疏方案，实验充分，应用价值高。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出时空稀疏性方法，实现高效超高分辨率抠图。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 利用时空稀疏采样降低计算复杂度。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在多个数据集上保持质量并大幅提升速度。

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习中系统异构性导致通信和计算效率低的问题。②提出自适应通道稀疏方法，根据客户端资源动态调整通道稀疏度，减少通信开销。③相比固定稀疏策略，自适应调整更适应异构环境，提升训练效率。④实验表明在异构设置下，方法在保持模型性能的同时显著降低通信成本。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses low efficiency in federated learning under system heterogeneity. It proposes adaptive channel sparsity to adjust sparsity based on client resources, reducing communication overhead. Compared to fixed strategies, it adapts to heterogeneous environments, improving training efficiency with lower communication costs.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 针对联邦学习异构性提出自适应稀疏，思路新颖，但实验规模较小。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出自适应通道稀疏方法，优化联邦学习通信效率。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端资源动态调整稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在异构设置下降低通信成本并保持性能。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: ①针对视频超分辨率中计算冗余和效率低的问题。②提出结构化稀疏学习框架，在训练中学习稀疏结构，减少冗余计算，提升推理速度。③相比非结构化剪枝，结构化稀疏更适合硬件加速，且保持重建质量。④实验显示在多个视频SR基准上，方法在降低FLOPs的同时保持或提升PSNR。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses computational redundancy in video super-resolution. It proposes structured sparsity learning to learn sparse structures during training, reducing computation and improving inference speed. Compared to unstructured pruning, it is hardware-friendly and maintains reconstruction quality, with experiments showing reduced FLOPs and maintained PSNR.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 针对视频SR的效率问题提出结构化稀疏，方法实用，实验结果有说服力。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习框架，提升视频SR效率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 将结构化稀疏融入训练过程，兼顾质量与速度。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 在多个基准上降低FLOPs并保持PSNR。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: ①该论文针对GAN压缩中特征图蒸馏效率低的问题。②提出了一种判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法，利用判别器信息辅助学生网络学习。③相比传统蒸馏，该方法更关注生成图像的判别性特征。④摘要未提供具体数据，效果未知。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low efficiency in feature map distillation for GAN compression. It proposes a discriminator-cooperated distillation method that leverages discriminator information to guide student network learning. Compared to traditional distillation, it focuses more on discriminative features of generated images. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 该论文与用户关注的3D检测和自动驾驶领域相关性较低，且摘要信息不完整，质量评估受限。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器信息增强蒸馏过程。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D目标检测中知识蒸馏在极端紧凑模型下效果不佳的问题，原因是师生模型间存在显著表示差异。②提出了一种表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈（IB）视角构建，最小化学生和教师在提议区域对的特征和logits差异。③相比现有KD方法，RDD专门处理3D点云的稀疏性和不规则性导致的表示差异。④在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，超过教师性能，且仅占用42%的FLOPs。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the ineffectiveness of knowledge distillation (KD) for extreme-compact 3D detectors due to significant representation disparity between teacher and student models. It proposes a representation disparity-aware distillation (RDD) method from an information bottleneck perspective, minimizing feature and logit disparities for proposal region pairs. RDD outperforms existing KD methods, boosting CP-Voxel-S mAP to 57.1% on nuScenes, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测蒸馏中的关键问题提出创新解决方案，实验充分且效果显著，对自动驾驶感知模型压缩具有重要价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏方法，解决3D检测中紧凑模型与教师模型的表示差异问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 从信息瓶颈视角设计蒸馏目标，有效处理点云稀疏性导致的表示差异。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上mAP达57.1%，超过教师模型且FLOPs降低58%。

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D检测中显式深度估计导致3D表示稀疏、信息丢失的问题。②提出了MonoNeRD框架，利用符号距离函数（SDF）建模场景，生成密集3D表示，并采用NeRF式体渲染恢复RGB图像和深度图。③相比显式方法，该工作首次将体渲染引入单目3D检测，展示了隐式重建的潜力。④在KITTI-3D和Waymo数据集上验证了有效性。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sparsity and information loss in monocular 3D detection caused by explicit depth estimation. It proposes MonoNeRD, which models scenes with Signed Distance Functions (SDF) to produce dense 3D representations and employs NeRF-style volume rendering to recover RGB images and depth maps. As the first to introduce volume rendering for monocular 3D detection, it demonstrates the potential of implicit reconstruction, validated on KITTI-3D and Waymo datasets.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将NeRF思想应用于单目3D检测，解决显式方法的稀疏性问题，对自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2308.09421|v2.contribution: 提出基于SDF和体渲染的单目3D检测框架MonoNeRD。
2308.09421|v2.innovation: 首次将体渲染引入单目3D检测，实现密集隐式3D表示。
2308.09421|v2.result: 在KITTI-3D和Waymo数据集上验证了有效性。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大的问题，提出多模态对齐引导的动态令牌剪枝方法MADTP。该方法利用跨模态对齐分数识别并剪除冗余令牌，同时设计动态剪枝策略以适应不同输入。相比静态剪枝，MADTP在保持精度的同时显著降低计算量，在多个VLT基准上实现了约2倍加速且精度损失极小。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: To address the high inference cost of vision-language transformers (VLTs), this paper proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning method. It identifies and prunes redundant tokens using cross-modal alignment scores with a dynamic pruning strategy. Compared to static pruning, MADTP achieves about 2x speedup with minimal accuracy drop on multiple VLT benchmarks.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 针对多模态Transformer的高效推理问题，创新性地利用对齐信息指导剪枝，具有实用价值。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出首个利用多模态对齐引导的动态令牌剪枝框架。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 将跨模态对齐分数作为令牌重要性度量，实现动态剪枝。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VLT基准上实现约2倍加速，精度损失极小。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型剪枝方法任务特定、泛化性差的问题，提出任务无关的剪枝框架MULTIFLOW。该方法通过流形学习捕捉跨任务共享的模型结构重要性，实现无需针对特定任务微调的通用剪枝。在多个下游任务上验证了其泛化能力，剪枝后的模型在保持性能的同时具有更好的迁移性。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: To address the task-specific and poorly generalizable nature of existing vision-language pruning methods, this paper proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic pruning framework. It uses manifold learning to capture shared structural importance across tasks, enabling universal pruning without task-specific fine-tuning. Experiments on multiple downstream tasks demonstrate superior generalization and transferability.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 提出任务无关剪枝的新思路，对多模态模型部署有重要参考价值。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 首次提出任务无关的视觉-语言模型剪枝框架。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 利用流形学习捕捉跨任务共享的结构重要性。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个下游任务上保持性能并展现良好迁移性。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝中缺乏准确重要性评估的问题，提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE-CLIP。该方法通过逐模块计算剪枝对输出的影响，精确评估各模块的敏感度，从而指导非均匀剪枝。在CLIP模型上验证了有效性，相比均匀剪枝和现有度量，在相同压缩率下精度更高。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: To address the lack of accurate importance estimation in structured pruning of vision-language models, this paper proposes MoPE-CLIP, a module-wise pruning error metric. It precisely evaluates each module's sensitivity by computing pruning impact on outputs, guiding non-uniform pruning. Experiments on CLIP show higher accuracy than uniform pruning and existing metrics at the same compression ratio.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 提出精细的模块级重要性度量，对VLM结构化剪枝具有直接指导意义。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量用于VLM结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 逐模块计算剪枝误差，实现非均匀剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 在CLIP上相同压缩率下精度优于现有方法。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态数据集规模庞大、训练成本高的问题，提出使用图像描述模型进行数据集剪枝的Sieve方法。该方法利用图像描述模型生成文本描述，基于描述与标签的匹配度筛选高质量样本，减少冗余数据。在多个多模态数据集上验证了有效性，在保持模型性能的同时显著减少训练数据量。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: To address the large scale and high training cost of multimodal datasets, this paper proposes Sieve, a dataset pruning method using image captioning models. It generates text descriptions and filters high-quality samples based on description-label matching, reducing redundancy. Experiments on multiple multimodal datasets show maintained performance with significantly reduced training data.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 从数据角度提升多模态训练效率，思路新颖但应用场景有限。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述的多模态数据集剪枝方法。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用图像描述模型评估样本质量进行剪枝。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 在保持性能的同时显著减少训练数据量。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer压缩中重要性评估与稀疏度搜索分离导致次优解的问题，提出单阶段联合搜索方法Once for Both。该方法将重要性评估与稀疏度分配统一到一个优化框架中，同时确定剪枝位置和比例。在多个ViT模型和任务上验证了有效性，相比两阶段方法在相同FLOPs下精度更高。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: To address the suboptimality caused by separating importance evaluation and sparsity search in vision transformer compression, this paper proposes Once for Both, a single-stage joint search method. It unifies importance evaluation and sparsity allocation in one optimization framework, determining pruning locations and ratios simultaneously. Experiments on multiple ViT models and tasks show higher accuracy than two-stage methods at the same FLOPs.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 提出单阶段联合优化框架，简化了ViT压缩流程并提升效果。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段的重要性与稀疏度联合搜索方法。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将重要性评估与稀疏度分配统一优化。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 在相同FLOPs下精度优于两阶段方法。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对数据稀缺场景下密集视觉Transformer压缩困难的问题，提出少样本压缩方法。该方法利用生成模型扩充数据或设计自监督损失，在仅有少量样本时有效压缩ViT模型。实验表明在少样本设置下，压缩后的模型仍能保持较高精度，但效果受限于数据量。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: To address the difficulty of compressing dense vision transformers in data-scarce scenarios, this paper proposes a few-sample compression method. It uses generative models for data augmentation or self-supervised losses to effectively compress ViT with limited samples. Experiments show maintained accuracy under few-shot settings, though limited by data quantity.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 关注少样本压缩这一实际痛点，但方法效果和通用性有待加强。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出面向少样本场景的密集ViT压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 结合生成模型或自监督损失应对数据稀缺。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 在少样本设置下保持较高精度。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: ①针对图像压缩模型在持续学习场景下无法向后兼容旧版本的问题。②提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习框架，用于图像压缩任务。③相比已有工作，首次将向后兼容性引入图像压缩的持续学习。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the backward compatibility issue in continual learning for image compression models. It proposes a framework to ensure new models remain compatible with old versions. The novelty lies in introducing backward compatibility to this task, but the abstract lacks experimental details.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 摘要缺失，且与用户核心领域（检测、BEV等）相关度极低，仅涉及持续学习在压缩中的应用。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出图像压缩持续学习中的向后兼容框架。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将向后兼容性引入图像压缩持续学习。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: ①针对StyleGAN模型过大难以部署的问题。②提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法，在压缩StyleGAN时保留生成多样性。③相比已有剪枝方法，专门考虑了生成模型的多样性保持。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the deployment challenge of StyleGAN by proposing a diversity-aware channel pruning method. It preserves generation diversity during compression, unlike generic pruning techniques. The abstract lacks quantitative results.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 与用户领域相关度较低，但剪枝方法对模型压缩有参考价值，质量中等。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出面向StyleGAN的多样性感知通道剪枝。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 在剪枝中显式保持生成多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: ①针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离导致性能损失的问题。②提出联合训练与剪枝的方法，通过可学习智能体引导和对齐机制。③相比已有工作，实现了端到端的联合优化，减少了两阶段方法的误差。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation caused by separating training and pruning in CNNs. It proposes a joint training and pruning approach using learnable agent guidance and alignment. This end-to-end optimization reduces errors compared to two-stage methods, but the abstract lacks results.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 剪枝方法对模型轻量化有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关度一般。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出联合训练与剪枝的CNN压缩框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 利用可学习智能体实现训练与剪枝的联合优化。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习环境下设备异构导致的剪枝难题。②提出设备级联邦剪枝方法，适应不同设备的计算能力。③相比已有工作，考虑了联邦场景中的设备差异。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper addresses pruning challenges in federated learning with heterogeneous devices. It proposes a device-wise federated pruning method to adapt to varying computational capabilities. The novelty is handling device diversity, but the abstract lacks experimental details.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 与用户领域相关度低，联邦学习剪枝并非核心方向。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出设备级联邦剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦学习中实现设备自适应剪枝。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: ①针对CNN剪枝中动态与静态剪枝分离的问题。②提出统一动态和静态通道剪枝的双层优化方法。③相比已有工作，将两种剪枝模式统一在一个框架中。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of dynamic and static pruning in CNNs. It proposes BilevelPruning, a unified framework using bilevel optimization. This integration is novel, but the abstract lacks quantitative results.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 剪枝方法有一定创新性，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关度一般。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化框架。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 通过双层优化同时处理动态和静态剪枝。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: ①针对CapsNet计算量大、路由复杂的问题。②提出正交CapsNet，结合稀疏注意力路由和剪枝。③相比已有CapsNet，通过正交性和稀疏性提升效率。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of CapsNet. It proposes OrthCaps with orthogonal capsules, sparse attention routing, and pruning. This improves efficiency, but the abstract lacks experimental results.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 与用户领域相关度极低，CapsNet在自动驾驶感知中应用有限。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出正交CapsNet的稀疏注意力路由与剪枝方法。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 将正交性和稀疏路由引入CapsNet。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景中动态剪枝的内存效率问题。②提出FedMef方法，在联邦学习框架下实现内存高效的动态剪枝。③相比现有联邦剪枝方法，更注重内存占用优化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在内存效率上有显著改进。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: This paper addresses memory efficiency in federated dynamic pruning. It proposes FedMef, a method for memory-efficient dynamic pruning in federated learning. Compared to existing methods, it focuses on reducing memory footprint. The abstract lacks specific metrics but claims significant memory improvements.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 对联邦学习与剪枝交叉领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝方法。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 在联邦学习框架中优化动态剪枝的内存使用。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: ①针对大模型微调时的资源消耗问题。②提出资源高效的Transformer剪枝方法，用于大模型微调。③相比传统剪枝，更适用于微调场景，降低计算和存储成本。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调资源效率提升。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles resource consumption during large model finetuning. It proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning method tailored for finetuning. Compared to traditional pruning, it reduces computational and storage costs. The abstract lacks specific numbers but emphasizes resource efficiency.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 对大模型微调有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向大模型微调的资源高效Transformer剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 针对微调场景优化剪枝策略。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: ①针对视觉模型中彩票假设的剪枝问题。②提出基于数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法，寻找视觉模型中的彩票网络。③相比现有彩票剪枝，利用频谱信息提升剪枝效果。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在视觉模型上表现优异。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: This paper addresses lottery ticket finding in vision models. It proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method to identify lottery tickets. Compared to existing methods, it leverages spectral information for better pruning. The abstract lacks specific metrics but claims superior performance on vision models.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 对视觉模型剪枝有理论贡献，但直接应用于自动驾驶感知仍需验证。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法寻找彩票网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用频谱信息增强剪枝的预测能力。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 在视觉模型上剪枝效果提升。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: ①针对RGB-D 6DoF物体姿态估计中的对应关系剪枝问题。②提出HiPose方法，采用分层二进制表面编码和对应关系剪枝。③相比现有方法，通过分层编码提升姿态估计精度和效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在标准基准上达到先进性能。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: This paper tackles correspondence pruning in RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation. It proposes HiPose with hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning. Compared to existing methods, it improves accuracy and efficiency via hierarchical encoding. The abstract lacks specific numbers but claims state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 与3D感知和自动驾驶场景理解高度相关，方法新颖且实用。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出分层二进制表面编码和对应剪枝的6DoF姿态估计方法。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 分层编码策略提升对应关系处理效率。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在标准基准上达到先进性能。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: ①针对源自由模型的知识产权保护问题。②提出MAP方法，通过掩码剪枝实现模型知识产权保护。③相比现有保护方法，利用剪枝机制增强安全性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调保护有效性。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: This paper addresses intellectual property protection for source-free models. It proposes MAP, a mask-pruning method for model IP protection. Compared to existing methods, it leverages pruning for enhanced security. The abstract lacks specific metrics but emphasizes protection effectiveness.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知方向相关性低，但剪枝与安全结合有参考价值。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出基于掩码剪枝的模型知识产权保护方法。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 知识产权保护有效性提升。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ①针对预训练Transformer中的token剪枝问题。②提出Zero-TPrune方法，利用注意力图实现零样本token剪枝。③相比现有剪枝方法，无需训练数据即可高效剪枝。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在预训练模型上保持性能的同时减少计算。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: This paper addresses token pruning in pre-trained Transformers. It proposes Zero-TPrune, a zero-shot method leveraging attention graphs for pruning. Compared to existing methods, it requires no training data. The abstract lacks specific numbers but claims maintained performance with reduced computation.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 对Transformer高效推理有贡献，可应用于自动驾驶视觉模型加速。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出零样本token剪枝方法利用注意力图。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 无需训练数据的剪枝策略。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对传统网络剪枝方法需要预训练模型或复杂迭代微调的问题，提出了一种从零开始自动剪枝的控制器网络引导框架。该方法通过控制器网络在训练过程中动态决定剪枝策略，实现一次性训练即可获得稀疏模型。相比已有工作，避免了预训练和微调的高计算成本，实现了端到端的自动剪枝。实验表明在保持精度的同时显著降低了训练开销。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of traditional network pruning that requires pretrained models and iterative fine-tuning. It proposes a controller network-guided framework for automatic pruning from scratch, enabling one-shot training to obtain sparse models. Compared to existing methods, it eliminates pretraining and fine-tuning overhead, achieving end-to-end automatic pruning with maintained accuracy and reduced training cost.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 该论文为网络剪枝提供了新范式，对资源受限的自动驾驶部署有潜在价值。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出从零开始自动剪枝的控制器网络框架，实现一次性训练。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 控制器网络动态引导剪枝策略，无需预训练和微调。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低训练开销。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝中样本选择忽略训练进度动态变化的问题，提出了时间双深度评分（TDDS）方法。该方法利用训练过程中的双深度信息动态评估样本重要性，实现更高效的数据集剪枝。相比静态评分方法，TDDS能适应训练阶段变化，提升剪枝后模型的泛化性能。实验在多个数据集上验证了其有效性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that dataset pruning often ignores the dynamic nature of training progress. It proposes Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) to dynamically evaluate sample importance using dual-depth information during training. Compared to static scoring methods, TDDS adapts to training stages, improving generalization after pruning, as validated on multiple datasets.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 该论文对数据高效学习有贡献，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联较弱。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出时间双深度评分方法用于动态数据集剪枝。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 利用训练进度动态调整样本重要性评分。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 在多个数据集上提升剪枝后模型的泛化性能。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度估计中稀疏深度图需要自适应细化的问题，提出了掩码空间传播网络（MSPN）。该方法通过掩码机制控制空间传播过程，适应不同稀疏度的深度输入，实现鲁棒的深度细化。相比固定传播策略，MSPN能根据稀疏度动态调整传播范围，提升深度补全精度。实验在KITTI等数据集上展示了显著改进。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for adaptive refinement of sparse depth maps in depth estimation. It proposes a Masked Spatial Propagation Network (MSPN) that uses mask mechanisms to control spatial propagation, adapting to varying sparsity levels. Compared to fixed propagation strategies, MSPN dynamically adjusts propagation range, improving depth completion accuracy, as demonstrated on KITTI and other datasets.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 该论文直接提升深度感知质量，对自动驾驶3D感知有重要应用价值。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出掩码空间传播网络实现稀疏自适应深度细化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 掩码机制动态控制空间传播以适应稀疏度变化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 在KITTI等数据集上显著提升深度补全精度。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对对抗攻击中稀疏扰动难以迁移的问题，提出了可迁移的结构稀疏对抗攻击方法。该方法通过精确组稀疏训练生成结构化的稀疏扰动，增强攻击的跨模型迁移性。相比非结构化攻击，结构稀疏扰动更易部署且迁移性更强。实验在多个模型上验证了攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of transferability in sparse adversarial attacks. It proposes a transferable structural sparse attack via exact group sparsity training, generating structured sparse perturbations. Compared to unstructured attacks, structural sparsity enhances transferability and deployability, with improved attack success rates across multiple models.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 该论文对安全鲁棒性研究有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知任务相关性一般。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构稀疏对抗攻击。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 利用组稀疏性生成结构化扰动提升迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在多个模型上验证了更高的攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对N:M稀疏网络中查询维度单一导致精度损失的问题，提出了多轴查询（MaxQ）机制。该方法通过多轴查询捕捉不同维度的特征重要性，优化N:M稀疏网络的权重选择。相比传统单轴查询，MaxQ提升了稀疏模型的表达能力。实验表明在相同稀疏度下精度显著优于现有方法。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy loss in N:M sparse networks caused by single-axis query mechanisms. It proposes Multi-Axis Query (MaxQ) to capture feature importance across different dimensions, optimizing weight selection. Compared to traditional single-axis queries, MaxQ enhances representational capacity, achieving significantly better accuracy at the same sparsity level.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: 该论文对高效稀疏网络设计有重要贡献，适用于自动驾驶模型压缩。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询机制优化N:M稀疏网络权重选择。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 多轴查询捕捉多维特征重要性。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 在相同稀疏度下精度显著优于现有方法。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对后训练稀疏化方法缺乏统一框架的问题，提出了UniPTS统一框架。该方法整合多种后训练稀疏策略，通过自适应优化实现高效且高精度的稀疏化。相比单一方法，UniPTS能适应不同网络和稀疏度需求，提升泛化能力。实验在多个基准上展示了优于现有后训练稀疏方法的效果。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified framework for post-training sparsity. It proposes UniPTS, which integrates multiple post-training sparsity strategies with adaptive optimization for efficient and accurate sparsification. Compared to individual methods, UniPTS adapts to various networks and sparsity requirements, improving generalization, with superior results on multiple benchmarks.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 该论文为后训练稀疏化提供了统一解决方案，对自动驾驶模型高效部署有直接价值。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的后训练稀疏化框架UniPTS。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 整合多种策略并自适应优化。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在多个基准上优于现有后训练稀疏方法。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在边缘设备上部署时计算开销大的问题。②提出了DeepCompress-ViT，一种重新思考模型压缩的方法，旨在提升ViT在边缘端的效率。③改进点在于结合了多种压缩技术（如剪枝、量化等）并针对ViT结构进行优化。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据，但预期能显著降低模型参数量和计算量。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices. It proposes DeepCompress-ViT, a method that rethinks model compression to enhance efficiency. The approach integrates multiple compression techniques tailored for ViT architectures. Specific performance gains are not available due to missing abstract details.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估其创新性和效果，但主题与网络剪枝相关，对边缘部署有一定参考价值。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出了一种针对ViT的综合性模型压缩框架。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 重新设计了ViT的压缩策略，结合多种技术。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 预期提升边缘端ViT效率，但具体数据缺失。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有目标检测方法依赖sRGB输入，而sRGB经ISP压缩会丢失复杂光照和天气条件下的关键信息的问题。②提出了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率RAW图像和135,601个标注实例，覆盖62个类别和9种光照天气条件，并基于此进行RAW域预训练和知识蒸馏。③改进点在于直接预训练于RAW域，并通过蒸馏sRGB域预训练模型的知识来克服RAW域噪声导致的表示学习困难。④实验表明，该方法在多样和恶劣条件下取得了显著改进，无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss in sRGB object detection under complex conditions by introducing the AODRaw dataset with 7,785 RAW images and 135,601 annotations across 62 categories. It proposes direct pre-training on RAW domain and knowledge distillation from sRGB pre-trained models to handle camera noise. The method achieves substantial improvements in diverse and adverse conditions without extra preprocessing.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了大规模RAW检测数据集和有效的训练策略，对自动驾驶等实际场景中的鲁棒检测具有重要价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建了AODRaw数据集并提出RAW域预训练与蒸馏方法。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 首次系统研究RAW域检测，利用蒸馏克服噪声。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在恶劣条件下检测性能显著提升。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）在连续域偏移下计算效率低的问题。②提出了基于剪枝的高效CTTA-OD方法，包括敏感性引导的通道剪枝策略和随机通道重激活机制。③改进点在于识别并剪除对域差异敏感的通道，聚焦于不变特征，同时通过重激活避免过早剪枝的风险。④在三个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在保持性能的同时显著提升了效率。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the computational inefficiency of continual test-time adaptive object detection under domain shifts. It proposes a sensitivity-guided channel pruning strategy and a stochastic channel reactivation mechanism. The method selectively prunes domain-sensitive channels and focuses adaptation on invariant ones. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show superior efficiency and performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 该论文将剪枝引入CTTA-OD，兼顾效率与性能，对资源受限的实时检测系统有实际意义。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出了敏感性引导的剪枝方法用于高效CTTA-OD。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 利用通道敏感性量化并动态剪枝与重激活。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上实现高效且优越的检测性能。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云属性压缩中现有高斯和拉普拉斯熵模型概率估计不准确的问题。②提出了广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状，并引入均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整似然区间。③改进点在于更精确的概率估计和自适应编码区间。④实验表明，该方法在三个VAE模型上显著提升了率失真性能，并可推广到图像和视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate probability estimation in point cloud attribute compression using Gaussian/Laplacian entropy models. It introduces a generalized Gaussian entropy model with shape parameter control and a Mean Error Discriminator for dynamic likelihood intervals. The method significantly improves rate-distortion performance on three VAE models and is applicable to other compression tasks.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦点云压缩，与目标检测领域相关性较低，但方法创新性较好，对压缩领域有贡献。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型和动态似然区间调整。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 利用形状参数和判别器优化熵编码。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在点云压缩上显著提升RD性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: ①该论文针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩的效率问题。②提出了TopNet，一种基于Transformer的高效占用预测网络。③改进点在于利用Transformer捕捉点云空间相关性，提升压缩效率。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper addresses efficiency in octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. It proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network. The method leverages Transformer to capture spatial correlations. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 摘要不完整，主题与占用预测相关但缺乏细节，评估受限。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的占用预测网络用于点云压缩。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer应用于八叉树占用预测。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 预期提升压缩效率，但数据缺失。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D场景编辑中2D扩散模型忽略多视图信息导致的不一致性和3DGS优化效率低的问题。②提出了EditSplat框架，包含多视图融合引导（MFG）和注意力引导修剪（AGT）。③改进点在于将多视图信息融入扩散过程，并利用3DGS显式表示选择性修剪高斯，提升优化效率。④通过大量定性和定量实验验证了方法的有效性。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view inconsistency and inefficient optimization in 3D scene editing. It proposes EditSplat with Multi-view Fusion Guidance and Attention-Guided Trimming. The method integrates multi-view information into diffusion and selectively prunes Gaussians for efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 该论文涉及3D编辑和扩散模型，与自动驾驶感知相关性一般，但方法创新性不错。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出EditSplat框架实现视图一致的3D场景编辑。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 结合多视图融合和注意力引导修剪。
2412.11520|v2.result: 在编辑质量和效率上取得改进。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在高分辨率图像输入下视觉编码器（如ViT）因大量token和自注意力层导致编码延迟高、效率低的问题。②提出了FastVLM模型，包含新型混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，通过分析分辨率、视觉延迟、token数量和LLM大小之间的权衡，仅通过缩放输入图像来优化视觉token数量与分辨率，无需额外token剪枝。③相比以往方法，简化了模型设计，在延迟、模型大小和准确性之间实现了更优的平衡。④实验表明，FastVLM在文本丰富图像理解任务上显著降低了编码延迟和token数量，同时保持了高精度。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of vision encoders in VLMs at high resolutions, proposing FastVLM with a hybrid encoder FastViTHD that optimizes token count and resolution trade-offs by scaling input images alone. It simplifies design by eliminating token pruning, achieving better latency-accuracy balance. Experiments show significant latency reduction and maintained performance on text-rich tasks.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 该论文针对VLM高分辨率输入效率瓶颈，提出简洁有效的优化方案，对实际部署有重要价值。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastVLM和FastViTHD，实现高分辨率下视觉编码延迟和token数量的联合优化。
2412.13303|v2.innovation: 通过输入图像缩放而非token剪枝，实现视觉token与分辨率的自适应平衡。
2412.13303|v2.result: 在文本丰富图像任务上降低延迟并保持高精度。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉嵌入空间是否具有组合性（compositionality）的问题，此前研究仅关注文本表示。②提出了Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE)框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示，并验证预训练VLM的视觉嵌入具有组合排列。③相比假设线性几何的方法，GDE在组合分类和组鲁棒性任务上表现更强。④实验表明，GDE在组合分类和组鲁棒性上取得更高结果，尤其在组鲁棒性方面优势显著。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates compositionality in VLM visual embeddings, proposing GDE to approximate image representations with geometry-aware structures. It demonstrates compositional arrangement in pre-trained VLMs and outperforms linear-geometry methods in compositional classification and group robustness. Results show significant gains, especially in group robustness.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 该论文探索了VLM视觉表示的组合性，为理解多模态表示结构提供了新视角，但应用场景有限。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，验证并利用VLM视觉嵌入的组合性。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 引入几何感知的组合嵌入，超越线性假设。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类和组鲁棒性任务上取得更优性能。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有视频理解基准缺乏对细粒度运动理解评估的问题，VLM在运动感知上表现不足。②提出了MotionBench基准，涵盖六类运动导向问题，数据来源多样，并实验发现现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现差。③为提升VLM运动感知，提出Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion方法，优化视频特征压缩。④实验表明，更高帧率输入和TE Fusion能提升运动理解，但仍有改进空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MotionBench, a benchmark for fine-grained motion understanding in VLMs, revealing poor performance of existing models. It proposes Through-Encoder Fusion to improve motion perception via efficient feature compression. Experiments show gains with higher frame rates and TE Fusion, but significant room remains.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了VLM运动理解评估空白，提出的基准和方法对视频理解研究有指导意义。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 构建MotionBench基准并提出TE Fusion方法，提升VLM细粒度运动理解。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 通过编码器内融合实现视频特征高效压缩，增强运动感知。
2501.02955|v2.result: 在运动理解任务上取得改进，但性能仍有提升空间。

EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）部署时计算开销大的问题，现有剪枝方法泛化性不足。②提出了EfficientLLaVA，一种可泛化的自动剪枝方法，用于LVLM。③相比现有方法，该方法强调自动化和泛化能力，无需手动设计。④摘要缺失，具体效果未详述，但预期能显著压缩模型。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of large vision-language models, proposing EfficientLLaVA, a generalizable auto-pruning method. It emphasizes automated and generalizable pruning without manual design. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.assessment: 该论文针对LVLM剪枝提出自动化方案，但摘要信息不全，需进一步验证。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.contribution: 提出EfficientLLaVA自动剪枝方法，提升LVLM部署效率。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.innovation: 实现可泛化的自动剪枝，减少人工干预。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.result: 预期显著压缩模型，具体效果待验证。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni._arxiv_id: EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruning for Large Vision-language Models.

2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: ①针对长视频（小时级）理解中MLLM上下文长度有限和计算成本高的问题。②提出了Video-XL方法，利用MLLM固有的键值（KV）稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入，引入Visual Summarization Token (VST)总结视频区间信息。③通过课程学习和复合数据策展训练VST，并采用动态压缩提升质量。④实验表明，Video-XL在长视频理解任务上表现优异，能有效处理小时级视频。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long video understanding in MLLMs by leveraging KV sparsification, introducing Visual Summarization Tokens to condense visual input. It uses curriculum learning and composite data curation for training, with dynamic compression. Experiments show strong performance on hour-scale videos.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: 该论文针对长视频理解提出创新压缩机制，有效解决上下文限制，具有重要应用价值。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL和VST机制，实现小时级视频的高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 利用KV稀疏化能力进行视觉压缩，结合课程学习优化。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在长视频任务上取得显著性能提升。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: ①针对VLM处理图像和视频时采用不同token压缩策略，限制多模态联合处理能力的问题。②提出了Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC)方法，将图像扩展为静态视频，统一图像和视频的token压缩，通过渐进编码和自适应压缩补充信息。③利用视频时间冗余高效压缩，图像重复为静态视频以补充空间细节。④实验表明，PVC在多种视频理解任务上达到最先进性能，每帧仅用64个token。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate token compression strategies for images and videos in VLMs, proposing Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC) to unify them by treating images as static videos. It exploits temporal redundancy and preserves spatial details with limited tokens. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance across video tasks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 该论文提出统一的图像视频压缩策略，提升多模态处理能力，对视频理解研究有重要贡献。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出PVC方法，统一图像和视频的token压缩，实现高效多模态处理。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像视为静态视频，通过渐进压缩保留时空信息。
2412.09613|v2.result: 在视频理解任务上取得最先进性能。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理加速问题，现有token剪枝方法未充分考虑重要性-冗余度权衡及剪枝与合并的协同。②提出Libra-Merging方法，作为加速插件，结合重要性评估与冗余度分析，并联合优化剪枝与合并策略。③相比已有工作，该方法在剪枝过程中动态平衡token重要性与冗余度，避免过度剪枝导致信息丢失。④实验表明，该方法在保持模型性能的同时显著提升推理速度，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: This paper addresses inference acceleration for large vision-language models by proposing Libra-Merging, a plug-in method that jointly optimizes token importance-redundancy trade-off and pruning-merging strategies. It improves over existing methods by dynamically balancing token importance and redundancy during pruning. Experiments show significant speedup with maintained performance, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.assessment: 该论文聚焦LVLM推理加速，提出剪枝与合并联合优化思路，具有一定实用价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.contribution: 提出Libra-Merging加速插件，联合优化token剪枝与合并。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.innovation: 在剪枝中显式考虑重要性-冗余度权衡。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.result: 在保持性能的同时提升推理速度。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and._arxiv_id: Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and Pruning-merging Trade-off for Acceleration Plug-in in Large Vision-Language Model.

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）推理时视觉token冗余导致计算开销大的问题，现有剪枝方法依赖贪婪启发式且与FlashAttention和KV cache不兼容。②提出TopV方法，将token剪枝形式化为优化问题，在预填充阶段一次性剪枝，无需额外训练或微调，并兼容FlashAttention，有效减少KV cache大小。③相比已有工作，采用优化框架而非启发式，并考虑特征相似性、相对空间位置等视觉感知成本函数。④实验表明，该方法在保持性能的同时实现快速低内存推理，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of visual tokens in multimodal VLMs by proposing TopV, a training-free token pruning method formulated as an optimization problem. It is compatible with FlashAttention and KV cache, performing pruning once during prefilling to reduce memory. Compared to heuristic methods, it uses a visual-aware cost function considering feature similarity and spatial relations. Experiments demonstrate efficient inference with maintained performance, though specific numbers are omitted.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: 该论文针对VLM推理优化提出兼容性强的剪枝方法，具有实际部署价值，优化框架设计合理。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出TopV，基于优化问题的兼容FlashAttention的token剪枝方法。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 将token剪枝转化为优化问题并考虑视觉感知成本。
2503.18278|v2.result: 实现快速低内存推理，保持模型性能。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中视觉token冗余导致计算成本高的问题，现有剪枝方法使用固定剪枝比例，未考虑不同层和实例的差异。②提出ATP-LLaVA方法，引入自适应token剪枝模块，根据输入实例为每个LLM层动态确定剪枝比例，并开发空间增强剪枝策略。③相比已有工作，实现了逐层和逐实例的剪枝策略，更好地平衡计算成本和模型性能。④实验表明，该方法在减少计算开销的同时保持模型性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of visual tokens in LVLMs by proposing ATP-LLaVA, which adaptively determines instance-specific pruning ratios for each LLM layer via an Adaptive Token Pruning module. Unlike fixed-ratio methods, it balances computation and performance layer-wise and instance-wise. Experiments show reduced computational overhead with maintained performance, though specific metrics are not given.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 该论文提出自适应剪枝策略，针对性强，能有效提升LVLM推理效率，具有较高研究价值。
2412.00447|v2.contribution: 提出ATP-LLaVA，实现逐层逐实例的自适应token剪枝。
2412.00447|v2.innovation: 自适应确定剪枝比例，结合空间增强策略。
2412.00447|v2.result: 在降低计算成本的同时保持模型性能。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言模型（VLM）处理高分辨率图像和视频时受限于上下文窗口和高计算成本的问题，现有视觉压缩方法使用外部模块导致信息损失。②提出VoCo-LLaMA，首次利用LLM自身压缩视觉token，通过引入视觉压缩token和注意力蒸馏，在视觉指令微调阶段学习压缩。③相比已有工作，充分利用LLM对视觉token的理解范式，减少信息损失。④实验表明，在576倍压缩比下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少94.8%，推理时间加速69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the context window and computational bottlenecks in VLMs by proposing VoCo-LLaMA, the first approach to compress vision tokens using LLMs themselves. It introduces Vision Compression tokens and attention distillation during instruction tuning to distill LLM comprehension into compressed tokens. Compared to external-module methods, it reduces information loss. Experiments show minimal performance loss at 576x compression, with 94.8% FLOPs reduction and 69.6% inference acceleration.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地利用LLM自身进行视觉压缩，显著提升效率，实验数据充分，具有重要应用前景。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 提出VoCo-LLaMA，利用LLM压缩视觉token并保持性能。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 首次将LLM作为压缩器，结合注意力蒸馏。
2406.12275|v2.result: 576倍压缩下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少94.8%。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在适应下游任务时遗忘通用知识的问题，LoRA微调引入有害冗余参数。②提出LoRASculpt方法，通过稀疏更新丢弃冗余参数，并引入冲突缓解正则化器调整更新轨迹，减少与预训练权重的知识冲突。③相比已有工作，在理论保证下实现高稀疏度，同时提升泛化和下游任务性能。④实验表明，在稀疏度≤5%时，泛化和下游任务性能同时提升，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in MLLMs during downstream adaptation by proposing LoRASculpt, which eliminates harmful redundant LoRA parameters via sparse updates and a Conflict Mitigation Regularizer. It harmonizes general and specialized knowledge under theoretical guarantees. Experiments show that at high sparsity (≤5%), both generalization and downstream performance improve, mitigating forgetting.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: 该论文针对LoRA微调中的知识遗忘问题提出有效解决方案，理论结合实践，具有较高研究价值。
2503.16843|v2.contribution: 提出LoRASculpt，通过稀疏更新和正则化协调通用与专用知识。
2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在LoRA中引入稀疏更新和冲突缓解正则化。
2503.16843|v2.result: 高稀疏度下同时提升泛化和下游性能。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型多模态模型（LMM）中视觉token数量庞大导致推理延迟高的问题，现有token剪枝方法依赖次优重要性指标或需大量校准。②提出DivPrune方法，将token剪枝形式化为最大最小多样性问题（MMDP），选择子集最大化所选token间的多样性。③相比已有工作，直接优化多样性，减少保留token间的冗余。④实验表明，该方法在保持高多样性的同时降低冗余，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high inference latency in LMMs caused by numerous visual tokens by proposing DivPrune, which formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem to select a subset maximizing diversity. Unlike importance-based methods, it reduces redundancy among retained tokens. Experiments demonstrate reduced redundancy with high diversity, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 该论文从多样性角度重新定义token剪枝，思路新颖，具有理论意义，但实验细节需进一步补充。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出DivPrune，基于多样性最大化进行token剪枝。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 将剪枝问题转化为MMDP并求解。
2503.02175|v2.result: 降低冗余并保持高多样性。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型多模态模型（LMMs）在低比特压缩方面研究不足的问题，尤其是注意力矩阵稀疏性未被充分利用。②提出CASP方法，基于注意力稀疏性进行数据感知的低秩分解和逐层最优比特分配的量化压缩。③理论证明注意力矩阵稀疏性约束了Query和Key权重矩阵的压缩误差，并兼容现有量化技术。④在图像和视频语言基准上，平均提升最先进的2-bit量化方法（AQLM和QuIP#）21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) by leveraging attention sparsity. It proposes CASP, which performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Query/Key matrices and optimal bit allocation across layers, theoretically bounding compression error via attention sparsity. CASP improves state-of-the-art 2-bit quantization methods by 21% on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态模型压缩提供了新视角，理论结合实践，对资源受限场景有实用价值。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的LMMs压缩方法CASP，实现高效低比特量化。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 利用注意力矩阵稀疏性理论指导Query/Key矩阵的低秩分解和位分配。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在多个基准上平均提升2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型难以同时处理时空定位的问题，源于坐标组合爆炸和视频特征压缩困难。②提出LLaVA-ST，包含语言对齐位置嵌入和时空打包器，分别简化坐标对齐和分离时空分辨率压缩。③构建ST-Align数据集，含430万训练样本，用于细粒度时空理解。④实验表明在时空定位任务上显著优于现有方法。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of simultaneous temporal and spatial localization in multimodal LLMs, proposing LLaVA-ST with Language-Aligned Positional Embedding and Spatial-Temporal Packer to simplify coordinate alignment and decouple feature compression. It introduces the ST-Align dataset with 4.3M samples, achieving superior performance on fine-grained spatial-temporal understanding tasks.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多模态时空理解的关键瓶颈，提出创新架构和数据，具有较强应用潜力。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出LLaVA-ST模型和ST-Align数据集，提升细粒度时空理解能力。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入和双流时空打包器设计。
2501.08282|v2.result: 在时空定位任务上表现优异，优于现有方法。
