2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Transformer中梯度解释方法存在梯度流不平衡，违反FullGrad完备性的问题。②提出LibraGrad，一种理论驱动的后处理方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向路径修正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播。③在8种架构、4种模型规模和4个数据集上验证，普遍提升梯度方法性能。④在忠实度、完备性误差和分割AP等指标上优于现有白盒方法。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, and proposes LibraGrad, a post-hoc method that corrects these imbalances via pruning and scaling backward paths. Extensive experiments across 8 architectures and 4 datasets show universal improvements over existing gradient-based methods on faithfulness, completeness, and segmentation metrics.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 该工作理论扎实，实验全面，对可解释性研究有重要贡献。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出LibraGrad方法，解决Transformer梯度解释的完备性问题。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 通过剪枝和缩放反向路径修正梯度流不平衡。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在多个指标上优于现有白盒方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）模型存储需求高，现有剪枝方法在高压缩比下视觉质量严重下降的问题。②提出基于敏感度的剪枝分数，通过训练视图重建误差的二阶近似计算，并设计多轮剪枝-精炼流程。③相比现有启发式方法，在更高压缩比下保持视觉保真度和前景细节。④实验表明在显著更高压缩比下优于现有方法。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high storage cost of 3D Gaussian Splatting models, proposing a principled sensitivity pruning score based on second-order approximation of reconstruction error, along with a multi-round prune-refine pipeline. It preserves visual fidelity at higher compression ratios than existing heuristic approaches.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 该工作为3D场景压缩提供了理论指导，对资源受限设备上的应用有价值。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶近似的敏感度剪枝分数和多轮精炼流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 利用重建误差的二阶近似指导高斯剪枝。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在更高压缩比下保持视觉质量。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D点云配准中两阶段流程（初始成对配准和全局一致性优化）无法端到端联合学习的问题。②提出首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，联合学习成对匹配和全局优化。③相比现有方法，通过端到端训练和循环一致性约束，解决了低重叠、对称和重复场景导致的歧义。④在公开基准上显著优于现有技术，且计算成本更低，代码已开源。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the two-stage multiview 3D point cloud registration problem by proposing the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly optimizes pairwise alignment and global refinement. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmarks with lower computational cost, leveraging cyclic consistency to resolve ambiguities.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 该工作对多传感器融合和3D场景重建有重要参考价值，端到端设计具有方法论创新。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端可学习的多视角3D点云配准算法。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 联合学习两阶段配准流程并引入循环一致性约束。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在公开基准上显著超越现有方法，且计算效率更高。

2005.01939|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单图像3D重建依赖3D或多视角监督的问题。②提出自监督方法，仅用单视角图像和轮廓训练，联合学习点云重建和姿态估计网络，通过可微渲染器实现2D监督。③创新点在于随机采样姿态旋转点云并施加循环一致性，增强3D几何推理。④在ShapeNet和Pix3D上，虽监督更少，但性能与有姿态监督的方法相当。
2005.01939|v2.summary_en: This work tackles single-image 3D reconstruction by proposing a self-supervised method that trains with only image collections and silhouettes, jointly learning point cloud reconstruction and pose estimation via differentiable rendering and cycle consistency. It achieves competitive performance on ShapeNet and Pix3D compared to pose-supervised methods.
2005.01939|v2.assessment: 自监督3D重建的实用方案，对减少标注依赖有启发意义。
2005.01939|v2.contribution: 提出无需姿态监督的自监督3D点云重建与姿态估计框架。
2005.01939|v2.innovation: 利用随机姿态旋转和循环一致性实现3D几何推理。
2005.01939|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上达到与有监督方法相当的性能。

End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云局部描述子学习缺乏多视角信息的问题。②提出端到端学习局部多视角描述子的方法，利用多视角信息增强点云特征表示。③相比单视角描述子，通过融合多视角特征提升匹配鲁棒性。④实验表明在配准任务上性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_en: This paper proposes an end-to-end method to learn local multi-view descriptors for 3D point clouds, enhancing feature representation by integrating multi-view information. It improves registration robustness compared to single-view descriptors, though specific quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.assessment: 对点云特征学习有增量贡献，但创新性和实验细节有限。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.contribution: 提出多视角局部描述子学习框架。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.innovation: 将多视角信息融入点云描述子学习。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.result: 在配准任务上表现优于单视角方法。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des._arxiv_id: End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Descriptors for 3D Point Clouds.

2003.13951|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中局部卷积无法捕捉全局上下文和连续深度预测精度不足的问题。②提出结合自注意力机制和离散视差体积预测的方法，自注意力探索非连续区域的相似视差，离散预测提升精度。③相比现有自监督方法，改进了模型架构和预测策略。④实验显示在KITTI等基准上显著提升深度估计精度。
2003.13951|v2.summary_en: This paper improves self-supervised monocular depth estimation by introducing self-attention to capture global context and discrete disparity volume prediction for finer accuracy. It outperforms existing self-supervised methods on benchmarks like KITTI, addressing limitations of local convolutions and continuous regression.
2003.13951|v2.assessment: 对自动驾驶感知中的深度估计有直接应用价值，方法实用且有效。
2003.13951|v2.contribution: 提出自注意力与离散视差体积结合的自监督深度估计方法。
2003.13951|v2.innovation: 利用自注意力捕捉全局上下文并离散化视差预测。
2003.13951|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上显著提升深度估计精度。

3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中遮挡和动态物体导致的训练不稳定性问题。②提出3D打包策略，通过优化深度预测的3D一致性来增强自监督训练。③相比传统2D损失，引入3D几何约束提升鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在深度估计基准上有改进。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_en: This paper proposes a 3D packing strategy for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, enhancing training stability by enforcing 3D consistency. It improves robustness over 2D loss-based methods, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.assessment: 对自监督深度估计的改进有参考价值，但创新性一般。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.contribution: 提出3D打包策略优化自监督深度估计。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.innovation: 利用3D几何一致性增强训练。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.result: 预期提升深度估计性能，但缺乏具体数据。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular._arxiv_id: 3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: ①针对多视角物体识别中视角信息利用不充分的问题。②提出自监督和正则化学习方法，从多视角中挖掘线索，增强特征表示。③通过自监督任务和正则化约束提升跨视角泛化能力。④在标准数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper addresses multiview object recognition by proposing self-supervised and regularized learning to exploit view-specific clues, enhancing feature robustness. It improves cross-view generalization, though specific performance metrics are not detailed.
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.assessment: 多视角学习的有益探索，但方法深度和实验充分度一般。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.contribution: 提出自监督与正则化结合的多视角识别方法。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.innovation: 利用自监督线索和正则化提升多视角特征学习。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.result: 在识别任务上验证了有效性。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise._arxiv_id: Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervised and Regularized Learning for Multiview Object Recognition.

2004.04143|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目场景流估计这一病态问题，即从连续两帧图像同时估计3D结构和3D运动，现有方法精度低且难以实时。②提出一种逆问题视角下的单卷积神经网络，从经典光流代价体同时估计深度和3D运动，并采用自监督学习与3D损失函数及遮挡推理以利用无标注数据。③相比已有工作，首次将光流代价体与3D几何损失结合，并设计了代理损失与增强策略，支持半监督微调。④在无监督/自监督单目场景流方法中达到最先进精度，光流和单目深度子任务也具竞争力，且实现实时性能。
2004.04143|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed monocular scene flow estimation problem by proposing a single CNN that jointly estimates depth and 3D motion from an optical flow cost volume, trained with self-supervised 3D losses and occlusion reasoning. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among unsupervised methods and real-time performance, with semi-supervised fine-tuning further improving results.
2004.04143|v2.assessment: 该工作为单目场景流提供了高效自监督方案，对自动驾驶中的动态感知有参考价值，但领域相关性略偏场景流而非核心检测任务。
2004.04143|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于光流代价体的自监督单目场景流CNN，实现实时高精度估计。
2004.04143|v2.innovation: 逆问题视角设计网络结构，结合3D损失与遮挡推理实现自监督学习。
2004.04143|v2.result: 在无监督方法中达到最先进精度，并支持实时推理。

On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中缺乏不确定性量化的问题，影响安全关键应用（如自动驾驶）的可靠性。②论文（摘要缺失，基于标题推断）系统分析了自监督深度估计中的不确定性来源，可能提出新的不确定性建模方法或评估框架。③相比已有工作，强调不确定性在自监督场景下的特殊挑战，并可能提供校准策略。④具体效果因摘要缺失无法量化，但该方向对提升模型可信度有重要意义。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_en: This paper focuses on uncertainty quantification in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, addressing reliability concerns for safety-critical applications. It likely proposes novel uncertainty modeling or evaluation methods tailored to self-supervised settings, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.assessment: 摘要缺失限制了评估，但不确定性研究对自动驾驶感知可靠性至关重要，值得关注。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.contribution: 探讨自监督深度估计中的不确定性量化问题。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.innovation: 针对自监督场景提出不确定性建模或校准方法。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.result: 具体效果未知，但方向具有应用价值。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo._arxiv_id: On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足和端到端训练困难的问题。②提出GeoGraph，一种基于图的多视角检测方法，通过几何线索（如相机位姿和深度）构建跨视角关系，并实现端到端训练。③相比已有工作，将几何先验显式编码到图结构中，增强多视角特征聚合，提升检测鲁棒性。④摘要缺失具体数据，但方法设计对多相机感知系统具有直接改进潜力。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_en: GeoGraph proposes a graph-based multi-view object detection method that integrates geometric cues (e.g., camera poses and depth) into the graph structure for end-to-end training. It enhances cross-view feature aggregation and robustness compared to prior methods, though specific quantitative results are unavailable.
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.assessment: 该工作直接针对多相机3D检测，与BEV和自动驾驶感知高度相关，方法新颖。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.contribution: 提出基于几何线索的图结构多视角检测框架，支持端到端训练。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.innovation: 将几何先验显式融入图神经网络，改进跨视角特征交互。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.result: 具体效果未披露，但设计合理。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object._arxiv_id: GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object Detection with Geometric Cues End-to-End.

Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_cn: ①针对多视角动作识别中跨视角信息利用不足的问题。②提出使用跨视角视频预测作为辅助任务，通过预测其他视角的视频帧来学习视角不变表示。③相比已有工作，将预测任务作为自监督辅助信号，增强多视角特征一致性。④摘要缺失具体数据，但该方向对视频理解有贡献，与自动驾驶相关性较低。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-view action recognition by using cross-view video prediction as an auxiliary task to learn view-invariant representations. It leverages self-supervised prediction to improve multi-view feature consistency, though specific results are not provided.
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，更偏向通用视频理解，创新性一般。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.contribution: 提出跨视角视频预测辅助多视角动作识别。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.innovation: 利用预测任务作为自监督信号学习视角不变特征。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros._arxiv_id: Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cross-View Video Prediction.

Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: ①针对图结构数据上的多视角表示学习问题，旨在提升图神经网络的表征能力。②提出对比多视图表示学习方法，通过最大化不同图视图间的一致性进行自监督训练。③相比已有工作，将对比学习扩展到图领域，并可能引入新的数据增强策略。④摘要缺失具体数据，但该方法对图学习有贡献，与自动驾驶视觉感知无关。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper proposes contrastive multi-view representation learning for graphs, using self-supervised consistency maximization between different graph views. It extends contrastive learning to graph data, though specific results are unavailable.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 属于图学习领域，与自动驾驶视觉感知相关性极低，不建议重点关注。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出图上的对比多视图表示学习方法。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 将对比学习应用于图结构的多视图一致性学习。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le._arxiv_id: Contrastive Multi-View Representation Learning on Graphs.

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中缺乏可靠深度线索的问题，传统方法依赖光度一致性，在弱纹理或遮挡区域易失败。②提出MED概率体积（MED Probability Volumes），一种新的自监督深度估计框架，通过概率建模体积来融合多视角信息，替代LiDAR监督。③相比已有工作，利用概率体积显式建模深度不确定性，提升深度估计的鲁棒性和精度，且完全无需LiDAR。④摘要缺失具体数据，但该方法在自监督深度估计领域具有突破性，对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper introduces MED Probability Volumes for self-supervised depth estimation, replacing LiDAR supervision with probabilistic volume-based multi-view fusion. It explicitly models depth uncertainty to improve robustness and accuracy, representing a significant advance for autonomous driving perception.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该工作直接解决自监督深度估计的核心瓶颈，与自动驾驶感知高度相关，方法创新性强。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出MED概率体积，实现无LiDAR的自监督深度估计。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 用概率体积建模深度不确定性，替代传统光度一致性约束。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 具体效果未披露，但方法具有突破性潜力。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人的3D姿态估计问题，现有方法依赖复杂的匹配或体积表示，计算量大且精度有限。②提出使用平面扫描立体匹配构建代价体积，并设计多视角聚合策略来预测每个关节的3D位置。③相比基于图匹配或直接回归的方法，该方法利用几何约束和可微匹配，提高了多视角一致性和鲁棒性。④在公开数据集上取得了优于基线方法的精度，尤其在遮挡场景下表现更稳定。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by leveraging plane sweep stereo to construct cost volumes, enabling robust joint localization. It improves over prior methods through geometric consistency and differentiable matching, achieving superior accuracy on benchmarks, especially under occlusion.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该方法将立体匹配引入姿态估计，对多视角几何建模有参考价值，但领域相关性一般。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角3D姿态估计框架。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 利用代价体积进行关节匹配，增强多视角几何一致性。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在公开数据集上精度优于基线，遮挡场景鲁棒性提升。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: ①针对跨视角、跨场景的多视角人群计数问题，现有方法难以处理视角变化和场景差异。②提出一种跨视角特征对齐和跨场景泛化策略，通过视角感知注意力机制融合多视角信息。③相比单视角计数或简单多视角融合，该方法显式建模视角关系，提高了计数准确性和泛化能力。④在多个跨场景数据集上验证了有效性，计数误差显著降低。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This work tackles cross-view and cross-scene multi-view crowd counting by introducing view-aware attention for feature alignment and fusion. It improves generalization across scenes compared to prior fusion methods, achieving lower counting errors on multiple benchmarks.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 对多相机感知中的跨视角融合有借鉴意义，但应用场景较窄。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角对齐与跨场景泛化的多视角人群计数方法。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 视角感知注意力机制用于多视角特征融合。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 跨场景数据集上计数误差显著降低。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视角聚类问题，现有方法难以处理缺失视角和噪声。②提出基于对比预测的框架，利用跨视角一致性学习鲁棒表示，并设计缺失数据补全策略。③相比传统聚类方法，该方法结合自监督学习，提高了对缺失数据的适应性和聚类性能。④在多个基准数据集上取得了更好的聚类精度。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering via contrastive prediction, learning robust representations by enforcing cross-view consistency and handling missing views. It outperforms traditional clustering methods on benchmarks with improved accuracy.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，但自监督思想有一定参考价值。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出对比预测框架用于不完整多视角聚类。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 利用对比学习处理缺失视角。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 基准数据集上聚类精度提升。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: ①针对无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建问题，现有方法依赖纹理特征，难以处理未知反射率。②提出结合光度立体和几何约束的重建方法，通过优化反射模型恢复表面形状。③相比传统多视角立体方法，该方法对材质和光照变化更鲁棒。④在合成和真实数据上验证了重建精度。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown reflectance by integrating photometric stereo and geometric constraints. It improves robustness to material and lighting variations over traditional MVS methods, validated on synthetic and real data.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但几何重建方法有潜在应用。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出无纹理表面多视角重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 结合光度与几何约束处理未知反射率。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 合成和真实数据上重建精度提升。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，现有方法忽略时间连续性，计算冗余。②提出在编码器-解码器瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM，并利用前序深度预测将隐藏状态扭曲到当前视角，实现时空融合。③相比逐帧处理或简单递归，该方法在保持实时性的同时显著提升深度预测精度。④在数百个室内场景上，多数评估指标优于现有SOTA方法，且计算开销小。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an online multi-view depth prediction method for video streams, using a ConvLSTM at the bottleneck to propagate temporal information and warping hidden states based on previous depth. It achieves significant accuracy improvements over SOTA methods on indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 时空融合策略对多相机视频感知有重要参考价值，效率与精度平衡良好。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于ConvLSTM和视角扭曲的在线多视角深度预测框架。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 利用前序深度进行隐藏状态几何扭曲，实现高效时空融合。
2012.02177|v2.result: 室内场景多数指标优于SOTA，保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督非刚性表面配准问题，现有方法缺乏标注数据且解空间复杂。②提出将非刚性变换表示为多个刚性变换的组合，并通过循环框架迭代求解，同时设计基于多视角深度图像的可微损失函数实现端到端训练。③相比现有方法，该表示约束了解空间，降低了学习难度，且无需真实标注。④在多个数据集上大幅超越先前SOTA。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration by representing transformations as combinations of rigid ones and using a recurrent framework with a differentiable multi-view depth loss. It outperforms previous SOTA by a large margin on several datasets without ground truth supervision.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 无监督配准方法对3D感知中的形状对齐有借鉴意义，但应用场景偏几何处理。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出无监督非刚性配准的循环多视角对齐网络。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 刚性变换组合表示和可微多视角深度损失。
2011.12104|v2.result: 多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角图像密集深度估计中稀疏点扩散优化效率低的问题，提出可微扩散方法，通过将点建模为具有解析透射率的高斯分布，联合优化点位置、深度和权重，并设计高效优化例程以处理超过5万个点。相比传统图像处理和深度学习方法，该方法在光场和宽基线图像上通过自监督方式显著降低了平均误差和离群误差。实验表明，该方法在复杂场景重建中具有高质量，且对不准确的稀疏点扩散更具鲁棒性。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of dense depth estimation from multi-view images by proposing a differentiable diffusion method that optimizes sparse points as Gaussians with analytic transmittance, enabling efficient joint optimization of positions, depths, and weights. It improves over traditional and deep learning baselines by reducing average and outlier errors in self-supervised settings, demonstrating high reconstruction quality and robustness to inaccurate sparse points.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 该方法创新性地将可微扩散与多视角几何结合，为深度估计提供了新思路，值得关注其在自动驾驶场景中的潜在应用。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，实现高效的多视角密集深度估计。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 将点云扩散建模为高斯分布并引入解析透射率，实现端到端优化。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在光场和宽基线数据上显著降低深度估计误差，重建质量高。

Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_cn: 针对多视角深度估计中时序信息利用不足的问题，提出极线时空网络，通过结合极线几何与时空特征提取，增强深度预测的准确性。方法利用多视角图像序列中的运动线索，改进传统静态多视角方法。实验表明，该方法在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法，尤其在动态场景中表现突出。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_en: This paper introduces an epipolar spatio-temporal network for multi-view depth estimation, leveraging temporal cues across frames to improve depth accuracy. It outperforms static multi-view methods on benchmarks, particularly in dynamic scenes.
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.assessment: 该工作将时序信息融入多视角深度估计，对自动驾驶动态场景感知有参考价值。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.contribution: 提出极线时空网络，融合时序信息提升多视角深度估计。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.innovation: 结合极线几何与时空特征，利用运动线索增强深度预测。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.result: 在多个数据集上取得更优深度估计性能。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol._arxiv_id: Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks.

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角聚类中表示对齐的缺陷，指出直接对齐视图分布会导致聚类可分性下降和视图优先级丧失。提出一个简单基线模型，避免表示对齐，并引入对比学习组件实现选择性对齐，保留视图优先级。实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上大幅超越现有最先进方法。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naive representation alignment in multi-view clustering, such as reduced cluster separability and loss of view prioritization. It proposes a baseline without alignment and a contrastive selective alignment variant, achieving large improvements over state-of-the-art on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 该研究对多视图聚类中的对齐策略提出批判性思考，但相关性较低。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 提出避免表示对齐的简单基线，并引入选择性对齐增强性能。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 揭示表示对齐的缺陷，设计对比学习实现选择性对齐。
2103.07738|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越现有方法。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率多视角立体匹配中3D代价体积正则化计算量大、内存占用高的问题，提出PatchmatchNet，一种可学习的级联Patchmatch框架。首次将迭代多尺度Patchmatch引入端到端可训练架构，并改进核心算法，采用自适应传播和评估方案。在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上，性能与最先进方法相当，但速度至少快2.5倍，内存使用减半。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: PatchmatchNet introduces a learnable cascade Patchmatch for high-resolution multi-view stereo, avoiding heavy 3D cost volume regularization. It features iterative multi-scale Patchmatch with adaptive propagation, achieving competitive accuracy on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D while being at least 2.5x faster and using half the memory of state-of-the-art methods.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 该工作显著提升多视角立体匹配的效率，对自动驾驶实时感知具有重要价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出高效可学习的PatchmatchNet，实现高分辨率多视角立体匹配。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 首次将迭代多尺度Patchmatch与自适应传播结合，实现端到端训练。
2012.01411|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能优异，速度提升2.5倍以上，内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: 针对新视角合成中泛化能力不足的问题，提出IBRNet，通过多层感知机和射线变换器估计连续5D位置的辐射和体积密度，并在渲染时从多个源视图动态获取外观信息。该方法学习通用的视图插值函数，可泛化到新场景，且通过经典体积渲染实现全微分训练。实验表明，IBRNet在泛化新视角合成任务上优于现有方法，微调后可与单场景神经渲染方法竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: IBRNet addresses novel view synthesis generalization by using a network with MLP and ray transformer to estimate radiance and density, drawing appearance from source views at render time. It learns a generic view interpolation function, outperforming recent generalization methods and matching single-scene neural rendering after fine-tuning.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 该工作结合图像渲染与神经表示，为多视角感知提供新视角，但相关性中等。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出IBRNet，实现可泛化的多视角图像渲染。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 在渲染时动态利用源视图信息，学习通用插值函数。
2102.13090|v2.result: 在泛化新视角合成上超越现有方法，微调后性能与单场景方法相当。

Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_cn: 针对多视角立体匹配中深度监督数据获取困难的问题，提出自监督学习方法，利用多视角图像一致性作为监督信号，训练深度推断网络。方法通过最小化重投影误差和正则化项，无需真实深度标签。实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上取得与有监督方法相当的性能，且泛化能力更强。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised learning method for multi-view stereo depth inference, using multi-view photometric consistency as supervision without ground truth depth. It achieves comparable performance to supervised methods and better generalization on benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.assessment: 该工作为多视角深度估计提供自监督方案，对自动驾驶数据稀缺场景有实际意义。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.contribution: 提出自监督多视角立体匹配方法，减少对标注数据的依赖。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.innovation: 利用多视角一致性损失实现无监督深度训练。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.result: 性能与有监督方法相当，泛化性更强。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Inference for Multi-View Stereo.

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中数据关联的挑战，如光照变化、运动模式差异和跨相机轨迹遮挡，提出了一种动态图模型与链接预测（DyGLIP）方法。该方法通过动态图建模和链接预测改进特征表示，并能从相机切换时的轨迹丢失中恢复，且不依赖相机重叠率。实验表明在多个实际数据集上大幅优于现有MC-MOT算法，并支持在线和增量设置。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-camera multi-object tracking by proposing a dynamic graph model with link prediction (DyGLIP). It improves feature representations and recovers from lost tracks during camera transitions, without relying on overlapping ratios. Experiments show significant improvements over existing MC-MOT algorithms on practical datasets, with support for online and incremental settings.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 该工作对多相机跟踪中的数据关联问题提供了新颖的图模型视角，对自动驾驶多视角感知有参考价值。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出DyGLIP动态图模型，通过链接预测解决MC-MOT数据关联问题。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 将动态图与链接预测结合，增强跨相机轨迹恢复能力。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 针对大场景宽基线多相机标定中3D关键点匹配困难的问题，提出利用行人重识别（re-ID）技术将行人作为关键点进行跨相机关联，从而获得对应关系。方法先通过re-ID关联行人边界框，再转换为点对应，最后用多视图几何和光束法平差求解相机位姿。该方法无需专用标定目标，适用于频繁标定更新的场景，并在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles wide-baseline multi-camera calibration by using person re-identification to associate pedestrians across views as keypoints. It converts bounding box correspondences to point correspondences and solves camera poses via multi-view geometry and bundle adjustment. The method requires no specialized targets and is suitable for frequent recalibration, with experiments on diverse datasets.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 该工作为宽基线标定提供了实用替代方案，但对自动驾驶场景的适用性有限。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出基于行人重识别的宽基线相机标定方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 将行人作为可重识别的关键点，替代传统3D匹配。
2104.08568|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了标定精度和实用性。

2010.13118|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中回归方法忽略相对深度顺序的问题，提出基于Plackett-Luce模型的列表式排序方法，作为成对排序的推广。方法结合先进神经网络架构和简单采样策略降低训练复杂度，并利用PL模型作为随机效用模型的表示，从排序数据中恢复平移不变的度量深度。在多个基准数据集上的零样本评估中展示了有效性。
2010.13118|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular depth estimation by proposing listwise ranking based on the Plackett-Luce model, generalizing pairwise ranking approaches. It integrates a state-of-the-art network with a sampling strategy to reduce complexity and recovers shift-invariant metric depth from ranking data. Zero-shot evaluations on benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness.
2010.13118|v2.assessment: 该工作对深度排序建模有理论贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关性较低。
2010.13118|v2.contribution: 提出基于Plackett-Luce模型的列表式深度排序方法。
2010.13118|v2.innovation: 利用随机效用模型从排序数据恢复度量深度。
2010.13118|v2.result: 在零样本基准上表现良好。

2105.14021|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计模型输出分辨率低且缺乏细节的问题，分析了输入分辨率和场景结构对性能的影响，发现全局结构一致性与高频细节之间存在权衡。提出内容自适应多分辨率合并方法，通过深度合并网络融合低分辨率和高分辨率估计，并采用双重估计和补丁选择增强局部细节。实验表明该方法能利用预训练模型生成多兆像素的高细节深度图。
2105.14021|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses low-resolution and detail-poor depth maps in monocular depth estimation by analyzing resolution and scene structure trade-offs. It proposes content-adaptive multi-resolution merging with a depth merging network, combining whole-image and patch-based estimations. The method generates multi-megapixel depth maps with high detail using pre-trained models.
2105.14021|v2.assessment: 该工作对提升深度图分辨率有实用价值，可增强自动驾驶感知的细节质量。
2105.14021|v2.contribution: 提出内容自适应多分辨率合并方法，提升单目深度估计分辨率。
2105.14021|v2.innovation: 利用分辨率与结构权衡，通过合并网络增强细节。
2105.14021|v2.result: 生成多兆像素高细节深度图。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 针对神经辐射场（NeRF）无法处理动态场景中物体运动的问题，提出STaR方法，实现多视角RGB视频中刚性运动物体的自监督跟踪与重建。方法显式建模物体刚性运动，将动态场景分解为静态背景和运动物体，分别用两个神经辐射场编码，并联合优化参数和刚性位姿。在合成和真实数据集上，该方法能渲染逼真的新视角，并在空间和时间上展示泛化能力。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of NeRF in dynamic scenes by proposing STaR, a self-supervised method for tracking and reconstructing rigid objects in motion from multi-view videos. It decomposes the scene into static and dynamic parts, each encoded by a neural radiance field, and jointly optimizes poses. Results on synthetic and real datasets show photorealistic novel view rendering with spatial and temporal generalization.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 该工作对动态场景神经渲染有重要贡献，可启发自动驾驶中动态目标建模。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督的刚性物体跟踪与重建方法STaR。
2101.01602|v2.innovation: 将刚性运动建模融入神经辐射场，实现无标注动态场景分解。
2101.01602|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上实现逼真新视角渲染。

Self-supervised Learning from a Multi-vi.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督学习在多视角数据中的表示学习问题，探讨如何利用多视角信息提升特征质量。②提出了一个从多视角角度进行自监督学习的框架，可能涉及多视角一致性或互补性约束。③相比单视角方法，改进在于显式建模视角间关系，增强表示的鲁棒性。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但理论上可提升下游任务性能。

It improves upon single-view methods by explicitly modeling inter-view relationships. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
Self-supervised Learning from a Multi-vi.assessment: 该论文选题有潜力，但摘要信息不足，难以评估具体贡献，适合作为理论参考。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对表格数据中自监督学习难以设计有效增强方法的问题，因为表格数据缺乏空间或时间结构。②提出了SubTab框架，通过将输入特征划分为多个子集，将表格学习转化为多视角表示学习问题，并在自编码器设置中重建子集特征而非损坏版本。③相比现有方法，改进在于利用特征子集作为自然增强，并通过协作推理聚合潜在变量。④实验表明SubTab在多个表格数据集上达到最先进性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of self-supervised learning on tabular data by introducing SubTab, which divides features into subsets to create a multi-view learning problem. It reconstructs from subsets rather than corrupted inputs, improving latent representation capture. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on tabular benchmarks.

2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出SubTab框架，将表格数据自监督学习转化为多视角表示学习。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 通过特征子集划分和协作推理，避免传统增强设计的困难。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在多个表格数据集上达到最先进性能。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: ①针对程序性活动理解中缺乏大规模多视角数据集的问题，现有数据集规模小、视角单一且缺乏细粒度标注。②提出了Assembly101数据集，包含4321个视频，101种可拆卸玩具车辆的组装与拆卸过程，同时记录8个静态视角和4个第一人称视角，并提供了超过100K粗粒度、1M细粒度动作片段和18M 3D手部姿态标注。③相比已有工作，首次结合多视角与第一人称视角，并引入错误检测任务，支持跨视角迁移和长尾分布研究。④在动作识别、预测和时间分割三个任务上进行了基准测试，并展示了新任务错误检测的潜力。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multi-view datasets for procedural activity understanding by introducing Assembly101, featuring 4321 videos with 8 static and 4 egocentric views, annotated with over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments and 18M 3D hand poses. It benchmarks recognition, anticipation, and temporal segmentation, and proposes a novel mistake detection task, enabling studies on generalization, cross-view transfer, and long-tailed distributions.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集规模大、标注丰富，对多视角视频理解和程序性活动分析有重要推动作用，尤其适合研究跨视角泛化和细粒度动作建模。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 提供了首个大规模多视角程序性活动数据集，并引入错误检测新任务。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 结合静态多视角与第一人称视角，并支持细粒度手部姿态和动作标注。
2203.14712|v2.result: 在多个任务上建立基准，展示了数据集在动作理解研究中的广泛适用性。

2203.16317|v2.result: 在多个检测基准上验证了性能提升。

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角图像中头发几何与外观建模的难题，现有方法难以兼顾真实感渲染和实时性能。②提出了Neural Strands，一种基于神经头皮纹理的头发表示，每个纹素编码发丝几何与外观，并通过光栅化实现实时渲染。③相比体积方法，该方法支持直观的形状和风格控制，并首次实现多视角设置下外观与显式头发几何的联合学习。④实验表明该方法在多种发型上实现了高保真和高效的渲染效果。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hair geometry and appearance modeling from multi-view images. It proposes Neural Strands, a representation using a neural scalp texture encoding per-strand geometry and appearance, rendered via rasterization for real-time performance. Unlike volumetric methods, it enables intuitive control and joint learning of appearance and explicit geometry, achieving photorealistic and view-consistent results.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 该论文在3D重建和渲染领域有创新，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关性较低。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于神经发丝的多视角头发建模与实时渲染框架。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 利用神经头皮纹理和光栅化实现显式几何与外观的联合学习。
2207.14067|v2.result: 在多种发型上实现了高保真和高效的渲染。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: ①针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，现有自监督方法在2D或3D单独使用效果有限。②提出了MvDeCor，通过多视角渲染和对比学习框架中的稠密对应学习，获得视角不变且几何一致的2D表示。③相比仅用2D或3D自监督的方法，该方法在有限标注下泛化性更好，尤其受益于2D处理和3D几何推理的结合。④在RenderPeople和PartNet数据集上，该方法在细粒度部件分割中优于现有技术，且在稀疏视角或纹理形状下改进更大。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses fine-grained 3D shape segmentation with limited labels. It proposes MvDeCor, which learns dense correspondences across rendered views via contrastive learning, yielding view-invariant and geometrically consistent representations. This outperforms 2D-only or 3D-only self-supervised methods, especially with sparse views or textured shapes, as shown on RenderPeople and PartNet.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了2D自监督在3D任务中的潜力，对多视角感知有参考价值，但非自动驾驶核心。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出了多视角稠密对应学习用于细粒度3D分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 结合2D对比学习与3D几何推理，提升自监督效果。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法，尤其在小样本和纹理场景。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准数据集的问题。②构建了一个包含998个日常桌面物体3D模型和84.7万张真实RGB与深度图像的数据集，并半自动标注相机位姿和物体位姿。③该数据集填补了学习型多视角3D重建在真实场景中的空白，支持形状重建、姿态估计等任务。④提供了标注工具和评估基线，便于社区使用和比较。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction. It presents a dataset of 998 3D models with 847,000 real RGB-D images, semi-automatically annotated with camera and object poses. This fills a gap for learned reconstruction methods and supports tasks like shape reconstruction and pose estimation, with tools and baselines provided.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 该数据集对3D重建研究有实用价值，但场景为桌面物体，与自动驾驶差异较大。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 提供了一个大规模真实世界多视角3D重建数据集。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 半自动标注流程和全面的评估基线。
2203.11397|v2.result: 填补了真实世界基准的空白，支持多种3D应用。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: ①针对学习型多视角立体匹配（MVS）中成本体积融合效率低、3D空间关联利用不足的问题。②提出了MVSTER，利用极线Transformer同时学习2D语义和3D空间关联，通过可分离单目深度估计增强语义，并用交叉注意力构建沿极线的数据相关3D关联。③相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet，该方法无需额外网络学习2D信息，降低了计算成本，并采用级联结构和熵正则化最优传输传播深度。④在DTU基准上，MVSTER相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别实现了34%和14%的相对改进，显著提升效率。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficiency in cost volume fusion for learning-based MVS. It proposes MVSTER, using an epipolar Transformer to jointly learn 2D semantics and 3D spatial associations, with a detachable monocular depth estimator and cross-attention. This reduces computation and improves accuracy, achieving 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet on DTU.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 该论文在MVS领域有显著创新，对3D重建和自动驾驶感知中的深度估计有重要参考价值。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出了基于极线Transformer的高效多视角立体匹配方法。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer统一2D语义和3D关联学习，减少计算开销。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU上大幅提升重建性能，效率更高。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视角域适应问题，即源域和目标域数据缺失部分视角。②提出了通过通道增强和知识迁移的方法，增强共享通道特征并迁移知识以对齐域。③相比传统域适应方法，该方法专门处理视角缺失情况，提升跨域泛化。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view domain adaptation, where views are missing. It proposes channel enhancement and knowledge transfer to align domains by enhancing shared features. This targets view-missing scenarios, but no specific results are provided in the abstract.
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.assessment: 该论文主题与自动驾驶多传感器融合有一定关联，但摘要信息不足，创新性和效果不明确。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.contribution: 提出了针对不完整多视角的域适应方法。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.innovation: 结合通道增强和知识迁移处理视角缺失。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.result: 未提供具体数据，效果未知。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation via Channel Enhancement and Knowledge Transfer.

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）方法多阶段处理导致误差累积的问题。②提出PS-NeRF，一种基于隐式神经表示的逆渲染方法，联合估计非朗伯物体的几何、材质和光照。③利用多光照图像估计逐视角法线图以正则化神经辐射场法线，并通过阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化法线、空间变化BRDF和光照。④在合成和真实数据集上，形状重建精度显著优于现有MVPS和神经渲染方法。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses error accumulation in traditional multi-view photometric stereo (MVPS) pipelines by proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method based on implicit representation. It jointly estimates geometry, materials, and lights, using multi-light normal maps to regularize NeRF normals and a shadow-aware differentiable renderer for optimization. Experiments show significantly more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods on synthetic and real datasets.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 该方法在逆渲染与神经隐式表示结合上具有创新性，但主题与自动驾驶感知核心领域（如检测、BEV、占用）相关性较低，主要面向图形学与三维重建。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于神经辐射场的多视角光度立体逆渲染框架，实现几何、材质和光照的联合优化。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 利用光度立体法线先验正则化NeRF，并引入阴影感知渲染层提升非朗伯表面重建精度。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据上，形状重建精度显著优于现有MVPS和神经渲染方法。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: ①该论文针对购物场景中多视角图像的无遮挡实例分割（amodal instance segmentation）缺乏大规模基准数据集的问题。②提出了MUVA，一个大规模多视角无遮挡实例分割基准，包含多视角图像和对应的无遮挡掩码标注。③相比现有数据集，MUVA专注于购物场景，提供了更丰富的多视角一致性和遮挡关系标注。④该基准为多视角感知和遮挡推理研究提供了新的评测平台，但摘要中未提供具体性能数据。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios. It introduces MUVA, a new dataset with multi-view images and amodal masks, enabling research on occlusion reasoning and multi-view consistency. The benchmark provides a new evaluation platform, though no specific performance metrics are reported in the abstract.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 该论文贡献了一个新领域的数据集，对多视角感知和遮挡推理有参考价值，但影响力可能局限于购物场景。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 提出了首个面向购物场景的多视角无遮挡实例分割基准MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 将无遮挡分割扩展到多视角购物场景，提供大规模标注数据。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 提供了新的评测基准，但未报告具体性能数据。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对车车协同感知中异构传感器模态（如相机和LiDAR）融合的问题，现有方法仅支持同质传感器。②提出了HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架，通过异构3D图Transformer联合推理智能体间和智能体内的交互，实现3D目标检测。③相比现有协同感知方法，HM-ViT支持不同数量和类型的智能体协作，增强了跨模态交互。④在OPV2V数据集上，HM-ViT优于最先进的协同感知方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of heterogeneous sensor modalities in V2V cooperative perception, where existing methods assume homogeneous sensors. It proposes HM-ViT, the first unified framework using a heterogeneous 3D graph transformer to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR across agents. Experiments on OPV2V show superior performance over SOTA methods, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了协同感知中的实际异构问题，具有较高的应用价值，但实验规模有限。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出了首个支持异构模态的V2V协同感知框架HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异构3D图Transformer联合建模智能体间和智能体内交互。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在OPV2V上超越现有协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测在未知域中因域偏移导致性能下降的问题，指出现有域对抗学习忽略了公共特征中隐含的非因果因素。②提出了基于多视角对抗判别器（MAD）的域泛化模型，包含伪相关生成器（SCG）和多视角域分类器（MVDC），通过多视角对抗训练去除非因果因素。③相比单视角域对抗方法，MAD利用数据多模态结构，在多个潜在空间识别并移除非因果因素，纯化域不变特征。④实验表明该方法在未知域检测中有效，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in object detection by identifying non-causal factors in common features overlooked by single-view adversarial learning. It proposes MAD, a domain generalization model with a spurious correlations generator and multi-view domain classifier to purify domain-invariant features. The method improves unseen domain detection, though specific results are not given.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 该论文从因果视角改进域泛化，思想新颖，对开放环境检测有启发。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出多视角对抗判别器以去除非因果因素，增强域泛化能力。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多视角潜在空间识别并移除非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.result: 在未知域检测任务中取得改进。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对纯相机3D检测中深度估计不准的问题，提出通过多智能体协作来提升性能，而非仅改进网络结构。②提出了CoCa3D，一种协作式纯相机3D检测框架，使智能体共享互补信息，并优化通信效率选择最有信息量的线索。③相比单智能体方法，多视角共享信息消除了深度估计的歧义，并补充了遮挡和远距离区域。④在DAIR-V2X上AP@70提升44.21%，OPV2V+提升30.60%，CoPerception-UAVs+提升12.59%，显著超越现有方法。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses depth estimation challenges in camera-only 3D detection by introducing multi-agent collaboration. CoCa3D enables agents to share complementary cues with efficient communication, disambiguating depth and covering occluded regions. It achieves significant improvements: 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+ for AP@70.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了协作感知的潜力，性能提升显著，对自动驾驶3D检测有重要影响。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协作式纯相机3D检测框架CoCa3D，通过多智能体通信提升深度估计。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 利用多视角协作和通信优化解决单目深度歧义。
2303.13560|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA，最高提升44.21%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多视角点云配准中位姿图初始化和历史信息利用的问题。②提出了鲁棒的多视角点云配准方法，包括可靠的位姿图初始化和历史重加权策略。③相比现有方法，改进了初始化和优化过程，增强了鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multiview point cloud registration by improving pose graph initialization and history reweighting. The proposed method enhances robustness in registration, but no specific results are provided in the abstract.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 该论文主题与3D感知相关，但摘要信息有限，创新性和影响力待评估。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出改进的位姿图初始化和历史重加权策略。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 结合可靠初始化和历史信息优化配准。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉中心自动驾驶中联合感知和预测的问题，现有BEV方法未充分利用时间信息。②提出了TBP-Former，学习时间BEV金字塔，用于联合3D检测和运动预测。③相比单帧BEV方法，TBP-Former通过时间金字塔建模动态场景，提升感知和预测的协同性。④摘要未提供具体数值，但框架设计具有创新性。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper addresses joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving by proposing TBP-Former, which learns a temporal BEV pyramid. It leverages temporal information to enhance 3D detection and motion forecasting. The framework is innovative, though specific results are not reported.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 该论文针对BEV感知与预测的联合优化，方向重要，设计合理，但需更多实验验证。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出时间BEV金字塔框架TBP-Former用于联合感知和预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 利用时间金字塔建模动态场景，增强BEV表示。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: ①针对多视图3D-4D视图合成问题，提出神经像素合成方法。②方法利用多视图几何和神经渲染技术，学习像素级合成以生成新视角。③相比传统方法，可能更有效地处理复杂场景和遮挡。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D-4D view synthesis via neural pixel composition. It leverages multi-view geometry and neural rendering to learn pixel-level composition for novel view generation. The approach may improve handling of complex scenes and occlusions, though specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 摘要不完整，且主题与目标领域相关性低，创新性和影响力有限。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出一种基于神经像素合成的多视图3D-4D视图合成方法。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 将像素级合成引入多视图渲染。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视图聚类中样本缺失和原型偏移问题。②提出跨视图部分样本和原型对齐网络（CPSPAN），利用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督，并改进原型对齐。③相比现有对比学习方法，保留视图差异性和灵活性。④摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view clustering with missing samples and prototype shift. It proposes CPSPAN, using pair-observed alignment as proxy supervision and improved prototype alignment. Unlike contrastive methods, it preserves view discrepancy, though specific results are unavailable.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 主题与自动驾驶感知相关性低，但方法在聚类领域有一定创新性。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出CPSPAN网络解决不完整多视图聚类中的样本和原型对齐问题。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 利用代理监督信号替代严格对比学习。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动态场景中多帧深度估计因多视图几何一致性被破坏而性能下降的问题。②提出学习融合单目和多视图线索的方法，无需启发式掩码，通过跨线索融合模块（CCF）在静态区域传播几何信息到动态区域，并增强多视图代价体。③相比现有方法，避免了掩码质量不可控和融合不充分的问题。④摘要不完整，但预期在动态场景中显著提升深度估计精度。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes where geometric consistency is violated. It proposes learning to fuse monocular and multi-view cues without heuristic masks, using a cross-cue fusion module to propagate static geometry to dynamic areas and enhance cost volumes. This avoids mask quality issues and improves fusion, with expected accuracy gains.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知高度相关，方法创新且实用，对动态场景深度估计有重要价值。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出无掩码的跨线索融合方法，提升动态场景多帧深度估计。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 学习式融合单目和多视图线索，无需显式掩码。
2304.08993|v2.result: 预期在动态场景中显著提升深度估计精度。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: ①针对城市理解中多级别和多视图图像缺乏大规模标注数据集的问题。②提出OmniCity数据集，包含卫星、全景和单视图图像，超过10万张像素级标注图像，来自纽约市2.5万个地理位置，并设计高效标注流程。③相比现有基准，图像数量更多、标注类型更丰富、视图更多，并引入新任务。④提供多种任务基准，包括建筑足迹提取、高度估计和分割。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OmniCity, a large-scale dataset for city understanding with multi-level and multi-view images, including satellite, panorama, and mono-view. It contains over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from 25K locations, with an efficient annotation pipeline. It offers richer annotations and new tasks compared to existing benchmarks, providing baselines for multiple tasks.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 数据集规模大、标注丰富，对多视图城市感知研究有重要推动作用。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建OmniCity多视图城市理解数据集及标注流程。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 利用卫星视图标签和视图变换关系高效标注街景。
2208.00928|v2.result: 提供多任务基准，支持城市感知研究。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图3D重建缺乏多传感器数据集的问题。②提出新数据集，包含不同分辨率和模态的RGB和深度数据，来自智能手机、RealSense、Kinect等传感器，覆盖107个场景、140万张图像。③相比现有数据集，强调材料多样性挑战。④数据集可用于评估和训练3D重建算法。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a multi-sensor dataset for multi-view 3D reconstruction, including registered RGB and depth data from various sensors. It covers 107 scenes with 1.4 million images under diverse lighting, emphasizing challenging materials. The dataset is useful for evaluating and training reconstruction algorithms.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 数据集对3D重建领域有价值，但与自动驾驶感知相关性中等。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 提供多传感器多视图3D重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 涵盖多种传感器和材料挑战。
2203.06111|v2.result: 支持3D重建算法评估和训练。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视图聚类中忽略样本间结构关系的问题。②提出全局和跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC），通过跨样本和跨视图聚合探索互补性，并用结构引导对比学习对齐表示。③相比现有视图级聚合方法，更充分利用样本结构。④摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view clustering by proposing GCFAggMVC, which aggregates features across samples and views to explore complementarity, and uses structure-guided contrastive learning for alignment. It improves over view-wise aggregation by leveraging sample structure, though specific results are unavailable.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 主题与自动驾驶感知相关性低，方法在聚类领域有创新但影响有限。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出GCFAggMVC网络用于多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 跨样本和跨视图特征聚合。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: ①针对多视角图像合成高分辨率新视图时，辐射场优化受限于低分辨率输入的问题。②提出跨引导优化框架，结合多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场训练，实现高分辨率新视图合成。③相比现有方法，通过跨视角信息引导超分辨率与辐射场联合优化，提升细节重建。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据，但方法在理论上可提升合成分辨率与质量。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of radiance field optimization constrained by low-resolution inputs in high-resolution novel view synthesis. It proposes a cross-guided optimization framework integrating multi-view image super-resolution with radiance field training. The improvement lies in joint optimization guided by cross-view information, enhancing detail reconstruction. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶多相机感知相关度较低，且摘要缺失，质量评估受限，但跨视角优化思路有一定参考价值。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出跨引导的辐射场与多视角超分辨率联合优化方法。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 跨视角信息引导的联合优化机制。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角重建任务中，现有方法将3D信息编码为2D特征导致几何感知不足的问题。②提出POEM方法，直接在多视角立体匹配中嵌入3D点，通过点特征融合和跨集点注意力机制重建手部网格。③相比已有工作，利用点的自然3D形式和跨视角投影特性，实现更有效的特征融合。④在三个多视角数据集上，POEM在手部网格重建中优于现有最先进方法。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of insufficient geometric awareness in multi-view reconstruction, where existing methods encode 3D information into 2D features. POEM directly operates on 3D points embedded in multi-view stereo, using point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention for hand mesh reconstruction. It improves by leveraging points' natural 3D form and cross-view projections. Experiments on three datasets show state-of-the-art performance.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 该方法在3D重建领域有创新性，与自动驾驶3D检测相关度中等，但手部重建场景限制其直接应用。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出基于3D点嵌入的多视角立体手部重建方法。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 点嵌入多视角立体与跨集点注意力机制。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个数据集上优于现有最先进方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: ①针对多视角立体匹配中纹理缺失区域重建困难的问题。②提出自适应补丁变形方法，增强对无纹理区域的鲁棒性。③相比现有方法，通过自适应调整补丁形状适应纹理缺失区域。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据，但方法旨在提升无纹理场景的重建质量。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of reconstructing textureless regions in multi-view stereo. It proposes adaptive patch deformation to enhance robustness in such areas. The improvement lies in adapting patch shapes to handle textureless regions. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶多相机感知相关度中等，但摘要缺失，质量评估受限，方法对无纹理区域处理有潜在应用价值。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应补丁变形以提升无纹理区域的多视角重建鲁棒性。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪（3D MOT）中检测与关联分离导致的误差累积和效率低下问题。②提出ADA-Track，一种端到端框架，通过交替进行检测和关联（Alternating Detection and Association）来联合优化两个任务。③相比传统两阶段方法，该方法在统一网络中动态交互检测与关联信息，减少信息丢失，提升跟踪一致性。④在nuScenes等基准上取得了具有竞争力的性能，尤其在遮挡和密集场景下显著降低了ID切换率。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation and inefficiency in multi-camera 3D MOT caused by separate detection and association. It proposes ADA-Track, an end-to-end framework with alternating detection and association for joint optimization. Compared to two-stage methods, it dynamically interacts between tasks in a unified network, improving consistency and reducing ID switches on benchmarks like nuScenes.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 该工作将检测与关联交替融合，是端到端多相机3D跟踪的重要探索，对自动驾驶感知系统有直接参考价值。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D跟踪框架。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 在统一网络中交替优化检测与关联，打破传统两阶段范式。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes上取得竞争性性能，显著降低ID切换率。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: ①针对多视图图像下的3D室内目标检测中，现有方法难以有效聚合射线特征的问题。②提出CN-RMA，结合组合网络与射线行进聚合（Ray Marching Aggregation）模块，沿射线方向逐步聚合多视图特征。③相比基于体素或Transformer的方法，该方法更精细地建模射线上的特征分布，提升几何感知能力。④在室内基准数据集（如ScanNet）上取得了优于现有方法的检测精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of aggregating ray features for 3D indoor object detection from multi-view images. It proposes CN-RMA, a combined network with a ray marching aggregation module to progressively fuse features along rays. Compared to voxel or transformer-based methods, it models feature distributions more precisely, achieving improved detection accuracy on indoor benchmarks like ScanNet.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 射线行进聚合思路新颖，对多视图3D检测的几何建模有启发，但室内场景与自动驾驶相关性中等。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出射线行进聚合模块用于多视图3D室内检测。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 沿射线方向逐步聚合特征，增强几何一致性。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在ScanNet等数据集上取得领先精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: ①针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中缺乏标注数据且多视图信息利用不足的问题。②提出对比预训练与多视图融合方法，利用对比学习从无标注点云中学习通用表示，并融合多视图特征进行质量回归。③相比仅依赖手工特征或单视图的方法，该方法通过自监督预训练提升泛化能力。④在多个PCQA基准上取得了与全监督方法相当或更优的性能。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotations and insufficient multi-view exploitation in no-reference point cloud quality assessment. It proposes contrastive pre-training with multi-view fusion to learn general representations and regress quality scores. Compared to handcrafted or single-view methods, it improves generalization, achieving comparable or better performance on multiple PCQA benchmarks.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 自监督预训练思路合理，但点云质量评估与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出对比预训练与多视图融合的无参考点云质量评估方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 利用自监督对比学习缓解标注稀缺问题。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在多个基准上达到与全监督方法相当的性能。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: ①针对帕金森病（PD）的客观运动评估中，传统临床量表主观且耗时的问题。②提出TULIP，利用多相机3D姿态估计技术，从多视角视频中精确量化PD患者的运动特征。③相比单相机或穿戴式设备，该方法提供更全面的3D运动分析，减少环境限制。④在PD患者数据上验证了与临床评分的高度相关性，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: This paper addresses the subjectivity and time cost of traditional clinical scales for Parkinson's disease assessment. It proposes TULIP, a multi-camera 3D pose estimation system to quantify motor symptoms from multi-view videos. Compared to single-camera or wearable methods, it provides comprehensive 3D analysis, showing high correlation with clinical scores, though specific numbers are not provided.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 医疗应用场景有社会价值，但技术核心为姿态估计，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 提出多相机3D评估系统用于帕金森病运动量化。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 将多相机3D感知技术应用于临床运动评估。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 与临床评分高度相关，但未提供具体数据。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm._arxiv_id: TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessment of Parkinson's Disease.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏监督的单目深度估计中，深度边缘预测不准确的问题。②提出Mind The Edge方法，通过显式建模深度边缘，利用边缘一致性损失和边缘感知的采样策略来细化预测。③相比仅使用像素级损失的现有方法，该方法在边缘区域引入额外约束，提升几何边界清晰度。④在KITTI等数据集上，深度估计精度（如RMSE）和边缘F1分数均有显著提升。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth edges in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes Mind The Edge, which explicitly models depth edges with edge consistency loss and edge-aware sampling. Compared to pixel-wise loss methods, it adds constraints on edge regions, improving boundary clarity, with significant gains in RMSE and edge F1 on KITTI.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 深度边缘细化对3D感知下游任务有实际价值，方法简洁有效，值得关注。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出边缘感知的稀疏监督单目深度估计细化方法。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 显式建模深度边缘并引入边缘一致性损失。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在KITTI上显著提升深度精度和边缘质量。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中依赖大规模标注数据且泛化性差的问题。②提出重新利用扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion）作为深度估计器，通过微调生成模型的潜在空间来输出深度图。③相比从头训练的深度网络，该方法利用预训练生成模型的强大先验，在零样本和少样本场景下表现更优。④在多个基准（如NYUv2、KITTI）上取得了与专用深度模型相当或更好的性能，尤其在跨域泛化上优势明显。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on large-scale annotations and poor generalization in monocular depth estimation. It proposes repurposing diffusion-based image generators for depth estimation by fine-tuning their latent space. Compared to training from scratch, it leverages strong priors from pre-trained generators, excelling in zero-shot and few-shot settings, achieving comparable or better performance on benchmarks like NYUv2 and KITTI.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 利用扩散模型先验是前沿方向，对自动驾驶的泛化需求有重要启示。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 提出将扩散模型重新用于单目深度估计的新范式。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 微调生成模型的潜在空间以输出深度图。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在多个基准上达到与专用模型相当或更好的性能。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态物体（如行人、车辆）深度不准的问题。②提出从地面到物体的粗到细方法，利用地面接触先验（物体与地面的交点）来约束动态物体的深度估计。③相比现有方法，显式引入几何先验，无需额外标注，提升动态区域的深度精度。④在KITTI等数据集上，动态物体区域的深度误差显著降低，整体性能优于基线。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation for dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a coarse-to-fine approach using ground contact priors to constrain object depth. Compared to existing methods, it explicitly leverages geometric priors without extra labels, significantly reducing depth errors on dynamic regions in KITTI benchmarks.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶中动态物体深度估计的痛点，提出实用的几何先验方案，值得关注。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出利用地面接触先验改进动态物体深度估计的自监督方法。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 粗到细的深度估计框架结合地面接触几何约束。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 在KITTI上动态区域深度误差显著降低。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域（如移动车辆）监督信号不足的问题。②提出一种挖掘动态区域监督信息的方法，通过分析多帧一致性或光流来识别并利用动态区域的可靠监督。③相比现有方法，更有效地利用动态区域的信息，减少对静态场景假设的依赖。④在KITTI和Cityscapes上，动态区域的深度精度提升，整体性能改善。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient supervision for dynamic regions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a method to mine supervision signals in dynamic areas using multi-frame consistency or optical flow. Compared to existing approaches, it better exploits dynamic region information, reducing reliance on static scene assumptions, and improves depth accuracy on KITTI and Cityscapes.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 该论文针对动态区域监督不足的常见问题，提出有效挖掘策略，对自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出动态区域监督挖掘方法，提升自监督深度估计性能。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 利用多帧一致性动态识别并利用可靠监督。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 在KITTI和Cityscapes上动态区域精度提升。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中扩散模型条件化不足、生成深度图细节不准确的问题。②提出ECoDepth，通过有效条件化扩散模型，引入全局和局部特征嵌入，并设计新的训练策略。③相比现有扩散深度估计方法，条件化更充分，能生成更精细的深度图。④在NYU-Depth-v2和KITTI上，相对误差降低约10%，达到SOTA性能。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient conditioning in diffusion models for monocular depth estimation. It proposes ECoDepth, which effectively conditions diffusion models with global and local feature embeddings and a novel training strategy. Compared to existing diffusion-based methods, it achieves finer depth maps, reducing relative error by ~10% on NYU-Depth-v2 and KITTI, reaching state-of-the-art.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 该论文将扩散模型有效应用于深度估计，方法创新且性能优异，值得关注。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出ECoDepth，有效条件化扩散模型实现高精度单目深度估计。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 全局与局部特征嵌入的扩散模型条件化机制。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.result: 在NYU和KITTI上相对误差降低约10%，达到SOTA。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计在复杂场景中缺乏语义理解、深度模糊的问题。②提出WorDepth，利用变分语言先验（如文本描述）来引导深度估计，通过变分自编码器将语言特征与视觉特征融合。③相比纯视觉方法，引入语言先验增强对场景结构的理解，尤其在遮挡和低纹理区域。④在NYU-Depth-v2和KITTI上，深度精度提升，尤其在语义复杂区域。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper addresses depth ambiguity in monocular depth estimation lacking semantic understanding. It proposes WorDepth, using variational language priors (e.g., text descriptions) to guide depth estimation via a variational autoencoder fusing language and visual features. Compared to vision-only methods, it enhances scene structure understanding, especially in occluded and low-texture areas, improving accuracy on NYU-Depth-v2 and KITTI.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 该论文创新性地引入语言先验，为深度估计提供新思路，与多模态趋势契合。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出变分语言先验引导的单目深度估计方法。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 将语言模型与变分推断结合用于深度估计。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在NYU和KITTI上精度提升，语义复杂区域改善明显。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖大量标注、泛化性差的问题。②提出SelfPose3d，一种自监督方法，利用多视角几何一致性（如重投影误差）进行训练，无需3D标注。③相比监督方法，减少标注成本，并利用多视角约束提升姿态一致性。④在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP上，3D姿态误差接近监督方法，但无需3D标签。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy annotation and poor generalization of multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation. It proposes SelfPose3d, a self-supervised method using multi-view geometric consistency (e.g., reprojection error) without 3D labels. Compared to supervised methods, it reduces annotation cost and improves pose consistency, achieving near-supervised accuracy on Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 该论文在3D姿态估计中探索自监督，虽与自动驾驶核心任务相关度中等，但方法有参考价值。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.contribution: 提出自监督多视角3D姿态估计方法，无需3D标注。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 利用多视角几何一致性进行自监督训练。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.result: 在Human3.6M上接近监督方法精度。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: ①针对实际多视角场景中噪声视图对自监督聚类算法的负面影响。②系统研究噪声视图（如缺失、损坏）对聚类性能的影响，并提出缓解策略（如鲁棒特征融合）。③相比现有聚类方法，增强对噪声的鲁棒性。④在多个多视角数据集上，聚类准确率提升，尤其在噪声比例高时。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views on self-supervised clustering in practical multi-view scenarios. It systematically studies the impact of noisy views (e.g., missing or corrupted) and proposes mitigation strategies like robust feature fusion. Compared to existing clustering methods, it enhances robustness, improving clustering accuracy on multiple multi-view datasets, especially under high noise ratios.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 该论文聚焦多视图聚类，与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度较低，但鲁棒性研究有一定参考。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 系统分析并缓解噪声视图对自监督聚类的影响。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 提出鲁棒特征融合策略应对噪声视图。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在多个数据集上聚类准确率提升。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D目标检测中像素级深度监督与DETR检测器不匹配的问题，即LiDAR点云深度多分布在物体表面，缺乏物体中心深度，且远处物体细粒度深度估计困难。②提出OPEN检测器，通过物体级深度编码器（以像素级深度图为先验）估计物体级深度，并利用物体级位置嵌入将深度信息注入Transformer解码器。③改进点在于将深度监督从像素级提升到物体级，更符合DETR的查询机制，并缓解远处物体深度估计难题。④实验表明OPEN在nuScenes等数据集上显著提升检测精度，尤其改善远距离物体的定位性能。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between pixel-wise depth supervision and DETR-based multi-view 3D detectors by proposing object-wise depth estimation and position embedding. The OPEN detector injects object-level depth into the transformer decoder, improving depth accuracy for distant objects. Experiments show notable gains in 3D detection performance on standard benchmarks.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多视角3D检测中的深度监督问题提出新颖的物体级深度建模，思路清晰且实用性强，对DETR类检测器有直接改进价值。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出物体级深度编码与位置嵌入机制，有效提升多视角3D检测的深度感知能力。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 将深度监督从像素级转向物体级，并设计专用位置嵌入注入Transformer解码器。
2407.10753|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上显著提升3D检测精度，尤其改善远距离目标定位。

Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_cn: ①针对多相机图像生成高分辨率向量表示用于3D目标检测的问题，现有方法在特征分辨率和向量化表示上存在不足。②提出一种从多相机图像学习高分辨率向量表示的方法，通过增强特征提取和向量化编码提升检测精度。③改进点在于利用高分辨率特征和向量表示更好地保留空间细节，适应复杂场景。④实验显示该方法在3D检测基准上取得优于基线的结果，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_en: This work tackles the challenge of learning high-resolution vector representations from multi-camera images for 3D object detection. It proposes enhanced feature extraction and vectorized encoding to preserve spatial details. Experiments demonstrate improved detection performance over baselines, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.assessment: 该论文聚焦多相机3D检测中的特征表示学习，方向重要，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证方法细节和效果。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.contribution: 提出高分辨率向量表示学习方法，提升多相机3D检测的空间信息保留能力。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.innovation: 结合高分辨率特征与向量化编码，优化多相机感知的表示质量。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.result: 在3D检测基准上取得优于基线的性能提升。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen._arxiv_id: Learning High-Resolution Vector Representation from Multi-camera Images for 3D Object Detection.

Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D目标检测中负样本采样策略忽视深度信息的问题，导致模型对深度模糊区域判别不足。②提出射线去噪（Ray Denoising）方法，利用深度感知的硬负样本采样，在训练中强化对深度不一致样本的学习。③改进点在于将深度信息融入负样本选择，提升模型对深度歧义的鲁棒性。④实验表明该方法在多个多视角3D检测基准上显著提升性能，尤其改善遮挡和远距离场景。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of depth-agnostic negative sampling in multi-view 3D detection by introducing ray denoising with depth-aware hard negative mining. The method enhances training by focusing on depth-inconsistent samples, improving robustness to depth ambiguity. Experiments show significant performance gains on standard benchmarks, particularly in occluded and distant scenarios.
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.assessment: 该论文针对训练采样策略提出深度感知改进，方法简洁有效，对多视角3D检测的实用价值高。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.contribution: 提出深度感知的硬负样本采样方法，提升多视角3D检测的判别能力。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.innovation: 将射线去噪与深度信息结合，优化负样本选择过程。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.result: 在多个基准上显著提升检测性能，尤其在复杂场景中。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative._arxiv_id: Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative Sampling for Multi-view 3D Object Detection.

AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全中嵌入表示和跨视角特征解耦不足的问题，影响补全质量。②提出AEDNet，采用自适应嵌入和多视角感知解耦机制，提升点云补全的精度和泛化性。③改进点在于通过自适应嵌入适应不同输入分布，并解耦多视角特征以减少干扰。④实验显示AEDNet在点云补全基准上优于现有方法，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in embedding and cross-view feature disentanglement for point cloud completion by proposing AEDNet with adaptive embedding and multiview-aware disentanglement. The method improves completion accuracy and generalization. Experiments show superiority over existing methods, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.assessment: 该论文针对点云补全提出自适应嵌入和解耦机制，方法有创新性，但与自动驾驶3D检测的直接相关性较低。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.contribution: 提出自适应嵌入和多视角解耦方法，提升点云补全性能。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.innovation: 结合自适应嵌入与多视角感知解耦，增强特征表达。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.result: 在点云补全基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview._arxiv_id: AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview-Aware Disentanglement for Point Cloud Completion.

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型（LLMs）在核心视觉感知能力上的不足，现有基准多依赖自然语言中介，难以评估真实感知。②提出BLINK基准，包含14个经典视觉任务、3807个多项选择题，涵盖相对深度估计、视觉对应、取证检测和多视角推理等。③改进点在于任务设计抵抗语言中介，直接测试感知能力，且人类平均准确率95.70%，而GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%。④结果表明当前多模态LLMs的感知能力尚未涌现，而专用CV模型表现更好，为未来改进指明方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces BLINK, a benchmark for multimodal LLMs focusing on core visual perception tasks that resist language mediation. With 14 tasks and 3,807 questions, humans achieve 95.70% accuracy, while GPT-4V and Gemini reach only 51.26% and 45.72%, highlighting the lack of emergent perception abilities. The benchmark reveals that specialist CV models outperform LLMs, suggesting pathways for improvement.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: 该论文提出高难度感知基准，揭示多模态LLMs的感知短板，对VLM和自动驾驶感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 构建BLINK基准，系统评估多模态LLMs的视觉感知能力。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 设计抵抗语言中介的感知任务，量化LLMs与人类的差距。
2404.12390|v2.result: 人类准确率95.70%，最佳LLM仅51.26%，凸显感知能力缺失。

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中丰富资源输入（高分辨率、多帧）依赖问题，推理时仅用单图但性能受限。②提出RPrDepth，离线提取丰富资源特征作为先验，推理时通过相似像素搜索增强单图深度估计。③改进点在于将丰富资源信息转化为离线参考特征，实现推理时无需额外输入。④实验表明RPrDepth在仅用低分辨率单图输入时，性能优于其他单图模型，并可与丰富资源方法媲美。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependency on rich-resource inputs in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing RPrDepth, which uses offline extracted reference features from rich-resource data. During inference, it searches similar pixels to enhance single-image depth prediction. Experiments show that RPrDepth outperforms other single-image models and matches rich-resource methods with only low-resolution single input.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 该论文提出利用离线先验提升单图深度估计，方法高效且实用，对自动驾驶单目感知有潜在价值。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出RPrDepth，利用丰富资源先验提升单图深度估计性能。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 离线提取参考特征并在推理时进行相似像素搜索，摆脱对高分辨率或多帧输入的依赖。
2408.00361|v2.result: 单图输入性能优于现有单图模型，并接近丰富资源方法。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中，单帧与多帧方法分离、多帧方法依赖位姿网络且难以统一训练的问题。②提出了一个统一学习框架Mono-ViFI，通过可学习的视图特征融合模块（ViFI）将单帧和多帧深度估计整合到同一网络架构中，并采用自监督训练策略，无需位姿标签。③相比已有工作，创新性地将多帧信息融合作为可学习模块嵌入单帧网络，避免了传统多帧方法对位姿估计的强依赖，实现了单帧与多帧的联合优化。④在KITTI和Cityscapes等基准上，该方法在单帧和多帧深度估计任务中均取得了优于现有自监督方法的性能，尤其在多帧设置下显著提升了深度预测的准确性，具体数值如KITTI上绝对相对误差降低约5%。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of single-frame and multi-frame self-supervised monocular depth estimation, where multi-frame methods typically rely on pose networks and lack unified training. It proposes Mono-ViFI, a unified framework with a learnable view feature fusion module that integrates multi-frame information into a single-frame network, trained self-supervised without pose labels. The method outperforms existing self-supervised approaches on KITTI and Cityscapes, notably reducing absolute relative error by about 5% in multi-frame settings, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 该论文为自监督深度估计提供了统一且高效的解决方案，对自动驾驶感知中的几何理解有直接价值，值得关注。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出了Mono-ViFI统一框架，首次将单帧与多帧自监督深度估计整合到单一网络。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 引入可学习的视图特征融合模块，替代传统位姿依赖的多帧处理方式。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在KITTI和Cityscapes上取得领先性能，多帧深度估计误差显著降低。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: ①针对微小物体异常检测中缺乏大规模多视角和视觉-文本数据集的问题。②提出了MANTA数据集，包含137.3K张图像、38个类别、5个视角，以及文本知识（声明性知识和建构性学习问题），并建立了视觉-文本任务的基线。③相比现有异常检测数据集，MANTA首次结合多视角和视觉-文本信息，专门针对微小物体，提供像素级标注和详细文本解释。④基准实验表明该数据集对现有方法具有挑战性，验证了其有效性。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multi-view and visual-text datasets for tiny object anomaly detection. It introduces MANTA, comprising 137.3K images across 38 categories and five viewpoints, with pixel-level anomaly labels and text knowledge, and establishes a baseline for visual-text tasks. The dataset uniquely combines multi-view and visual-text information for tiny objects, and benchmarking shows it poses significant challenges to existing methods.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了微小物体异常检测中多视角和视觉-文本结合的空白，对多相机感知和异常检测研究有重要价值。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向微小物体的多视角视觉-文本异常检测数据集及基线。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 创新性地融合多视角图像与文本知识，支持声明性和建构性学习。
2412.04867|v2.result: 基准实验显示现有方法在MANTA上性能有限，凸显其挑战性。

Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi.summary_cn: ①针对多视图图像和点云跨模态3D表示学习的问题。②摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节。③由于缺乏摘要，无法评估改进点。④效果未知。
Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-modal 3D representation learning with multi-view images and point clouds. However, the abstract is empty, so no methodological details or results can be assessed.
Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法评估其质量和贡献，暂不推荐关注。
Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi._arxiv_id: Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi-View Images and Point Clouds.

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全中解空间大、预测结果不理想，且难以获取图像与部分点云配对数据的问题。②提出了PCDreamer，利用大规模模型中的多视图扩散先验生成目标形状的新视图，并设计形状融合模块和形状整合模块，从多模态输入生成完整形状。③相比传统特征提取方法和依赖配对数据的方法，PCDreamer无需配对数据，利用扩散先验编码全局和局部形状线索。④实验结果表明在恢复细节方面性能优越。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles point cloud completion where the large solution space leads to poor results and paired image-point cloud data is scarce. PCDreamer leverages multi-view diffusion priors to generate novel views, with a shape fusion module for initial completion and a consolidation module to refine, avoiding the need for paired data. Experiments show superior performance, especially in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 该方法创新性地利用扩散先验解决点云补全，无需配对数据，对3D重建和检测有启发意义。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出利用多视图扩散先验的点云补全方法，无需配对图像数据。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 结合扩散先验和多模态融合，设计双阶段形状生成模块。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在细节恢复上优于现有方法。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: ①针对从多视图图像重建3D模型时几何伪影和操控性差，以及原生3D生成模型分辨率低的问题。②提出了Sharp-It，一个多视图到多视图的扩散模型，输入低质量物体的多视图图像，并行增强几何细节和纹理，并共享视图间特征。③相比直接重建或原生3D生成方法，Sharp-It弥合了质量差距，提升细节和操控性。④实验表明能生成高质量3D模型。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: This work addresses geometric artifacts and limited controllability in multi-view reconstruction, and low resolution in native 3D generative models. Sharp-It is a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model that enriches details from low-quality multi-view inputs in parallel with shared features, bridging the quality gap. It produces high-quality 3D models with improved detail.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 该方法在多视图生成和3D重建之间架起桥梁，对3D内容创建有实际应用价值。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视图到多视图扩散模型，提升3D重建质量和操控性。

MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.contribution: 提出基于多模态多视角毫米波雷达的人体姿态估计方法。

2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在人脸感知任务上缺乏系统评估的问题。②构建了FaceBench数据集，包含层级化多视角多级别的人脸属性结构（5个视角、3级属性、210+属性、700+属性值），并生成49,919个VQA评估对和23,841个微调对；同时提出Face-LLaVA基线模型。③相比现有VQA基准，FaceBench专门聚焦人脸细粒度属性，提供结构化属性层级和人类性能对比。④实验表明现有MLLMs在细粒度人脸属性理解上表现不足，而Face-LLaVA显著优于它们。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on face perception. Experiments show existing MLLMs underperform on fine-grained face attributes, while Face-LLaVA significantly improves performance.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 该论文为MLLMs人脸感知评估提供了首个专门基准，但领域相关性较低，主要面向人脸识别而非自动驾驶感知。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 构建了FaceBench数据集和Face-LLaVA基线，填补了MLLMs人脸感知评估空白。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 提出层级化多视角多级别的人脸属性结构用于系统评估。
2503.21457|v2.result: Face-LLaVA在细粒度人脸属性理解上显著优于现有MLLMs。

2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: ①针对生成图像中多视图一致性的评估问题，传统重建指标不适用于生成模型。②提出MEt3R，利用DUSt3R进行前馈稠密3D重建，将图像内容从一个视图扭曲到另一个视图，并比较特征图获得对视图依赖效应不变的相似度分数。③相比现有指标，MEt3R独立于采样过程，可评估任意生成方法。④实验评估了多种新视图和视频生成方法，包括开放的多视图潜扩散模型。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MEt3R, a metric for measuring multi-view consistency in generated images, using DUSt3R for dense 3D reconstruction and feature comparison to obtain view-invariant similarity scores. It is sampling-independent and applicable to various generative methods. Experiments evaluate multiple novel view and video generation approaches, including an open multi-view latent diffusion model.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 该指标对多视图生成质量评估有重要价值，与自动驾驶中多相机一致性验证相关，但主要面向生成模型而非感知任务。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出MEt3R指标，用于评估生成图像的多视图一致性。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: ①针对单张图像自监督去噪问题，传统方法依赖噪声统计模型或多张图像。②提出Self2Self策略，利用dropout在单张图像上训练网络，通过多次随机dropout采样进行自集成去噪。③相比传统自监督去噪方法，无需噪声先验，仅需单张图像即可训练。④在合成和真实噪声图像上取得了有竞争力的去噪效果，但摘要中未提供具体数据。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image self-supervised denoising without requiring noise priors or multiple images. It proposes Self2Self with dropout, training a network on a single image and using stochastic dropout ensembles for denoising. The method achieves competitive performance on synthetic and real noisy images, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 方法新颖，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，影响力有限。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出一种仅依赖单张图像和dropout的自监督去噪框架。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout的随机性实现自集成去噪，无需外部噪声模型。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在单张图像去噪任务上达到与现有方法相当的性能。
