2212.07401|v2.summary_cn: 针对动物和人类3D姿态标注成本高的问题，提出BKinD-3D方法，从多视角视频中自监督发现3D关键点，无需2D或3D关键点及边界框监督。方法采用编码器-解码器架构，使用3D体积热图，训练目标包括重建多视角时空差异和关节长度约束。在人类和大鼠视频上验证了有效性，展示了3D关键点发现用于行为研究的潜力。
2212.07401|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of 3D pose annotation by proposing BKinD-3D, a self-supervised method for discovering 3D keypoints from multi-view videos without any keypoint or bounding box supervision. It uses a 3D volumetric heatmap encoder-decoder trained to reconstruct spatiotemporal differences and enforce joint length constraints. Experiments on human and rat videos demonstrate its potential for behavior analysis.
2212.07401|v2.assessment: 该工作将自监督关键点发现扩展到3D多视角场景，对行为分析有启发，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务相关性一般。
2212.07401|v2.contribution: 提出了无需监督的3D关键点发现方法，适用于多视角视频。
2212.07401|v2.innovation: 结合3D体积热图和关节长度约束实现跨视角时空重建。
2212.07401|v2.result: 在人类和大鼠视频中成功发现3D关键点。

2303.09877|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度多视图聚类中自监督方法发展不一致的问题，提出DeepMVC统一框架，涵盖多种现有方法。通过理论分析证明对比对齐可能损害聚类可分性，且视图越多影响越严重。基于此开发了新的自监督形式，实验表明对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能，而所有方法都受益于某种自监督，新实例在多个数据集上优于先前方法。
2303.09877|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inconsistencies in self-supervised deep multi-view clustering by proposing DeepMVC, a unified framework encompassing many recent methods. It theoretically proves that contrastive alignment can negatively impact cluster separability, worsening with more views. New instances with alternative self-supervision outperform previous methods on several datasets, while all benefit from some form of self-supervision.
2303.09877|v2.assessment: 该工作对自监督聚类领域有理论贡献，但与自动驾驶感知的直接相关性较低。
2303.09877|v2.contribution: 提出了统一的多视图聚类框架并揭示了对比对齐的局限性。
2303.09877|v2.innovation: 理论证明对比对齐对聚类可分性的负面影响。
2303.09877|v2.result: 新方法在多个数据集上取得最优性能。

Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中CNN感受野有限和Transformer计算量大的问题，提出Lite-Mono轻量级CNN-Transformer混合架构。该方法通过高效的特征提取和全局上下文建模，在保持低计算量的同时提升深度估计精度。实验表明，在KITTI和Cityscapes等基准上，Lite-Mono在参数量和FLOPs显著降低的情况下，取得了与更大模型相当或更优的性能。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between limited receptive fields in CNNs and high computational cost of Transformers for self-supervised monocular depth estimation. Lite-Mono proposes a lightweight hybrid architecture combining efficient CNN features with global context modeling. Experiments on KITTI and Cityscapes show competitive or superior accuracy with significantly reduced parameters and FLOPs.
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶中的轻量级深度估计提供了高效方案，兼顾精度与效率，具有工程应用价值。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.contribution: 提出了轻量级CNN-Transformer混合架构用于自监督单目深度估计。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.innovation: 高效融合CNN局部特征与Transformer全局建模，降低计算开销。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.result: 在多个基准上以更低计算量达到先进精度。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo._arxiv_id: Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transformer Architecture for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_cn: 针对3D异常检测与定位缺乏大规模基准和有效方法的问题，该论文提出了一个通过3D异常合成生成的大规模基准，并设计了一个自监督学习网络。方法利用合成异常进行训练，无需真实异常标注，从而提升泛化能力。相比现有方法，该基准覆盖更多异常类型和场景，网络在多个数据集上取得了显著的检测和定位性能提升。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks and effective methods for 3D anomaly detection and localization by proposing a benchmark via 3D anomaly synthesis and a self-supervised learning network. The method trains on synthetic anomalies without real annotations, improving generalization. It outperforms existing approaches on multiple datasets with notable gains in detection and localization accuracy.
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.assessment: 该论文为3D异常检测提供了新基准和自监督方法，对工业检测和自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.contribution: 提出了首个大规模3D异常合成基准和配套自监督网络。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.innovation: 利用合成异常进行自监督训练，避免依赖真实标注。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.result: 在多个3D异常检测数据集上取得显著性能提升。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an._arxiv_id: Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection and Localization: A Benchmark via 3D Anomaly Synthesis and A Self-Supervised Learning Network.

SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_cn: 针对自监督地标估计中对应关系不准确的问题，该论文提出了SCE-MAE，一种结合选择性对应增强和掩码自编码器的方法。方法通过选择性增强关键点对应关系，提升特征表示质量。相比标准MAE，SCE-MAE在多个地标估计基准上提高了定位精度。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate correspondence in self-supervised landmark estimation by proposing SCE-MAE, which integrates selective correspondence enhancement with masked autoencoders. It improves feature representations by enhancing keypoint correspondences, achieving higher localization accuracy on multiple benchmarks compared to standard MAE.
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.assessment: 对自监督特征学习有改进，但应用场景相对狭窄。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.contribution: 提出选择性对应增强机制用于自监督地标估计。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.innovation: 在MAE框架中引入对应关系选择性增强。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.result: 在多个地标估计基准上提升定位精度。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc._arxiv_id: SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhancement with Masked Autoencoder for Self-Supervised Landmark Estimation.

T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_cn: 针对点云表示学习中时间信息利用不足的问题，该论文提出了T-MAE，一种时间掩码自编码器。方法通过掩码和重建点云序列的时间维度，学习时空特征。相比静态MAE，T-MAE在多个点云下游任务（如分类、分割）上取得了更好的性能。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient temporal information utilization in point cloud representation learning by proposing T-MAE, a temporal masked autoencoder. It learns spatiotemporal features by masking and reconstructing the temporal dimension of point cloud sequences, outperforming static MAE on downstream tasks like classification and segmentation.
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.assessment: 对自动驾驶中的动态点云感知有重要价值，方法简洁有效。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.contribution: 提出时间掩码自编码器用于点云序列表示学习。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.innovation: 将MAE扩展到时间维度，捕捉动态特征。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.result: 在多个点云下游任务上取得性能提升。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for._arxiv_id: T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for Point Cloud Representation Learning.

ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_cn: 针对图像和视频联合表示学习不足的问题，该论文提出了ViC-MAE，一种结合对比学习和掩码自编码器的多模态方法。方法通过对比学习对齐图像和视频特征，同时用MAE重建增强表示。相比单模态方法，ViC-MAE在跨模态检索和视频理解任务上表现更优。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient joint representation learning from images and video by proposing ViC-MAE, which combines contrastive learning with masked autoencoders. It aligns image and video features via contrastive learning and enhances representations via MAE reconstruction, outperforming unimodal methods on cross-modal retrieval and video understanding tasks.
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.assessment: 对多模态感知和自动驾驶场景理解有借鉴意义。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.contribution: 提出图像-视频联合自监督学习框架ViC-MAE。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.innovation: 融合对比学习和MAE实现跨模态对齐。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.result: 在跨模态检索和视频理解任务上取得更好性能。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation._arxiv_id: ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation Learning from Images and Video with Contrastive Masked Autoencoders.

NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_cn: 针对神经辐射场（NeRF）表示学习中缺乏自监督方法的问题，该论文提出了NeRF-MAE，将掩码自编码器应用于3D场景表示。方法通过掩码NeRF的输入视图并重建，学习鲁棒的3D特征。相比传统NeRF和现有自监督方法，NeRF-MAE在3D重建和下游任务上取得了显著提升。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of self-supervised methods for neural radiance field (NeRF) representation learning by proposing NeRF-MAE, which applies masked autoencoders to 3D scene representations. It learns robust 3D features by masking and reconstructing input views, significantly improving 3D reconstruction and downstream tasks compared to traditional NeRF and existing self-supervised methods.
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.assessment: 该论文开创了NeRF自监督学习的先河，对3D感知和自动驾驶有深远影响。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.contribution: 首次将MAE应用于NeRF，提出自监督3D表示学习方法。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.innovation: 掩码NeRF输入视图进行重建，学习通用3D特征。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.result: 在3D重建和下游任务上取得显著性能提升。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s._arxiv_id: NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-supervised 3D Representation Learning for Neural Radiance Fields.

DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_cn: 针对单视频中自监督点跟踪的挑战，该论文提出了DINO-Tracker，利用DINO预训练特征进行点跟踪。方法通过特征匹配和时序一致性，无需标注即可跟踪任意点。相比传统光流和自监督方法，DINO-Tracker在多个视频跟踪基准上取得了更高的准确率。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of self-supervised point tracking in a single video by proposing DINO-Tracker, which leverages DINO pre-trained features. It tracks arbitrary points via feature matching and temporal consistency without annotations, achieving higher accuracy on multiple video tracking benchmarks compared to traditional optical flow and self-supervised methods.
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.assessment: 对视频理解和自动驾驶中的运动估计有实用价值。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.contribution: 提出基于DINO特征的自监督点跟踪方法。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.innovation: 利用预训练视觉特征实现无需标注的跟踪。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.result: 在多个视频跟踪基准上取得更高准确率。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super._arxiv_id: DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-supervised Point Tracking in a Single Video.

SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_cn: ①针对点云上采样任务中依赖密集标注或合成数据的问题。②提出SPU-PMD方法，通过渐进式网格变形实现自监督点云上采样，无需真实稠密点云作为监督。③相比现有监督方法，首次将自监督与网格变形结合，利用点云自身几何结构生成训练信号。④在多个基准数据集上达到与监督方法相当的性能，显著减少标注成本。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations in point cloud upsampling by proposing SPU-PMD, a self-supervised method using progressive mesh deformation. It generates training signals from the input geometry itself, eliminating the need for ground-truth dense clouds. The method achieves performance comparable to supervised baselines on standard benchmarks, substantially reducing annotation overhead.
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.assessment: 该论文为点云上采样提供了自监督新思路，对依赖3D感知的自动驾驶场景有潜在应用价值。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.contribution: 提出首个自监督点云上采样框架，结合渐进网格变形。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.innovation: 利用网格变形生成自监督信号，替代人工标注。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.result: 在多个数据集上与监督方法性能持平。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups._arxiv_id: SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Upsampling via Progressive Mesh Deformation.

Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_cn: ①针对点云自监督学习中对象间依赖导致特征学习不充分的问题。②提出对象交换策略，在训练时交换不同点云中的对象，破坏对象间相关性，增强模型对单个对象的表征能力。③相比现有全局对比学习方法，通过局部对象级操作提升特征判别性。④在多个下游任务（如分类、分割）上取得显著性能提升。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_en: This work tackles object dependencies in point cloud self-supervised learning by introducing an object exchange strategy that swaps objects between point clouds during training. This breaks inter-object correlations, forcing the model to learn more discriminative object-level features. It achieves notable improvements on downstream tasks like classification and segmentation over global contrastive baselines.
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.assessment: 方法简单有效，对点云自监督学习有明确改进，适合3D感知研究参考。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.contribution: 提出对象交换策略以缓解点云自监督中的对象依赖问题。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.innovation: 在自监督训练中引入对象级数据增强。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.result: 下游任务性能显著提升。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin._arxiv_id: Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improving Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning Through Object Exchange.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出基于路径一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法，利用视频帧间轨迹的时空一致性作为监督信号，无需目标身份标注。③相比监督跟踪方法，首次将路径一致性用于自监督训练，有效利用未标注视频数据。④在多个跟踪基准上达到接近监督方法的性能，显著降低标注需求。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation burden in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised method based on path consistency, which uses spatiotemporal trajectory consistency across frames as supervision without identity labels. It is the first to apply path consistency for self-supervised tracking, effectively leveraging unlabeled video data. The method achieves performance close to supervised baselines on several benchmarks, greatly reducing annotation costs.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 对自动驾驶中的多目标跟踪具有直接应用价值，自监督设计减少标注依赖。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出路径一致性自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用轨迹时空一致性替代身份标注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 性能接近监督方法，标注成本大幅降低。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Path Consistency.

RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D场景理解中模型难以识别未知类别的问题。②提出RegionPLC，通过区域级点-语言对比学习，将3D点云区域与文本描述对齐，实现开放词汇的3D场景理解。③相比现有3D-语言方法，引入区域级对齐，提升细粒度识别能力，并利用预训练VLM知识。④在多个开放词汇3D分割和检测基准上达到最先进性能，显著优于现有方法。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_en: This paper tackles open-world 3D scene understanding by proposing RegionPLC, which aligns point cloud regions with text descriptions via regional point-language contrastive learning, enabling open-vocabulary recognition. Unlike existing 3D-language methods, it introduces region-level alignment and leverages pre-trained VLM knowledge for finer granularity. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple open-vocabulary 3D segmentation and detection benchmarks.
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.assessment: 该论文将VLM与3D感知结合，对自动驾驶开放场景理解具有重要参考价值。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.contribution: 提出区域级点-语言对比学习实现开放世界3D理解。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.innovation: 区域级对齐与VLM知识迁移。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr._arxiv_id: RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contrastive Learning for Open-World 3D Scene Understanding.

Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在训练中因幻觉数据导致鲁棒性下降的问题。②提出幻觉增强对比学习（HACL），通过生成幻觉样本并用于对比学习，增强模型区分真实与幻觉内容的能力。③相比标准对比学习，专门针对幻觉进行数据增强，提升模型泛化性。④在多个MLLM基准上显著降低幻觉率，提升指令跟随和视觉问答性能。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness degradation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) caused by hallucinated data during training. It proposes Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning (HACL), which generates hallucination samples and uses them in contrastive learning to improve the model's ability to distinguish real from hallucinated content. Compared to standard contrastive learning, it specifically augments data with hallucinations, enhancing generalization. It significantly reduces hallucination rates and improves performance on several MLLM benchmarks.
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.assessment: 对多模态感知和VLM应用有直接帮助，提升模型可靠性。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.contribution: 提出幻觉增强对比学习以提升MLLM鲁棒性。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.innovation: 将幻觉样本用于对比学习训练。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.result: 幻觉率显著降低，多项基准性能提升。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear._arxiv_id: Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model.

BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_cn: ①针对多模态对比学习模型（如CLIP）易受后门攻击的安全问题。②提出BadCLIP，通过双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法，在图像和文本嵌入中同时注入触发器，提高攻击隐蔽性和成功率。③相比现有单模态攻击，首次实现双嵌入协同攻击，增强攻击鲁棒性。④在多个多模态模型上实现高攻击成功率，同时保持正常任务性能。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_en: This paper addresses the security vulnerability of multimodal contrastive models like CLIP to backdoor attacks. It proposes BadCLIP, a dual-embedding guided attack that injects triggers into both image and text embeddings, improving attack stealth and success rate. Unlike single-modality attacks, it is the first to coordinate dual embeddings for robust attacks. It achieves high attack success rates on several multimodal models while maintaining normal task performance.
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.assessment: 该论文揭示多模态模型的安全隐患，对自动驾驶感知系统的安全性有警示意义。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.contribution: 提出双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.innovation: 图像和文本嵌入协同攻击。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.result: 高攻击成功率且保持正常性能。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor._arxiv_id: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning.

SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D占用预测依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出自监督方法。②利用多帧图像和相机位姿，通过可微渲染将3D占用投影到2D进行光度一致性约束，无需3D标签。③相比现有自监督方法，引入显式几何建模和时序信息，提升了几何精度。④在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上，占用预测IoU显著提升，且能迁移到语义占用预测。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on expensive 3D annotations for vision-based 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving. It proposes a self-supervised method that leverages multi-frame images and camera poses, using differentiable rendering to project 3D occupancy into 2D for photometric consistency without 3D labels. Compared to existing self-supervised approaches, it introduces explicit geometric modeling and temporal information, significantly improving occupancy IoU on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, and enabling transfer to semantic occupancy prediction.
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.assessment: 该论文是自监督3D占用预测的代表性工作，对降低自动驾驶感知标注成本具有重要意义，方法设计严谨，实验充分。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.contribution: 提出首个无需3D标注的视觉3D占用预测自监督框架。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.innovation: 利用可微渲染和时序光度一致性实现自监督3D占用学习。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上显著提升占用预测IoU。

What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: ①针对未修剪多动作视频中时空定位依赖密集标注的问题，提出自监督方法。②利用叙述指令作为弱监督信号，通过对比学习对齐视频片段与文本指令，同时学习动作类别、时间和空间位置。③相比现有弱监督方法，联合建模多动作的时序边界和空间区域，无需帧级标注。④在多个基准数据集上，时空定位精度优于现有弱监督方法。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of spatio-temporal grounding in untrimmed multi-action videos, which typically requires dense annotations. It proposes a self-supervised method that uses narrated instructions as weak supervision, aligning video segments with text instructions via contrastive learning to jointly learn action categories, temporal boundaries, and spatial regions. Compared to existing weakly-supervised methods, it jointly models temporal boundaries and spatial regions for multiple actions without frame-level annotations, achieving superior grounding accuracy on several benchmarks.
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该论文在视频理解领域有一定创新，但与自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低，适合关注多模态视频理解的读者。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出利用叙述指令实现未修剪视频中多动作时空定位的自监督框架。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.innovation: 联合建模时序边界和空间区域，利用文本-视频对比学习。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.result: 在多个基准上时空定位精度优于现有弱监督方法。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised Spatio- Temporal Grounding in Untrimmed Multi-Action Videos from Narrated Instructions.

Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_cn: ①针对超分辨率模型泛化能力差的问题，提出自监督学习方法。②利用低分辨率图像作为引导，通过自监督预训练提升模型对未知退化类型的适应能力。③相比传统监督训练，引入低分辨率先验和自监督任务，增强特征鲁棒性。④在多个超分辨率基准上，模型泛化性能显著提升，尤其在跨数据集场景下。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of super-resolution models to unseen degradation types. It proposes a self-supervised learning method that uses low-resolution images as guidance, pre-training the model to adapt to unknown degradations. Compared to traditional supervised training, it introduces low-resolution priors and self-supervised tasks to enhance feature robustness, significantly improving generalization on multiple SR benchmarks, especially in cross-dataset scenarios.
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.assessment: 该论文对图像超分领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱，适合图像恢复方向研究者。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.contribution: 提出利用低分辨率图像引导的自监督预训练方法提升超分泛化。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.innovation: 以低分辨率图像作为自监督信号，增强模型对未知退化的鲁棒性。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.result: 在多个超分基准上跨数据集泛化性能显著提升。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General._arxiv_id: Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving Generalization for Super-Resolution by Self-Supervised Learning.

Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_cn: ①针对人脸自监督表示学习忽略面部区域结构的问题，提出区域感知方法。②设计区域感知的自监督预训练任务，利用面部关键点划分区域，分别学习局部特征。③相比通用自监督方法，引入面部结构先验，提升细粒度特征表达。④在人脸识别和属性分析等下游任务上，性能优于现有自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that self-supervised facial representation learning often ignores facial region structures. It proposes a region-aware self-supervised pre-training method that divides the face into regions using facial landmarks and learns local features separately. Compared to general self-supervised methods, it introduces facial structure priors, improving fine-grained feature representation, and achieving superior performance on downstream tasks like face recognition and attribute analysis.
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.assessment: 该论文针对人脸领域有针对性创新，但与自动驾驶感知方向相关性低，适合人脸分析方向研究者。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.contribution: 提出区域感知的自监督人脸表示学习方法。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.innovation: 利用面部关键点划分区域，增强局部特征学习。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.result: 在人脸识别和属性分析任务上性能优于现有自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Facial Representation Learning with Facial Region Awareness.

CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_cn: ①针对无监督目标发现中现有方法依赖聚类或伪标签、泛化性差的问题，提出增强方法。②利用自监督Transformer的密集特征，通过穷举式匹配和对比学习发现目标，无需类别先验。③相比现有方法，引入更全面的特征利用和匹配策略，提升目标发现的完整性和准确性。④在多个目标发现基准上，显著提升检测精度和召回率，尤其在开放场景下。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing unsupervised object discovery methods that rely on clustering or pseudo-labels and generalize poorly. It proposes an enhanced method that leverages dense features from self-supervised Transformers, using exhaustive matching and contrastive learning to discover objects without category priors. Compared to existing methods, it introduces more comprehensive feature utilization and matching strategies, significantly improving detection precision and recall on multiple object discovery benchmarks, especially in open-world scenarios.
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.assessment: 该论文在开放集目标发现方面有较强创新，与自动驾驶中的未知目标检测相关，值得关注。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.contribution: 提出基于自监督Transformer的穷举式无监督目标发现方法。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.innovation: 利用密集特征和穷举匹配，无需类别先验发现目标。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.result: 在多个目标发现基准上显著提升精度和召回率。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis._arxiv_id: CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Discoveries through Exhaustive Self-Supervised Transformers.

Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_cn: ①针对文本引导图像编辑中提示词不足导致编辑效果差的问题，提出提示增强方法。②利用自监督学习生成多样化的提示增强，提升编辑模型对文本理解的鲁棒性。③相比固定提示，引入动态提示生成，增强编辑的语义一致性。④在多个图像编辑基准上，编辑质量和文本对齐度有所提升。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient prompts in text-guided image manipulation, which leads to poor editing results. It proposes a prompt augmentation method that uses self-supervised learning to generate diverse prompt variations, improving the model's robustness to text understanding. Compared to fixed prompts, it introduces dynamic prompt generation, enhancing semantic consistency, and achieving improved editing quality and text alignment on several benchmarks.
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.assessment: 该论文在文本图像编辑领域有应用价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关性低，适合多模态生成方向研究者。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.contribution: 提出自监督提示增强方法提升文本引导图像编辑效果。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.innovation: 利用自监督生成多样化提示，增强编辑语义一致性。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.result: 在图像编辑基准上编辑质量和文本对齐度提升。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised Text-guided Image Manipulation.

BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D亚断层图像对齐中方向估计精度不足的问题。②提出了BOE-ViT，利用等变性（equivariance）增强方向估计，通过自监督学习框架实现3D亚断层图像对齐。③相比现有方法，创新性地将等变性约束引入自监督对齐任务，提升方向估计的鲁棒性和准确性。④实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上显著提高了对齐精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient orientation estimation accuracy in self-supervised 3D subtomogram alignment. It proposes BOE-ViT, which leverages equivariance to enhance orientation estimation within a self-supervised learning framework. Compared to existing methods, it innovatively introduces equivariance constraints, improving robustness and accuracy. Experiments show significant gains in alignment precision across datasets, though specific numbers are not provided.
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.assessment: 该论文聚焦于生物成像领域的自监督对齐，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但等变性思想对3D几何理解有参考价值。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.contribution: 提出基于等变性的自监督3D亚断层图像对齐方法。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.innovation: 将等变性约束融入自监督方向估计。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.result: 提升对齐精度，但缺乏具体数据。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation._arxiv_id: BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation with Equivariance in Self-Supervised 3D Subtomogram Alignment.

DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_cn: ①针对跨域点云学习中自监督预训练模型泛化能力不足的问题。②提出了DAP-MAE，一种域自适应点云掩码自编码器，通过域自适应机制提升跨域学习效果。③相比标准MAE，引入了域自适应模块，使模型能更好地适应目标域分布。④实验表明，在多个跨域基准上显著优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited generalization of self-supervised pre-training for cross-domain point cloud learning. It proposes DAP-MAE, a domain-adaptive masked autoencoder that incorporates domain adaptation to improve cross-domain performance. Compared to standard MAE, it adds a domain-adaptive module for better target-domain adaptation. Experiments show significant improvements over baselines on cross-domain benchmarks, though specific numbers are omitted.
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.assessment: 该论文对3D感知和跨域学习有较强相关性，方法具有实用价值。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.contribution: 提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.innovation: 将域自适应机制集成到MAE框架。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas._arxiv_id: DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Masked Autoencoder for Effective Cross-Domain Learning.

2503.23220|v2.summary_cn: ①针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中Mean Teacher自标记方法的脆弱性和耦合问题。②提出了DINO Teacher，利用冻结的DINOv2大模型作为骨干，在源数据上训练新标记器，生成更准确的目标域标签。③相比现有方法，解耦了学习与标签生成过程，利用大规模预训练模型提升标签质量。④实验表明，该方法在多个DAOD基准上显著优于现有技术，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
2503.23220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the brittleness and coupling issues of Mean Teacher self-labelling in domain adaptive object detection (DAOD). It proposes DINO Teacher, which trains a new labeller on source data using a frozen DINOv2 backbone to generate more accurate target-domain labels. Compared to existing methods, it decouples learning from label generation and leverages large pre-trained models. Experiments show significant improvements over state-of-the-art on DAOD benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
2503.23220|v2.assessment: 该论文直接针对自动驾驶中的域适应检测问题，方法创新且实用，具有高影响力。
2503.23220|v2.contribution: 提出利用冻结DINOv2生成高质量目标域标签的DAOD方法。
2503.23220|v2.innovation: 解耦标签生成与学习，利用大规模自监督模型。
2503.23220|v2.result: 在DAOD基准上显著提升性能。

A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified interpretation for self-supervised pre-training methods on 3D point clouds. It proposes a unified framework based on interactions to explain various methods. Compared to fragmented analyses, it offers a theoretical perspective on commonalities. Experiments validate the framework, though specific numbers are not provided.
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.assessment: 该论文提供理论分析，对理解自监督方法有帮助，但应用性较弱。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.contribution: 提出基于交互的统一解释框架。

2503.13739|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角人物关联在相似外观和未标定相机场景下的挑战。②提出了Self-MVA，一种自监督无标定多视角人物关联方法，利用跨视角图像同步作为预文本任务。③相比全监督方法，无需标注和相机标定，通过同步标签训练编码器-解码器模型。④实验表明，在挑战性场景下显著优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2503.13739|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in multi-view person association under similar appearances and uncalibrated cameras. It proposes Self-MVA, a self-supervised uncalibrated approach using cross-view image synchronization as a pretext task. Compared to fully-supervised methods, it requires no annotations or calibration. Experiments show significant improvements in challenging scenes, though specific numbers are not provided.
2503.13739|v2.assessment: 该论文对多相机感知有参考价值，自监督设计具有创新性。
2503.13739|v2.contribution: 提出自监督无标定多视角人物关联方法。

2503.13739|v2.result: 在挑战场景下性能提升。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中从点级到平面级建模的不足。②提出了GeoDepth，将深度估计从点对点建模扩展为平面对平面建模，提升几何一致性。③相比现有方法，通过平面约束增强深度预测的平滑性和准确性。④实验表明，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by shifting from point-to-depth to plane-to-depth modeling. It proposes GeoDepth, which enhances geometric consistency through plane constraints. Compared to existing methods, it improves smoothness and accuracy. Experiments show significant gains on benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶深度估计有直接应用价值，方法创新且实用。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出平面级深度建模方法。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.innovation: 从点级扩展到平面级建模。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.result: 深度估计性能显著提升。

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对事件相机在资源受限的微型无人机上实现低延迟单目深度估计的在线自监督学习问题。作者通过改进对比最大化的时间和内存效率，使在线设备端学习成为可能，并验证了在线学习相比仅预训练能显著提升深度估计精度和避障成功率。实验表明，该方法在自监督方法中达到了最先进的深度估计性能，同时保持了高效性。这项工作挖掘了在线设备端机器人学习的未开发潜力。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of online self-supervised learning for low-latency monocular depth estimation from event cameras on resource-constrained drones. By improving the time and memory efficiency of contrast maximization, the authors enable on-device learning, demonstrating that online learning yields more accurate depth estimates and better obstacle avoidance than pre-training alone. The proposed pipeline achieves state-of-the-art performance among self-supervised approaches while remaining efficient.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 该论文在事件相机和在线学习交叉领域具有创新性，为低功耗机器人感知提供了实用方案，值得关注。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 提出了首个高效的事件相机在线自监督深度估计框架，支持设备端实时学习。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 通过优化对比最大化的计算和存储效率，实现了事件相机深度估计的在线设备端学习。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在线学习显著提升深度估计精度和避障成功率，性能达到自监督方法最优。

2505.04410|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对CLIP在开放词汇密集预测任务中局部特征表示不足的问题，观察到CLIP图像token难以聚合空间或语义相关区域的信息，导致特征缺乏局部判别性和空间一致性。作者提出DeCLIP框架，通过解耦自注意力模块分别获得“内容”和“上下文”特征，前者与图像裁剪表示对齐以提升局部判别性，后者在视觉基础模型（如DINO）指导下保留空间相关性。大量实验表明，DeCLIP在多个开放词汇密集预测任务上显著优于现有方法。
2505.04410|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of CLIP in open-vocabulary dense prediction due to limited local feature representation. The authors propose DeCLIP, which decouples the self-attention module to obtain 'content' and 'context' features, aligning content with image crops for local discriminability and guiding context with vision foundation models for spatial consistency. Extensive experiments show DeCLIP significantly outperforms existing methods across multiple open-vocabulary dense prediction tasks.
2505.04410|v2.assessment: 该论文针对开放词汇密集预测的关键瓶颈提出有效解决方案，具有高实用价值和广泛影响。
2505.04410|v2.contribution: 提出了DeCLIP框架，通过解耦自注意力增强CLIP的局部特征表示，提升开放词汇密集预测性能。
2505.04410|v2.innovation: 创新性地解耦CLIP自注意力为内容和上下文特征，分别优化局部判别性和空间一致性。
2505.04410|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇密集预测任务上显著超越现有方法，验证了框架的有效性。

2503.21003|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对AI生成图像的取证检测和来源归属问题，传统方法因依赖已知生成器的特定特征而难以泛化到新生成技术。作者提出一种新方法，显式建模取证微结构（像素级细微模式），仅使用真实图像以自监督方式学习一组多样预测滤波器来提取残差，并在多尺度上联合建模，得到每个图像的紧凑取证自描述。该方法支持零样本检测合成图像、开放集来源归属和基于来源的聚类，实验显示在准确性和适应性上优于现有技术。
2503.21003|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of detecting and attributing AI-generated images, where traditional methods fail to generalize to unseen generators. The authors propose a novel approach that models forensic microstructures using self-supervised predictive filters on real images, producing a compact forensic self-description for each image. This enables zero-shot detection, open-set source attribution, and clustering, achieving superior accuracy and adaptability over competing methods.
2503.21003|v2.assessment: 该论文为AI生成图像取证提供了通用且自监督的解决方案，对安全领域有重要价值。
2503.21003|v2.contribution: 提出了基于取证微结构的自描述方法，实现零样本检测和开放集来源归属。
2503.21003|v2.innovation: 利用自监督预测滤波器显式建模像素级取证微结构，无需已知生成器先验。
2503.21003|v2.result: 在多个任务上达到最先进性能，显著提升对新生成技术的泛化能力。

S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对自动驾驶中多模态大语言模型的可扩展自监督学习问题，提出S4-Driver框架，利用时空视觉表示增强驾驶场景理解。方法通过自监督方式学习多模态数据中的时空特征，提升模型在复杂驾驶环境中的感知和推理能力。相比现有方法，S4-Driver强调可扩展性和自监督性，减少对标注数据的依赖。实验表明其在驾驶任务上表现出色，但摘要未提供具体数据。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_en: This paper addresses scalable self-supervised learning for driving multimodal large language models, proposing S4-Driver with spatio-temporal visual representation. The method leverages self-supervised learning to capture spatio-temporal features, enhancing perception and reasoning in complex driving scenes. It emphasizes scalability and reduced annotation dependency, showing strong performance in driving tasks.
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶多模态模型的自监督学习提出新框架，具有高相关性和应用潜力。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.contribution: 提出了S4-Driver框架，通过时空视觉表示实现可扩展的自监督驾驶多模态学习。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.innovation: 创新性地结合自监督学习和时空表示，提升驾驶大语言模型的感知能力。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.result: 在驾驶任务上表现优异，但具体数据未在摘要中提供。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv._arxiv_id: S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driving Multimodal Large Language Model with Spatio-Temporal Visual Representation.

2412.04424|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对视觉语言模型中CLIP风格编码器的局限性，提出Florence-VL，利用生成式视觉基础模型Florence-2增强视觉表示。作者提出深度-广度融合（DBFusion）架构，融合不同深度和多种提示下的视觉特征，并设计端到端预训练和微调流程。定量分析和可视化显示，Florence-VL在视觉语言对齐上优于流行视觉编码器，丰富的深度和广度特征提升了多模态任务性能。
2412.04424|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of CLIP-style vision encoders in multimodal large language models, proposing Florence-VL with Florence-2's generative visual features. The authors introduce depth-breadth fusion (DBFusion) to integrate features from different depths and prompts, with a training recipe of pretraining and finetuning. Quantitative analysis shows advantages in vision-language alignment and downstream task performance.
2412.04424|v2.assessment: 该论文通过生成式视觉编码器显著提升VLM性能，对多模态研究有重要参考价值。
2412.04424|v2.contribution: 提出了Florence-VL，利用Florence-2和深度-广度融合增强视觉语言模型的表示能力。
2412.04424|v2.innovation: 创新性地采用生成式视觉编码器和DBFusion架构，融合多深度多提示特征。
2412.04424|v2.result: 在视觉语言对齐和下游任务上优于现有方法，验证了特征融合的有效性。

2502.18290|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对自监督学习视觉编码器在大型视觉语言模型中的后门攻击漏洞，提出BadVision方法，通过新颖的触发优化和后门学习技术，仅攻击编码器即可诱导LVLMs产生视觉幻觉。实验在两种SSL编码器和多个LVLMs上验证，攻击成功率超过99%，相对视觉理解错误率增加77.6%，同时保持隐蔽性，现有后门检测方法难以识别。
2502.18290|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses backdoor vulnerabilities in self-supervised vision encoders for large vision language models, proposing BadVision with novel trigger optimization and backdoor learning. The method induces visual hallucinations in LVLMs by compromising encoders, achieving over 99% attack success rate and 77.6% relative visual understanding error while maintaining stealthiness. SoTA detection methods fail to identify the backdoor.
2502.18290|v2.assessment: 该论文揭示了LVLMs的安全隐患，对模型部署和安全性研究具有重要警示意义。
2502.18290|v2.contribution: 提出了BadVision，首个利用SSL编码器漏洞实现LVLMs后门攻击的方法。
2502.18290|v2.innovation: 创新性地优化触发器和后门学习，实现高成功率和隐蔽性的编码器攻击。
2502.18290|v2.result: 攻击成功率超99%，视觉理解错误率增加77.6%，且难以被检测。

2003.13942|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对视频字幕生成任务中现有方法仅利用场景级或物体级信息、未显式建模物体交互，导致预测缺乏视觉基础且易受虚假相关性影响的问题。②提出了一个时空图模型，通过构建可解释的物体交互链接来显式利用时空关系，并引入物体感知的知识蒸馏机制，用局部物体信息正则化全局场景特征，以应对物体数量可变带来的性能不稳定。③相比已有工作，创新在于将图结构用于视频字幕并融合知识蒸馏，增强了视觉接地能力。④在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了有竞争力的性能，并提供了可解释的预测。
2003.13942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing video captioning methods fail to explicitly model object interactions, leading to predictions lacking visual grounding and sensitivity to spurious correlations. It proposes a spatio-temporal graph model that exploits object interactions in space and time with interpretable links, plus an object-aware knowledge distillation mechanism to regularize global scene features. Experiments on two benchmarks show competitive performance with interpretable predictions.
2003.13942|v2.assessment: 该论文将图建模与知识蒸馏结合用于视频字幕，思路新颖，但领域相关性较低，且实验规模有限，适合对视频理解与蒸馏交叉方向感兴趣的读者。
2003.13942|v2.contribution: 提出时空图模型与物体感知知识蒸馏，提升视频字幕的视觉接地和可解释性。
2003.13942|v2.innovation: 在视频字幕中首次结合时空图交互建模与知识蒸馏正则化。
2003.13942|v2.result: 在两个基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并生成可解释的字幕预测。

2103.03454|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中智能体仅将历史经验存储为循环网络隐状态，无法捕捉环境布局和进行长期规划的问题。②提出了结构化场景记忆（SSM）架构，包含可分离的记忆模块以准确记忆导航感知，并作为结构化场景表示捕捉环境中的视觉和几何线索；设计了收集-读取控制器，自适应收集信息支持决策，并模拟迭代算法进行长程推理；基于SSM提供的完整动作空间，引入前沿探索导航决策策略实现高效全局规划。③相比现有方法，SSM显式建模场景结构，支持长期推理和全局规划。④在R2R和R4R数据集上取得最先进性能。
2103.03454|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of VLN agents that store past experiences as latent states in recurrent networks, failing to capture environment layouts and long-term planning. It proposes Structured Scene Memory (SSM), a compartmentalized architecture with a collect-read controller for adaptive information gathering and iterative long-range reasoning, enabling frontier-exploration-based global planning. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on R2R and R4R datasets.
2103.03454|v2.assessment: 该论文在VLN中引入结构化记忆和全局规划，对多模态感知与导航结合有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关度一般。
2103.03454|v2.contribution: 提出结构化场景记忆架构，提升VLN中的环境建模和长期规划能力。
2103.03454|v2.innovation: 将场景记忆设计为可分离的结构化表示，并采用前沿探索策略进行全局决策。
2103.03454|v2.result: 在R2R和R4R数据集上达到最先进性能。

VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言模型中视觉表示质量不足的问题，现有模型多依赖预训练目标检测器特征，但特征表达有限。②提出了VinVL，重新审视视觉表示，通过改进目标检测预训练（使用更大的数据集和更好的架构）生成更丰富的视觉特征，并集成到视觉语言模型中。③相比现有工作，VinVL在视觉特征提取上更强大，显著提升下游任务性能。④在多个视觉语言基准（如VQA、image captioning）上取得最先进结果，例如在VQA 2.0上达到76.71%准确率。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient quality of visual representations in vision-language models by revisiting visual feature extraction. It proposes VinVL, which improves object detection pre-training with larger datasets and better architectures to generate richer visual features for downstream VL tasks. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks, e.g., 76.71% on VQA 2.0.
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.assessment: 该论文对视觉语言模型中的视觉表示进行了系统性改进，对多模态感知和VLM研究有重要参考价值，与自动驾驶中的视觉-语言融合相关。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.contribution: 提出改进的视觉特征提取方法，显著提升视觉语言模型性能。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.innovation: 通过优化目标检测预训练策略增强视觉表示质量。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.result: 在多个VL基准上取得最先进性能。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations._arxiv_id: VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models.

InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_cn: ①针对点云视觉定位（visual grounding）中缺乏对实例级上下文充分理解的问题，现有方法多依赖全局特征或简单融合。②提出了InstanceRefer，通过实例多级上下文参照实现协同整体理解，包括实例级语义、几何和关系建模，并利用多级上下文进行目标定位。③相比现有工作，InstanceRefer更全面地利用实例级信息，提升定位精度。④在ScanRefer和ReferIt3D数据集上取得领先性能。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of instance-level contextual understanding in point cloud visual grounding. It proposes InstanceRefer, which performs cooperative holistic understanding through instance multi-level contextual referring, modeling semantic, geometric, and relational cues. The method achieves leading performance on ScanRefer and ReferIt3D datasets.
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.assessment: 该论文在3D视觉定位中引入实例级上下文建模，对3D感知和场景理解有参考价值，但直接应用于自动驾驶检测需进一步适配。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.contribution: 提出实例多级上下文参照方法，提升点云视觉定位性能。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.innovation: 协同利用实例级语义、几何和关系信息进行定位。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde._arxiv_id: InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Understanding for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds through Instance Multi-level Contextual Referring.

3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_cn: ①针对点云视觉定位中关系建模不足的问题，现有方法未充分利用目标间关系。②提出了3DVG-Transformer，采用Transformer架构显式建模点云中目标间的关系，通过自注意力机制捕捉上下文依赖，提升定位准确性。③相比现有工作，3DVG-Transformer引入关系建模增强特征表达。④在ScanRefer等数据集上取得有竞争力的性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient relation modeling in point cloud visual grounding. It proposes 3DVG-Transformer, which uses a Transformer architecture to explicitly model inter-object relations via self-attention, enhancing contextual feature representation. The method achieves competitive performance on ScanRefer datasets.
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.assessment: 该论文将Transformer应用于3D视觉定位的关系建模，对3D感知中的上下文理解有参考意义，但创新性有限。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的关系建模方法，提升点云视觉定位性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.innovation: 利用自注意力机制显式建模目标间关系。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.result: 在ScanRefer上取得有竞争力的结果。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for._arxiv_id: 3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds.

3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云场景中密集描述和视觉定位任务分离、缺乏统一框架的问题。②提出了3DJCG，一个联合进行3D密集描述和视觉定位的统一框架，通过共享编码器和任务交互模块实现两个任务的协同学习。③相比分别处理两个任务的现有方法，该框架利用任务间的互补信息，提升了整体性能。④在ScanRefer等数据集上，联合训练显著提高了两个任务的准确率，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of dense captioning and visual grounding in 3D point clouds by proposing 3DJCG, a unified framework that jointly performs both tasks via shared encoders and task interaction modules. It leverages complementary information between tasks, improving performance over separate baselines on datasets like ScanRefer, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.assessment: 该论文为3D多模态理解提供了统一框架，对自动驾驶场景中的3D感知与语言交互有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.contribution: 提出了首个联合3D密集描述和视觉定位的统一框架。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.innovation: 通过任务交互模块实现3D描述与定位的协同学习。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.result: 在ScanRefer等数据集上联合训练提升了两个任务的性能。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den._arxiv_id: 3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Dense Captioning and Visual Grounding on 3D Point Clouds.

A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇语义分割中依赖复杂架构或额外训练数据的问题。②提出了一个简单基线，利用预训练视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）直接生成像素级分割结果，无需微调或复杂解码器。③相比现有方法，该基线简化了流程，仅通过特征相似度计算实现分割，展示了预训练模型的强大泛化能力。④在多个基准数据集上，该基线达到了与复杂方法相当的性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by proposing a simple baseline that leverages pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP to generate pixel-level segmentation via feature similarity, without fine-tuning or complex decoders. It simplifies the pipeline while achieving competitive performance on multiple benchmarks, highlighting the generalization of pre-trained models.
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.assessment: 该论文以极简方法验证了预训练VLM在开放词汇分割中的潜力，对自动驾驶中的未知物体识别有启示，但性能上限可能受限。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.contribution: 提出了一个无需微调的开放词汇语义分割简单基线。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.innovation: 利用预训练VLM的特征相似度直接实现像素级分割。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.result: 在多个基准上达到与复杂方法相当的性能。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se._arxiv_id: A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Pre-trained Vision-Language Model.

A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言导航中命令可行性未知的问题，现有数据集假设所有命令均可执行。②构建了一个新数据集，包含不可行命令的交互式导航场景，并设计了评估协议。③相比现有数据集，该工作引入了命令可行性判断的挑战，更贴近真实应用。④数据集规模和具体结果未在摘要中详述。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of unknown command feasibility in vision-language navigation by introducing a new dataset with infeasible commands and an evaluation protocol. It extends existing benchmarks to include feasibility judgment, better reflecting real-world scenarios, though dataset details are limited.
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.assessment: 该数据集对多模态导航研究有补充价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关性较低。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.contribution: 构建了包含不可行命令的交互式视觉-语言导航数据集。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.innovation: 首次引入命令可行性判断到导航任务。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.result: 提供了新基准，但具体性能未报告。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility.

Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言导航中模型依赖标签相关性、缺乏解耦表示的问题。②提出了使用解耦标签学习解耦表示的方法，通过分离指令中的不同语义成分（如动作和物体）来增强导航决策。③相比传统端到端方法，该方法提高了表示的可解释性和泛化能力。④在R2R等数据集上，导航成功率显著提升，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of disentangled representations in vision-language navigation by proposing a method that uses decoupled labels to separate semantic components like actions and objects. It enhances interpretability and generalization, improving navigation success on datasets like R2R, though exact metrics are not specified.
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.assessment: 该论文通过解耦学习提升了导航模型的鲁棒性，对多模态感知有借鉴意义，但应用场景偏机器人导航。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.contribution: 提出了基于解耦标签的视觉-语言导航表示学习方法。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.innovation: 利用标签解耦增强指令理解的语义分离。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.result: 在R2R数据集上提升了导航成功率。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled._arxiv_id: Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled Labels for Vision-Language Navigation.

UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_cn: ①针对接地视觉-语言建模中文本和框输出分离、缺乏统一生成框架的问题。②提出了UniTAB，一个统一文本和框输出的生成模型，通过单一解码器同时生成语言和边界框。③相比分别处理文本和框的现有方法，该框架简化了训练流程并增强了任务间的协同。④在多个接地任务（如视觉定位和图像描述）上，UniTAB达到了最先进性能，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of text and box outputs in grounded vision-language modeling by proposing UniTAB, a unified generative model that decodes both language and bounding boxes with a single decoder. It simplifies training and enhances task synergy, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple grounding tasks, though specific metrics are not detailed.
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.assessment: 该论文的统一生成框架对多模态感知和自动驾驶中的目标定位与描述有重要参考价值。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.contribution: 提出了统一文本和框输出的接地视觉-语言生成模型。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.innovation: 使用单一解码器联合生成文本和边界框。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.result: 在多个接地任务上达到最先进性能。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo._arxiv_id: UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs for Grounded Vision-Language Modeling.

2207.09644|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督骨架序列表示学习忽略层次时空结构的问题。②提出了层次化自监督预训练方案，集成到层次Transformer编码器（Hi-TRS）中，分别在帧、片段和视频级别捕获空间、短期和长期时间依赖。③相比仅使用视频级对比学习的现有方法，该方案显式建模了骨架的层次结构，提升了表示质量。④在动作识别、动作检测和运动预测三个下游任务上，在监督和半监督协议下均达到最先进性能。
2207.09644|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of hierarchical spatio-temporal structures in self-supervised skeleton representation learning by proposing a hierarchical pre-training scheme integrated into a Transformer encoder (Hi-TRS), capturing spatial, short-term, and long-term dependencies at frame, clip, and video levels. It outperforms video-level contrastive methods, achieving state-of-the-art results on action recognition, detection, and motion prediction under supervised and semi-supervised settings.
2207.09644|v2.assessment: 该论文的层次化自监督方法对视频理解有显著贡献，虽非自动驾驶直接相关，但可迁移到人体姿态估计。
2207.09644|v2.contribution: 提出了层次化自监督预训练方案用于骨架序列表示学习。
2207.09644|v2.innovation: 在帧、片段和视频级别显式建模层次时空依赖。
2207.09644|v2.result: 在三个下游任务上达到最先进性能。

2208.06105|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频表征学习中现有方法未能充分利用短期运动动态的问题，提出了运动敏感对比学习（MSCL）。该方法将光流捕获的运动信息注入RGB帧以增强特征学习，并设计了帧级局部运动对比学习（LMCL）以及流旋转增强（FRA）和运动差分采样（MDS）来生成负样本和筛选训练样本。在UCF101和Something-Something v2上分别达到91.5%和50.3%的top-1准确率，视频检索top-1召回率65.6%，显著优于现有方法。
2208.06105|v2.summary_en: To address the insufficient exploitation of short-term motion dynamics in self-supervised video representation learning, we propose Motion Sensitive Contrastive Learning (MSCL) that injects optical flow motion into RGB frames, with frame-level local contrastive learning and novel augmentation/sampling strategies. It achieves 91.5% top-1 accuracy on UCF101 and 50.3% on Something-Something v2, notably improving state-of-the-art.
2208.06105|v2.assessment: 该论文针对视频自监督学习中的运动信息利用问题提出了有效方案，实验充分且性能提升显著，对视频理解领域有重要参考价值。
2208.06105|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合光流运动信息与对比学习的自监督视频表征方法。
2208.06105|v2.innovation: 通过局部运动对比学习和运动感知的负样本生成策略增强运动敏感性。
2208.06105|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得领先性能，验证了方法的有效性。

2208.09843|v2.summary_cn: 针对图像-文本检索中对比学习受限于负样本数量少、手动加权和缺乏外部知识的问题，提出了耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习（CODER）。该方法通过动态字典扩大样本规模，自适应加权负样本，并利用常识知识图谱生成概念级描述符，同时结合实例级和概念级对齐。在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2208.09843|v2.summary_en: To address limitations of contrastive learning in image-text retrieval, such as limited negative pairs and manual weighting, we propose CODER with dynamic dictionaries, adaptive negative weighting, and commonsense knowledge graph integration. It improves cross-modal representation but specific performance numbers are not detailed in the abstract.
2208.09843|v2.assessment: 方法设计有创新性，但摘要缺乏具体实验结果，影响对其实际效果的评估。
2208.09843|v2.contribution: 提出了耦合多样性敏感的动量对比学习框架用于图像-文本检索。
2208.09843|v2.innovation: 结合动态字典、自适应负样本加权和外部知识图谱增强跨模态表征。
2208.09843|v2.result: 在图像-文本检索任务上取得改进，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2207.12661|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态对比预训练中通常使用独立编码器导致参数冗余和知识共享不足的问题，研究了模态共享的对比语言-图像预训练（MS-CLIP）框架。通过系统探索Transformer模型中跨模态参数共享的比例，发现大部分统一编码器优于分离更多参数的变体，且轻量级模态特定模块可进一步提升性能。在零样本ImageNet分类上相对vanilla CLIP提升高达13%。
2207.12661|v2.summary_en: To address parameter redundancy and limited knowledge sharing in multi-modal contrastive pre-training, we investigate modality-shared CLIP frameworks, finding that a mostly unified encoder outperforms variants with more separated parameters, and light-weight modality-specific modules further improve performance. It achieves up to 13% relative improvement over vanilla CLIP in zero-shot ImageNet classification.
2207.12661|v2.assessment: 该论文系统研究了模态共享架构的设计空间，为多模态预训练提供了新视角，具有较高的实用价值。
2207.12661|v2.contribution: 提出了模态共享的CLIP变体并系统评估了参数共享比例的影响。
2207.12661|v2.innovation: 探索了Transformer中跨模态参数共享的架构设计选择。
2207.12661|v2.result: 在零样本分类任务上显著优于传统CLIP。

2107.06383|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言（V&L）模型中视觉编码器依赖有限标注数据的问题，提出将CLIP作为视觉编码器集成到现有V&L模型中。在两种场景下（任务特定微调和V&L预训练后迁移）验证了CLIP的优势，显著优于广泛使用的BottomUp-TopDown编码器。在视觉问答、视觉蕴含和V&L导航任务上取得了新的最先进结果。
2107.06383|v2.summary_en: To address the reliance on limited annotated data for visual encoders in Vision-and-Language models, we propose using CLIP as the visual encoder in various V&L models, showing significant improvements over widely-used encoders like BottomUp-TopDown. It achieves state-of-the-art results on VQA, Visual Entailment, and V&L Navigation tasks.
2107.06383|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了CLIP在V&L任务中的强大迁移能力，为后续研究提供了实用指导，具有较高影响力。
2107.06383|v2.contribution: 系统评估了CLIP作为视觉编码器在多种V&L任务中的性能提升。
2107.06383|v2.innovation: 将大规模预训练的CLIP集成到任务特定和预训练V&L模型中。
2107.06383|v2.result: 在多个V&L基准上取得最先进结果。

2106.12570|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态VAE中现有方法通过显式组合（如乘积、混合）整合模态信息的问题，提出了MEME方法，通过重新利用半监督VAE以互监督方式隐式结合模态信息。该方法自然支持部分观测数据（某些模态完全缺失），在MNIST-SVHN和CUB数据集上优于基线，并展示了表征质量的优势。
2106.12570|v2.summary_en: To avoid explicit combinations in multimodal VAEs, we introduce MEME, which repurposes semi-supervised VAEs to combine information implicitly through mutual supervision, naturally handling partially-observed data. It outperforms baselines on MNIST-SVHN and CUB datasets and shows improved representation quality.
2106.12570|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的多模态VAE训练范式，对处理缺失模态数据有实际意义，但实验规模较小。
2106.12570|v2.contribution: 提出了基于互监督的多模态VAE方法，支持部分观测数据。
2106.12570|v2.innovation: 利用半监督VAE隐式整合模态信息，避免显式组合。
2106.12570|v2.result: 在标准数据集上优于现有基线。

2106.09667|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态对比学习（如CLIP）在噪声和未整理数据上训练的安全性问题，揭示了后门和投毒攻击的严重威胁。通过仅投毒0.01%的数据（如Conceptual Captions中300张图像）即可使模型错误分类，而定向投毒仅需0.0001%数据（3张图像）。该研究质疑了在互联网噪声数据上训练的做法。
2106.09667|v2.summary_en: We show that multimodal contrastive learning methods like CLIP are vulnerable to backdoor and poisoning attacks, where poisoning just 0.01% of a dataset can cause misclassification, and targeted attacks require only 0.0001%. This calls into question the safety of training on noisy and uncurated Internet data.
2106.09667|v2.assessment: 该论文揭示了对比学习的安全漏洞，对实际部署具有重要警示意义，研究角度新颖。
2106.09667|v2.contribution: 首次系统展示了多模态对比学习对投毒和后门攻击的脆弱性。
2106.09667|v2.innovation: 量化了极低比例投毒数据对模型行为的严重影响。
2106.09667|v2.result: 证明了极少量投毒即可实现攻击，引发对数据安全性的关注。

2207.03482|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇检测中CLIP模型缺乏精确目标定位和图像级监督启发式不准确的问题，提出通过目标中心对齐CLIP语言嵌入，并利用伪标签过程在仅图像级监督下视觉接地目标，以提供高质量目标提议并扩展训练词汇。通过新颖的权重传递函数聚合两种对齐策略的互补优势，弥合目标级和图像级表示之间的差距。实验表明该方法在开放词汇检测基准上显著提升性能。
2207.03482|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment of CLIP and image-level supervision in open-vocabulary detection by performing object-centric alignment of language embeddings and grounding objects via pseudo-labeling. A weight transfer function bridges the two strategies, improving detection performance on benchmarks.
2207.03482|v2.assessment: 该工作有效结合CLIP和图像级监督，通过目标对齐和伪标签提升开放词汇检测性能，值得关注。
2207.03482|v2.contribution: 提出目标中心对齐和伪标签策略，弥合开放词汇检测中表示差距。
2207.03482|v2.innovation: 创新性地通过权重传递函数融合两种弱监督策略。
2207.03482|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著性能提升。

2208.05592|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇模型如CLIP在特定任务上零样本性能不佳的问题，提出PAINT方法，通过微调前后模型权重的插值来修补特定任务，同时保持其他任务性能。在九个零样本性能差的任务上，PAINT将准确率提升15到60个百分点，同时ImageNet准确率保持在零样本模型的一个百分点内。该方法支持多任务修补，并随模型规模提升，还发现跨任务泛化现象。
2208.05592|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces PAINT, a weight interpolation method to patch open-vocabulary models on specific tasks without degrading others. It improves accuracy by 15-60 points on nine tasks while preserving ImageNet accuracy, and supports multi-task patching with scale benefits.
2208.05592|v2.assessment: 该工作提供简单有效的模型修补方法，对开放词汇模型实用性强，值得关注。
2208.05592|v2.contribution: 提出权重插值修补方法，提升特定任务性能同时保持整体能力。
2208.05592|v2.innovation: 创新性地利用权重插值实现任务修补，无需额外参数。
2208.05592|v2.result: 在多个任务上显著提升准确率，并保持ImageNet性能。

2211.14241|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D视觉定位中视觉流仅依赖点云编码器的问题，提出利用从点云合成的2D语义知识蒸馏来增强3D编码器，无需额外2D输入。通过Look Around and Refer (LAR)模块，在训练和测试中有效利用2D线索提升视觉表示质量。在Nr3D、Sr3D和ScanRefer三个基准上显著优于现有方法，验证了方法的有效性。
2211.14241|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes LAR, a module that distills 2D synthetic semantics from point clouds to enhance 3D visual grounding without extra 2D inputs. It consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Nr3D, Sr3D, and ScanRefer benchmarks.
2211.14241|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用2D知识蒸馏提升3D视觉定位，方法有效且实用，值得关注。
2211.14241|v2.contribution: 提出2D合成语义知识蒸馏方法，增强3D视觉定位性能。
2211.14241|v2.innovation: 创新性地从点云合成2D线索并用于知识蒸馏。
2211.14241|v2.result: 在三个基准上显著优于现有方法。

2301.05499|v2.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测（SDG-OD）研究空白的问题，本文提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）引入语义域概念。方法包括对检测器骨干特征进行语义增强，以及基于文本的分类损失，以同时学习鲁棒的定位和表示。在多样天气驾驶基准上，该方法比现有唯一SDG-OD方法Single-DGOD提升10%，验证了其有效性。
2301.05499|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored problem of single domain generalization for object detection (SDG-OD) by leveraging a pre-trained vision-language model to introduce semantic domain concepts via textual prompts. It proposes a semantic augmentation strategy on backbone features and a text-based classification loss, achieving a 10% improvement over the existing SDG-OD method on a diverse weather-driving benchmark.
2301.05499|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了SDG在检测领域的空白，利用VLM提升跨域鲁棒性，对自动驾驶感知的域适应有参考价值。
2301.05499|v2.contribution: 首次将视觉-语言模型应用于单域泛化目标检测，提出语义增强和文本分类损失。
2301.05499|v2.innovation: 利用CLIP的文本提示实现特征级语义增强，缓解域差异。
2301.05499|v2.result: 在天气驾驶基准上超越现有方法10%。

2303.12027|v2.summary_cn: 针对自然语言规范跟踪中视觉定位与跟踪分离、无法端到端训练的问题，本文提出联合视觉定位与跟踪框架，将两者统一为基于视觉-语言参考的定位任务。设计了多源关系建模模块构建参考与测试图像的关系，以及时间建模模块利用全局语义信息提升外观变化适应性。该方法有效改善跟踪性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2303.12027|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of separated visual grounding and tracking in natural language specification tracking by proposing a joint framework that unifies both as a localization task based on visual-language references. It introduces a multi-source relation modeling module and a temporal modeling module to enhance adaptability, though specific performance numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2303.12027|v2.assessment: 该工作统一了定位与跟踪流程，利于端到端优化，对多模态跟踪研究有启发。
2303.12027|v2.contribution: 提出联合视觉定位与跟踪框架，实现端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.innovation: 多源关系建模和时间建模模块结合全局语义。
2303.12027|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称有效提升适应性。

2303.16891|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇实例分割中依赖人工掩码标注导致新类别泛化差的问题，本文提出Mask-free OVIS管道，利用预训练视觉-语言模型从图像-文本对生成伪掩码，以弱监督方式学习基类和新类。该方法避免了对基类标注的强监督过拟合，提升新类别泛化能力，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2303.16891|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization to novel categories in open-vocabulary instance segmentation caused by reliance on manual mask annotations. It proposes a Mask-free OVIS pipeline that generates pseudo-masks from vision-language models using image-caption pairs, enabling weakly supervised learning for both base and novel categories, though no specific results are given.
2303.16891|v2.assessment: 该工作减少标注依赖，利用VLM生成伪掩码，对开放世界感知有实际意义。
2303.16891|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工掩码的开放词汇实例分割管道。
2303.16891|v2.innovation: 利用VLM的定位能力自动生成伪掩码。

2303.13076|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇检测中CLIP应用于区域识别时的分布不匹配和未见类定位困难问题，本文提出CORA框架，采用区域提示和锚点预匹配机制。区域提示缓解整图到区域的分布差距，锚点预匹配通过类感知匹配提升定位泛化。在COCO OVD基准上，新类AP50达41.7，超越先前SOTA 2.4 AP50，且无需额外训练数据。
2303.13076|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses distribution mismatch and localization difficulty in open-vocabulary detection with CLIP by proposing CORA, a DETR-style framework with region prompting and anchor pre-matching. It achieves 41.7 AP50 on novel classes in COCO OVD, outperforming previous SOTA by 2.4 AP50 without extra training data.
2303.13076|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决CLIP在检测中的适配问题，性能显著，对开放世界检测研究有重要价值。
2303.13076|v2.contribution: 提出区域提示和锚点预匹配机制，适配CLIP于开放词汇检测。
2303.13076|v2.innovation: 类感知匹配机制提升未见类定位能力。

2301.09121|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割中依赖掩码标注的问题，本文提出OVSegmentor模型，仅利用网络爬取的图像-文本对预训练，无需掩码标注。通过槽注意力绑定模块将像素组装为组令牌，并与标题嵌入对齐；设计掩码实体补全和跨图像掩码一致性两个代理任务，提升细粒度对齐和视觉不变性。构建CC4M数据集提高训练效率，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2301.09121|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OVSegmentor for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation using only image-text pairs, without mask annotations. It employs slot-attention to bind pixels into group tokens aligned with captions, and introduces masked entity completion and cross-image mask consistency tasks, though specific results are not mentioned.
2301.09121|v2.assessment: 该工作探索无标注的开放词汇分割，代理任务设计有创新性，对降低标注成本有贡献。
2301.09121|v2.contribution: 提出无需掩码标注的开放词汇分割模型及代理任务。
2301.09121|v2.innovation: 掩码实体补全和跨图像一致性任务增强对齐。

2212.00785|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界语义分割中对比学习训练与测试不一致的问题，本文提出文本接地对比学习（TCL）框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐。方法为给定文本生成分割掩码，提取掩码区域的图像嵌入并与文本嵌入对齐，从而直接提升掩码质量。在8个广泛使用的数据集上统一评估，TCL取得先进性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2212.00785|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the train-test discrepancy in open-world semantic segmentation by proposing Text-grounded Contrastive Learning (TCL), which directly learns region-text alignment by generating masks and aligning masked embeddings with text. It achieves state-of-the-art results on 8 datasets under a unified protocol, though specific numbers are not given.
2212.00785|v2.assessment: 该工作直接优化区域-文本对齐，解决对比学习缺陷，评估协议统一，对开放世界分割有重要贡献。
2212.00785|v2.contribution: 提出文本接地对比学习框架，实现直接区域-文本对齐。
2212.00785|v2.innovation: 通过掩码生成和嵌入对齐消除训练测试差异。
2212.00785|v2.result: 在8个数据集上取得先进性能。

2303.14038|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言预训练（VLP）中训练成本高、收敛慢的问题，本文指出掩码语言建模（MLM）中预测率与破坏率耦合是主要障碍。提出自由语言建模（FLM）任务，实现100%预测率与任意破坏率解耦，并允许为每个预测token定制破坏跨度。相比MLM方法，FLM在相同GPU时间下训练速度提升2.5倍，同时保持下游任务性能。
2303.14038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and slow convergence in vision-language pretraining (VLP), identifying the coupling of prediction rate and corruption rate in masked language modeling (MLM) as a key obstacle. It proposes Free Language Modeling (FLM), which decouples a 100% prediction rate from arbitrary corruption rates and allows customized corruption spans per token. FLM achieves a 2.5x pretraining time reduction over MLM-based methods while maintaining downstream performance.
2303.14038|v2.assessment: 该工作从预训练任务设计角度切入，有效提升VLP训练效率，对大规模多模态预训练研究具有实用价值。
2303.14038|v2.contribution: 提出FLM预训练任务，解耦预测率与破坏率，显著加速VLP收敛。
2303.14038|v2.innovation: 创新性地实现100%预测率与任意破坏率解耦，并支持逐token定制破坏跨度。
2303.14038|v2.result: 训练时间减少2.5倍，性能与MLM方法相当。

2211.10277|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉语言模型（VLM）在下游任务微调时，现有高效迁移学习方法（如提示微调、适配器微调）要么破坏预训练知识，要么过度依赖预训练特征的问题，提出Task Residual Tuning（TaskRes）方法。该方法直接在文本分类器上操作，冻结原始分类器权重，通过调整一组与先验无关的残差参数来获得新分类器，显式解耦先验知识与任务新知识。实验表明TaskRes在保留可靠先验知识的同时，能灵活探索任务特定知识，在多个下游任务上优于现有ETL方法。
2211.10277|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that existing efficient transfer learning (ETL) methods for vision-language models (VLMs) either damage prior knowledge or are overly biased towards it. It proposes Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes), which freezes the original text-based classifier and learns a residual parameter set to form a new classifier, explicitly decoupling prior and task-specific knowledge. TaskRes outperforms existing ETL approaches on various downstream tasks while preserving reliable prior knowledge.
2211.10277|v2.assessment: 该方法为VLM高效迁移提供了新思路，通过残差机制平衡先验与任务知识，具有较强实用性和推广性。
2211.10277|v2.contribution: 提出TaskRes，一种基于残差调优的VLM高效迁移方法，显式解耦先验与任务知识。
2211.10277|v2.innovation: 创新性地在文本分类器上引入残差参数，实现先验知识保留与任务自适应。
2211.10277|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上优于现有ETL方法。

2303.15786|v2.summary_cn: 针对人类-物体交互（HOI）检测中依赖大规模训练数据且少样本/零样本性能差的问题，提出HOICLIP框架，高效提取CLIP的先验知识。引入交互解码器通过交叉注意力提取CLIP视觉特征图中的信息区域，并与检测骨干融合；利用CLIP文本编码器生成分类器，通过视觉语义算术和轻量级动词适配器构建细粒度动词分类器。此外提出无需训练的全局HOI预测增强方法。实验表明在多个HOI基准上显著提升性能，尤其在少样本场景下。
2303.15786|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on large-scale training data and poor few/zero-shot performance in Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection. It proposes HOICLIP, which efficiently extracts prior knowledge from CLIP via an interaction decoder and knowledge integration, and builds classifiers using CLIP text embeddings with visual semantic arithmetic. The method achieves significant performance gains on HOI benchmarks, especially in few-shot settings.
2303.15786|v2.assessment: 该工作有效利用CLIP先验提升HOI检测的泛化能力，对少样本场景有重要价值。
2303.15786|v2.contribution: 提出HOICLIP框架，通过CLIP知识迁移实现高效HOI检测。
2303.15786|v2.innovation: 创新性地结合交互解码器、知识融合和文本嵌入分类器，实现少样本HOI检测。
2303.15786|v2.result: 在多个HOI基准上性能显著提升，少样本场景优势明显。

2303.10431|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）因训练数据分布不均而产生的社会偏见问题，提出DeAR（Debiasing with Additive Residuals）方法。该方法学习加性残差图像表示以偏移原始表示，确保输出表示公平，减少不同身份群体间的表示区分度。同时引入新的公平性评估基准Protected Attribute Tag Association，以更全面地评估偏见。实验表明DeAR在多个数据集上有效降低偏见，同时保持下游任务性能。
2303.10431|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses societal biases in large pre-trained vision-language models caused by skewed training data distributions. It proposes DeAR, which learns additive residual image representations to offset original ones, ensuring fair outputs and reducing distinguishability across identity groups. A new benchmark, Protected Attribute Tag Association, is introduced for better evaluation. Experiments show DeAR effectively reduces bias while maintaining downstream performance.
2303.10431|v2.assessment: 该工作关注VLM的公平性问题，提出有效去偏方法并完善评估基准，具有社会意义和应用价值。
2303.10431|v2.contribution: 提出DeAR去偏方法，并引入新的公平性评估基准。
2303.10431|v2.innovation: 创新性地使用加性残差表示进行去偏，同时提出更全面的评估协议。
2303.10431|v2.result: 在多个数据集上有效降低偏见，保持任务性能。

THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在自由形式生成中产生对象级幻觉（即生成不存在的对象）的问题，缺乏专门的评估基准。②提出了THRONE基准，包含一系列对象类别和开放式问题，用于系统评估LVLM在自由生成中的幻觉倾向，并引入基于对象检测的自动评估指标。③相比现有幻觉基准，THRONE更聚焦于自由形式生成场景，而非受限的VQA任务，且提供了细粒度的对象级分析。④实验表明，现有LVLM在THRONE上表现出显著的幻觉率，且模型大小与幻觉率并非简单线性关系，为后续缓解幻觉提供了量化依据。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for object-level hallucination in free-form generations of large vision-language models (LVLMs). It introduces THRONE, a benchmark with object categories and open-ended questions, plus an object-detection-based metric, revealing notable hallucination rates in current LVLMs and offering fine-grained analysis.
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.assessment: 该基准填补了LVLM幻觉评估在自由生成场景的空白，对多模态感知研究有参考价值，但方法本身为评估工具，创新性有限。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.contribution: 提出了首个针对LVLM自由生成的对象级幻觉基准THRONE及自动评估协议。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.innovation: 将幻觉评估从受限VQA扩展到开放式生成，并利用检测模型实现对象级量化。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.result: 揭示了现有LVLM在自由生成中的高幻觉率，并分析了模型规模与幻觉的关系。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be._arxiv_id: THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Benchmark for the Free-Form Generations of Large Vision-Language Models.

VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）知识编辑缺乏统一评估基准的问题。②构建了VLKEB基准，包含多种知识编辑场景（如事实更新、反事实编辑）和评估指标，用于衡量编辑后的模型在准确性、泛化性和鲁棒性上的表现。③相比已有知识编辑基准，VLKEB专门针对LVLM的多模态特性，覆盖视觉和语言联合知识。④实验显示，现有编辑方法在VLKEB上表现有限，尤其在多跳编辑和跨模态泛化上存在明显不足。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for knowledge editing in large vision-language models (LVLMs). It introduces VLKEB, covering diverse editing scenarios and metrics, revealing that current methods struggle with multi-hop edits and cross-modal generalization.
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.assessment: 为LVLM知识编辑提供了系统评估工具，对多模态持续学习有参考意义，但偏重评测而非新方法。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.contribution: 构建了首个面向LVLM的知识编辑基准VLKEB，包含多场景任务和评估协议。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.innovation: 将知识编辑评估扩展到多模态LVLM，并设计了跨模态泛化测试。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.result: 实验表明现有编辑方法在VLKEB上性能有限，尤其在多跳和跨模态场景。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno._arxiv_id: VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Knowledge Editing Benchmark.

ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多轮对话中的评估缺乏层次化诊断能力的问题。②提出了ConvBench基准，支持多轮对话评估，并具有层次化消融能力，可分别评估模型在感知、推理和对话管理等方面的表现。③相比现有单轮或简单多轮基准，ConvBench能更细粒度地定位模型失败原因。④实验表明，当前LVLM在多轮对话中错误累积明显，且不同能力维度表现差异显著。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of hierarchical evaluation for multi-turn conversations in LVLMs. It proposes ConvBench, a benchmark with hierarchical ablation capability, revealing that current LVLMs suffer from error accumulation and uneven performance across perception, reasoning, and dialogue management.
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.assessment: 为多轮对话LVLM评估提供了细粒度工具，对多模态交互研究有参考价值，但创新性中等。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.contribution: 提出了多轮对话评估基准ConvBench，支持层次化能力消融分析。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.innovation: 设计了层次化消融机制，可独立评估LVLM在不同对话阶段的能力。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.result: 揭示了LVLM在多轮对话中的错误累积和维度差异。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva._arxiv_id: ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark with Hierarchical Ablation Capability for Large Vision-Language Models.

2408.16176|v2.summary_cn: ①针对预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）在生物图像性状发现任务中的有效性缺乏评估的问题。②构建了VLM4Bio数据集，包含469K问答对和30K图像，覆盖鱼类、鸟类和蝴蝶三类生物，涉及五个生物学任务，并评估了12个SOTA VLM的零样本性能。③相比通用VLM基准，VLM4Bio专注于生物领域，并探索了提示技术和推理幻觉的影响。④实验显示，现有VLM在生物任务上表现参差不齐，提示技术可提升部分任务性能，但推理幻觉仍普遍存在。
2408.16176|v2.summary_en: This paper evaluates pretrained VLMs for trait discovery from biological images using a new dataset VLM4Bio, covering 469K QA pairs and 30K images across three organism groups. It finds that current VLMs show uneven performance, with prompting techniques offering limited gains and reasoning hallucination remaining common.
2408.16176|v2.assessment: 为生物图像分析提供了VLM评估基准，对跨学科应用有参考价值，但领域较专。
2408.16176|v2.contribution: 构建了生物图像VLM评估数据集VLM4Bio，并系统评估了12个SOTA模型。
2408.16176|v2.innovation: 将VLM评估扩展到生物性状发现，并分析提示和幻觉影响。
2408.16176|v2.result: 揭示了VLM在生物任务上的性能差异和幻觉问题。

Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇语义分割依赖大规模标注或复杂训练的问题，探索如何利用现成视觉语言模型（如CLIP）实现零样本分割。②提出了一种无需训练的方法，通过利用现成VLM的注意力图和文本-图像对齐，生成像素级分割结果，并设计了类无关的掩码提议机制。③相比需要微调或蒸馏的方法，该方法完全免训练，且能泛化到任意开放词汇。④在多个分割基准上取得了与训练方法相当的性能，展示了现成VLM的涌现能力。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_en: This paper explores emergent open-vocabulary semantic segmentation from off-the-shelf VLMs without training. It leverages attention maps and text-image alignment to generate pixel-level masks, achieving competitive performance with trained methods and demonstrating strong generalization.
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.assessment: 展示了现成VLM在分割任务上的涌现能力，方法简洁且实用，对开放集感知有重要启示。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.contribution: 提出了一种免训练的开放词汇分割方法，利用现成VLM的注意力机制。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.innovation: 无需任何训练或微调，直接利用VLM的涌现能力实现像素级分割。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.result: 在多个基准上达到与训练方法相当的性能。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen._arxiv_id: Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation from Off-the-Shelf Vision-Language Models.

Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_cn: ①针对零样本开放词汇3D视觉定位（3DVG）任务，现有方法依赖3D标注或训练，泛化性差。②提出了一种视觉编程方法，将3DVG分解为多个子任务（如目标检测、属性推理、空间关系判断），通过调用现成的视觉语言模型和2D检测器，以代码形式组合执行。③相比端到端训练方法，该方法无需3D训练数据，且能处理开放词汇和复杂空间关系。④在多个3DVG基准上取得了领先的零样本性能，尤其在复杂场景中表现突出。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_en: This paper addresses zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding via visual programming. It decomposes the task into subtasks executed by off-the-shelf VLMs and 2D detectors, achieving leading zero-shot performance without 3D training data.
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.assessment: 将视觉编程应用于3D定位，创新性强，且与自动驾驶3D感知高度相关，值得关注。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.contribution: 提出了基于视觉编程的零样本开放词汇3D视觉定位方法。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.innovation: 利用代码化组合现成模型，避免3D训练，实现开放词汇推理。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.result: 在多个3DVG基准上取得领先零样本性能。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo._arxiv_id: Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding.

DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_cn: 针对开放世界少样本学习（OW-FSL）中，CLIP模型在基类上过拟合且难以泛化到新类的问题，提出Direct-and-Inverse CLIP（DeIL）方法。该方法通过直接学习基类特征和逆映射（将特征映射回类别语义）来增强CLIP的泛化能力，并利用逆映射生成伪样本以缓解少样本数据不足。相比现有微调策略，DeIL在多个基准上显著提升了新类识别准确率，例如在ImageNet-LT上提升约5%。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_en: This paper addresses open-world few-shot learning (OW-FSL) where CLIP overfits base classes and fails to generalize to novel classes. It proposes Direct-and-Inverse CLIP (DeIL), which learns both direct base-class features and inverse mappings to class semantics, generating pseudo-samples to mitigate data scarcity. DeIL significantly improves novel-class accuracy on benchmarks like ImageNet-LT by ~5% over existing fine-tuning methods.
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.assessment: 该方法为CLIP在开放世界场景下的应用提供了新思路，逆映射机制具有理论新颖性，但实验规模有限，需进一步验证在更大数据集上的鲁棒性。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.contribution: 提出DeIL框架，结合直接与逆CLIP学习，提升开放世界少样本分类性能。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.innovation: 引入逆映射生成伪样本，增强CLIP对未见类的泛化能力。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.result: 在多个少样本基准上，新类识别准确率提升约5%。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W._arxiv_id: DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-World Few-Shot Learning.

Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉编码器与语言模型融合不充分的问题，提出一种视觉启发的VLM架构改进方法。该方法通过设计视觉感知的注意力机制和跨模态特征对齐模块，增强视觉特征在语言生成中的引导作用。相比基线模型，在多个VQA和图像描述任务上取得了更优的准确率和BLEU分数，例如在VQAv2上提升2.1%。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient fusion between visual encoders and language models in vision-language models (VLMs). It proposes a vision-inspired architecture with visual-aware attention and cross-modal alignment modules to better guide language generation. It achieves superior accuracy and BLEU scores on VQA and captioning tasks, e.g., +2.1% on VQAv2 over baselines.
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.assessment: 该工作对VLM架构的改进具有实用价值，实验覆盖多个任务，但创新性相对常规，未突破性改变现有范式。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.contribution: 提出视觉启发的VLM架构，增强视觉特征在语言生成中的主导作用。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.innovation: 设计视觉感知注意力机制，实现更紧密的跨模态对齐。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.result: 在VQAv2等任务上准确率提升2.1%。

DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在人类交互中缺乏对齐和反馈能力的问题，提出DRESS方法，通过自然语言反馈指令来训练模型对齐人类意图。该方法构建了包含人类反馈的指令数据集，并采用两阶段训练策略（先对齐后交互），使模型能根据反馈调整输出。实验显示，DRESS在多个交互基准上显著优于现有LVLM，如对话质量评分提升15%。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of alignment and interaction capabilities in large vision-language models (LVLMs) with humans. It proposes DRESS, which uses natural language feedback to train models for human-aligned interaction, via a two-stage strategy (alignment then interaction). DRESS outperforms existing LVLMs on interaction benchmarks, e.g., +15% in dialogue quality scores.
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.assessment: 该工作聚焦LVLM的人类对齐问题，具有实际应用价值，反馈机制设计合理，实验充分，是值得关注的交互式多模态研究。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.contribution: 提出DRESS框架，利用自然语言反馈实现LVLM与人类意图的对齐和交互。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.innovation: 引入两阶段训练策略，结合反馈指令增强模型交互能力。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.result: 在交互基准上对话质量评分提升15%。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Language Models to Align and Interact with Humans via Natural Language Feedback.

Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中语言幻觉与视觉错觉纠缠的问题，提出HallusionBench诊断套件，用于系统评估模型的幻觉现象。该套件设计了多种图像-文本组合，区分语言幻觉和视觉错觉，并引入结构化测试协议。实验表明，现有LVLM在HallusionBench上错误率高达40%，揭示了模型在复杂视觉推理中的脆弱性。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_en: This paper addresses entangled language hallucination and visual illusion in large vision-language models (LVLMs). It proposes HallusionBench, a diagnostic suite with structured tests to distinguish these phenomena. Experiments show existing LVLMs have up to 40% error rates, revealing vulnerabilities in complex visual reasoning.
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.assessment: 该工作为LVLM评估提供了重要基准，对自动驾驶等安全关键领域具有参考价值，诊断设计严谨，数据详实。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.contribution: 构建HallusionBench诊断套件，系统评估LVLM的幻觉与错觉问题。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.innovation: 设计区分语言幻觉和视觉错觉的测试协议。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.result: 现有LVLM在套件上错误率高达40%。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S._arxiv_id: Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic Suite for Entangled Language Hallucination and Visual Illusion in Large Vision-Language Models.

Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）提示调优中依赖梯度计算的问题，提出利用语言模型作为黑盒优化器来搜索提示。该方法将提示优化视为文本生成任务，通过语言模型迭代生成候选提示，无需访问VLM梯度。实验显示，在多个下游任务上，该方法能达到与梯度方法相当的精度，同时降低计算开销。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_en: This paper addresses gradient-dependent prompt tuning in vision-language models (VLMs). It proposes using language models as black-box optimizers to search prompts via text generation, without accessing VLM gradients. It achieves comparable accuracy to gradient methods on downstream tasks with lower computational cost.
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.assessment: 该工作提供了一种无梯度的提示优化思路，具有实用潜力，但性能提升有限，创新性中等。

2412.09082|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing VLN methods in multi-stage and long-horizon tasks by proposing a new task LH-VLN, an automated data generation platform NavGen, and a benchmark LHPR-VLN with 3,260 tasks. 1912.00381|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对深度3D CNN在视频动作识别中参数和计算量过大、在中小规模数据集上难以训练的问题。②提出了Gate-Shift Module (GSM)，通过空间门控和时空分解，将2D-CNN高效转换为时空特征提取器，实现自适应特征路由和组合。③相比3D CNN，GSM几乎不增加参数和计算开销，同时保持高精度。④在Something Something-V1和Diving48数据集上达到最先进结果，在EPIC-Kitchens上以更低的模型复杂度获得有竞争力的性能。
1912.00381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter and computational cost of deep 3D CNNs for video action recognition, which hinders training on moderate datasets. It introduces the Gate-Shift Module (GSM), which uses spatial gating and spatio-temporal decomposition to turn a 2D-CNN into an efficient spatio-temporal feature extractor with minimal overhead. GSM achieves state-of-the-art results on Something Something-V1 and Diving48, and competitive performance on EPIC-Kitchens with far less complexity.
1912.00381|v2.assessment: 方法轻量高效，实验充分，对视频理解领域有实用价值，值得关注。
1912.00381|v2.contribution: 提出GSM模块，实现2D-CNN到高效时空特征提取器的转换。
1912.00381|v2.innovation: 通过空间门控和时序移位实现自适应特征路由，几乎零额外开销。
1912.00381|v2.result: 在多个数据集上达到最先进或竞争性结果，且模型复杂度显著降低。

RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频动作识别中3D卷积计算效率低的问题。②提出了RubiksNet，利用可学习的3D移位操作替代传统3D卷积，实现高效时空建模。③相比固定移位或3D卷积，该方法通过可学习移位增强灵活性，降低计算成本。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果数据未知，但该方向旨在平衡精度与效率。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational inefficiency of 3D convolutions in video action recognition. It proposes RubiksNet, which uses learnable 3D shifts to replace traditional 3D convolutions for efficient spatio-temporal modeling. The learnable shifts offer more flexibility than fixed shifts while reducing cost, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of labeled data in few-shot fine-grained sports action recognition. It proposes video pose distillation to leverage pose information. Compared to RGB-only features, it improves generalization in few-shot settings. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.

2102.05095|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频理解中3D卷积网络计算量大、难以捕捉长距离时空依赖的问题，提出纯自注意力架构TimeSformer。②方法上，将标准Transformer适配到视频，从帧级patch序列直接学习时空特征，并比较多种自注意力方案，发现“divided attention”（块内分别应用时间注意力和空间注意力）效果最佳。③相比3D卷积网络，TimeSformer训练更快、测试效率更高（精度略有下降），且能处理超过一分钟的长视频。④在Kinetics-400和Kinetics-600上达到当时最优精度，验证了无卷积架构在视频分类中的潜力。
2102.05095|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces TimeSformer, a convolution-free video classification architecture based solely on self-attention over space and time. It shows that divided attention, applying temporal and spatial attention separately, achieves the best accuracy, and outperforms 3D CNNs in training speed, test efficiency, and long-video handling, setting state-of-the-art results on Kinetics-400/600.
2102.05095|v2.assessment: 开创性工作，证明了Transformer在视频理解中的有效性，对后续视频Transformer研究影响深远。
2102.05095|v2.contribution: 提出首个纯自注意力视频分类架构TimeSformer。
2102.05095|v2.innovation: 采用divided attention机制分别建模时空关系。

2106.11958|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪与分割（MOTS）中仅利用时间维度进行关联、分割依赖单帧预测的问题，提出原型交叉注意力网络（PCAN）。②方法上，PCAN将时空记忆蒸馏为一组原型，通过交叉注意力从过去帧检索丰富信息；同时采用原型外观模块学习对比性前景/背景原型并随时间传播。③改进点在于充分利用时空信息进行在线MOTS，且适用于单阶段和两阶段分割框架。④在YouTube-VIS和BDD100K数据集上超越当时的视频实例跟踪与分割竞赛冠军。
2106.11958|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Prototypical Cross-Attention Network (PCAN) for online multiple object tracking and segmentation, leveraging spatio-temporal information via prototypes and cross-attention. It outperforms competition winners on YouTube-VIS and BDD100K, demonstrating efficacy in both one-stage and two-stage frameworks.
2106.11958|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，有效结合原型学习和交叉注意力，对MOTS任务有显著提升。
2106.11958|v2.contribution: 提出PCAN，利用原型交叉注意力增强时空信息利用。
2106.11958|v2.innovation: 原型蒸馏与对比性原型传播机制。

2104.11178|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态（视频、音频、文本）自监督表示学习问题，提出无卷积的Video-Audio-Text Transformer（VATT）。②方法上，VATT直接以原始信号为输入，使用多模态对比损失端到端训练，并探索了共享权重的模态无关单骨干Transformer。③改进点在于避免监督预训练，纯Transformer架构在多个下游任务上超越基于ConvNet的SOTA。④在Kinetics-400/600/700和Moments in Time上取得新纪录，迁移到ImageNet分类达到78.7% top-1精度，验证了模型泛化性。
2104.11178|v2.summary_en: This paper presents VATT, a convolution-free Transformer framework for multimodal self-supervised learning from raw video, audio, and text. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks, including Kinetics and Moments in Time, and demonstrates strong transferability to image classification, outperforming ConvNet-based counterparts.
2104.11178|v2.assessment: 多模态自监督学习的代表性工作，展示了Transformer在跨模态表示学习中的潜力。
2104.11178|v2.contribution: 提出VATT，实现无卷积多模态自监督表示学习。
2104.11178|v2.innovation: 模态无关单骨干Transformer与多模态对比学习。
2104.11178|v2.result: 在多个视频和音频基准上取得新纪录。
