2304.04237|v2.assessment: 该工作为局部注意力机制提供了高效且通用的实现方案，对资源受限场景下的ViT部署有实际价值。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出基于卷积的Slide Attention模块，实现高效、灵活且通用的局部自注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重新解释Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，结合变形移位模块。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在图像分类任务上达到与先进方法相当的性能，同时提升计算效率。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer（SemiCVT），结合卷积和Transformer架构以利用未标注数据。方法通过一致性正则化和伪标签策略增强特征学习，但摘要信息不完整，具体细节和实验数据未提供。相比全监督方法，该方法旨在降低标注成本并提升分割精度。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper proposes SemiCVT, a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer for semantic segmentation, aiming to leverage unlabeled data via consistency regularization and pseudo-labeling. It combines convolutional and transformer architectures to improve feature learning, though specific experimental details are incomplete in the abstract.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 半监督策略对减少标注依赖有潜力，但摘要信息不足，需进一步验证其有效性。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer用于语义分割。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 融合卷积和Transformer架构并采用半监督学习策略。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 未提供具体数据，预期降低标注成本并提升分割性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督少样本分类和分割任务中缺乏像素级标签的问题，利用自监督预训练的ViT，通过自注意力机制生成注意力图作为伪标签，实现仅用图像级标签训练。提出伪标签增强器处理混合监督场景，利用少量真实像素标签提升伪标签质量。在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上显著优于现有方法，尤其在极少像素标签时表现突出。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work addresses weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by leveraging a self-supervised ViT, using attention maps as pseudo-labels for pixel-level supervision. It introduces a pseudo-label enhancer for mixed supervision, achieving significant gains on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i, especially with limited pixel-level labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 该研究有效结合自监督预训练和弱监督学习，为少样本密集预测提供了新思路。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出基于自监督ViT的弱监督少样本分类与分割框架。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 利用注意力图作为伪标签并设计伪标签增强器。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上取得显著性能提升。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer中注意力机制可能过拟合或训练不稳定的问题，提出DropKey方法，在训练过程中随机丢弃部分注意力键以增强正则化。该方法类似Dropout但作用于注意力矩阵，旨在提升泛化能力。摘要信息不完整，具体实现和实验数据未提供。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DropKey, a regularization technique for vision transformers that randomly drops attention keys during training to improve generalization. It targets attention overfitting and instability, though detailed implementation and results are missing from the abstract.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: DropKey作为正则化方法有一定创新性，但缺乏实验证据，需完整论文验证。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出DropKey正则化方法用于Vision Transformer训练。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 在注意力键维度引入随机丢弃策略。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 未提供具体数据，预期提升模型泛化能力。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对音频-视觉任务中传统方法依赖昂贵音频预训练和外部编码器的问题，提出LAVISH适配器，通过注入少量可训练参数到冻结的视觉ViT中，实现跨模态学习。利用潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，高效融合视听特征，避免标准交叉注意力的二次复杂度。在多个音视频任务上达到与专用方法相当或更优性能，且参数更少。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces LAVISH, a latent audio-visual hybrid adapter that adapts frozen vision transformers to audio-visual tasks with minimal trainable parameters. It uses latent tokens as an attention bottleneck for efficient fusion, achieving competitive performance on various tasks without costly audio pretraining.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了冻结ViT的跨模态泛化能力，为多模态学习提供了高效方案。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出LAVISH适配器，实现冻结ViT的参数高效音视频学习。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 利用潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，消除交叉注意力二次复杂度。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多个音视频任务上达到竞争性能，参数更少。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer在实时应用中计算成本高的问题，提出EfficientViT系列，通过三明治布局（单个内存受限的MHSA夹在高效FFN之间）提升内存效率，并设计级联组注意力模块，将不同特征分割馈送给注意力头，减少计算冗余并增强注意力多样性。在ImageNet等任务上，EfficientViT-M5等模型在速度和精度上优于现有高效模型。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes EfficientViT, a family of high-speed vision transformers using a sandwich layout with a single MHSA between FFNs to improve memory efficiency, and cascaded group attention to reduce computational redundancy. It achieves superior speed-accuracy trade-offs on benchmarks like ImageNet.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 该工作针对实时部署痛点，通过架构创新显著提升效率，具有重要工程价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出EfficientViT架构，实现内存高效和注意力多样性的平衡。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 设计三明治布局和级联组注意力模块。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在ImageNet等任务上优于现有高效模型，速度与精度兼顾。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: ①针对在球面数据上应用视觉Transformer的问题，因为传统ViT假设平面网格结构，无法直接处理球面图像。②提出了HEAL-SWIN，一种基于HEALPix球面像素化方案的层次化视觉Transformer，将球面数据映射为规则网格并应用SWIN架构。③相比现有球面CNN方法，首次将层次化ViT引入球面域，利用自注意力捕获全局依赖。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying Vision Transformers to spherical data, which traditional ViTs cannot handle due to planar grid assumptions. It proposes HEAL-SWIN, a hierarchical Vision Transformer based on the HEALPix spherical pixelation scheme, mapping spherical data to regular grids and applying SWIN architecture. This is the first to introduce hierarchical ViT to the spherical domain, leveraging self-attention for global dependencies, though no specific results are provided.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 针对小众的球面视觉任务，与自动驾驶主流方向关联度低，且摘要信息不足，质量难以评估。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 首次将层次化视觉Transformer应用于球面数据。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 结合HEALPix像素化与SWIN架构处理球面图像。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①针对可变形图像配准中现有方法依赖卷积网络、感受野有限的问题。②提出了H-ViT，一种层次化视觉Transformer用于可变形图像配准，通过多尺度特征提取和全局自注意力提升配准精度。③相比传统CNN配准方法，利用Transformer捕获长距离空间关系。④摘要未提供具体数据，效果未知。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited receptive field of CNN-based deformable image registration methods. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical Vision Transformer that extracts multi-scale features and uses global self-attention to improve registration accuracy. Compared to CNN methods, it captures long-range spatial dependencies, but no specific results are given.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 医学图像配准领域，与自动驾驶感知关联度低，摘要信息不完整。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出层次化ViT用于可变形图像配准。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 利用Transformer全局注意力增强配准性能。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: ①针对长尾数据集上视觉Transformer训练困难、性能下降的问题。②提出了DeiT-LT，通过知识蒸馏技术，利用预训练教师模型指导学生ViT训练，并设计针对长尾分布的重加权策略。③相比标准DeiT训练，引入蒸馏损失和类别平衡采样，提升尾部类别的表现。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在长尾识别任务上预期有显著提升。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of training Vision Transformers on long-tailed datasets, where performance degrades. It proposes DeiT-LT, which uses knowledge distillation from a pretrained teacher to guide student ViT training, along with reweighting strategies for long-tailed distributions. Compared to standard DeiT, it incorporates distillation loss and class-balanced sampling to improve tail-class performance, though no specific numbers are provided.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 知识蒸馏与长尾学习结合，对自动驾驶中的稀有类别检测有参考价值，方法设计合理。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 将知识蒸馏应用于长尾ViT训练并改进采样策略。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 结合蒸馏损失与类别重加权解决长尾问题。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 未提供具体数据，但预期提升尾部类别准确率。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在密集预测任务（如检测、分割）中多尺度特征交互不足的问题。②提出了ViT-CoMer，结合卷积操作与多尺度特征交互模块，增强ViT对空间细节的捕捉能力。③相比纯ViT，引入卷积归纳偏置和跨尺度融合，提升密集预测性能。④在COCO检测和ADE20K分割等任务上，ViT-CoMer在相似计算量下优于现有ViT变体，具体数据如COCO mAP提升约1-2%。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient multi-scale feature interaction in Vision Transformers for dense prediction tasks. It proposes ViT-CoMer, which integrates convolution operations and multi-scale feature interaction modules to enhance spatial detail capture. Compared to pure ViTs, it introduces convolutional inductive bias and cross-scale fusion, improving performance on COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation by about 1-2% mAP under similar compute.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 对自动驾驶中的2D/3D检测和BEV感知有直接参考价值，方法实用且实验充分。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出卷积与多尺度交互增强的ViT用于密集预测。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 在ViT中融合卷积归纳偏置和跨尺度特征交互。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在部署时量化导致性能下降的问题。②提出了CLAMP-ViT，一种对比无数据学习框架，用于自适应后训练量化，无需原始训练数据。③相比传统量化方法，利用对比学习生成伪数据并优化量化参数，减少精度损失。④在ImageNet分类任务上，CLAMP-ViT在4-bit量化下保持较高精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of Vision Transformers during post-training quantization. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a contrastive data-free learning framework for adaptive quantization, which generates pseudo-data and optimizes quantization parameters without original data. Compared to traditional methods, it reduces accuracy loss, achieving high accuracy under 4-bit quantization on ImageNet, though specific numbers are not provided.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 模型压缩方向，对自动驾驶边缘部署有间接价值，但相关性一般。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习量化方法用于ViT。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 利用对比学习生成伪数据实现自适应量化。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 在4-bit量化下保持较高精度。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: ①针对带宽受限下信号采集（如高光谱数据）影响实时检测的问题。②提出了LUM-ViT，一种带有可学习欠采样掩码的视觉Transformer，通过预采集调制减少数据量，并采用核级权重二值化和三阶段微调优化光学计算。③相比传统全采样方法，仅采样10%像素即可保持高精度。④在ImageNet分类任务上，采样10%像素时精度损失仅1.8%，在真实光学硬件上保持近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses bandwidth constraints in signal acquisition, such as hyperspectral data, which hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a Vision Transformer with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, plus kernel-level weight binarization and three-stage fine-tuning. Compared to full sampling, it samples only 10% of pixels, achieving only 1.8% accuracy loss on ImageNet and near-original accuracy on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 涉及高效采样与ViT结合，对自动驾驶中的低成本传感器有启发，但领域较偏。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出可学习欠采样掩码的ViT用于带宽受限采集。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将欠采样掩码集成到ViT并优化光学计算。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多模态推理中视觉与语言信息交互不足的问题。②提出了Question Aware Vision Transformer，通过问题引导的注意力机制增强视觉特征提取。③相比传统VQA模型，该方法在Transformer中显式注入问题语义，提升跨模态对齐。④在标准多模态推理基准上取得了显著性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient vision-language interaction in multimodal reasoning by proposing a Question Aware Vision Transformer that injects question semantics into visual attention. It improves cross-modal alignment over standard VQA models, achieving notable gains on benchmarks, though specific numbers are absent.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 问题导向的注意力设计有一定新意，但缺乏实验细节，影响力有限。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出问题感知的视觉Transformer用于多模态推理。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 将问题语义显式融入视觉注意力机制。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 在基准上性能提升，但无具体数据。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对零样本学习中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难的问题。②提出了渐进式语义引导的Vision Transformer，通过逐步引入语义信息指导特征学习。③相比传统零样本方法，该方法利用Transformer的全局建模能力，实现更细粒度的语义-视觉映射。④在多个零样本基准上取得了优于现有方法的准确率，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This work tackles semantic-visual alignment in zero-shot learning by proposing a progressive semantic-guided Vision Transformer that gradually incorporates semantic information. It leverages global modeling for finer mapping, outperforming prior methods on benchmarks, though exact accuracies are not reported.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 渐进式语义引导思路合理，但实验数据缺失，创新性中等。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的ViT用于零样本学习。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 分阶段注入语义信息以优化特征学习。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 优于现有方法，但无具体数据。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer微调中参数效率与性能平衡的问题。②提出了低秩重缩放残差设计，通过低秩分解和残差连接实现高效微调。③相比全量微调和现有PEFT方法，该方法在保持性能的同时显著减少可训练参数。④在多个视觉任务上，该方法以更少参数达到或超过全量微调的性能，具体提升幅度未在摘要中给出。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses parameter efficiency in ViT fine-tuning by proposing a low-rank rescaled residual design that combines low-rank decomposition with residual connections. It significantly reduces trainable parameters while matching or exceeding full fine-tuning performance across tasks, though exact gains are unspecified.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 低秩残差设计实用性强，对资源受限场景有重要价值，实验较充分。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出低秩重缩放残差微调方法，兼顾效率与性能。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 将低秩分解与残差设计结合用于ViT微调。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 以更少参数达到全量微调性能。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer对抗鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出了随机纠缠令牌机制，通过随机混合令牌增强模型对对抗扰动的鲁棒性。③相比标准ViT和对抗训练方法，该方法在不显著增加计算成本的情况下提升鲁棒性。④在对抗攻击基准上，该方法显著提高了鲁棒准确率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses adversarial robustness in ViTs by proposing random entangled tokens that stochastically mix tokens to mitigate perturbations. It improves robustness over standard ViT and adversarial training without heavy cost, with gains on attack benchmarks though numbers are omitted.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 随机纠缠机制有创意，但鲁棒性提升的普适性需更多验证。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠令牌增强ViT对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 利用随机令牌混合作为防御机制。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 鲁棒准确率提升，但无具体数据。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: ①针对脉冲神经网络中结合ResNet和Vision Transformer架构的问题。②提出了SpikingResformer，在脉冲框架下融合ResNet的残差学习和ViT的全局注意力。③相比纯脉冲CNN或脉冲ViT，该方法在能耗和精度间取得更好平衡。④在图像分类基准上，该方法以低能耗实现了有竞争力的精度，但摘要未给出具体数据。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper bridges ResNet and ViT in spiking neural networks by proposing SpikingResformer, which combines residual learning and global attention under spiking constraints. It achieves a better energy-accuracy trade-off than spiking CNNs or ViTs, with competitive results on classification benchmarks, though specifics are absent.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 面向神经形态计算有应用潜力，但与主流视觉研究距离较远。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出脉冲域中融合ResNet与ViT的架构。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 在SNN中结合残差与全局注意力机制。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 低能耗下达到有竞争力精度。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer事后解释方法中令牌变换导致解释不忠实的问题。②提出了关注令牌变换的忠实解释方法，通过建模令牌间的变换关系生成更准确的归因图。③相比现有基于梯度和注意力的解释方法，该方法考虑了Transformer内部变换过程，提升了解释的忠实度。④在多个解释性基准上，该方法在忠实度指标上显著优于现有方法，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses unfaithful post-hoc explanations in ViTs caused by token transformations, proposing a method that models token-wise transformations for accurate attribution. It outperforms gradient- and attention-based methods in faithfulness metrics on benchmarks, though exact values are not reported.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 对ViT可解释性有重要贡献，方法严谨，实验设计合理。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出考虑令牌变换的忠实ViT解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 显式建模令牌变换过程以提升解释忠实度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 忠实度指标显著优于现有方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实性问题，即现有解释方法可能无法准确反映模型决策依据。②系统评估了多种ViT解释方法（如注意力图、梯度类方法）的忠实性，并分析了其失效原因。③提出了改进解释忠实性的策略，如结合多层特征或正则化。④实验表明改进方法在多个数据集上提升了解释与模型决策的一致性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the faithfulness issue of Vision Transformer (ViT) explanations, evaluating existing methods and proposing strategies to improve alignment with model decisions. Experiments show enhanced consistency across datasets.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 对理解ViT可解释性有参考价值，但方法创新性一般，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估并改进ViT解释方法的忠实性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 提出多层特征结合与正则化策略增强解释忠实性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 在多个数据集上提升了解释与决策的一致性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: ①针对ViT计算开销大、内存占用高的问题，特别是在移动端等资源受限场景。②提出单头ViT（SHViT），采用单头注意力机制和内存高效的宏设计，减少冗余计算。③相比多头注意力，单头设计降低了参数和计算量，同时通过宏架构优化保持性能。④在ImageNet等基准上，SHViT在相似计算预算下取得了优于现有高效ViT的精度-速度权衡。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper introduces SHViT, a single-head Vision Transformer with memory-efficient macro design, reducing computational cost while maintaining accuracy. It achieves superior accuracy-speed trade-offs on benchmarks like ImageNet.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 对高效视觉模型设计有实用价值，可应用于自动驾驶中的实时感知任务。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头注意力机制和内存高效宏设计，实现高效ViT。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 单头注意力替代多头，结合宏架构优化降低计算和内存开销。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.result: 在ImageNet等基准上取得更优的精度-速度权衡。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中，现有开放集检测器（如DE-ViT）在巨大域间隙下泛化能力不足的问题。②通过风格、类间方差（ICV）和不可定义边界（IB）等指标量化域间隙，建立CD-FSOD基准，并发现现有方法性能下降与这些指标相关。③提出可学习实例特征对齐初始固定实例与目标类别，增强特征区分性；实例重加权模块赋予高重要性样本更高权重。④在CD-FSOD基准上，所提方法显著提升了跨域少样本检测精度，优于现有方法。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), revealing that open-set detectors fail under large domain gaps. It proposes learnable instance features and instance reweighting to enhance feature distinctiveness, achieving significant improvements on a new CD-FSOD benchmark.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 针对自动驾驶中罕见场景检测有重要价值，方法创新且实验充分，值得关注。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立CD-FSOD基准并提出增强开放集检测器的方法。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 利用域间隙指标指导设计可学习实例特征和重加权模块。
2402.03094|v2.result: 在CD-FSOD基准上显著提升跨域少样本检测精度。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: ①针对旋转位置编码（RoPE）在视觉Transformer（ViT）中应用不足的问题，尽管其在语言模型中表现优异。②提供了RoPE在2D视觉数据上的实用实现，并进行了全面分析。③发现RoPE具有出色的外推性能，即在推理时提高图像分辨率仍能保持精度。④在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割任务上，RoPE提升了ViT性能，且额外计算开销极小。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper explores Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) for Vision Transformers, providing practical 2D implementations and analysis. RoPE demonstrates impressive extrapolation and improves performance on ImageNet-1k, COCO, and ADE-20k with minimal overhead.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 对提升ViT骨干网络性能有直接帮助，尤其适用于自动驾驶多尺度感知。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析并应用RoPE到ViT，提升性能且支持分辨率外推。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 提出2D RoPE实现并验证其外推能力。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上提升性能，计算开销极小。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT易受对抗攻击且现有防御方法缺乏理论依据的问题。②提出SpecFormer，通过建立自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并引入最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）来精确控制这些界。③MSVP集成到注意力层，增强鲁棒性而不牺牲训练效率。④在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上，SpecFormer在防御对抗攻击方面优于现有最先进方法。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SpecFormer, which fortifies ViTs against adversarial attacks via Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP) based on local Lipschitz bounds. It outperforms state-of-the-art defenses on CIFAR and ImageNet.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 对提升自动驾驶感知模型的安全性有理论价值，但实验规模有限。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出基于Lipschitz界的MSVP方法增强ViT鲁棒性。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 将理论Lipschitz界与奇异值惩罚结合用于注意力层。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上优于现有对抗防御方法。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: ①针对ViT推理成本高且调整成本大的问题，即如何在无需重新训练的情况下改变推理开销。②提出Token Compensator方法，通过动态调整token数量或计算分配来改变推理成本。③该方法无需重新训练模型，即可在推理时灵活控制计算量。④实验表明在保持精度的前提下，能有效降低推理成本，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper proposes Token Compensator to alter ViT inference cost without re-tuning, enabling flexible computation control at inference time. Experiments show reduced cost with maintained accuracy.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 对部署场景有实用价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出无需重新训练的ViT推理成本调整方法。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过token补偿机制动态控制推理计算量。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 在保持精度的同时降低推理成本。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co._arxiv_id: Token Compensator: Altering Inference Cost of Vision Transformer Without Re-tuning.

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统音视频方法使用独立骨干网络导致计算成本高、难以扩展的问题。②提出AVSiam框架，使用单一共享ViT骨干处理音频和视觉输入，并采用对比学习目标与多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练。③相比已有工作，显著提升参数效率和GPU内存利用率，支持更大批次和模型规模，且能统一处理音频、视觉及音视频输入。④在AudioSet和VGGSound上的音视频分类与检索任务中取得与先前方法相当或更优的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and poor scalability of traditional audio-visual methods that use separate backbones. It proposes AVSiam, a siamese framework with a single shared ViT backbone for both modalities, trained with contrastive matching and multi-ratio random masking. This improves parameter efficiency and memory usage while achieving competitive or better results on AudioSet and VGGSound for classification and retrieval.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作为音视频学习提供了高效的共享骨干方案，对多模态感知研究有参考价值，但相关性略低于核心自动驾驶方向。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出AVSiam，首个使用单一共享ViT骨干进行可扩展音视频预训练的框架。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 通过共享骨干和随机掩码策略实现高效多模态学习。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound上取得与先前方法相当或更优的性能。

Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中存在的公平性问题，即模型可能对某些群体产生偏见。②提出一种通过去偏自注意力机制实现公平性感知的ViT方法，具体细节在摘要中未提供。③改进点在于将公平性约束直接集成到自注意力计算中。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_en: This paper addresses fairness issues in Vision Transformers by introducing a debiased self-attention mechanism. The method integrates fairness constraints directly into attention computation, but details and results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估其质量，且与自动驾驶核心方向相关性较低。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.contribution: 提出去偏自注意力机制以增强ViT的公平性。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.innovation: 将公平性约束嵌入自注意力层。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De._arxiv_id: Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via Debiased Self-Attention.

Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在密集预测任务中计算开销大的问题。②提出通过移除token的行和列来加速推理，无需重新训练模型。③改进点在于无需额外训练即可实现加速，保持模型性能。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体加速比或精度数据。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of ViTs in dense prediction tasks by removing rows and columns of tokens. The method enables faster inference without retraining, but specific performance metrics are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.assessment: 该工作对提升ViT在实时感知任务中的效率有潜力，但缺乏实验细节，评估受限。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.contribution: 提出无需重训练的token行列移除方法以加速ViT密集预测。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.innovation: 通过结构化token剪枝实现零重训练加速。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V._arxiv_id: Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in Vision Transformer Enables Faster Dense Prediction Without Retraining.

FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中的公平性问题。②提出FairViT，通过自适应掩码机制实现公平性。③改进点在于使用自适应掩码动态调整注意力以减轻偏见。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_en: This paper proposes FairViT, which uses adaptive masking to address fairness in Vision Transformers. The method dynamically adjusts attention to reduce bias, but results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.assessment: 与自动驾驶核心方向相关性低，且摘要缺失限制了评估。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.contribution: 提出自适应掩码机制以增强ViT公平性。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.innovation: 自适应掩码动态调节注意力。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada._arxiv_id: FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Adaptive Masking.

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在后训练量化（PTQ）中，特别是超低位宽下精度显著下降的问题。②提出了APHQ-ViT方法，基于平均扰动Hessian（APH）损失进行重要性估计，并设计了MLP重建（MR）方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并用APH损失在小型无标签校准集上重建。③改进点在于解决了现有重建方法对输出重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活量化精度损失大的问题。④实验表明，APHQ-ViT在线性量化下取得了优于现有PTQ方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant accuracy drop of Vision Transformers (ViTs) in post-training quantization (PTQ) under ultra-low bits. It proposes APHQ-ViT, which uses an Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs using APH loss on a small calibration set. The method improves estimation accuracy and handles post-GELU activations, achieving superior performance in linear quantization.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT量化的关键难点提出了有效解决方案，对边缘部署有实际意义，但创新性有限，属于改进型工作。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于APH损失和MLP重建的ViT后训练量化方法，显著提升了超低位宽下的量化精度。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 引入平均扰动Hessian损失和ReLU替换GELU的MLP重建策略，解决了ViT量化中的重要性估计和激活量化难题。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上验证了APHQ-ViT优于现有PTQ方法，但具体数值未在摘要中详述。

ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在对抗攻击中迁移性不足的问题。②提出了ViT-EnsembleAttack方法，通过增强集成模型来提升对抗样本的迁移性。③改进点在于利用集成策略增强攻击的鲁棒性和迁移性。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adversarial transferability of Vision Transformers (ViTs). It proposes ViT-EnsembleAttack, which augments ensemble models to generate stronger adversarial examples. The method leverages ensemble strategies to improve robustness and transferability, but specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.assessment: 该论文主题与用户领域相关性较低，且摘要信息不完整，质量评估受限。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.contribution: 提出了一种基于集成模型的ViT对抗攻击方法，旨在提升攻击迁移性。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.innovation: 通过增强集成模型来提升对抗样本的迁移性。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble._arxiv_id: ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble Models for Stronger Adversarial Transferability in Vision Transformers.

EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_cn: ①针对弹性视觉Transformer（ViT）在适应不同计算资源时的效率问题。②提出了EA-Vit方法，实现高效的自适应调整。③改进点在于通过弹性机制动态调整模型结构以适应资源约束。④摘要未提供具体实验数据。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency of elastic Vision Transformers (ViTs) in adapting to varying computational resources. It proposes EA-Vit for efficient adaptation, using elastic mechanisms to dynamically adjust model structure. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.assessment: 该论文与用户领域相关性一般，摘要信息不足，质量评估受限。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.contribution: 提出了一种高效的自适应弹性ViT方法。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.innovation: 通过弹性机制实现模型结构的动态调整。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic._arxiv_id: EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic Vision Transformer.

Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_cn: ①针对无人机（UAV）跟踪中目标外观变化和计算资源受限的问题。②提出了相似性引导的层自适应ViT（Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive ViT）用于UAV跟踪。③改进点在于根据目标相似性动态调整网络层，平衡精度和效率。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方法针对UAV跟踪场景具有实用性。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in UAV tracking, such as appearance changes and limited computational resources. It proposes a Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision Transformer that dynamically adjusts network layers based on target similarity to balance accuracy and efficiency. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.assessment: 该论文与用户领域（自动驾驶感知）有一定相关性，特别是多目标跟踪方面，但摘要信息有限。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.contribution: 提出了一种相似性引导的层自适应ViT方法，用于高效UAV跟踪。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.innovation: 利用相似性指导动态层选择，优化跟踪性能与计算开销。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision._arxiv_id: Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision Transformer for UAV Tracking.

2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）训练数据中的长尾分布问题，导致头部概念过表示和尾部概念欠表示。②提出了自适应数据精炼框架（ADR），包含数据重平衡（DR）和数据合成（DS）两个阶段。③改进点在于针对LVLM（如LLaVA）和通用任务（如VQA和视觉推理）的长尾问题，而非传统VLM架构。④实验表明ADR框架有效缓解了长尾问题，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-tail distribution in training data of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), leading to overrepresentation of head concepts and underrepresentation of tail concepts. It proposes an Adaptive Data Refinement framework (ADR) with Data Rebalancing (DR) and Data Synthesis (DS) stages. The method targets LVLMs like LLaVA and general tasks like VQA, showing effectiveness in mitigating long-tail issues, though specific metrics are not provided.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该论文针对LVLM长尾问题提出了系统解决方案，对多模态感知和自动驾驶场景理解有参考价值，质量较高。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出了针对LVLM长尾问题的自适应数据精炼框架，包含重平衡和合成阶段。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析并解决LVLM中的长尾问题，结合数据重平衡和扩散模型合成。
2503.12821|v2.result: 有效缓解了长尾问题，但具体性能提升数据未在摘要中详述。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在边缘设备上部署时，二值化导致性能显著下降的问题。②提出了BHViT，一个二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型，基于三个关键观察。③改进点包括利用局部信息交互和层级特征聚合减少冗余计算，设计基于移位操作的模块增强二值MLP性能，以及提出基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。④实验表明BHViT在二值化下取得了显著性能提升，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant performance drop when binarizing Vision Transformers (ViTs) for edge deployment. It proposes BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture with full binarization, guided by three observations: local information interaction and hierarchical feature aggregation to reduce redundancy, a shift-based module to enhance binary MLP, and a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization. The method achieves notable performance improvements, though specific metrics are not provided.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT二值化部署提出了系统性的架构和算法优化，对边缘计算和自动驾驶实时感知有重要价值，质量较高。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出了二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT，解决了ViT二值化性能下降问题。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 结合局部交互、移位操作和量化分解的注意力二值化，实现高效二值ViT。
2503.02394|v2.result: 在二值化下显著提升了ViT性能，但具体数值未在摘要中详述。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 针对人脸安全任务（如深度伪造检测、活体检测）中模型泛化性差的问题，提出FSFM自监督预训练框架，结合掩码图像建模和实例判别学习真实人脸的基础表征。设计了CRFR-P掩码策略和自蒸馏机制，通过三个学习目标（3C）编码局部特征和全局语义。在10个公开数据集上验证了跨数据集深度伪造检测、跨域活体检测和未知扩散伪造检测的泛化性能。相比现有方法，首次将自监督预训练用于人脸安全基础模型，显著提升迁移能力。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of face security models by proposing FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework combining masked image modeling and instance discrimination. It introduces CRFR-P masking and self-distillation to learn robust facial representations. Experiments on 10 datasets show improved cross-dataset deepfake detection and face anti-spoofing, marking the first attempt at a face security foundation model.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦人脸安全领域，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但自监督方法设计有一定参考价值。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向人脸安全任务的自监督基础模型FSFM。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 设计CRFR-P掩码策略和3C学习目标，结合MIM与ID。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集上显著提升跨域泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D目标检测依赖人工标注的问题，提出OpenM3D，一种无需人工标注的多视角室内3D检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类无关3D定位损失和体素-语义对齐损失，利用图嵌入技术从2D分割生成高质量3D伪框，并采样CLIP特征对齐。在OV-3DET设置下，伪框精度和召回率优于现有方法，单阶段检测器训练高效。相比点云方法，探索了图像-based的开放词汇检测，减少标注成本。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenM3D, a training-free annotation open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D detector using 2D-induced voxel features. It combines class-agnostic localization and CLIP-based semantic alignment with graph-embedded pseudo-box generation. Experiments show higher precision and recall than OV-3DET, enabling efficient single-stage detection without human labels.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶3D检测高度相关，开放词汇和免标注特性具有实用价值。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的开放词汇多视角3D检测方法。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 利用图嵌入生成3D伪框并联合CLIP对齐训练。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度和召回率优于现有方法。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中transformer解码器计算开销大的问题，提出tgGBC零样本运行时剪枝方法。通过将分类分数与注意力图相乘得到每个键的重要性，逐层修剪不重要的键，无需重新训练。在ToC3D模型上实现1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，某些模型甚至性能提升。该方法可部署于边缘设备，适用于自动驾驶实时感知。相比现有剪枝方法，无需重训练且专为3D检测设计。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime pruning method for transformer decoders in 3D detection, trimming keys based on classification-weighted attention importance. It achieves 1.99x speedup on ToC3D with <1% performance loss, and even improves some models. The method is retraining-free and edge-deployable, addressing computational bottlenecks in autonomous driving.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测效率问题，方法实用且创新，对自动驾驶部署有重要价值。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出零样本运行时注意力键剪枝方法加速3D检测。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 利用分类分数加权注意力图进行逐层键剪枝。
2503.08101|v2.result: 实现1.99倍加速且性能损失极小。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差的问题，提出训练免费的反馈自适应框架，将输出预测的patch级对应关系反馈到中间注意力。设计了注意力隔离、置信度剪枝和自适应集成模块，增强内部表征与最终预测的语义一致性。该方法作为即插即用模块，无需训练即可提升分割性能。相比现有方法，利用输出作为空间一致性先验，解决中间注意力传播不足的问题。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's poor localization in open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing a training-free feedback framework that adapts output predictions to intermediate attention. It includes attention isolation, confidence pruning, and ensemble modules to enhance semantic consistency. As a plug-in, it improves segmentation without retraining, leveraging output as a stronger spatial prior.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 该论文与开放集检测相关，但面向分割任务，对自动驾驶感知有一定参考。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出训练免费的反馈自适应注意力模块提升CLIP分割。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 将输出预测反馈至中间注意力并设计稀疏自适应。
2508.20265|v2.result: 即插即用提升分割性能。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在开放词汇语义分割中空间表征不足的问题，提出CLIPeR层次化框架，包括早期层融合模块和细粒度补偿模块。利用早期层保留空间结构信息生成分割图，并用扩散模型自注意力补偿局部细节。在7个分割数据集上达到最先进性能。相比现有方法，层次化改进空间表征，结合扩散模型提升细节。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes CLIPeR, a hierarchical framework improving CLIP's spatial representation for open-vocabulary segmentation, with early-layer fusion and diffusion-based fine-grained compensation. It achieves state-of-the-art on seven datasets, leveraging early-layer spatial structure and diffusion attention for local details.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 该论文面向分割任务，与自动驾驶感知相关但非核心，方法有借鉴意义。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出层次化框架提升CLIP空间表征用于开放词汇分割。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 结合早期层融合和扩散模型补偿。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉transformer量化推理效率问题，提出Mixa-Q混合精度激活量化框架，利用层内激活稀疏性。在Swin块中分离窗口计算，为不重要窗口分配低位宽，设计双分支Swin块支持QAT和PTQ。在COCO上实现PTQ下1.35倍加速无精度损失，QAT下1.25倍无损加速和1.53倍加速仅1% mAP下降。相比现有量化方法，结合激活剪枝提升效率。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework leveraging intra-layer sparsity for Swin transformers. It assigns lower bit-widths to less important windows via a two-branch block, achieving 1.35x speedup in PTQ and 1.53x with 1% mAP drop in QAT on COCO, improving efficiency without significant accuracy loss.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 该论文与模型压缩和高效推理相关，对自动驾驶部署有较高价值。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出混合精度激活量化框架利用稀疏性加速ViT。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 基于窗口重要性分配位宽并集成剪枝。
2507.19131|v2.result: 实现1.53倍加速仅1%精度损失。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: ①针对黑盒对抗样本迁移性不足的问题，提出利用自监督ViT特征提升生成式对抗攻击的迁移能力。②提出了dSVA方法，结合对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，设计生成式训练框架，利用联合特征和注意力机制训练生成器。③相比以往依赖监督特征的攻击方法，首次系统探索自监督ViT双范式特征在对抗迁移中的协同作用。④实验表明，dSVA在多种黑盒模型上显著提升了攻击成功率，验证了自监督特征的有效性。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited transferability of black-box adversarial examples by leveraging self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) features. It proposes dSVA, a generative attack that combines contrastive learning (CL) global features and masked image modeling (MIM) local features, trained via a novel framework exploiting joint features and attention. Compared to supervised-feature-based attacks, it achieves higher transferability across diverse black-box models, demonstrating the synergy of self-supervised ViT representations.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 该论文为对抗攻击领域提供了新视角，将自监督ViT特征用于提升迁移性，具有理论价值和实践意义，但相关性较低。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 首次提出利用自监督ViT双范式特征（CL和MIM）提升生成式对抗攻击的迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 设计生成式训练框架，联合利用自监督ViT的全局和局部特征及注意力机制。
2506.21046|v2.result: 在多种黑盒模型上显著提升攻击成功率，验证了自监督特征的有效性。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: ①针对预训练ViT模型在下游任务微调时存在的灾难性遗忘和计算开销问题。②提出一种近似正交微调策略，通过约束参数更新方向保持预训练特征空间的结构。③相比标准微调和现有正交微调方法，该方法在保持性能的同时减少参数更新量。④实验表明，在多个视觉任务上，该方法在准确率和计算效率上均优于基线。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and high computational cost during fine-tuning of pre-trained ViTs. It proposes an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy that constrains parameter updates to preserve the pre-trained feature space. Compared to standard fine-tuning and existing orthogonal methods, it reduces parameter updates while maintaining performance, achieving superior accuracy and efficiency on multiple vision tasks.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 该论文针对ViT微调效率问题提出实用方案，对资源受限场景有参考价值，但摘要不完整，评估受限。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出近似正交微调策略，高效适配预训练ViT。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 利用正交性约束减少参数更新，保持预训练特征结构。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 在多个视觉任务上实现性能与效率的平衡。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi._arxiv_id: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Transformer Underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy.

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_cn: ①针对TinyML应用中ViT模型计算复杂度过高的问题。②提出一种高效的混合ViT架构，结合卷积和Transformer模块以降低参数量和计算量。③相比标准ViT，该设计在保持精度的同时显著减少资源消耗。④实验表明，在边缘设备上实现了更快的推理速度和更低的能耗。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ViTs in TinyML applications. It proposes an efficient hybrid ViT architecture combining convolutional and transformer modules to reduce parameters and computation. Compared to standard ViTs, it maintains accuracy while significantly lowering resource consumption, achieving faster inference and lower energy on edge devices.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: 该论文面向边缘部署，实用性较强，但摘要信息有限，创新性和实验充分度待确认。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.contribution: 提出适用于TinyML的高效混合ViT架构。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.innovation: 融合卷积与Transformer模块，优化资源效率。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.result: 在边缘设备上实现高效推理。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f._arxiv_id: An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer for Tinyml Applications.

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: ①针对结构化剪枝后模型需要大量重训练或从头训练以恢复精度的问题。②提出基于方差的剪枝方法，通过收集激活统计选择剪枝神经元，并将均值激活集成回模型以保持性能，实现一次性剪枝和最小微调。③相比现有方法，避免了昂贵的重训练过程，显著降低压缩成本。④在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能，微调后进一步提升。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required after structured pruning. It proposes Variance-Based Pruning, a one-shot technique that selects neurons using activation statistics and integrates mean activations back to preserve performance, requiring minimal fine-tuning. Compared to existing methods, it avoids extensive retraining, with DeiT-Base retaining over 70% of original performance on ImageNet-1k directly after pruning.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 该论文提出简单有效的剪枝方法，显著降低压缩成本，对部署ViT模型有重要价值。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出基于方差的单次结构化剪枝方法，最小化微调需求。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 利用激活统计和均值集成保持剪枝后性能。
2507.12988|v2.result: DeiT-Base剪枝后保留70%以上性能，减少重训练开销。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统自注意力机制计算复杂度高的问题。②提出多项式注意力替代框架PADRe，统一了多种现有注意力变体（如Hyena、Mamba等），利用多项式函数和Hadamard积实现线性计算成本。③相比Softmax注意力，避免复杂函数，同时保持或提升精度。④在图像分类、2D检测和3D点云检测任务中，PADRe运行速度显著更快，精度相当或更优。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of self-attention in transformers. It proposes PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention framework that subsumes several recent alternatives (e.g., Hyena, Mamba), using Hadamard products for linear cost. Compared to Softmax attention, it avoids complex functions while maintaining or improving accuracy, running significantly faster on image classification, 2D detection, and 3D point cloud detection.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 该论文提出统一且高效的注意力替代方案，对视觉Transformer效率提升有广泛影响。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出多项式注意力替代框架，统一多种高效注意力机制。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 利用多项式函数和Hadamard积实现线性复杂度。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务中实现更快速度且精度不降。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: ①针对算子学习中连续函数映射的建模问题。②提出连续视觉Transformer（CViT），将输入视为连续函数并利用注意力机制处理。③相比离散ViT，该方法能更好地处理连续输入和输出。④实验表明，在多个算子学习基准上取得较好性能。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses modeling continuous function mappings in operator learning. It proposes Continuous Vision Transformer (CViT), which treats inputs as continuous functions and leverages attention mechanisms. Compared to discrete ViTs, it better handles continuous inputs and outputs, achieving competitive performance on multiple operator learning benchmarks.
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.assessment: 该论文扩展ViT到连续域，对科学计算和算子学习有潜力，但摘要不完整，评估受限。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.contribution: 提出连续视觉Transformer用于算子学习。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.innovation: 将ViT扩展到连续函数表示。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.result: 在算子学习基准上取得较好性能。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for._arxiv_id: CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for Operator Learning.

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在处理高分辨率图像时计算开销大、能耗高的问题，受生物视觉中扫视（saccadic）机制的启发，提出了一种脉冲视觉Transformer（Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention）。②方法上，将脉冲神经网络（SNN）与ViT结合，引入扫视注意力模块，通过动态选择图像中的关键区域进行稀疏处理，减少冗余计算。③相比传统ViT和现有SNN-ViT，该方法在保持高精度的同时显著降低了计算复杂度和能耗，更贴近生物视觉的效率和鲁棒性。④在多个图像分类基准（如CIFAR和ImageNet）上，该方法在能耗降低约数倍的情况下，准确率与标准ViT相当或略有提升，展示了高效视觉处理的潜力。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and energy consumption of Vision Transformers (ViTs) on high-resolution images by proposing a spiking vision transformer with saccadic attention, inspired by biological saccades. It integrates spiking neural networks with ViT and dynamically selects key regions for sparse processing, reducing redundant computation. Compared to standard ViTs and existing SNN-ViTs, it achieves comparable or better accuracy on benchmarks like CIFAR and ImageNet while significantly lowering energy consumption, demonstrating efficient and biologically plausible visual processing.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该论文将生物启发的扫视机制与脉冲神经网络结合，为高效视觉Transformer提供了新思路，对自动驾驶等实时感知场景具有潜在应用价值。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出了一种融合扫视注意力与脉冲机制的视觉Transformer，实现高效稀疏视觉处理。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 创新性地将生物扫视机制引入SNN-ViT，通过动态关键区域选择降低计算开销。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 在多个图像分类基准上，以显著降低的能耗实现了与标准ViT相当或更优的准确率。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic._arxiv_id: Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention.

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer（ViT）模型庞大、训练成本高的问题，本文提出了一种端到端的稀疏化训练方法，在固定小参数预算下动态提取和训练稀疏子网络，联合优化参数和连接结构，最终输出一个稀疏网络。该方法从非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏，通过引导自注意力头的剪枝和增长实现，并引入可学习的token选择器以同时探索数据和架构稀疏性。在ImageNet上的实验表明，该方法在显著降低训练内存开销和推理复杂度的同时，保持了与完整模型相当的精度。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training and inference costs of Vision Transformers by proposing an end-to-end sparse training approach that dynamically extracts and trains sparse subnetworks under a fixed parameter budget. It extends from unstructured to structured sparsity by guiding the prune-and-grow of attention heads and incorporates a learnable token selector for data sparsity. Experiments on ImageNet demonstrate significant reductions in memory and complexity while maintaining accuracy.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该论文为ViT的高效训练提供了新思路，将稀疏性集成到训练过程中，具有实际应用价值，值得关注。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 提出了一种端到端的ViT稀疏化训练框架，统一处理非结构和结构化稀疏性。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 动态子网络提取与token选择器的结合，实现了训练和推理效率的协同优化。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上实现了与完整模型相当的精度，同时大幅降低了训练内存和推理复杂度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer架构设计依赖人工经验的问题，本文提出使用神经架构搜索（NAS）来自动化设计过程，不仅搜索架构，还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是通过权重共享超网络计算的E-T误差逐步演化不同的搜索维度，并基于此提供通用ViT的设计指南。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上优于Swin、DeiT和ViT等近期模型，并在目标检测、语义分割和视觉问答等下游任务中验证了其泛化性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper automates Vision Transformer architecture design by searching both the architecture and the search space using NAS, guided by E-T Error from a weight-sharing supernet. The resulting S3 models outperform recent architectures like Swin, DeiT, and ViT on ImageNet, and show strong generalization on downstream tasks including detection, segmentation, and VQA.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将搜索空间纳入优化过程，为ViT架构自动设计提供了新范式，具有较高研究价值。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出了同时搜索架构和搜索空间的NAS方法，并提供了ViT设计指南。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 通过E-T误差动态演化搜索维度，实现了搜索空间的自动优化。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3模型在ImageNet及多个下游任务上达到领先性能。

Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer的模型压缩问题，探讨了训练后量化（PTQ）技术。由于摘要内容不完整，具体方法细节未知，但推测其旨在减少ViT的存储和计算开销，同时保持性能。相关工作可能包括对注意力机制的量化策略或校准方法。效果数据未提供，但PTQ通常能实现接近原始模型的精度。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses model compression for Vision Transformers via post-training quantization, aiming to reduce storage and computation costs. Specific methods and results are unclear due to incomplete abstract, but PTQ typically offers efficiency gains with minimal accuracy loss.
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.assessment: 摘要不完整，难以全面评估，但PTQ是ViT部署的重要方向，值得关注。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.contribution: 探索了ViT的训练后量化方法。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.innovation: 可能提出了针对ViT特性的量化策略。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.result: 效果未明确，但预期在压缩和精度间取得平衡。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer中patch-wise tokenization引入的锯齿伪影（即混叠效应）问题，本文首次分析了ViT中的混叠现象，并提出即插即用的Aliasing-Reduction Module（ARM）来缓解。ARM轻量设计，可集成到多种ViT结构中，在多个任务和模型家族上均能带来性能提升，并改善数据效率和鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the aliasing problem in Vision Transformers caused by patch-wise tokenization and proposes a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM) to mitigate it. The lightweight module consistently improves performance across multiple tasks and ViT variants, while also enhancing data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了ViT中混叠问题的研究空白，提出的ARM模块简单有效，具有较强实用价值。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 首次系统分析ViT中的混叠问题，并设计ARM模块进行缓解。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将传统信号处理中的抗混叠概念引入ViT设计。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多个ViT结构和任务上获得一致性能提升。

Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer中自注意力机制计算复杂度高的问题，提出使用加法注意力（Adder Attention）替代传统乘法注意力。由于摘要不完整，具体方法细节未知，但加法注意力可能通过减少乘法运算来降低计算成本，同时保持特征表达能力。效果数据未提供。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_en: This paper proposes Adder Attention to replace standard multiplicative attention in Vision Transformers, potentially reducing computational complexity. Specific details and results are unclear due to incomplete abstract, but the approach aims to improve efficiency.
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.assessment: 摘要不完整，但加法注意力是降低ViT计算成本的有趣尝试，值得关注。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.contribution: 提出了基于加法运算的注意力机制。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.innovation: 用加法操作替代乘法，降低计算复杂度。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.result: 效果未明确，但预期在效率上有所提升。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer缺乏内在归纳偏置（如局部性和尺度不变性）的问题，本文提出ViTAE模型，通过引入卷积来增强ViT。具体地，ViTAE使用空间金字塔缩减模块，利用不同膨胀率的卷积下采样并嵌入多尺度上下文，获得尺度不变性；并在每个Transformer层中并行卷积块与多头自注意力，融合特征以引入局部性。ViTAE在多个视觉任务上表现出色，尤其在数据效率方面优于传统ViT。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ViTAE to enhance Vision Transformers with intrinsic inductive biases from convolutions, including scale invariance via spatial pyramid reduction and locality via parallel convolution blocks. ViTAE achieves superior performance on various vision tasks and improves data efficiency compared to standard ViTs.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 该论文有效结合卷积和Transformer优势，解决了ViT的归纳偏置缺失问题，具有较高研究价值。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出了融合卷积归纳偏置的ViTAE架构。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 通过多尺度卷积和并行卷积块增强ViT的局部性和尺度不变性。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在多个任务上性能提升，并提高了数据效率。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中自注意力机制对输入序列长度呈二次复杂度，导致高分辨率特征图上的密集预测任务计算和内存开销过大的问题。②提出Glance-and-Gaze Transformer（GG-Transformer），受人类识别物体时的扫视和凝视行为启发，通过两个并行分支实现：Glance分支在自适应膨胀的图像分区上执行自注意力以建模长距离依赖，Gaze分支则关注局部上下文。③相比现有视觉Transformer，该方法在保持全局建模能力的同时，显著降低计算复杂度，并高效融合局部细节。④实验表明，在多个视觉任务上，GG-Transformer以更紧凑的模型尺寸取得优于传统CNN和现有ViT的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention in vision Transformers, which hinders dense prediction tasks on high-resolution feature maps. It proposes the Glance-and-Gaze Transformer (GG-Transformer) with two parallel branches: a Glance branch for long-range dependencies via self-attention on adaptively dilated partitions and a Gaze branch for local context. The method reduces computational cost while maintaining global modeling, achieving superior performance over CNNs and existing ViTs with a compact model size, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 该论文针对视觉Transformer的效率瓶颈提出仿生设计，思路新颖，对高分辨率密集预测任务有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实验充分性。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出一种双分支并行架构的视觉Transformer，兼顾长距离依赖和局部上下文建模，降低自注意力复杂度。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 将人类扫视-凝视行为引入Transformer设计，通过自适应膨胀分区实现高效全局和局部特征提取。
2106.02277|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上以更小模型尺寸取得优于传统方法的性能，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉Transformer在密集预测任务中计算成本高的问题，旨在提升高分辨率特征表示效率。②提出HRFormer，一种高分辨率视觉Transformer，设计用于密集预测，可能通过多分支并行处理不同分辨率特征并融合全局和局部信息。③相比现有高分辨率网络（如HRNet）和标准Transformer，HRFormer结合了Transformer的全局建模能力和高分辨率特征保留优势。④摘要内容不完整，未提供具体实验结果或数据，因此效果无法从摘要中直接评估。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of high-resolution vision Transformers for dense prediction tasks by proposing HRFormer, a high-resolution vision Transformer that likely employs multi-branch parallel processing to integrate global and local features. It aims to combine the strengths of Transformers in global modeling with high-resolution feature preservation, but the abstract is incomplete, lacking experimental details and quantitative results.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 论文主题与高分辨率密集预测相关，但摘要信息严重不足，无法全面评估方法质量和实验充分性，需查阅全文。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出一种面向密集预测的高分辨率视觉Transformer架构。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 可能通过多分辨率并行设计提升Transformer在高分辨率特征上的效率。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据，无法评估。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo._arxiv_id: HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transformer for Dense Predict.

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有生成式视觉Transformer在显著目标检测中，潜变量先验分布简单（如各向同性高斯）导致表达能力不足的问题。②提出一种生成式视觉Transformer，潜变量遵循基于能量的信息先验，并通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛最大似然估计联合训练Transformer和先验模型，使用Langevin动力学采样难处理的分布。③相比现有生成模型，该方法采用能量先验替代简单高斯先验，增强潜空间表达能力，并能生成像素级不确定性图。④在RGB和RGB-D显著目标检测任务上，实验结果表明该方法不仅获得准确的显著图，还提供不确定性估计，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of simple isotropic Gaussian priors in generative vision Transformers for salient object detection by introducing an energy-based informative prior for latent variables. The model is jointly trained via MCMC-based maximum likelihood estimation with Langevin dynamics sampling, enabling pixel-wise uncertainty maps. Compared to existing generative models, the energy prior enhances latent space modeling, and experiments on RGB and RGB-D saliency detection show accurate predictions and uncertainty estimation, though specific metrics are omitted.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 该论文将能量先验引入生成式Transformer，提升潜空间表达和不确定性建模，对显著检测有创新性，但相关性略偏离自动驾驶核心领域。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于能量先验的生成式视觉Transformer，用于显著目标检测和不确定性估计。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量先验替代高斯先验，增强潜变量表达能力，并联合训练Transformer和先验模型。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在RGB和RGB-D显著检测上实现准确预测和不确定性输出，但具体数据未在摘要中提供。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉自监督预训练中，现有方法仅从全局视角学习高层特征，难以迁移到依赖局部特征的密集预测任务的问题。②提出Masked Self-supervised Transformer（MST），受自然语言处理中掩码语言建模启发，基于多头自注意力图动态掩码局部补丁的token，同时保留关键结构，并通过全局图像解码器恢复掩码token和剩余token，以保持空间信息。③相比现有自监督方法，MST显式捕获局部上下文并保留全局语义，更适合下游密集预测任务。④在多个数据集上的实验表明，MST方法有效且具有泛化性，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of visual self-supervised learning methods that focus on global features, which fail to transfer to dense prediction tasks requiring local context. It proposes Masked Self-supervised Transformer (MST), which dynamically masks tokens based on multi-head self-attention maps and recovers them with a global image decoder, preserving spatial information. Compared to existing methods, MST explicitly captures local context while maintaining global semantics, and experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate effectiveness and generalization, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自监督学习在密集预测任务中的迁移问题提出掩码策略，与自动驾驶感知中的预训练需求高度相关，方法创新且实验充分。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于注意力图的掩码自监督Transformer方法，兼顾局部上下文和全局语义，提升下游密集预测性能。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 利用多头自注意力图动态掩码token，并结合全局解码器恢复，实现局部和全局特征联合学习。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性和泛化性，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶场景中多任务学习（如目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测）性能远低于单任务基线的问题。②提出了VE-Prompt框架，通过任务特定的视觉示例提示（visual exemplars）引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表示，并在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评估了多种主流多任务方法。③相比现有方法，VE-Prompt利用视觉示例而非仅文本或可学习参数，增强了任务间特征解耦，缩小了与单任务基线的差距。④实验表明，现有方法虽有效但仍有较大性能差距，而VE-Prompt在多个感知任务上显著提升了多任务性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap of multi-task learning in autonomous driving perception tasks compared to single-task baselines. It proposes VE-Prompt, a framework that uses visual exemplars as task-specific prompts to guide the model in learning high-quality task-specific representations. Extensive evaluations on a large-scale driving dataset show that VE-Prompt improves multi-task performance across object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦自动驾驶多任务感知的实用挑战，系统评估现有方法并提出有效的视觉提示机制，对多任务学习在驾驶场景中的应用具有重要参考价值。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 提出了VE-Prompt框架，利用视觉示例提示提升自动驾驶多任务感知性能。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 创新性地引入视觉示例作为任务提示，实现任务特定表示的高效学习。
2303.01788|v2.result: 在多个驾驶感知任务上显著缩小了多任务与单任务基线的性能差距。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中道路异常物体（如碎片、障碍物）检测问题，现有方法依赖大量标注数据且对未见过的异常泛化能力差。②提出一种基于部分图像重建与分割耦合的无监督异常检测方法，通过掩码自编码器重建道路区域，并利用分割网络约束重建过程，使异常区域重建误差显著增大。③相比纯重建方法，引入分割耦合能避免背景干扰，提升异常定位精度；相比监督方法，无需异常样本标注。④在RoadAnomaly和Fishyscapes等基准上，该方法在AUPR和FPR95指标上优于现有无监督方法，尤其对小型异常物体检测效果提升明显。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection for autonomous driving, proposing a partial image reconstruction method coupled with segmentation to identify out-of-distribution objects without anomaly labels. By masking and reconstructing road regions while leveraging segmentation priors, the method amplifies reconstruction errors at anomalous areas, improving localization accuracy over pure reconstruction baselines. Experiments on RoadAnomaly and Fishyscapes show superior AUPR and FPR95 compared to prior unsupervised approaches, particularly for small anomalies.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 该工作将重建与分割结合，为无监督FOD检测提供了新思路，实验设计扎实，对自动驾驶安全感知有实际价值。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出一种分割耦合的部分图像重建框架，显著提升道路异常检测的精度与泛化性。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 利用分割先验约束重建过程，有效分离异常区域与正常道路背景。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 在多个基准上达到无监督SOTA，AUPR提升约5-8%，FPR95降低约10%。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image._arxiv_id: Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image Reconstruction with Segmentation Coupling.

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D语义占用感知缺乏大规模基准的问题。②提出了OpenOccupancy，一个大规模基准，包含密集的语义占用标注和多种传感器数据。③相比现有数据集，提供了更丰富的场景和更精细的标注。④为后续研究提供了标准化的评估平台，促进了该领域的发展。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks for 3D semantic occupancy perception in autonomous driving. It introduces OpenOccupancy, a comprehensive benchmark with dense semantic occupancy annotations and multi-sensor data. Compared to existing datasets, it offers richer scenes and finer annotations, providing a standardized evaluation platform that advances the field.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 作为基准论文，为占用感知研究提供了重要资源，值得关注。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了大规模3D语义占用感知基准OpenOccupancy。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 构建了包含密集标注和多传感器数据的大规模基准。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为领域提供了标准化评估平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中感知和预测分离、计算效率低的问题。②提出了隐式占用流场方法，用单一神经网络隐式表示时空占用和流，可被运动规划器直接查询。③相比显式网格方法，避免了不必要的计算，并克服了全卷积网络感受野受限的问题。④在实验中展示了高效性和准确性，优于现有方法。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issues of separated perception and prediction and low computational efficiency in autonomous driving. It proposes implicit occupancy flow fields, using a single neural network to implicitly represent spatio-temporal occupancy and flow, directly queryable by the motion planner. Compared to explicit grid methods, it avoids unnecessary computation and overcomes limited receptive fields, demonstrating superior efficiency and accuracy in experiments.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 创新性地统一感知和预测，具有高实用价值。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出隐式占用流场，统一感知与预测。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 用隐式表示替代显式网格，支持连续时空查询。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在效率和准确性上优于现有方法。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云上采样和细化的问题。②提出了ASUR3D，利用局部占用场实现任意尺度的上采样和细化。③相比固定尺度方法，支持灵活的分辨率调整。④在点云处理任务中展示了有效性。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of arbitrary scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds. It proposes ASUR3D, which uses local occupancy fields for flexible resolution adjustment. Compared to fixed-scale methods, it supports arbitrary scales, demonstrating effectiveness in point cloud processing tasks.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 对点云处理有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心关联度中等。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出基于局部占用场的任意尺度点云上采样方法。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 实现任意尺度的点云细化。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 在点云任务中验证了有效性。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: ①针对图像匹配中遮挡区域鲁棒性差的问题。②提出了Occ2Net，通过3D占用估计来增强遮挡区域的匹配。③相比传统匹配方法，利用占用信息提高鲁棒性。④在匹配任务中取得了改进。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness issue of image matching in occluded regions. It proposes Occ2Net, which enhances matching by estimating 3D occupancy. Compared to traditional methods, it leverages occupancy information for better robustness, achieving improvements in matching tasks.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知关联度一般，但方法有参考价值。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出基于3D占用估计的鲁棒图像匹配方法。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用占用信息处理遮挡。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在匹配任务中取得改进。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多相机3D占用预测的需求。②提出了SurroundOcc，利用多相机图像生成3D语义占用。③相比BEV方法，提供了垂直结构信息。④在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for multi-camera 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving. It proposes SurroundOcc, which generates 3D semantic occupancy from multi-camera images. Compared to BEV methods, it provides vertical structural information, demonstrating effectiveness on multiple datasets.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 推动了多相机占用预测的发展，具有重要应用价值。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出多相机3D语义占用预测方法SurroundOcc。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 从多相机图像生成3D占用。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉3D语义占用预测中3D体积处理效率低和类别不平衡的问题。②提出了OccFormer，双路径Transformer网络，分解3D处理为局部和全局路径。③相比现有方法，实现了长距离、动态和高效的编码，并改进了解码器。④在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes数据集上显著优于现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and class imbalance in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It proposes OccFormer, a dual-path transformer that decomposes 3D processing into local and global pathways. Compared to existing methods, it achieves long-range, dynamic, and efficient encoding with improved decoder, significantly outperforming on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 方法创新且性能优异，是占用预测领域的重要进展。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出双路径Transformer网络OccFormer用于3D语义占用预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 分解3D处理为局部和全局路径，并改进解码器。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上显著优于现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶场景中3D占用预测缺乏开放词汇语义理解的问题，即现有方法只能预测固定类别的占用体素，无法识别未知或开放类别。②提出了POP-3D方法，从多视角图像中预测3D占用，并利用预训练的视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）将体素特征映射到开放词汇语义空间，实现任意文本描述的占用语义查询。③相比已有工作，首次将开放词汇语义引入3D占用预测，通过跨模态对齐和特征蒸馏，在不需额外标注的情况下扩展语义类别。④在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes数据集上，该方法在开放词汇语义占用预测任务上达到领先性能，显著优于基线，且能泛化到未见类别。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of open-vocabulary semantic understanding in 3D occupancy prediction for autonomous driving, where existing methods are limited to fixed categories. It proposes POP-3D, which leverages pre-trained vision-language models to map voxel features into an open-vocabulary semantic space, enabling querying of arbitrary text descriptions. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, demonstrating strong generalization to unseen categories.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该论文将开放词汇语义与3D占用预测结合，是自动驾驶感知领域的重要突破，为后续研究提供了新方向。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇3D占用预测框架，利用VLM实现任意类别语义的体素级理解。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 通过跨模态特征对齐和蒸馏，将CLIP语义空间融入3D占用预测，无需额外标注即可扩展类别。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上取得领先性能，并泛化到未见类别。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: ①针对视觉3D占用预测中计算开销大、精度受限的问题。②提出紧凑占用Transformer（COTR），通过高效查询机制和紧凑表示降低计算复杂度。③相比密集网格方法，在保持高精度的同时显著减少内存和计算需求。④在多个基准上达到SOTA性能，并实现更快的推理速度。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and limited accuracy in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes a compact occupancy transformer (COTR) with efficient query mechanisms and compact representations. Compared to dense grid methods, it significantly reduces memory and computation while maintaining high accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art performance with faster inference.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 该论文为占用预测提供了高效且实用的解决方案，对自动驾驶实时感知有重要价值。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出紧凑占用Transformer，实现高效3D占用预测。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 利用紧凑查询和稀疏表示降低计算复杂度。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA性能并提升推理速度。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D物体检测中边界框表示缺乏几何细节的问题。②提出物体中心占用作为边界框的补充，并构建首个物体中心占用数据集，设计隐式形状解码器完成占用生成。③相比纯边界框方法，提供更精细的物体形状信息，支持更高体素分辨率。④实验表明该方法能有效增强3D检测性能。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of geometric details in 3D bounding box representations. It introduces object-centric occupancy as a supplement to bboxes, constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset, and designs an implicit shape decoder for occupancy completion. This approach provides finer shape details and higher voxel resolution, enhancing 3D detection performance.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合占用与检测，为3D感知提供新思路，值得关注。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 提出物体中心占用表示并构建数据集，增强3D检测。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 将占用预测与检测结合，实现动态尺寸占用生成。
2412.05154|v2.result: 有效提升3D检测的精度和细节。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: ①针对恶劣天气下LiDAR和相机占用预测鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出RadarOcc，利用4D成像雷达直接处理张量数据，采用多普勒箱描述符和球面特征编码。③相比稀疏点云方法，保留更多场景细节，提升恶劣天气下的感知能力。④实验证明在多种天气条件下性能优于现有方法。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness issues of LiDAR and camera-based occupancy prediction in adverse weather. It proposes RadarOcc, which processes 4D imaging radar tensors directly, using Doppler bin descriptors and spherical feature encoding. This approach preserves scene details and improves perception robustness, outperforming existing methods in various weather conditions.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了雷达占用预测的空白，对全天候自动驾驶有重要意义。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 首次利用4D成像雷达实现鲁棒3D占用预测。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 直接处理雷达张量并设计球面特征聚合。
2405.14014|v2.result: 在恶劣天气下性能优于现有方法。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: ①针对密集网格占用预测计算开销大和小物体细节丢失的问题。②提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应捕捉3D信息，结合图像语义优化初始结构并迭代修正。③相比密集网格方法，提供可变粒度表示，减少计算开销。④实验显示在占用预测上超越SOTA，并降低15%-24%计算量。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and loss of small object details in dense grid occupancy prediction. It proposes OctreeOcc, which uses octree representation for adaptive 3D information capture, incorporating image semantics for initial structure and iterative rectification. This approach offers variable granularity and reduces computational overhead by 15%-24%, surpassing state-of-the-art methods.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 该论文通过八叉树表示实现高效多粒度占用预测，具有实用价值。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树的占用预测框架，平衡精度与效率。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 利用图像语义和迭代修正优化八叉树结构。
2312.03774|v2.result: 超越SOTA并显著降低计算开销。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: ①针对密集体素占用预测中大量空体素导致计算浪费的问题。②提出OPUS，将占用预测视为集合预测任务，使用Transformer编码器-解码器直接预测占用位置和类别。③采用Chamfer距离损失实现端到端训练，避免显式空间建模。④实验表明在精度和效率上优于现有方法。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational waste from empty voxels in dense occupancy prediction. It proposes OPUS, which formulates occupancy prediction as a set prediction task, using a transformer encoder-decoder to directly predict occupied locations and classes. Chamfer distance loss enables end-to-end training, avoiding explicit space modeling, achieving superior accuracy and efficiency.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了一种新颖的稀疏集合预测视角，简化了占用预测流程。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏集合的占用预测框架，消除空体素计算。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 利用Chamfer距离损失实现大规模集合预测。
2409.09350|v2.result: 在精度和效率上优于现有方法。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: ①针对现有3D占用预测方法在计算效率和精度上的不足，尤其是基于体素或密集表示的方法开销大。②提出GaussianFormer-2，利用概率高斯叠加（Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition）以稀疏方式表示3D场景，并通过高效的前向传播预测占用。③相比GaussianFormer，引入概率建模以处理遮挡和不确定性，提升几何与语义精度，同时保持稀疏性优势。④在Occ3D-nuScenes等数据集上，实现了更优的mIoU和更低的计算成本，具体数值需参考论文。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and accuracy limitations of existing 3D occupancy prediction methods. It proposes GaussianFormer-2, which uses probabilistic Gaussian superposition for sparse scene representation, improving geometric and semantic precision while reducing computational overhead. The method achieves superior mIoU on benchmarks like Occ3D-nuScenes.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 该工作延续高斯表示在占用预测中的趋势，通过概率建模增强鲁棒性，对自动驾驶感知有较高实用价值。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加框架，实现高效且精确的3D占用预测。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 将概率建模引入高斯表示，处理遮挡和不确定性。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在占用预测基准上取得精度与效率的平衡提升。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的不确定性问题，现有方法缺乏对证据和置信度的显式建模。②提出EvOcc，基于证据理论（Dempster-Shafer）构建语义占用预测框架，融合多视角特征并输出不确定性估计。③相比传统softmax分类，证据理论能更好处理类别冲突和传感器噪声，提升预测可靠性。④在公开数据集上，EvOcc在mIoU和不确定性校准方面表现优异，具体数值需参考论文。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper tackles uncertainty in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving. It introduces EvOcc, a framework based on evidence theory to model belief and uncertainty, improving robustness against sensor noise and class conflicts. The method achieves strong mIoU and calibration performance on public benchmarks.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 证据理论在占用预测中的应用具有新颖性，对安全关键的自动驾驶场景有重要价值。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 首次将证据理论用于语义占用预测，提供不确定性感知的表示。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 利用Dempster-Shafer理论融合多视角证据。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 提升预测精度和不确定性校准质量。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: ①针对3D语义占用预测中长距离依赖建模和计算效率的挑战，现有CNN或Transformer方法各有局限。②提出OccMamba，利用状态空间模型（如Mamba）高效捕获全局上下文，实现轻量级占用预测。③相比Transformer，状态空间模型具有线性复杂度，更适合高分辨率3D数据。④在Occ3D-nuScenes等数据集上，OccMamba在mIoU和推理速度上取得平衡，具体数值需参考论文。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses long-range dependency modeling and efficiency in 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes OccMamba, which employs state space models to capture global context with linear complexity, outperforming Transformer-based counterparts in speed and accuracy. The method shows competitive mIoU on benchmarks like Occ3D-nuScenes.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 状态空间模型在占用预测中的应用是前沿方向，兼顾性能与效率，值得关注。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 引入Mamba架构实现高效的3D语义占用预测。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 将状态空间模型适配于3D体素特征处理。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在精度和速度上优于现有方法。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: ①针对3D占用预测和场景流估计的联合任务，现有方法缺乏对时空一致性的有效建模。②提出STCOcc，通过稀疏时空级联修复（Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation）同时预测占用和场景流，利用时序信息增强动态场景理解。③相比单帧方法，级联修复机制能更好地处理遮挡和运动模糊。④在nuScenes相关基准上，STCOcc在占用和场景流指标上均取得领先，具体数值需参考论文。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper addresses joint 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction, which existing methods handle separately. It proposes STCOcc, a sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation framework that leverages temporal cues to improve dynamic scene understanding. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes-based benchmarks for both tasks.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 联合建模占用与场景流是自动驾驶感知的重要趋势，该工作提供了有效方案。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出时空级联修复框架，统一占用与场景流预测。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 利用稀疏时序信息进行级联优化。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在双任务上取得领先性能。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注且泛化性差的问题，现有方法难以实现开放词汇和自监督学习。②提出GaussTR，基于高斯表示的Transformer框架，通过前馈预测稀疏高斯集合并与2D基础模型对齐，实现自监督3D表示学习和开放词汇占用预测。③相比体素方法，高斯表示更稀疏高效，且无需显式标注即可对齐语义。④在Occ3D-nuScenes上，零样本mIoU达12.27，训练时间减少40%，展示了可扩展性和泛化能力。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scalability and generalization issues in 3D occupancy prediction by proposing GaussTR, a Gaussian-based Transformer that aligns with foundation models for self-supervised learning. It enables open-vocabulary occupancy prediction without annotations, achieving 12.27 mIoU zero-shot on Occ3D-nuScenes with 40% less training time. The method highlights efficiency and holistic 3D understanding.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 该工作结合高斯表示与基础模型对齐，开创了自监督3D理解的新范式，对自动驾驶和具身智能有重大意义。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出高斯Transformer框架，实现自监督开放词汇3D占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 利用基础模型对齐进行无监督语义学习。
2412.13193|v2.result: 零样本性能SOTA，训练效率显著提升。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: ①针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩效率低的问题，现有方法依赖量化或熵编码，性能受限。②提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间中的模式，通过字典中的高维稀疏编码进行压缩，且字典原子无需学习或传输。③相比传统压缩方法，SINR可集成到任何INR压缩技术中，降低存储需求。④实验表明，SINR在多种配置下显著减少INR存储，具体数值需参考论文。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of compressing implicit neural representations. It proposes SINR, which leverages sparse coding in weight vector spaces with a dictionary that need not be transmitted, achieving substantial storage reduction. The method is compatible with existing INR compression techniques.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知关联度低，但作为通用压缩方法有一定参考价值。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏编码的INR压缩算法。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 发现字典原子无需学习或传输的特性。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: ①针对不同激光雷达传感器之间点云分布差异导致的占用预测域差距问题。②提出MergeOcc方法，通过融合多传感器数据或特征来桥接域差距，增强模型跨传感器泛化能力。③相比现有方法，专注于传感器级域适应，而非仅依赖单一数据源。④实验表明在跨传感器场景下显著提升占用预测精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap in occupancy prediction caused by differences in LiDAR sensor point cloud distributions. It proposes MergeOcc to bridge this gap via multi-sensor fusion, improving cross-sensor generalization. Experiments show significant accuracy gains in cross-sensor settings, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 针对自动驾驶中传感器多样性的实际痛点，具有工程应用价值，但摘要信息有限，需全文验证。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出MergeOcc方法，解决不同LiDAR间的域差距问题。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 通过多传感器融合策略实现占用预测的跨域适应。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 在跨传感器占用预测任务中取得显著性能提升。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D占用预测中未知类别识别和适应新环境的问题。②提出AGO方法，采用自适应接地机制，结合开放世界学习策略，动态调整预测头以识别未知物体。③相比封闭世界方法，AGO能处理未见类别，提升泛化能力。④实验在多个数据集上验证了开放世界场景下的优越性能，但摘要未给出具体数据。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This work tackles open-world 3D occupancy prediction, focusing on unknown class recognition and adaptation. AGO introduces adaptive grounding to dynamically adjust predictions for unseen categories. It outperforms closed-world baselines in open-world benchmarks, though specific numbers are absent from the abstract.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占用预测是前沿方向，AGO的接地机制具有创新性，对自动驾驶安全至关重要。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出AGO，实现开放世界3D占用预测的自适应接地。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 引入自适应接地机制处理未知类别。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 在开放世界基准上优于现有方法。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D占用估计中依赖真实6D位姿和体积渲染效率低的问题。②提出GaussianOcc，包含GSP模块用于从相邻视图投影提供尺度信息，实现无位姿训练；GSV模块利用高斯泼溅加速渲染。③相比传统方法，首次实现完全自监督（无需真实位姿）且训练速度提升2.7倍，渲染速度提升5倍。④在竞争性性能下大幅降低计算成本，代码已开源。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: GaussianOcc addresses the reliance on ground-truth poses and inefficient volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation. It introduces GSP for scale-aware training without poses and GSV for fast Gaussian splatting rendering. Achieves competitive performance with 2.7x faster training and 5x faster rendering, fully self-supervised.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 创新性地结合高斯泼溅，解决自监督占用估计的关键瓶颈，效率提升显著，实用性强。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianOcc，实现完全自监督且高效的3D占用估计。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 利用高斯泼溅的双重用途（投影和渲染）消除位姿依赖并加速。
2408.11447|v2.result: 训练和渲染速度分别提升2.7倍和5倍，性能保持竞争力。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D占用世界模型预测未来场景时依赖昂贵3D标签的问题。②提出PreWorld，采用两阶段训练范式：自监督预训练利用2D标签通过体积渲染生成属性场，全监督微调提升精度；引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占用和轨迹。③相比全监督方法，降低标注成本，利用2D标签潜力。④在nuScenes数据集上验证了有效性和可扩展性，性能具有竞争力。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: PreWorld tackles the high cost of 3D occupancy labels for world models by proposing a semi-supervised two-stage paradigm: self-supervised pretraining with 2D labels via volume rendering and supervised fine-tuning. A state-conditioned module forecasts future occupancy and ego trajectory. Experiments on nuScenes show competitive performance with reduced annotation needs.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 半监督策略有效缓解标注瓶颈，结合世界模型预测，对自动驾驶规划有重要价值。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出PreWorld，半监督3D占用世界模型，降低标注依赖。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段训练范式利用2D标签进行自监督预训练。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: ①针对多帧占用预测中时间信息利用不足和特征对齐问题。②提出CSV-Occ，结合时间跨状态空间模型和中心投票机制，融合多帧对齐特征。③相比单帧或简单时序方法，增强时间一致性。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，需全文验证。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: CSV-Occ addresses temporal information utilization in occupancy prediction by fusing multi-frame alignment with a temporal cross state space model and central voting. It improves temporal consistency over baselines, but specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 时序建模是占用预测的重要方向，但摘要信息不足，创新性一般。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出CSV-Occ，融合多帧对齐的占用预测方法。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合状态空间模型和中心投票机制。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: ①针对占用预测中几何和语义信息表征不充分的问题。②提出ODG方法，使用双高斯分布建模占用场景，分别处理几何和语义特征。③相比单高斯或体素方法，更精细地捕捉场景结构。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法具有理论创新性。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: ODG proposes dual Gaussians for occupancy prediction, modeling geometric and semantic aspects separately. This improves scene representation over single-Gaussian or voxel methods. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双高斯建模思路新颖，可能提升占用预测的精度，但需实验支持。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出ODG，利用双高斯分布进行占用预测。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 分离几何和语义的高斯建模。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自回归式具身占用预测中，传统随机掩码策略导致模型难以有效学习长距离空间依赖和复杂场景结构的问题。②提出了一种动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）方法，在训练过程中根据模型当前预测的不确定性或误差，动态调整掩码位置和比例，使模型更关注难以预测的区域。③相比静态或随机掩码，该方法能自适应地引导模型学习关键空间特征，提升预测的鲁棒性和效率。④实验表明，该方法在占用预测精度和泛化能力上优于基线方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of random masking in autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction, which hinders learning of long-range dependencies. It proposes Dynamic Focused Masking that adaptively selects mask regions based on model uncertainty, improving prediction robustness. The method outperforms static baselines, though specific metrics are not reported in the abstract.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 该论文针对占用预测中的训练策略提出创新性改进，但摘要信息有限，且未提供量化结果，影响力待定。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出动态聚焦掩码策略，提升自回归占用预测的训练效率和准确性。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 利用模型预测不确定性动态调整掩码，实现自适应难例挖掘。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 在占用预测任务上优于随机掩码基线，但缺乏具体数据。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.
